beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Marylebone bookshop, Sylvie Bancroft is browsing novels with maps inside. As she closes her own paper notebook beside a book table, a small inked scrap slips out and lands beside your shoe.
beats.chinese: 在马里波恩书店，Sylvie Bancroft 正翻看带有地图的小说。她站在书桌旁，合上随身的纸质笔记本，一张画着墨线的小纸片滑出来，落在你鞋边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my island by your shoe. May I reach down?
beats.chinese: 你鞋边那座岛是我的。我可以弯腰捡一下吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sylvie points to the scrap. A blue coastline runs around its uneven edges.
beats.chinese: Sylvie 指了指纸片。一圈蓝色海岸线沿着参差的纸边延伸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It slipped out of my notebook. The rest of the country is behaving.
beats.chinese: 它从我的笔记本里滑出来了。这个国家其余的地方倒还安分。

choices.english: Of course. Is it a real place?
choices.chinese: 当然可以。这是真实的地方吗？

choices.english: Of course. I thought it was a bookmark.
choices.chinese: 当然可以。我还以为是书签呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sylvie picks up the scrap and holds it beside the open notebook. The same blue coast continues across a larger sheet.
beats.chinese: Sylvie 捡起纸片，把它放在打开的笔记本旁。同样的蓝色海岸线延续到一张更大的纸上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Entirely invented. I used to draw the atlas on a tablet. Now I use paper, which sheds rather more territory.
beats.chinese: 完全是虚构的。我以前在平板上画这套地图集。现在改用纸，领土掉得也多了些。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the little island upright and holds it out without moving it into your space.
beats.chinese: 她把小岛转正，向你递出一点，手仍停在自己身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can have this piece, if you'd like.
beats.chinese: 你喜欢的话，可以拿走这一小片。

choices.english: Yes, thank you. I'll take the little island.
choices.chinese: 好，谢谢。那我收下这座小岛。

choices.english: No, thank you. I'd rather just look at the map.
choices.chinese: 不用了，谢谢。我只想看看地图。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sylvie retrieves the scrap and slips it securely between two notebook pages.
beats.chinese: Sylvie 捡回纸片，把它稳稳夹进笔记本的两页之间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It could be. Nearly forty years cutting glove samples, and I still produce things that won't quite fit.
beats.chinese: 也可以当书签。做了将近四十年的手套样版，我还是会弄出尺寸不太合适的东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes her notebook and puts it in her cloth bag, leaving the books on the table untouched.
beats.chinese: 她合上笔记本，放进布袋，没有碰桌上的书。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm looking for a novel with a map. I like to know which direction everyone is getting lost in.
beats.chinese: 我在找带地图的小说。我喜欢知道大家都往哪个方向迷了路。

choices.english: I'll leave you to look. Enjoy your browsing.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你找书了。慢慢看。

choices.english: Do you read the map before the story?
choices.chinese: 你会先看地图，再看故事吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sylvie places the scrap in your hand, then returns the larger map to her notebook.
beats.chinese: Sylvie 把小纸片放到你手里，随后把大地图收回笔记本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you are. The ink's dry.
beats.chinese: 给你。墨已经干了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the notebook into her bag and turns back to a novel on the table.
beats.chinese: 她把笔记本放进包里，转身重新看向桌上的一本小说。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you for stopping me stepping on it. Enjoy the rest of your visit.
beats.chinese: 谢谢，幸好你让我有机会捡起来，没一脚踩上去。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sylvie's hand lowers. For a moment she looks at the offered scrap rather than at you.
beats.chinese: Sylvie 放低了手。有一会儿，她只看着刚才递出的纸片，没有看你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh. I could give you a larger piece.
beats.chinese: 哦。我也可以给你大一点的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her fingers settle on the larger sheet, then stop. She holds the notebook open toward you for a brief look before closing it and putting both pieces away.
beats.chinese: 她的手指搭上大纸张，又停住了。她把打开的笔记本朝向你，让你看了一会儿，随后合上本子，把两张纸都收好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just looking. Yes. I'll get back to these books now. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 只是看看。对。那我接着看这些书了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sylvie settles the bag strap on her shoulder and turns fully toward the book table.
beats.chinese: Sylvie 整理好肩上的包带，转身面向书桌。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I've only examined three, despite appearances.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。别看我这副架势，其实才翻了三本。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts a novel and checks its opening pages, keeping herself and her bag clear of the passage.
beats.chinese: 她拿起一本小说，查看前面的几页，人和包都留在通道外侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 再见。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sylvie rests her hand on a closed novel, considering the question.
beats.chinese: Sylvie 把手搭在一本合着的小说上，想了想你的问题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Usually. Then someone takes a boat and I spend twenty pages checking the wrong coast.
beats.chinese: 通常会。然后有人坐船出发，我就对着错误的海岸查上二十页。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens the novel at the first page of the story rather than searching through the front matter.
beats.chinese: 她翻到故事的第一页，没有继续在书前寻找地图。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll try the first paragraph of this one. I'll leave you to your browsing.
beats.chinese: 这一本，我先读读第一段。你也慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Marylebone bookshop, Sylvie stands beside a book table on the same floor as you, holding a novel. She recognises you and looks up from the page.
beats.chinese: 在马里波恩书店，Sylvie 正站在与你同层的书桌旁，手里拿着一本小说。她认出了你，从书页上抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. The map's lovely. The story hasn't made me want to read on yet.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。地图很好看。正文还没让我想往下读。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She finishes the paragraph in front of her, then closes the novel and gently returns it to its place on the table.
beats.chinese: 她读完眼前这一段，随后合上小说，轻轻放回桌上原处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A lovely coastline can't do the story's work. I'll look for another one.
beats.chinese: 海岸线漂亮，也不能替故事干活。再找一本。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the grass at Primrose Hill, Ruth Mercer is writing a postcard clipped securely to her notebook. She looks up at the distant skyline, then turns to you nearby.
beats.chinese: 樱草山的草坡上，鲁思·默瑟正在写明信片，卡片牢牢夹在笔记本上。她抬头望了望远处的天际线，又转向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Would 'open' be accurate for this view? Just that word.
beats.chinese: 这景色，用“开阔”算准确吗？只问这个词。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps her pencil above the clipped card, leaving the rest of the draft out of the discussion.
beats.chinese: 她的铅笔停在夹稳的卡片上方，没有把其余草稿拿出来讨论。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Ruth. The rest of the sentence is my problem.
beats.chinese: 我叫鲁思。句子的其余部分归我操心。

choices.english: Yes. 'Open' fits this view.
choices.chinese: 算。“开阔”适合这里的景色。

choices.english: I'd rather not choose your words for you.
choices.chinese: 我还是不替你选词了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ruth looks back down at the postcard clipped to her notebook.
beats.chinese: 鲁思低头看回夹在笔记本上的明信片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. One postcard. Six attempts at the message.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。一张明信片。正文试写了六遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks down at her pencil draft, counting on her fingertips.
beats.chinese: 她低头看着铅笔写的草稿，用指尖数着词。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came up here to see the skyline. Eight words. 'Here' can go.
beats.chinese: 我到这里来看看天际线。英文八个词。可以删掉“这里”。

choices.english: I'd keep 'here.' You're writing from here.
choices.chinese: 我会留着“这里”。你就是在这里写的嘛。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your postcard. Enjoy the view.
choices.chinese: 那就不打扰你写明信片了。好好看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ruth nods and lowers her pencil to the postcard, still clipped securely to her notebook.
beats.chinese: 鲁思点点头，把铅笔落回明信片上，卡片仍牢牢夹在笔记本上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I'll choose it myself.
beats.chinese: 好。那我自己选。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She rests her pencil against the clip, then looks past the notebook towards the skyline.
beats.chinese: 她把铅笔抵在夹子旁，随后越过笔记本，望向天际线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came up to write about the view. I've mostly looked at this sentence.
beats.chinese: 我是上来写几句风景的。结果大部分时间都在看这句话。

choices.english: What's keeping you at that sentence?
choices.chinese: 是什么让你一直改那句话？

choices.english: I'll give you some space. Turn your attention to the skyline.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰了。把目光转向天际线。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ruth considers your suggestion, her pencil held just above the card.
beats.chinese: 鲁思想了想你的建议，铅笔悬在卡片上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The picture supplies the location. I'm crossing it out.
beats.chinese: 图片已经交代地点了。我要把它划掉。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She strikes through the word, adds her name and closes the notebook with the completed postcard still clipped inside.
beats.chinese: 她划掉那个词，签上名字，合起笔记本，写好的明信片仍夹在里面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Done. Thank you. That word was taking up useful space.
beats.chinese: 好了，谢谢。那个词确实有点占地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ruth lowers the notebook with the postcard still clipped to it and gives you a small nod.
beats.chinese: 鲁思放低笔记本，明信片仍夹在上面，向你轻轻点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I'll see how it reads.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我再读读看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sits on the grass, lays the notebook across her knees and anchors the postcard with her thumb.
beats.chinese: 她在草地上坐下，把笔记本横放在膝头，用拇指压住明信片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll finish this before I find a seventh version.
beats.chinese: 得赶在想出第七稿之前写完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ruth looks at the short pencil draft, then pauses before answering.
beats.chinese: 鲁思看着那段简短的铅笔稿，停了一会儿才回答。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A seven-word limit. Mine. Nobody requested it.
beats.chinese: 七个词的限制。我定的。没人要求。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the unfinished postcard inside her notebook and tucks the pencil into her coat pocket. With both hands free, she turns towards the distant buildings.
beats.chinese: 她把没写完的明信片夹进笔记本，将铅笔放回大衣口袋。空出双手后，她转身望向远处的楼群。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That can wait. I'll have a look while I'm here. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 那个可以等等。既然来了，我先看看。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ruth notices your attention return to the skyline and lowers her voice.
beats.chinese: 鲁思注意到你重新看向天际线，放轻了声音。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Enjoy it.
beats.chinese: 好。慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves a few paces farther across the grass, clear of the path, and turns her back to the breeze to shelter the card.
beats.chinese: 她沿草地走开几步，避开路径，转身背对着风，护住卡片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This end of the conversation is going back to pencil.
beats.chinese: 我这边要换回铅笔说话了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Primrose Hill, Ruth Mercer is standing on the grass beside the path with one earbud in. She pauses her music when she recognises you.
beats.chinese: 在樱草山，Ruth Mercer戴着一只耳机站在草坡步道旁。认出你后，她暂停音乐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. A track I'm making. Six minutes, mostly the same bass phrase. I rather like it.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我自己做的曲子。六分钟，大部分都是同一句低音。我挺喜欢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the running time, moves the playhead back a few seconds and leaves the audio paused while she speaks.
beats.chinese: 她看看时长，把播放位置往回调了几秒，说话时仍停着音乐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It could be shorter. I don't want it shorter. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 还能缩短。不过我不想。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Primrose Hill, Nora Price sits on the grass beside the path. After helping with adult swimming lessons, she has come up for a quiet break. As you come within earshot, a voice starts playing from the battered tape recorder in her bag.
beats.chinese: 在樱草山，诺拉·普赖斯坐在路径旁的草地上。协助完成人游泳课后，她来这里安静地歇一会儿。你走到附近时，她包里那台旧录音机突然传出了说话声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. Wrong button. That was a recording, not me calling you.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，按错键了。那是录音，不是我在叫你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stops the tape and lifts the recorder clear of her bag.
beats.chinese: 她关掉录音，把录音机从包里拿出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Nora. Usually I can manage a stop button.
beats.chinese: 我叫诺拉。平常我还是会按停止键的。

choices.english: What were you listening to?
choices.chinese: 你刚才在听什么？

choices.english: No harm done. Taking a break?
choices.chinese: 没关系。你在休息吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nora turns the recorder over. A handwritten label covers one side of the cassette.
beats.chinese: 诺拉把录音机翻过来。磁带的一面贴着手写标签。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: People's memories. This one's a baker describing her first night shift. She said I could play this part to other people.
beats.chinese: 一些人的回忆。这段是一位面包师在讲她第一次上夜班。她同意我把这一段放给别人听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her thumb rests beside the play button without pressing it.
beats.chinese: 她的拇指停在播放键旁，没有按下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's a good twenty seconds here. You can hear her counting the trays again.
beats.chinese: 这里有二十秒挺有意思。能听见她又开始数烤盘。

choices.english: I'd like to hear those twenty seconds.
choices.chinese: 我想听听那二十秒。

choices.english: I'd rather hear how you got into collecting these.
choices.chinese: 我更想听听你怎么开始收集这些录音的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nora settles the recorder on top of her closed bag, safely away from the path.
beats.chinese: 诺拉把包合上，将录音机放在包上，离路径远远的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I help with adult beginner swimming classes. I've heard quite enough instructions for one morning.
beats.chinese: 是啊。我协助教成人游泳入门课。今天上午听的指令已经够多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks that the recorder is off, then rests both hands on her knees.
beats.chinese: 她确认录音机已经关好，随后把双手放在膝盖上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came up for ten quiet minutes. Apparently I needed instructions for the recorder too.
beats.chinese: 我上来是想安静十分钟。看来我还需要有人教我怎么用录音机。

choices.english: Would you mind some company? No instructions.
choices.chinese: 介意有人陪你坐会儿吗？保证不发指令。

choices.english: Enjoy the break. I'll keep walking.
choices.chinese: 好好休息。我继续走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nora plays the short passage at a low volume. The recorded woman counts trays, loses her place, then laughs and starts again.
beats.chinese: 诺拉调低音量，播放了那一小段。录音里的女人数着烤盘，数乱了，笑了一声，又从头开始。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She remembered every tray. Couldn't remember the manager's name.
beats.chinese: 每个烤盘她都记得。经理叫什么倒是忘了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the end of the passage, Nora presses stop and puts the recorder in her bag. She stands and brushes grass from her trousers.
beats.chinese: 片段结束，诺拉按下停止键，把录音机放回包里。她站起来，拍掉裤子上的草屑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the bit I wanted to hear again. Right then. I'll be on my way. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 我想重听的就是这一段。好了，我该走了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nora leaves the tape stopped. She looks down at its handwritten label before answering.
beats.chinese: 诺拉没有播放磁带。回答之前，她低头看了看那张手写标签。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thirty years as a postal clerk. I heard plenty of stories. Eventually I asked a few people if I could keep theirs on tape.
beats.chinese: 我做过三十年邮局柜员，听过不少故事。后来我问了几个人，能不能把他们的故事录下来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a single earpiece from her bag and plugs it into the recorder.
beats.chinese: 她从包里取出一只单耳耳机，插到录音机上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my own history for now. I'm going back to hers. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 我的故事就先讲这些。我接着听她的了。很高兴和你聊了几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nora gestures towards an empty patch of grass beside her, leaving plenty of space between it and her bag.
beats.chinese: 诺拉示意了一下身旁的一块空草地，那里与她的包之间留着宽宽的距离。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's fine. I'm leaving this switched off.
beats.chinese: 可以。这东西我就不开了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A few minutes later, Nora checks her watch. She puts the recorder away, closes her bag and gets to her feet.
beats.chinese: 几分钟后，诺拉看了看手表。她收起录音机，合上包，站起身。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My ten minutes are up. I'll leave you the view. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 我的十分钟到了。风景留给你慢慢看。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the path. Nora stays on the grass and draws her bag closer to her feet.
beats.chinese: 你沿着路径继续走。诺拉仍坐在草地上，把包拉近脚边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She notices the recorder's loose strap against the controls, tucks it inside the bag and pulls the zip shut.
beats.chinese: 她发现录音机松垂的带子抵着按键，便把带子塞进包里，拉好拉链。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. That should keep it out of the conversation.
beats.chinese: 好了。这下它应该不会插话了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Primrose Hill, Nora Price is putting a book into her bag beside the grass path. She recognises you and gives a quick wave.
beats.chinese: 在樱草山，Nora Price站在草坡步道旁，正把书放进包里。她认出你，很快挥了挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm meeting someone I used to work with at the post office. Lunch. She's promised to tell me absolutely everything.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我约了以前邮局的同事吃午饭。她保证要把所有事都讲给我听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A woman approaches along the path and calls her name. Nora smiles broadly and closes her bag.
beats.chinese: 一位女士沿步道走来，喊了她的名字。Nora笑开了，把包合上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There she is. Good, I'm starving. See you around.
beats.chinese: 她来了。太好了，我都饿了。回头见。

causality.presenceReason: 诺拉协助完成人游泳课后，先来到樱草山草坡休息，并带着平时使用的旧录音机。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Primrose Hill, Ollie Sandbrook stands on the grass beside the path, holding up his phone towards the skyline. The apprentice urban tree surveyor has come for the view on his day off.
beats.chinese: 在樱草山，Ollie Sandbrook站在路径旁的草坡上，举着手机对准远处的天际线。这位城市树木调查员学徒今天休息，特地来看看风景。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was about to take a photo. You're at the edge of it, so I'll wait. I'm Ollie.
beats.chinese: 我正准备拍照。你在画面边上，我先等等。我叫Ollie。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the phone instead of taking the picture.
beats.chinese: 他放下手机，没有按快门。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Usually it's trees on my phone. Giving the buildings a turn.
beats.chinese: 我手机里通常都是树。今天也轮到楼房出个镜。

choices.english: Go ahead. I don't mind being at the edge.
choices.chinese: 拍吧。我不介意出现在画面边上。

choices.english: I'd rather stay out of the picture, thanks.
choices.chinese: 我还是不想入镜，谢谢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Before Ollie raises the camera again, his phone sounds an alarm. He glances at the screen.
beats.chinese: Ollie还没重新举起手机，闹钟就响了。他看了一眼屏幕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my get-going alarm. I've left myself two minutes for this.
beats.chinese: 这是提醒我该走的闹钟。我给拍照留了两分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He dismisses the alarm and opens the camera again, keeping the phone pointed down.
beats.chinese: 他关掉闹钟，重新打开相机，镜头仍然朝下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I set it early. Otherwise I take twelve versions of the same picture.
beats.chinese: 我特意设早了。不然同一个画面我能拍上十二遍。

choices.english: All right. I'll leave you to get your picture.
choices.chinese: 好，那我不打扰你拍照了。

choices.english: You should check the time again, just to be sure.
choices.chinese: 你还是再看一眼时间吧，保险一点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ollie turns the phone towards his own chest. He stays on the grass, leaving the path clear.
beats.chinese: Ollie把手机转向自己胸前。他仍站在草地上，没有占着路径。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I haven't taken anything.
beats.chinese: 当然。我还一张都没拍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He locks the screen and holds the phone loosely at his side.
beats.chinese: 他锁上屏幕，随意地把手机垂在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No rush. The buildings look fairly settled.
beats.chinese: 不着急。那些楼看着也没打算挪地方。

choices.english: What do you usually take photos of?
choices.chinese: 你平时都拍些什么？

choices.english: Step away from the frame. Thanks. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 走出取景范围。谢谢，你拍吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With your permission to remain at the edge of the frame, Ollie raises the phone towards the skyline.
beats.chinese: 你已经同意出现在画面边缘，Ollie便举起手机，对准天际线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. One picture. That's the plan, anyway.
beats.chinese: 谢了。就拍一张。至少计划是这样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes one photo, briefly checks it, then pockets the phone without trying another angle.
beats.chinese: 他拍了一张，简单看了看，便把手机收进口袋，没有再找别的角度。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Managed to stop at one. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好了。真在一张停住了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ollie's thumb stops above the camera button. His jaw tightens.
beats.chinese: Ollie的拇指停在快门键上方，下颌绷紧了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've checked it. You can leave that bit to me.
beats.chinese: 我看过了。这事让我自己管就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets the phone without taking a picture and turns towards the path. After a moment, his shoulders loosen.
beats.chinese: 他没拍照就把手机收起来，转身朝向路径。片刻后，他的肩膀放松下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That came out sharp. Sorry. I'm heading off. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 刚才语气冲了，抱歉。我先走了。慢慢看风景吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ollie slips the locked phone into his pocket and turns away from his planned shot.
beats.chinese: Ollie把锁屏的手机放进口袋，转过身，不再对着原先的取景方向。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: London trees, mostly. I map the interesting ones for myself. Work's got enough forms already.
beats.chinese: 主要是伦敦的树。我会自己标下那些有意思的。工作里的表格已经够多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rubs a small patch of chain grease on his thumb and gives a short laugh.
beats.chinese: 他搓了搓拇指上的一小块链条油污，短促地笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My old bike gets photos too. Mostly to prove where a bit went before I took it off. Anyway, enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 我那辆旧自行车也常入镜。主要是拆零件前，留个证据证明它原来装在哪儿。好了，祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ollie waits while you step out of the frame, keeping his phone lowered.
beats.chinese: 你走出取景范围时，Ollie一直放低手机等着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. That gives me a clear shot.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。这样就不会拍到你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He angles the phone towards the skyline, away from you, and takes his photo. He lowers it again before giving you a small nod.
beats.chinese: 他将手机朝向天际线，避开你，拍下照片。随后他放下手机，向你轻轻点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Got it. Have a good one.
beats.chinese: 拍好了。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Primrose Hill, Ollie stands on the grass beside the path, turning over a small bicycle part he brought along to examine. He recognises you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 在樱草山，Ollie站在路径旁的草地上，将特意带来查看的自行车小零件在掌心翻过一面。他认出了你，笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I'm halfway through fixing my bike at home. Came out to clear my head.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我在家修车修到一半，出来换换脑子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He carefully wraps the part in a tissue, secures it in a zipped pocket and turns towards the skyline.
beats.chinese: 他用纸巾仔细包好零件，收进带拉链的口袋，然后转向天际线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave it for now. Get back to it when I'm home. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 这会儿先不琢磨它，回去再接着修。见到你真好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the High Line, Jonah Petrov is taking a walk after a shift building bicycle wheels. Beside the railing and late-winter grasses, Jonah holds an old magazine securely inside an open folder. A picture of a kettle is visible on the page.
beats.chinese: 高线公园里，Jonah Petrov结束了一班自行车轮组制作工作，来这里散步。在护栏与冬末的枯草带旁，Jonah把一本旧杂志稳稳夹在打开的文件夹里。书页上露出一张水壶的图片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me. This kettle looks red, doesn't it? I remembered it as orange.
beats.chinese: 打扰一下。这只壶看着是红的吧？我一直记成橙色。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah angles the magazine toward you without handing it over, staying beside the railing and leaving the walking lane clear.
beats.chinese: Jonah把杂志朝向你，没有递过来，仍站在护栏旁，留出通行的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just the kettle in the corner.
beats.chinese: 就是角落里那只水壶。

choices.english: Yes, red. Did you bring the magazine to read?
choices.chinese: 是红的。你带杂志来是想读吗？

choices.english: Looks red to me. It's windy up here.
choices.chinese: 我看是红的。上面风挺大的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah holds the open magazine flat against the folder. The magazine has several neat rectangular gaps.
beats.chinese: Jonah把打开的杂志按平在文件夹上。杂志里有几处裁得整整齐齐的长方形缺口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: For a collage at home. I remembered a picture in here halfway through my walk.
beats.chinese: 是给家里的拼贴画用的。走到一半，我想起里面有张图片。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah lifts one corner of the page, keeping the rest pinned down with a thumb.
beats.chinese: Jonah掀起纸页的一角，拇指仍然压着其余部分。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I have a whole wall of unfinished ones. Finding another picture is easier than finishing anything.
beats.chinese: 我有一整面墙都挂着没做完的。再找一张图片，比完成哪一幅都容易。

choices.english: What stood out about the picture?
choices.chinese: 这张图片有什么特别显眼的地方？

choices.english: I'll leave you to your walk.
choices.chinese: 那就不打扰你散步了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah lowers the magazine against the folder and holds the cover down with a forearm.
beats.chinese: Jonah放低杂志，让它贴着文件夹，用前臂压住封面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I only opened it to check that picture.
beats.chinese: 是啊。我打开它，只是想确认一下那张图片。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah tries to slide the magazine into the folder, but one corner catches.
beats.chinese: Jonah试着把杂志塞回文件夹，一个角却卡住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Almost.
beats.chinese: 好了。差一点。

choices.english: You could fold it in half.
choices.chinese: 可以把它对折一下。

choices.english: I'll let you get that sorted. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 你慢慢收好吧。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah angles the open magazine so the rest of the old advertisement is visible. The red kettle fills one corner.
beats.chinese: Jonah调整打开的杂志的角度，让你也能看见那则旧广告的其他部分。红水壶占据了其中一个角落。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That kettle. Most of the page is beige, and then there's this very loud red thing.
beats.chinese: 那只水壶。整页大半都是米色，偏偏这里有个特别抢眼的红东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah slides the magazine into the folder and closes it firmly, remaining beside the railing.
beats.chinese: Jonah把杂志放进文件夹，牢牢合上，仍站在护栏旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the one. I'll deal with the scissors at home. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 就是它了。剪刀的事回家再说。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah stops looking through the magazine and closes its cover.
beats.chinese: Jonah不再翻看杂志，合上了封面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I came out to walk and immediately gave myself something else to do.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我明明出来散步，立刻又给自己找了件别的事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With the closed folder tucked under one arm, Jonah turns along the path and takes a few steps.
beats.chinese: Jonah把合好的文件夹夹在臂下，转身沿步道往前走了几步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care.
beats.chinese: 再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah pauses with the magazine halfway inside the folder, then gently pulls it back out.
beats.chinese: 杂志塞到一半，Jonah停了一下，又轻轻把它抽出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hm, no. I don't like a crease through the pictures. Even the ones I'm going to cut up.
beats.chinese: 嗯，还是不了。我不喜欢图片中间有折痕。就算准备剪碎的也一样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah straightens the caught corner and slides the magazine in flat. The folder closes at last.
beats.chinese: Jonah理平卡住的纸角，把杂志平整地送进去。文件夹终于合上了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That took longer than it deserved. Thanks, though. Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 为这点事花的时间可真够长的。不过还是谢谢。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah stops trying to fit the magazine inside and lays it against the closed folder instead.
beats.chinese: Jonah不再往里塞杂志，转而把它贴在合上的文件夹外侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. This will do until I'm indoors.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。进屋之前，先这样拿着就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah secures both beneath one arm and turns back along the same stretch of walkway.
beats.chinese: Jonah把两样东西一起夹稳在臂下，转身沿着这段步道往回走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beside the railing on the side of the High Line walkway, Jonah Petrov closes a folder containing old magazines, then looks up and recognizes you.
beats.chinese: 在高线公园步道同一侧的护栏旁，Jonah Petrov合上装着旧杂志的文件夹，抬头认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello. On my walk today, I finally worked out which part of my collage at home to leave blank.
beats.chinese: 哦，你好。今天散步时，我终于想好了家里的拼贴画该在哪儿留一块空白。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah keeps the folder closed and glances at the dry grasses, looking satisfied. With the folder tucked under one arm, Jonah turns to continue along the same walkway.
beats.chinese: Jonah没有重新打开文件夹，只望了一眼枯草带，神情满足。把文件夹夹在臂下后，Jonah转身，准备沿原步道继续向前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Leaving that space blank is the right choice. All right, I'll keep walking.
beats.chinese: 留着那块空白就对了。好了，我继续走走。

causality.presenceReason: Jonah在制作轮组的班次结束后，主动来高线公园散步，随身带着供家中拼贴使用的旧杂志。
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢来此随意走走，途中想起杂志中的水壶图片，便在护栏旁短暂停下查看。注意到高架步道上的风后准备收好杂志。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the High Line, Dolores Camacho has stopped beside the railing after her sculpture-cleaning shift to loosen her shoulders. Dry winter grass borders the walkway. As you come level with her, a flap of the paper model in her hands springs toward your sleeve.
beats.chinese: 高线公园里，Dolores Camacho结束了清洗雕塑的工作，停在护栏旁活动肩膀。冬末的枯草沿着步道生长。你来到她身边时，她手中纸模型的一片折翼突然弹向你的袖口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. Did that catch your sleeve?
beats.chinese: 抱歉。碰到你的袖子了吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She draws the model close to her coat and holds the loose flap between two fingers.
beats.chinese: 她把模型收回外套前，用两根手指夹住松开的折翼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That bit opens farther than I remembered.
beats.chinese: 这部分展开的幅度比我记得的大。

choices.english: It brushed me. No harm. What is it?
choices.chinese: 擦到了一下，没事。这是什么？

choices.english: It missed. You caught it in time.
choices.chinese: 没碰到。你及时收回去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dolores turns the model sideways. It is a small paper bird with several folds tucked beneath its wings.
beats.chinese: Dolores把模型侧过来。那是一只小纸鸟，翅膀下藏着几道折叠。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A bird with moving wings. I'm Dolores. I fold these at home, usually with a cat trying to sit on the paper.
beats.chinese: 一只翅膀会动的鸟。我叫Dolores。我在家折这些，通常还有只猫想坐到纸上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her thumb stops on a crease. She looks toward your sleeve again, then notices that she has stopped showing you the bird.
beats.chinese: 她的拇指停在一道折痕上，又朝你的袖口看了一眼，随后才发觉自己停下了展示。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And the sleeve's all right? You did say no harm. Yes. Sorry.
beats.chinese: 袖子也没事吧？你确实说了没事。对。抱歉。

choices.english: We're fine. I'd like to see the wings move.
choices.chinese: 真的没事。我想看看翅膀怎么动。

choices.english: It's fine. May I hold it?
choices.chinese: 没事。我可以拿着看看吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dolores checks that both paper wings are tucked in. She stays beside the railing, leaving the walking space clear.
beats.chinese: Dolores检查了一下，确认两边纸翅膀都收好了。她留在护栏旁，让出通行的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I'm Dolores. I've finished work, but my hands apparently haven't.
beats.chinese: 那就好。我叫Dolores。我已经下班了，看来手还没下班。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers the bird and rolls one shoulder, then the other.
beats.chinese: 她放低纸鸟，先转了转一侧肩膀，又转了转另一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came up for a short walk. Standing here folding things wasn't the plan.
beats.chinese: 我本来是上来走一小段的，没打算站在这儿折东西。

choices.english: I'll let you get to your walk. Take care.
choices.chinese: 那就不耽误你散步了。再见。

choices.english: What sort of work do you do?
choices.chinese: 你做什么工作？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dolores holds the bird low between you, well away from your clothes and the passing space.
beats.chinese: Dolores把纸鸟放低，举在你们之间，离你的衣服和通行区域都远一些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. This one gets two good flaps before something slips.
beats.chinese: 好。这只能好好扑腾两下，之后就有地方会松。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves the tail. Both wings lift twice, then one sticks upright. She presses it flat and puts the bird in her coat pocket.
beats.chinese: 她动了动尾巴。两只翅膀抬起两次，随后一只竖着卡住了。她把它压平，将纸鸟放进外套口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two. Better stop while it's keeping its promise. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 两下。趁它还算说话算话，就到这里吧。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dolores keeps the bird in her own hands, with her fingers supporting the folded body.
beats.chinese: Dolores仍把纸鸟拿在自己手里，手指托住折起来的鸟身。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd rather keep hold of it. A fold inside is splitting.
beats.chinese: 我还是自己拿着吧。里面有道折痕快裂了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tilts it once so the small tear is visible, then carefully folds both wings against the body and puts it away.
beats.chinese: 她把纸鸟倾斜了一下，让那道小裂口露出来，随后小心地将双翼贴着鸟身折好，收了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough handling for this one. Nice talking to you. Take care.
beats.chinese: 这只今天经不起再摆弄了。很高兴和你聊了几句。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The conversation ends as you continue along the walkway. Dolores remains beside the railing.
beats.chinese: 你沿着步道继续前行，对话就此结束。Dolores留在护栏旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Thanks for letting me know it missed.
beats.chinese: 你也是。谢谢你告诉我没碰到。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the folded bird securely into her pocket and closes the pocket flap.
beats.chinese: 她把折好的纸鸟稳稳放进口袋，盖好袋盖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. That can stay put for a bit. Bye.
beats.chinese: 好了。让它在里面待一会儿。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dolores tucks the bird away. She rubs her thumb across a faint dry patch on one knuckle.
beats.chinese: Dolores收起纸鸟，用拇指擦了擦另一只手指关节上一小块干燥的皮肤。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: City sculpture cleaning crew. Nineteen years. Bronze, granite, whatever needs the right treatment.
beats.chinese: 市里的雕塑清洗队。干了十九年。青铜、花岗岩，各有各的处理办法。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens and closes her hand, then turns along the clear walkway to begin her own walk.
beats.chinese: 她张开手，又握了一下，随后转向畅通的步道，开始自己的散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mostly careful work, with some hard scrubbing. My shoulders have had enough of both today. Nice meeting you.
beats.chinese: 大部分时候得细心，有时也得用力刷。今天这两样，我的肩膀都受够了。很高兴认识你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the High Line, Dolores stands beside the railing with her arms hanging loosely at her sides. She recognizes you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 在高线公园，Dolores站在护栏旁，双臂自然垂在身侧。她认出了你，笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. My shoulders are tired today. This is as far as I'm walking.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天肩膀累，我就走到这里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slowly rolls one shoulder once, then stops. She lets her arms rest at her sides, leaving the walkway clear.
beats.chinese: 她慢慢转动了一次肩膀，随后停下，让双臂垂在身侧休息，没有占住通行的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A walk isn't an extra shift. I'll stand here a little longer. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 散步不是补一班工。我再站一会儿，你慢慢走。

causality.presenceReason: Dolores清洗雕塑下班后，已独自来到高线公园短走、活动肩膀，停步时拿出了随身纸机关。

causality.currentGoal: 收好意外弹开的纸翼，确认没有碰坏对方衣物，然后继续自己的散步。
causality.currentState: 肩膀疲劳，态度温和，愿意短聊。得到没事的回答后，仍会走神复核小小的过失。
causality.contactTrigger: 玩家来到身边时，纸机关的一片折翼突然朝袖口弹开，Dolores主动询问是否碰到。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the High Line, Theo Marchetti is taking an after-work walk with a pocket maze book he brought for a break. As you reach him, he moves toward the railing, leaving the walkway clear beside the dry grasses.
beats.chinese: 在高线公园，Theo Marchetti正下班散步，随身带着一本休息时翻的小迷宫册。你来到他附近时，他往护栏一侧靠了靠，让枯草带旁的通行面保持畅通。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go ahead. I'm stopping here. Walking and looking at this was a poor combination.
beats.chinese: 你先过吧，我在这儿停一会儿。边走边看这个，实在不太合适。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the book. One pencil line already reaches the maze's exit, but his pencil is resting at the entrance again.
beats.chinese: 他放低小册子。一条铅笔线已经通到了迷宫出口，他的笔尖却又停在入口处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Theo. I've found the way out. Apparently I also need to investigate the bad options.
beats.chinese: 我叫Theo。出去的路已经找到了。看来我还非得研究一下那些糟糕的选项。

choices.english: What are you trying this time?
choices.chinese: 这次你准备怎么走？

choices.english: Thanks. I'll let you get back to it.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，那就不打扰你继续研究了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Theo angles the book toward you without stepping back into the walking space. His pencil follows a narrow branch away from the completed route.
beats.chinese: Theo把小册子朝你倾过来，没有退回通行面。他的笔尖沿着一条狭窄岔路移动，离已经画好的路线越来越远。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This branch. It looks terrible, but there's a little turn behind that wall I haven't tried.
beats.chinese: 这条岔路。看着就不妙，不过那堵墙后面有个小弯，我还没试过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He starts down the branch, pauses at the obvious route to the exit, and deliberately carries on past it.
beats.chinese: 他沿岔路画下去，在那条明显通向出口的路旁停了一下，又有意绕了过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I edit rules for children's board games. At work, I have to catch every dead end. This one can waste a little of my evening.
beats.chinese: 我是儿童桌游的规则编辑。工作时，每一条走不通的路都得查出来。这一条嘛，可以让它浪费我一点晚上的时间。

choices.english: I'll watch one attempt, then move on.
choices.chinese: 我看你试一次，然后就继续走。

choices.english: I'd stop once I'd found the exit. Enjoy your puzzle.
choices.chinese: 换作我，找到出口就收手了。你慢慢玩。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Theo draws the book closer to his chest and turns his shoulders toward the railing. There is clear space to pass.
beats.chinese: Theo把小册子收近胸前，身体转向护栏，旁边留出了足够的通行空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 好，散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the pencil tip, then holds it above the page without making another mark.
beats.chinese: 他检查了一下笔尖，随后把笔悬在纸页上，没有再落笔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll stay out of the traffic up here.
beats.chinese: 我就靠边待着，不挡这里的路。

choices.english: Give him a nod and continue along the walkway.
choices.chinese: 向他点点头，沿步道继续走。

choices.english: Before moving on, ask, “Do you make those puzzles?”
choices.chinese: 离开前问一句：“这些谜题是你设计的吗？”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Theo traces the little turn. It leads into a closed square, a few millimeters from the route he already knows works.
beats.chinese: Theo沿着那个小弯画过去，结果钻进了一个封闭方格，离那条已知可行的路线只有几毫米。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There it is. A very thorough dead end.
beats.chinese: 找到了。一条堵得相当彻底的死路。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts his pencil and smiles. As you move on after the agreed attempt, he turns the book slightly and studies the same branch again.
beats.chinese: 他抬起铅笔，笑了笑。看完说好的一次尝试后，你继续前行。他却把小册子转了个角度，又端详起同一条岔路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That was your one attempt. Thanks for stopping. I'm checking whether I missed a gap.
beats.chinese: 说好的一次试完了。谢谢你停下来看看。我再检查一下，是不是漏了个缺口。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Theo glances from the finished route to the unfinished pencil line. His pencil hovers over the next turn.
beats.chinese: Theo看看已经走通的路线，又看看没画完的铅笔线。笔尖悬在下一个转弯上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I did come up here for a walk.
beats.chinese: 也对。我本来是上来散步的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He almost touches the pencil to the page, then closes the book and puts both in his coat pocket. He turns to look at the vehicles moving below.
beats.chinese: 铅笔差一点又落到纸上，他却合起小册子，把书和笔都放进外套口袋，转头望向下方行驶的车辆。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm putting it away before I find another excuse. Enjoy the rest of your walk.
beats.chinese: 趁我还没找到别的借口，先收起来。祝你接下来逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You nod and continue along the High Line. Theo stays beside the railing rather than falling into step with you.
beats.chinese: 你点点头，沿高线公园继续走。Theo留在护栏边，没有跟上来同行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care.
beats.chinese: 慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He raises his pencil in a brief goodbye, then looks down and adds another short line to the maze.
beats.chinese: 他举了举铅笔，简短地道别，随后低头，在迷宫里又添了一小段线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. One more corner.
beats.chinese: 好，再看一个拐角。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Theo looks up at your question and closes the book around his pencil.
beats.chinese: 听见你的问题，Theo抬起头，把铅笔夹进小册子里，合上书。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, I buy these. I edit rulebooks for children's board games. Enough tiny print to keep me busy.
beats.chinese: 不是，这些是我买的。我做儿童桌游的规则书编辑。那些小字就够我忙的了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets the book, checks the space beside him, and resumes his own walk along the same side of the elevated path.
beats.chinese: 他把小册子放进口袋，确认身旁有空当，便沿着高架步道的同一侧继续自己的散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And that's enough small print for one evening. Nice meeting you.
beats.chinese: 今晚的小字也看够了。很高兴认识你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the High Line, Theo Marchetti recognises you beside the railing. A small boxed game is tucked under his arm.
beats.chinese: 在高线公园，Theo Marchetti在栏杆旁认出你，腋下夹着一小盒桌游。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Found this in a Queens game shop. Never heard of it. Two players, twenty minutes, according to the box.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。在皇后区一家游戏店找到这个，从没听过。盒上写两个人、二十分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the box to read the description, smiling, then secures it under his arm again.
beats.chinese: 他把盒子转过来读了读介绍，笑着重新夹稳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: For once I don't know the winning move. Looking forward to that. I'll ask who's free tonight. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 这回总算不知道哪步能赢了。挺期待。问问今晚谁有空。散步愉快。

stories.titleZh: 海泽尔把结尾说在了前头

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On New York's High Line, Hazel Wroe has paused beside the winter-brown grasses to read a message from her sister Ruth. She came for a short walk between sessions on a temporary archive project. As you come within earshot, she laughs and looks up.
beats.chinese: 在纽约高线公园，海泽尔·罗停在冬末枯草带旁，读姐姐露丝发来的消息。她正参与一个临时档案项目，趁工作间隙来走走。你进入她说话可听见的范围时，她笑出了声，抬起头来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, I'm laughing at this, love. Nothing you've done. I'm Hazel.
beats.chinese: 哦，我是在笑这个，亲爱的，跟你没关系。我叫海泽尔。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts her phone away, still smiling, and stays close to the grass edge so others can pass.
beats.chinese: 她收起手机，脸上还带着笑，站在靠近草带的一侧，让其他人通行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My sister's reminded me of a daft joke from work. I've already started laughing too early.
beats.chinese: 我姐姐让我想起了单位里的一个傻笑话。我这还没讲呢，就先笑上了。

choices.english: Go on, what's the joke?
choices.chinese: 说来听听，什么笑话？

choices.english: No worries. I'll leave you to your walk.
choices.chinese: 没事。那我不打扰你散步了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hazel turns towards you without moving farther into the walkway. Her smile widens before she gets a word out.
beats.chinese: 海泽尔转向你，没有往通行面中间挪。话还没出口，她的笑容就更大了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He says, 'If we find them, they're not missing!' And I—no wait, I've missed the beginning.
beats.chinese: 他说，‘要是找着了，那就不算遗失了！’然后我——等等，我把开头漏了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She presses her lips together, trying to stop another laugh, then opens both hands.
beats.chinese: 她抿住嘴，努力忍住又一阵笑，随后摊开双手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I check script licences at a regional TV archive. A colleague labelled an empty folder 'Missing Scripts'. That bit was supposed to come first.
beats.chinese: 我在一家地方电视档案馆核查剧本授权。有个同事给一个空文件夹贴了‘遗失剧本’的标签。这部分本来该先说。

choices.english: Start again. Give me the whole thing in order.
choices.chinese: 重新来吧。按顺序讲一遍。

choices.english: No restart for me, thanks. I'd rather look at the view.
choices.chinese: 不用重讲了，谢谢。我想看看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hazel nods and turns slightly along the walkway, leaving the conversation easy to end.
beats.chinese: 海泽尔点点头，身体稍稍转向步道前方，没有拦着你继续交谈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I only meant to explain the laughing.
beats.chinese: 好啊。我就是解释一下刚才为什么笑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a step, then looks back with one finger raised. The finger drops almost immediately.
beats.chinese: 她迈出一步，又回过头，竖起一根手指。那根手指几乎立刻就放下了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It starts with an empty folder—oh, you've said you're going. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 开头是一个空文件夹——哦，你都说要走了。散步愉快。

choices.english: Thanks. Enjoy yours. (Continue along the walkway.)
choices.chinese: 谢谢，你也是。（沿步道继续走。）

choices.english: All right, give me the short version.
choices.chinese: 好吧，那就讲个简短版。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hazel settles her hands at her sides and makes a serious attempt to begin properly.
beats.chinese: 海泽尔把双手放回身侧，认认真真地试着从头讲。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: An empty folder says 'Missing Scripts'. I ask what goes inside. My colleague says, 'Nothing. Once we find a script, it belongs somewhere else.'
beats.chinese: 一个空文件夹上写着‘遗失剧本’。我问里面放什么。同事说，‘什么都不放。剧本一旦找着，就该放别处了。’

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gets through the final sentence, then breaks into a laugh of her own and begins walking along the same side of the path.
beats.chinese: 她总算把最后一句说完整，接着自己笑了起来，沿着步道同一侧往前走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There, a beginning and an end. Cheers for letting me get both out. Enjoy the rest of your walk.
beats.chinese: 这回有头有尾了。谢谢你肯让我把两头都讲出来。接着好好散步吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hazel's mouth is already open for another attempt when your refusal reaches her.
beats.chinese: 听见你不想再听时，海泽尔已经张开嘴，准备再讲一遍了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The folder was empty because—yes, right. No restart.
beats.chinese: 文件夹空着是因为——嗯，好。不重讲。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shuts her mouth, gives a small nod, and turns towards the grasses, ending the conversation without moving into your space.
beats.chinese: 她合上嘴，轻轻点头，转向枯草带，没有往你这边挤，交谈就此结束。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the view. I'll keep the rest to myself.
beats.chinese: 好好看风景吧。剩下的我就不说了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the walkway, Hazel remains beside the grass edge.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道继续前行，海泽尔留在草带旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers, love. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 谢谢，亲爱的。祝你下午过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives one brief wave, then takes out her phone and begins typing a reply to Ruth.
beats.chinese: 她简短地挥了一下手，随后拿出手机，开始给露丝回消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, Ruth. You're getting the long version.
beats.chinese: 好了，露丝。完整版归你听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hazel turns back towards you and holds up two fingers, counting out her shortened version.
beats.chinese: 海泽尔转回身，竖起两根手指，数着讲她的简短版。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Empty folder labelled 'Missing Scripts'. I ask what goes in it. 'Nothing. Find them and they're not missing.' That's the lot.
beats.chinese: 空文件夹上贴着‘遗失剧本’。我问里面放什么。‘什么都不放。找着了，就不算遗失。’讲完了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds both fingers down, pleased to have kept it brief, and turns to resume her walk.
beats.chinese: 她把两根手指收起来，很满意这回讲得够短，转身继续散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Managed it without a detour. I'll leave you to it now. Bye!
beats.chinese: 这回总算没绕弯。现在不耽误你了。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: During another work break on the High Line, Hazel Wroe stands near the grass edge, typing a reply to her sister Ruth. She looks up and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 又一次工作间隙，海泽尔·罗站在高线步道的草带旁，打字回复姐姐露丝。她抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again, love! I need to finish this reply to Ruth first.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了，亲爱的！我得先把给露丝这条回完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks down and finishes the last sentence. Her smile fades as she reads it through carefully to check the wording, then sends it and puts her phone away.
beats.chinese: 她低头补完最后一句，收起笑意，认真通读一遍，确认措辞后发送，再把手机收起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Some things are better written out clearly than made into a joke. I've still got a few minutes. I'm going for a walk.
beats.chinese: 有些话打清楚比讲个笑话管用。我还剩几分钟，走走去。

causality.presenceReason: 海泽尔参与纽约临时馆际剧本授权项目，工作间隙先来高线公园短暂散步，停下读露丝的消息。
causality.placeAttitude: 把这里当作离开文书工作、走动透气的地方，没有导览或结交陌生人的任务。
causality.stayingConstraint: 只是工作间隙的短暂停留，无须等待玩家，也没有必须完成的公园事务。
causality.currentGoal: 原本想读完消息继续散步，笑声引起近距离接触后先澄清自己并非在笑玩家。
causality.currentState: 当天心情轻快，被姐姐的消息勾起单位笑话，很容易先笑后讲。
causality.contactTrigger: 玩家进入可听见的距离时，她读消息笑出声并抬头，主动解释笑声。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留地方电视档案馆授权助理身份、直爽热情、讲笑话漏开头及对方已想结束时仍多说半句的毛病。重逢时她仍热情招呼，但直说需要先回复姐姐，体现健谈不等于随时愿意放下手头的联系。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa获准重讲，完整讲完后离开。ab忍不住补半句，随后接受拒绝，转身看草带。ba玩家离开，她留下回复露丝。bb玩家改口听简版，她压缩讲完后继续散步。重逢时先完成给露丝的回复，认真核对措辞并发送，随后收起手机，准备利用剩下几分钟散步，不要求玩家陪同。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the upper platform overlooking Grand Central Terminal's main concourse, Herbert Nussbaum is waiting for his wife to arrive by train. He holds a sheet of lettering practice close in front of him, looking at one letter.
beats.chinese: 在中央车站俯瞰大厅的上层平台上，Herbert Nussbaum正等妻子乘火车到站。他把一张练字纸收在自己身前，看着其中一个字母。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That g. Finally got it right.
beats.chinese: 这个g，总算写顺了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He says it softly, with a pleased smile, then glances toward you nearby. Several versions of the same names cover the sheet, each written in careful, rounded letters.
beats.chinese: 他轻声说着，满意地笑了笑，随后看向近处的你。纸上反复写着几个相同的名字，字母圆润，一笔一画都很仔细。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was talking to this letter. Names for a small dinner. I brought this to finish while I wait for my wife.
beats.chinese: 我是在跟这个字母说话。给一顿小聚餐写的名字。我带来，想等我太太的时候写完。

choices.english: Are you making place cards?
choices.chinese: 你在做座位名卡吗？

choices.english: I'd like to look at the hall quietly for a while.
choices.chinese: 我想安静地看看大厅。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Herbert turns the sheet inward so it stays within the width of his shoulders. A few names have tiny pencil marks underneath.
beats.chinese: Herbert把纸向内转了转，让它不再超出肩膀的宽度。有几个名字下面画着细小的铅笔记号。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. Eight people, one meal. Then a memory from each person. No photographs.
beats.chinese: 是。八个人，一顿饭。然后每人讲一段回忆。不拍照。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His finger stops beneath a lowercase g. He smiles, then notices a neighboring letter and presses his lips together.
beats.chinese: 他的手指停在一个小写g下面，脸上露出笑意。接着他看到旁边的字母，又抿起了嘴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That g came out well. The next letter leans. That's why George has been written six times.
beats.chinese: 这个g写得挺好。后面那个字母歪了。所以George这个名字写了六遍。

choices.english: May I have a closer look at that g?
choices.chinese: 我能凑近看看那个g吗？

choices.english: Did your work involve lettering?
choices.chinese: 你以前的工作跟写字有关吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Herbert nods and lowers the sheet, keeping clear of the people passing along the platform. He brings the two edges of the sheet together.
beats.chinese: Herbert点点头，放低纸，也避开了平台上经过的人。他把纸的两边对齐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll leave you to the view.
beats.chinese: 当然。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The corners fail to meet. He opens the sheet and starts the fold again, more slowly.
beats.chinese: 两个纸角没对上。他重新展开纸，更慢地折了一次。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It fits my bag when it's folded properly.
beats.chinese: 折齐了才能放进包里。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。你慢慢弄，我不打扰了。

choices.english: You could just tuck it in. A crease won't hurt it.
choices.chinese: 直接塞进去也行吧。有道折痕又不会弄坏。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Herbert holds the sheet upright at chest height, with the small g facing you. The paper stays close to him as people pass.
beats.chinese: Herbert把纸竖在胸前，让那个小写g朝着你。有人经过时，他也始终把纸收在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here. The tail clears the letter beside it. Just enough space.
beats.chinese: 这里。它的尾巴跟旁边那个字母分开了。距离刚刚好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He leaves it visible for a few seconds, smiling at the letter himself. Then he folds the sheet and puts it away.
beats.chinese: 他把纸展示了几秒，自己也望着那个字母笑了笑。随后，他折好纸，收了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm keeping that version. Enjoy the view. I'll watch for my wife.
beats.chinese: 这一版我要留下。你慢慢看风景，我留意一下我太太。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Herbert lowers the sheet. He shakes his head once, with a small smile.
beats.chinese: Herbert放低纸，轻轻摇了一下头，露出一点笑意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tea inspection. Twenty-six years with a bubble tea chain, going around the boroughs. Brew strength, steep times, tapioca texture.
beats.chinese: 茶饮质检。在一家珍珠奶茶连锁店干了二十六年，跑纽约各个区。查茶的浓度、浸泡时间，还有珍珠的口感。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the practice sheet into his bag, then looks down at the concourse from the same upper platform.
beats.chinese: 他把练字纸折好放进包里，随后仍站在同一上层平台上，向下看大厅。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Retired four years ago. I don't miss the commuting. Well, I'll get back to watching for my wife. Nice talking with you.
beats.chinese: 四年前退休了。我可不怀念通勤。好了，我得接着留意我太太了。跟你聊得很愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Herbert stops folding long enough to give you a small nod. He keeps the sheet close to him.
beats.chinese: Herbert暂时停下折纸，向你轻轻点头。他仍把纸收在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 好。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns slightly away and lines up the paper's corners. Once they meet, he smooths the fold with his thumb.
beats.chinese: 他稍稍转过身，把纸角对齐。对好后，他用拇指压平折痕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. That fits.
beats.chinese: 好了。这下放得进去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Herbert pauses with the sheet half folded. He looks down at its uneven edges rather than putting it into his bag.
beats.chinese: Herbert拿着折到一半的纸停了一下。他低头看着没对齐的纸边，没有把它放进包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It won't hurt the paper. It'll bend the corners, though.
beats.chinese: 纸是不会坏。不过纸角会翘起来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens it again and carefully matches the corners. He finishes the fold before putting the sheet away.
beats.chinese: 他再次展开纸，仔细把几个角对齐。折好之后，他才把纸收起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I want them flat when I write. All done now. I'll let you get on.
beats.chinese: 我写字时希望纸是平的。现在弄好了。不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Grand Central Terminal, you see Herbert on the upper platform above the main concourse. He recognizes you while tapping three fingers against his trouser seam.
beats.chinese: 在中央车站，你在大厅上方的平台看到了Herbert。他认出了你，三根手指还在裤缝边轻轻敲着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've had three notes in my head since handbell rehearsal.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。手铃排练以后，三个音就一直在我脑子里转。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His fingers repeat the pattern once. He notices, opens his hand, and rests it against his leg.
beats.chinese: 他的手指又敲了一遍那个节奏。他察觉后，张开手，把手掌贴在腿边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We finally got that bit together. I can give it a rest now. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 我们总算把那一小段合上了。现在可以歇歇了。见到你真好。

causality.presenceReason: Herbert先到中央车站等乘火车来的妻子，随身带了聚餐名卡的练字稿，想利用等候时间完成。
causality.placeAttitude: 把上层平台当作普通等候地点，也接受别人来此看大厅，没有主动充当导游。
causality.stayingConstraint: 尚在等妻子，因此结束交谈后仍留在上层平台留意下方大厅。
causality.currentGoal: 检查聚餐名卡上名字的字形，并把练字纸妥善收好。
causality.currentState: 不赶时间，专注于纸上细节，因一个小写g终于写顺而轻声表达喜悦。愿意短聊，但对折纸和字形略显固执。
causality.contactTrigger: 练字纸始终保持在自己身前。他看着字母轻声说这个g终于写顺，随后向近处的玩家解释自己是在跟字母说话，并说明在写聚餐用的名字。不道歉、不索取评价，玩家可选择询问名卡或表示想安静看大厅。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留退休茶饮质检员、手铃团成员和字形爱好者身份。通过对小写g的喜悦、反复写名字和坚持对齐纸角表现细致与固执，聚餐不拍照的界限保持明确。玩家想安静看大厅时，他礼貌接受，不要求继续交谈。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家询问名卡后，aa按玩家请求短暂展示小写g，再收纸结束。ab简答职业问题后，仍在同一上层平台向下看大厅，继续等妻子。玩家表示想安静看大厅后，他开始收纸。ba接受玩家结束交流，独自折纸。bb没有采纳随手塞纸的建议，完成整齐折叠后道别。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全部发生在照片所示俯瞰大厅的同一上层平台。练字纸保持在Herbert身前，收纸时避开经过的人，不新增设施，不下楼，也不进入其他场景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Grand Central Terminal, Cecil Grantley stands on the upper platform overlooking the main concourse. They arrived early to meet their nephew. With you nearby, they give a crisp, practiced greeting.
beats.chinese: 中央车站里，Cecil Grantley站在俯瞰大厅的上层平台上。他们来早了，正在等侄子。你就在附近，他们字正腔圆、十分熟练地打了声招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good evening. Here is the—oh, hello.
beats.chinese: 晚上好。现在为您播报——哦，你好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cecil stops halfway through a small announcing gesture and lowers their hand.
beats.chinese: Cecil那只配合播报而抬起的手停在半空，随后放了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Cecil. I used to read the news. That greeting comes out when I'm waiting. My nephew isn't here yet.
beats.chinese: 我叫Cecil，以前是新闻播音员。等人的时候，这句开场白就会自己冒出来。我侄子还没到。

choices.english: You can finish that introduction.
choices.chinese: 你可以把那句开场白说完。

choices.english: Hello, Cecil. I'd like to look at the hall quietly.
choices.chinese: 你好，Cecil。我想安静地看看大厅。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cecil straightens a little and addresses you in an even, carefully paced voice.
beats.chinese: Cecil稍稍站直，用平稳而讲究节奏的声音对你说话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here is the news, read by Cecil Grantley. That's how we opened in Kingston.
beats.chinese: 现在由Cecil Grantley为您播报新闻。我们在金斯敦就是这样开场的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They smile. After a brief pause, their fingers begin marking out another sentence.
beats.chinese: 他们笑了笑。才停顿片刻，手指又开始随着下一句话打起拍子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thirty years of that. Nine years retired. And now the weather—sorry, you only asked for the introduction.
beats.chinese: 这样播了三十多年，退休也九年了。接下来是天气——抱歉，你只让我说完开场白。

choices.english: I'd like one short story about the station.
choices.chinese: 我想听一个关于电台的小故事，简短的就好。

choices.english: That's enough broadcasting for me. I'll be on my way. Goodbye, Cecil.
choices.chinese: 我听到这里就够了。我该走了。再见，Cecil。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cecil turns slightly toward the concourse, leaving you out of their direct line of sight.
beats.chinese: Cecil稍稍转向大厅，不再正面看着你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll leave you to the view.
beats.chinese: 当然。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A few seconds pass. Their thumb taps against their fingertips, and they glance toward the distant clock.
beats.chinese: 几秒钟过去。他们用拇指轻点其他手指，朝远处的钟看了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That clock is a long way off. I used to keep one beside the microphone. Oh. I was going to be quiet.
beats.chinese: 那座钟离这里真远。我以前会在麦克风旁边放一只钟。哦，我刚才说好不出声的。

choices.english: I'll move farther along the platform. Enjoy meeting your nephew.
choices.chinese: 我往平台那边挪一挪。祝你和侄子见面愉快。

choices.english: A little conversation is fine. What keeps you busy at home?
choices.chinese: 聊一小会儿也可以。你在家都忙些什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cecil lifts one finger, marking your request for a single story.
beats.chinese: Cecil竖起一根手指，记着你只要一个故事。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Our transmitter used to drop out in the rain. Once, I finished a whole item before the producer told me nobody could hear it. I even read the correction.
beats.chinese: 我们以前的发射机一下雨就会断讯。有一次，我把整条新闻念完，制作人才告诉我根本没人听得到。连更正稿我都念了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Someone farther along the same platform waves. Cecil recognizes their nephew, returns the wave, and turns toward him.
beats.chinese: 同一平台稍远处有人挥手。Cecil认出是侄子，挥手回应，转身朝向他。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's my nephew. I'll spare him the repeat bulletin. It was good talking with you. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 我侄子来了。就不给他重播一遍了。很高兴和你聊了聊，再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cecil draws breath as if to add something, then closes their mouth and nods.
beats.chinese: Cecil吸了口气，像是还想补充什么，随后闭上嘴，点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I nearly started another item.
beats.chinese: 当然。我差点又要播下一条了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They give a small wave as you continue along the platform, then turn back to look for their nephew.
beats.chinese: 你沿着平台继续走去，他们轻轻挥手，随后转回去寻找侄子的身影。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 再见。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You move farther along the same platform. Cecil makes no move to follow.
beats.chinese: 你往同一平台的另一边走开一些。Cecil没有跟过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. Take care.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cecil clasps their hands and turns to watch for their nephew, ending the exchange across the growing distance.
beats.chinese: Cecil双手交握，转头留意侄子是否来了。随着距离拉开，这段交谈也结束了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll stay here so he can find me.
beats.chinese: 我就在这里等，方便他找到我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cecil turns back toward you, their hands opening briefly as they begin.
beats.chinese: Cecil转回身面向你，刚开口，双手便轻轻摊开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I restore pictures from old video games. My nephew's discarded console started it. These days I can spend an evening fixing six red squares.
beats.chinese: 我会修复老电子游戏里的图像。这爱好是从侄子淘汰的游戏机开始的。现在我能花一整晚，就修好六个红色小方块。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They trace a small square in the air, start to trace another, then lower their hand and glance along the platform.
beats.chinese: 他们在空中比画一个小方块，正要再画一个，又放下手，沿平台望了望。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could give you the history of all six. I'll stop there and get back to waiting. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 这六个方块，每一个的来历我都能讲。我就说到这里，继续等人了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Grand Central Terminal, Cecil is on the upper platform, looking over the concourse. They recognize you and give a small wave.
beats.chinese: 在中央车站，Cecil正在上层平台俯看大厅。他们认出你，轻轻挥手打招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm not meeting anyone today. I just came to look at the hall.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天没约人。我就是来看看大厅。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After a pause, Cecil draws breath as if to add something. They let it out without speaking and turn their gaze back to the concourse.
beats.chinese: 话停了片刻，Cecil吸了口气，像是还想补上一句。他们最终没有继续，只把气呼出来，目光回到大厅。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I haven't got another news item just now. You don't have to fill the gap for me.
beats.chinese: 我暂时没有下一条新闻。你也不用替我接话。

causality.presenceReason: Cecil与侄子约在中央车站上层平台见面，提前抵达后留在约定地点等候。
causality.placeAttitude: 大厅是方便与家人碰面的地方，远处的钟也会让他们联想到播音室。
causality.stayingConstraint: 侄子尚未抵达，Cecil需要留在约定的平台位置，不能随意离开。
causality.currentGoal: 等到侄子，同时用简短交谈填补难熬的等待空当。
causality.currentState: 态度温和、愿意交流，但几秒钟的停顿就会让播音习惯冒出来。
causality.contactTrigger: 附近有玩家时，Cecil脱口而出新闻播报式问候，随即向玩家解释并自我介绍。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留金斯敦社区电台播音经历、清晰措辞、怕冷场而不断续话的缺点，以及对家人和像素图修复的兴趣。重逢时仍有补话的冲动，只在当下暂时容纳片刻安静，不表示永久克服习惯。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa中按要求讲一个电台故事，侄子到达后结束交谈。ab中克制追加话题，挥手让玩家离开。ba中玩家拉开距离，Cecil不追随。bb中改聊修复游戏图像，差点展开细讲后自行收尾。重逢时Cecil认出玩家并主动招呼，在停顿后没有继续添话，也不要求玩家接话。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有节点均留在照片所示上层平台，俯看大厅，钟只作为远处地标。人物仅沿同一平台移动。重逢同样发生在上层平台，不新增设施或转往其他场景。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Cecil Grantley。本次重逢位于中央车站大厅，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the upper platform overlooking Grand Central Terminal's main concourse, Bernard Ellison has stopped on his way home to photograph the hall for himself. As he raises his pocket camera, he notices you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在中央车站俯瞰大厅的上层平台，Bernard Ellison回家途中停下来，想给自己拍张大厅的照片。他举起便携相机，注意到旁边的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, sorry. Am I getting in your view?
beats.chinese: 哦，抱歉。我挡着你看了吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the camera to his chest and turns slightly toward you.
beats.chinese: 他把相机放低到胸前，稍稍转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can put this down. I'm only taking a picture for myself.
beats.chinese: 我可以先放下。我就是自己随便拍一张。

choices.english: You're fine. What caught your eye?
choices.chinese: 没挡着。什么吸引了你？

choices.english: I'd like a clear view, thanks.
choices.chinese: 我想不受遮挡地看看，谢谢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernard keeps the camera lowered and looks across the concourse.
beats.chinese: Bernard没有重新举起相机，而是望向大厅。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The way people get around each other down there. I'd have three camera cables tangled in about a minute.
beats.chinese: 下面那些人互相让开、各走各的，挺有意思。换我带着三根摄像机线，一分钟准缠上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His finger traces a short route in the air. He starts another gesture, then lets his hand drop.
beats.chinese: 他用手指在空中划出一小段路线，刚想接着比画，又把手放了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You'd have to run the cables along—well, nobody asked me to wire the place.
beats.chinese: 那些线就得沿着——得，也没人请我给这儿布线。

choices.english: I was looking at the building. That clock caught my eye.
choices.chinese: 我在看建筑。那座钟挺吸引我的。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your picture. Enjoy it.
choices.chinese: 那我不耽误你拍照了。慢慢拍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernard shifts out of your sightline, keeping to the same platform.
beats.chinese: Bernard往旁边挪了一点，让开你的视线，仍留在同一平台上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. There you go.
beats.chinese: 当然。这下可以了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He switches off the camera and slips it into his coat pocket.
beats.chinese: 他关掉相机，放进外套口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I pass through after my shift at the community TV station. Usually I only stop because I've forgotten which pocket my ticket's in.
beats.chinese: 我在社区电视台下班后会经过这里。平常停下来，都是因为忘了车票放在哪个口袋。

choices.english: Do you work at the station?
choices.chinese: 你在那家电视台工作吗？

choices.english: Thanks. I'll just look at the hall.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。我就看看大厅。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernard follows your reference to the distant clock. His camera stays lowered.
beats.chinese: Bernard顺着你的话望向远处的钟，相机仍然垂在手边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, the clock. Yes. I went straight past that and started planning a cable run.
beats.chinese: 啊，那座钟。是啊。我直接把它略过去，开始琢磨怎么走线了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He chuckles, pockets the camera, and gives the clock a proper look before taking a few steps along the platform.
beats.chinese: 他笑了笑，收起相机，认真看了看那座钟，再沿平台走开几步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Glad you pointed it out. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 幸好你提了一句。慢慢看吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernard checks that his camera will stay clear of your view.
beats.chinese: Bernard确认了一下，自己的相机不会挡住你的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. One picture, then I'll stop pretending I'm on a camera shift.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。拍一张，然后就别再弄得跟值摄像班似的了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes one photograph of the hall, lowers the camera, and gives you a small farewell nod.
beats.chinese: 他拍下一张大厅的照片，放下相机，朝你轻轻点头道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. That's enough fiddling with it. Take care.
beats.chinese: 好了。不折腾它了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernard turns toward you again without moving back into your view.
beats.chinese: Bernard再次转向你，但没有挪回去挡住视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Part-time camera assistant. Seventy-one, and I can still spend a whole evening talking about a loose connection.
beats.chinese: 兼职摄像助理。七十一岁了，还能为了一个松动的接头说上一整晚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He begins to demonstrate a cable connection with his fingers, catches himself, and puts his hands into his coat pockets.
beats.chinese: 他刚想用手指比画接线，便自己停下来，把双手放回外套口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll spare you the demonstration. Better get home before I start planning another camera position. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 就不给你现场演示了。趁我还没开始规划另一个机位，赶紧回家。很高兴聊这几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernard nods and leaves the camera in his pocket.
beats.chinese: Bernard点点头，没有再把相机拿出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. I'll stay out of your way.
beats.chinese: 好。我不挡着你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves a little farther along the same platform and looks out over the concourse, leaving your sightline clear.
beats.chinese: 他沿同一平台挪远一点，望向大厅，留出你的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Grand Central Terminal, you see Bernard on the upper platform overlooking the hall. He has arrived early to look around before meeting a friend. He is reviewing his personal photos on a pocket camera when he recognizes you.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到中央车站时，你又在俯瞰大厅的同一上层平台看见Bernard。他约了朋友，提前来看看大厅。他正用便携相机查看自己拍的私人照片，这时认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello. Good to see you. These came out clear enough. I haven't quite caught what I like about this place, though.
beats.chinese: 哦，你好。见到你真好。这几张拍得倒是挺清楚。不过，我还没拍出自己喜欢这里的原因。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the camera and looks across the whole hall again, making no move to take another picture yet.
beats.chinese: 他把相机放低，重新望向整个大厅，暂时没有急着再拍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll look a little longer. My friend isn't here yet. No rush to take this one.
beats.chinese: 我再看一会儿。朋友还没到，不赶这一张。

causality.presenceReason: Bernard从社区电视台下班后途经中央车站，自行停在上层平台拍大厅的私人照片。
causality.placeAttitude: 他乐于观看大厅，却习惯先注意人流和设备布线问题，容易错过建筑本身。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有候人或工作的义务，可自行拍照或继续回家。
causality.currentGoal: 拍一张自己喜欢的大厅照片再回家。
causality.currentState: 今天不赶时间，愿意闲聊，但注意力很容易滑向摄像工作的技术细节。
causality.contactTrigger: 他举起相机时发现玩家就在旁边，主动放低相机，确认是否挡住视线。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留兼职摄像助理身份、朴实温和的说话方式、幕后技术兴趣，以及未经邀请就开始解释布线的习惯。他能笑着收住话头。重逢中延续摄影兴趣，以认真查看照片、略有不满足但不急于再拍的状态呈现，不再以拿错用品出糗或展开布线讲解。
causality.reactionAndChange: a中谈人流又滑向摄像布线。aa被钟的话题拉回建筑，收机继续看。ab自行拍一张后告别。b让开视线，说明下班途经。ba回答职业并收住接线演示，准备回家。bb保持距离，让玩家独自看大厅。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有初遇节点与重逢都留在照片所示的上层平台。大厅与钟均为远处景物，不靠近钟，不新增楼梯、座椅或设施。重逢中仅查看便携相机、放低相机并远望大厅。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the upper platform overlooking Grand Central's main concourse, Marisol Vega has just put a small notebook into their bag. They turn toward you.
beats.chinese: 在俯瞰中央车站大厅的上层平台，Marisol Vega刚把一本小笔记本收进包里。他们转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me, do you have the time? I'm meeting someone from my handbell ensemble. Just checking how much longer I've got to wait.
beats.chinese: 打扰一下，现在几点了？我约了手铃团的人，想确认还要等多久。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol pauses, then shifts their bag to their side and adjusts the strap. They look across the concourse.
beats.chinese: Marisol停了停，把包挪到身侧，调整背带，朝大厅望去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Marisol. I'll give them a few more minutes. Now I can watch for them.
beats.chinese: 我叫Marisol。我再等他们几分钟。这样就能留意他们过来了。

choices.english: Is that a sketchbook?
choices.chinese: 那是速写本吗？

choices.english: No problem. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 没事。那我不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol pulls the notebook halfway out again. A thumb stays firmly over its closed edge.
beats.chinese: Marisol又把笔记本抽出一半，一只拇指牢牢按住合拢的书页边缘。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lesson log. I'm an apprentice on a canal lock maintenance crew. Teacher, date, number of tries. Denny showed me the seal gauge on March second, and that took—
beats.chinese: 学习记录。我在运河船闸维修队当学徒。记老师、日期、试了几次。三月二号，Denny教我用密封量规，那次我学了——

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their thumb presses harder. They slide the notebook back into the bag without opening it.
beats.chinese: 他们的拇指按得更紧了，随后没翻开本子，就把它塞回包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Anyway. I keep the pages private. You asked about the cover and nearly got the full contents.
beats.chinese: 总之，里面的内容我不让人看。你只是问问这是什么本子，我差点把整本都讲了。

choices.english: No need to show me. I'll let you get back to it.
choices.chinese: 不用给我看。你继续忙吧。

choices.english: You can keep it closed. Why write down who taught you?
choices.chinese: 不用打开。为什么还要记下是谁教的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol finishes adjusting the strap and holds the bag upright against their hip.
beats.chinese: Marisol调整好包带，把包竖着贴在胯边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. I'm only waiting for someone from handbells. There's no luggage inspection you need to stay for.
beats.chinese: 好。我只是在等手铃团的人。这里没有什么行李检查需要你留下旁观。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol checks the strap once more, then releases their grip.
beats.chinese: Marisol又检查了一遍包带，随后松开了手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Inspection cancelled. Management has lost interest.
beats.chinese: 检查取消。管理人员已经没兴趣了。

choices.english: Good luck with rehearsal. [Move on.]
choices.chinese: 祝你排练顺利。[继续走。]

choices.english: At least the bag isn't arguing.
choices.chinese: 至少这个包没跟你顶嘴。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you turn away, Marisol settles the notebook fully inside the bag.
beats.chinese: 你转身离开时，Marisol把笔记本完全收进包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. It gets a bit crowded in there without an audience.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。就算没人旁观，里面的内容也已经够挤了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They give you a small parting wave, then lift the notebook out once more, keeping its pages turned toward their chest.
beats.chinese: 他们向你轻轻挥手道别，随后又取出笔记本，把书页朝向自己胸前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. One date to check before rehearsal. Take care.
beats.chinese: 好了。排练前核对一个日期。慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With the notebook safely inside the bag, Marisol's hand relaxes.
beats.chinese: 笔记本稳妥地收在包里，Marisol的手放松下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Otherwise I remember the thing and forget the person who stood there while I got it wrong four times. Denny deserves his name on the page.
beats.chinese: 不然我会记住学到的东西，却忘了是谁站在旁边，看着我弄错四次。那页上应该写着Denny的名字。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They start reaching into the bag, catch themselves, and put both hands around its strap instead.
beats.chinese: 他们刚想把手伸进包里，又停住，改用双手握住包带。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And that nearly became a demonstration of how I write a name. I'll stop there. Enjoy the station.
beats.chinese: 我差点又要示范自己怎么写人名了。就说到这儿吧。祝你在车站逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You move on across the platform. Marisol stays where they arranged to meet their ensemble partner.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿平台走去。Marisol留在与团员约好的碰头地点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I'm on bells today. The bag doesn't get a part.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。今天由我摇铃。这个包没有演奏的份。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They raise a hand in farewell, then turn their attention toward the people passing across the platform.
beats.chinese: 他们抬手道别，随后望向平台上来往的人，继续等候。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye.
beats.chinese: 再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol looks from you to the bag at their side and laughs.
beats.chinese: Marisol看看你，又看看身侧的包，笑出了声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: True. I'm supplying both sides of the argument. Very efficient. Terrible meeting.
beats.chinese: 确实。争论双方都由我负责。效率很高，会议质量很差。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put the strap over their shoulder and let the bag hang as it is, finished with the adjustments.
beats.chinese: 他们把包带挂上肩，让包保持原样垂着，不再调整。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I'm leaving it alone now. Thanks for the laugh. Have a good day.
beats.chinese: 好了。现在不管它了。谢谢你逗我笑。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the upper platform overlooking Grand Central's main concourse, Marisol is waiting for someone from their handbell ensemble, their bag settled at their side. They recognize you and raise a hand.
beats.chinese: 在俯瞰中央车站大厅的上层平台，Marisol正等一位手铃团员，包已经妥当地放在身侧。他们认出你，抬手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. My turn to get here first today. I'm going over what I need for rehearsal.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天轮到我先到。我正在心里过一遍排练要带的东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They quietly count the last item, then pat the outside of the bag to check it is there. The notebook stays inside.
beats.chinese: 他们低声数到最后一项，隔着包摸了一下，确认东西在里面，没有拿出笔记本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's everything. Just waiting for the person now. Good to see you. I'll wait here.
beats.chinese: 都齐了，现在只差人。见到你真好，我在这儿等。
