beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Union Square Greenmarket, Bernadette Toups has finished buying ingredients for a family supper. She is waiting beside the wide passage between the tents while her daughter finishes shopping. She looks your way, her full cloth bag beside her leg.
beats.chinese: 在联合广场农夫市集，Bernadette Toups已经买好了家庭晚餐的食材，正在帐篷间的宽通道旁等女儿买完东西。她看向你，鼓鼓的布袋放在腿边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If you hear me say I need one more thing, don't believe me. I've got plenty for supper already. I'm Bernadette.
beats.chinese: 你要是听见我说还缺一样，别信。我家今晚已经够吃了。我叫Bernadette。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gathers the bag handles in one hand and stays beside the passage, leaving room for shoppers to pass.
beats.chinese: 她把袋子的提手拢在一只手里，仍站在通道旁，留出空间让顾客经过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Family supper. I came with a list and bought enough to need another list.
beats.chinese: 要做家庭晚餐。我带着清单来的，结果买得都够再写一张了。

choices.english: What are you making?
choices.chinese: 你打算做什么？

choices.english: I'll leave you to it, then.
choices.chinese: 那我就不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernadette turns toward you, keeping her bag tucked beside her feet and out of the passing shoppers' way.
beats.chinese: Bernadette转过身面对你，袋子贴着脚边，没有挡住来往的顾客。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Chicken and rice. Plenty of carrots, apparently. My daughter lives near me, so she gets the leftovers.
beats.chinese: 鸡肉饭。看来还得加上好多胡萝卜。我女儿住得近，剩菜就归她了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds her shopping list, then opens it again when she notices a note on the back.
beats.chinese: 她把购物清单折起来，注意到背面的一条备注，又把它展开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And I need to clear my kitchen table. There's a little soldering kit spread all over it.
beats.chinese: 我还得收拾餐桌。现在上面摊着一整套小焊接套件。

choices.english: What are you building?
choices.chinese: 你在组装什么？

choices.english: I'll look at the stalls while you tell me.
choices.chinese: 你接着说，我边看摊位边听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernadette nods and shifts her bag farther from the passage. A large bunch of carrots tilts out of the top.
beats.chinese: Bernadette点点头，把袋子往通道外又挪了挪。一大把胡萝卜从袋口歪了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. I've bought mine. Just waiting on my daughter.
beats.chinese: 好啊。我已经买完了，就等我女儿了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tucks the carrots back in and glances at her list.
beats.chinese: 她把胡萝卜塞好，瞥了一眼清单。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She wrote six carrots. I counted the bunches. That'll teach her to send me shopping hungry.
beats.chinese: 她写的是六根胡萝卜，我数成六把了。下回她就知道，不能让我饿着肚子来买菜。

choices.english: Enjoy your supper. I'll keep looking around.
choices.chinese: 祝你们晚餐愉快。我接着逛逛。

choices.english: Six bunches? That sounds like a whole week of soup.
choices.chinese: 六把？听起来够喝一个星期的汤了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernadette leaves the list unfolded in her hand. Her attention returns fully to you.
beats.chinese: Bernadette把展开的清单拿在手里，注意力又全回到了你身上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A little radio. Thirty-one years assembling wiring harnesses for car stereos, and I retire into more wires.
beats.chinese: 一台小收音机。我给汽车音响组装了三十一年线束，退休了又接着摆弄电线。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She laughs, folds the list into her bag, and lifts the handles together.
beats.chinese: 她笑了，把清单折好放进袋子，再把两个提手拢到一起。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I like the little kits. Fewer parts to spread around. Well, that's enough shop talk from me. Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 我喜欢这种小套件，零件少，摊不开太大一片。好了，我这行当就聊到这儿。逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernadette's smile tightens a little. She turns her list over and smooths its corners against her palm.
beats.chinese: Bernadette的笑容微微收了收。她把清单翻过来，在掌心压平纸角。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, you go look. I've got this list to sort out.
beats.chinese: 哦，你去看吧。我得理理这张清单。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the items against her bag, carefully moving a bunch of carrots from one side to the other.
beats.chinese: 她对着袋子核对清单，仔细地把一把胡萝卜从一边挪到另一边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There now. Plenty here to keep me busy. Take care.
beats.chinese: 好了。我这儿有的是事要忙。慢走啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue looking around, Bernadette draws the last loose carrot leaves against her bag.
beats.chinese: 你继续逛市集，Bernadette把最后几片散开的胡萝卜叶拢到袋子旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. It'll certainly be a big supper.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。这顿晚餐肯定少不了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives you a small wave, then turns toward the tents to watch for her daughter.
beats.chinese: 她朝你轻轻挥手，然后转向帐篷，留意女儿的身影。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernadette looks down at the carrots and lets out a short laugh.
beats.chinese: Bernadette低头看着胡萝卜，笑出了声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Soup Monday. Soup Tuesday. By Wednesday, I'll be answering the door with a saucepan.
beats.chinese: 周一喝汤，周二喝汤。到周三，我就该端着汤锅去开门了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the list around the carrot leaves to tuck them inside, then settles the bag securely at her feet.
beats.chinese: 她用清单拢住胡萝卜叶，把叶子塞进袋里，再把袋子稳稳地放在脚边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Well, all right then. That's my menu settled. You enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好吧，那就这么定了。我的菜单算是安排好了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another market day at Union Square, Bernadette recognizes you between the tents. She is carrying a cloth bag of vegetables she has already bought.
beats.chinese: 另一个开市日，在联合广场的帐篷之间，Bernadette认出了你。她提着布袋，里面装着已经买好的蔬菜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello there. I've got to get home and clear my kitchen table today.
beats.chinese: 哎，你好啊。我今天得赶回家收拾餐桌。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Standing clear of passing shoppers, she checks her shopping list once and puts it away. She keeps her attention off the stalls.
beats.chinese: 她站在不妨碍顾客通行的地方，核对了一遍购物清单便收起来，没有再看摊位。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My soldering kit is still taking up the place where we eat. I can't stop for a long chat today. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 焊接套件还占着吃饭的地方。今天先不聊长的，见到你真好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the open Union Square Market, Devon Achebe is waiting between the tents for a coworker. He has already bought apples for a birthday lunch at their tailoring shop. He looks into the tote, quietly rehearsing an introduction.
beats.chinese: 联合广场农夫市集正在营业。Devon Achebe在帐篷之间等同事，已经买好了裁缝店生日午餐要用的苹果。他看着购物袋里的苹果，小声排练登场介绍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Please welcome the apples. They've come a long way in this bag.
beats.chinese: 有请苹果登场。它们坐着这个袋子，一路远道而来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He notices you nearby and looks up. He gathers both straps into one hand and brings the tote close to his leg, leaving the wide aisle clear.
beats.chinese: 他注意到近处的你，抬起头。他把两根袋带攥到一只手里，让袋子贴着腿，留出宽敞的通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Shop birthday lunch. I'm in charge of apples. I never agreed to a speech. That one didn't count. I'm Devon.
beats.chinese: 店里生日午餐。我负责苹果，可没答应负责致辞。刚才那句不算。我叫Devon。

choices.english: Do the apples get a proper introduction?
choices.chinese: 那苹果能得到一次正式介绍吗？

choices.english: Got it. I'm just looking around.
choices.chinese: 明白了。我只是随便看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon lifts the tote a few inches as though presenting the apples, keeping it beside his leg.
beats.chinese: Devon把袋子稍稍提起，像在向人介绍苹果，始终没让它离开腿边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Absolutely. They show up looking polished and never interrupt. Tough competition for me.
beats.chinese: 当然。它们出场时个个光鲜亮丽，还从不插嘴。对我来说是劲敌。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the bag. His voice drops briefly, then picks up speed again.
beats.chinese: 他放低袋子，声音短暂地低下来，随即又加快了语速。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I do measurements at a tailoring shop in Brooklyn. Somehow I got the birthday announcements too. I can introduce a cake. Solemn speeches need another host.
beats.chinese: 我在布鲁克林一家裁缝店负责量尺寸。不知怎么，生日主持也归我了。介绍蛋糕我可以，郑重致辞得另请主持。

choices.english: You can skip the speech with me.
choices.chinese: 跟我就不用致辞了。

choices.english: Then introduce the apples.
choices.chinese: 那就介绍一下这些苹果吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon angles his shoulders away to give you room, then turns his head back with another grin.
beats.chinese: Devon侧过身给你留出空间，随后又转回头，咧嘴笑起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure, take your time. I'm waiting for my coworker anyway.
beats.chinese: 好，慢慢看。我反正也在等同事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances into the tote, then raises his free hand as if reporting an impressive achievement.
beats.chinese: 他往购物袋里瞥了一眼，又抬起空着的手，像要汇报一项了不起的成就。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I measure people at a Brooklyn tailoring shop. Thirty inseams yesterday. Today, rehearsing for apples. Excellent range.
beats.chinese: 我在布鲁克林一家裁缝店给人量尺寸。昨天量了三十条裤子的内长，今天给苹果排练登场介绍。业务范围真广。

choices.english: I'd like to look around without chatting, please.
choices.chinese: 我想自己看看，先不聊天了，谢谢。

choices.english: One more joke is fine, if it's about you.
choices.chinese: 可以再讲一个，不过得拿你自己开玩笑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon starts to raise his free hand for another introduction, then holds it halfway up.
beats.chinese: Devon刚要抬起空着的手再做一番介绍，动作停在半途。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. No speech. The apples have also declined interviews.
beats.chinese: 好，不致辞。苹果也拒绝接受采访。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens his mouth, closes it, and lowers his hand. After checking the aisle, he moves a few paces farther along it to wait.
beats.chinese: 他张了张嘴，又闭上，把手放下。确认通道畅通后，他沿着原来的通道走开几步，继续等人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Okay, leaving it there. Have a good one.
beats.chinese: 好，就说到这儿。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon squares his shoulders toward the tote, giving the apples his full ceremonial attention.
beats.chinese: Devon朝着购物袋挺直肩膀，煞有介事地把全部注意力交给苹果。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Please welcome the apples. No speech prepared, excellent attendance, and every single one remembered to wear a sticker.
beats.chinese: 有请苹果登场。没准备发言，出勤率优秀，而且每一位都记得佩戴贴纸。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives the bag a tiny bow, then settles it against his leg and offers you a quick farewell wave.
beats.chinese: 他向袋子微微鞠躬，随后让它重新贴好腿，朝你挥手道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the whole ceremony. Thanks for coming. I'll let you get back to the market.
beats.chinese: 仪式到此结束。感谢出席。你继续逛吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon's raised hand drops immediately. He turns slightly so he is no longer facing you directly.
beats.chinese: Devon立刻放下抬着的手，稍稍转身，不再正面对着你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Got it. Enjoy looking around.
beats.chinese: 明白。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He adjusts his grip on the tote and turns his attention down the aisle toward the passing shoppers.
beats.chinese: 他重新握稳购物袋，把注意力转向通道里来往的顾客。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait here for my coworker. Take care.
beats.chinese: 我在这儿等同事。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon taps his own chest with his free hand, accepting the restriction without looking for another target.
beats.chinese: Devon用空着的手拍拍自己的胸口，接受了这个限制，没有另找取笑对象。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Easy. No surprise roasts. I played badminton this week. My best shot was apologizing to the shuttle.
beats.chinese: 没问题。不搞突然袭击式吐槽。我这周打羽毛球了，发挥最好的一下，是向球道歉。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He mimes one small, hopeless swing close to his body, then closes his hand around the tote straps again.
beats.chinese: 他贴着身体比画了一个毫无胜算的小挥拍动作，随后重新攥住袋带。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my one. Enjoy the market. I'm going to stand here and look like a responsible apple owner.
beats.chinese: 一个讲完。逛得开心。我得站在这儿，装成一个负责任的苹果持有人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the open Union Square Market, Devon Achebe recognizes you beside the wide aisle between the tents. He smiles and lifts a hand in greeting.
beats.chinese: 后来一次逛正在营业的联合广场农夫市集时，Devon Achebe在帐篷间的宽通道旁认出了你。他笑着抬手打招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. Just here for bread today. Don't really feel like being in charge of the mood.
beats.chinese: 嘿，今天只想买点面包。暂时不太想负责活跃气氛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks toward the stalls for a little while without adding another joke, keeping the aisle clear.
beats.chinese: 他朝摊位方向安静地看了一会儿，没有追加笑话，也没有挡住通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm taking a break today. You haven't made things awkward. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 我今天歇会儿。不是你冷场。见到你挺好。

causality.presenceReason: Devon已为裁缝店生日午餐买好苹果，正在市集等仍在采购的同事。
causality.placeAttitude: 初遇时，他把市集当成轻松的午餐采购地点，等待时对着苹果排练滑稽介绍。重逢时，他只是来买面包，当天不想承担活跃气氛的角色。
causality.stayingConstraint: 初遇时，他需要留在约定的帐篷间通道附近等同事，购物袋由他保管。
causality.currentGoal: 初遇时，他要保管好苹果、等到同事，并用排练登场介绍打发等待时间，没有要求路人评价表演。
causality.currentState: 初遇时精力充沛，开玩笑的冲动较强，容易在对方准备结束交流时再补一句。重逢时社交能量较低，仍温和地打招呼，但不追加包袱。
causality.contactTrigger: Devon看着袋内苹果排练滑稽的登场介绍，注意到近处的玩家后，主动解释这是店里生日午餐用的苹果，表示自己没答应负责致辞，并自报姓名。没有袋带侵扰或其他物理惊扰。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留布鲁克林裁缝店量体助理身份、快节奏幽默、羽毛球爱好及用笑话填补停顿的习惯。他只拿自己和随身物品开玩笑。重逢时暂时不想表演，体现当天精力变化，不改变其平日外向、在意气氛的性格。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Union Square Market, Marcus Feld stands clear of the flow between the tents, his shopping bag against his leg. He lifts one leaf just above the bag, keeping it in front of himself.
beats.chinese: 联合广场农夫市集里，Marcus Feld站在帐篷之间、不妨碍人流的位置，购物袋贴在腿边。他把一片叶子稍稍举到袋口上方，收在自己身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I bought this mainly for printing onto fabric. What do you notice first, the veins or the edges? I'm Marcus.
beats.chinese: 我买它主要为了在布上拓印。你第一眼注意的是叶脉，还是边缘？我叫Marcus。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks from the leaf to your face, openly waiting for a reaction. The bag stays against his leg.
beats.chinese: 他的视线从叶子移到你脸上，毫不掩饰地等着你的反应。袋子始终贴在他的腿边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm waiting for my friend to finish shopping. I've been staring at these so long, I wanted a fresh pair of eyes.
beats.chinese: 我在等朋友买完东西。这些叶子我盯着看太久了，就想听听别人第一眼会注意到什么。

choices.english: The veins. How do you use the leaves?
choices.chinese: 叶脉。你怎么用这些叶子？

choices.english: I'd rather not hear a long story.
choices.chinese: 我不太想听长篇故事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcus lifts one leafy stem just above the bag. He keeps it close.
beats.chinese: Marcus把一根带叶子的茎稍稍提到袋口上方，收在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We put leaves against fabric and hammer the colour through. I cut wooden jigsaw puzzles all week. Weekends, different noise.
beats.chinese: 把叶子贴着布敲，让颜色印上去。我平时整周都切木头拼图，周末换一种响声。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He watches your face, his grin lingering. Then he lowers the stem.
beats.chinese: 他看着你的表情，脸上的笑容迟迟没收起来。随后，他把茎放低。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Even the tiny veins can leave a mark. Those little branching lines. Were those what caught your eye?
beats.chinese: 连细小的叶脉都能留下印子。就是那些分叉的小线条。你注意到的是那些吗？

choices.english: Yes, those little lines. I'll leave you to your friend. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 对，就是那些小线条。你等朋友吧，再见。

choices.english: Just the short leaf story, please. Then I'll go.
choices.chinese: 简单讲讲叶子的事就好。听完我就走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcus nods and tucks the loose leaves inward, keeping the bag against his leg.
beats.chinese: Marcus点点头，把散开的叶子拢进袋子，袋子仍贴在腿边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll keep it short.
beats.chinese: 当然。我简短点说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He starts to raise the bag again, catches himself, and keeps it against his leg.
beats.chinese: 他刚想再提起袋子，又停住了，继续把它贴在腿边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My friend's finishing their shopping. I'll wait here and keep these tucked in.
beats.chinese: 我朋友还在买最后几样东西。我就在这里等，把叶子收好。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll carry on. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。那我继续走了，再见。

choices.english: Before I go, are the beets for dinner?
choices.chinese: 走之前问一句，甜菜是准备当晚饭的吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcus's grin widens immediately. He gives a small bow without swinging the bag.
beats.chinese: Marcus立刻笑得更开了。他微微欠身，手里的袋子倒是稳稳没动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. That's exactly what I'm hoping to get on the fabric.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我就希望能把那些线条印在布上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He raises his free hand in farewell, then turns his attention toward the shoppers between the tents.
beats.chinese: 他抬起空着的手道别，随后转头望向帐篷间的购物人群。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye! Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 再见！祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcus draws breath for a longer answer, then closes his mouth briefly and holds up one finger.
beats.chinese: Marcus吸了口气，像是准备长篇大论，随即短暂地闭上嘴，竖起一根手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Short version. My friends bring the fabric, I bring leaves, and we see what marks they leave. I usually bring far too many.
beats.chinese: 简短版。朋友带布，我带叶子，大家看看能印出什么样。我一般都带得太多。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He settles the greens inside the bag and folds its top loosely around them, ending the display.
beats.chinese: 他把菜叶放回袋子里，松松地拢好袋口，结束了展示。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I managed the short version. Thanks for stopping. Bye.
beats.chinese: 好了。居然真让我讲了个简短版。谢谢你停下来聊，再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcus keeps the bag against his leg and gives a quick nod.
beats.chinese: Marcus把袋子贴在腿边，轻轻点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye. I'll let you get on.
beats.chinese: 再见。不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns sideways to keep the passage open and scans the market for his friend.
beats.chinese: 他侧过身，让通道保持畅通，转而在人群里寻找朋友。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcus looks down into the bag as though the beets have only just become his responsibility.
beats.chinese: Marcus低头看看袋子，仿佛直到这时才想起自己还得处理那些甜菜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They are now. I'll roast them. I got so pleased with the leaves that I forgot the rest was coming home too.
beats.chinese: 现在是了。我会把它们烤了。刚才光顾着高兴叶子不错，都忘了剩下的部分也得一起带回家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a folded shopping list from his pocket and adds a word in pencil. His attention settles on the list.
beats.chinese: 他从口袋里掏出折好的购物清单，用铅笔添了一个词，注意力也落到了清单上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oil. Nearly forgot that. Thanks for the reminder, and goodbye.
beats.chinese: 油。差点忘了。谢谢提醒，再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another market day at Union Square Market, Marcus Feld checks his dinner shopping list, standing clear of the flow between the tents. He recognizes you and lifts a hand.
beats.chinese: 另一个开市日，Marcus Feld站在联合广场农夫市集帐篷间通道的人流外，核对晚餐采购清单。他认出你，抬手招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello! Good to see you. I'm using both the beets and the leaves tonight. Just deciding what to start first.
beats.chinese: 噢，你好！见到你真好。今晚我打算把甜菜和叶子都用上。正在决定先做哪一道。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He uses his pencil to swap the order of two steps on the paper. He reads them through carefully, then smiles as he makes up his mind.
beats.chinese: 他用铅笔在纸上把两个步骤交换了顺序，认真看了一遍，露出拿定主意的笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Leaves first. The beets can roast slowly. I still need one more thing. I'll go look for it.
beats.chinese: 好了，先弄叶子，甜菜慢慢烤。我还缺一样，去找找。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At New York's Union Square Market, Clive Bennett has finished buying apples. He stands at the edge of the aisle between the tents, clear of the moving crowd, holding his shopping bag securely and running his thumb over a broad canvas handle. He notices you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在纽约联合广场农夫市集，Clive Bennett刚买好苹果。他站在帐篷间通道的边上，不挡来往人流，稳稳提着购物袋，用拇指摸着宽宽的帆布提手。他注意到近处的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If you're looking for a shopping bag, wide handles are worth a feel. This one's full of apples and it doesn't dig into my hand.
beats.chinese: 要是你正打算买购物袋，宽提手值得摸一摸。我这个装了苹果也不勒手。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Clive keeps the bag beside his leg, with both handles resting securely in his hand.
beats.chinese: Clive仍把袋子提在腿边，两根提手稳稳握在手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Clive, by the way. Lovely thick canvas, too. Worth spending a bit extra.
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫Clive。这厚帆布也真不错。多花一点也值得。

choices.english: What makes that one worth it?
choices.chinese: 这个袋子好在哪里？

choices.english: No thanks. I'm not looking for a shopping bag.
choices.chinese: 不用了，谢谢。我没打算买购物袋。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Clive lifts the handles just enough to show their stitched edges, keeping the bag close to his body.
beats.chinese: Clive稍稍提起提手，露出缝边，袋子仍紧贴着身体。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Wide handles. No thin edge digging into your fingers. I fit curtain tracks part-time, and my hands get quite enough punishment there.
beats.chinese: 提手宽，没有细细的边勒进手指。我还在兼职装窗帘轨道，干活时手已经够受罪了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rubs the doubled fabric between finger and thumb, warming to the subject.
beats.chinese: 他用拇指和食指捻了捻双层布料，越说越起劲。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd pay double for a handle like that. Spread over a few years, you'd hardly notice the extra. And the stitching—well, I could go on. You're welcome to feel it if you like.
beats.chinese: 为了这样的提手，我愿意多花一倍。摊到几年里，那点差价几乎感觉不到。还有这针脚——哎，我能一直说下去。你要是愿意，可以摸摸。

choices.english: May I feel the handle?
choices.chinese: 我能摸摸提手吗？

choices.english: That's more than I'd want to spend on a shopping bag.
choices.chinese: 我不想在购物袋上花那么多钱。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Clive lowers the handle immediately. His smile stays easy.
beats.chinese: Clive立刻放下提手，脸上仍是轻松的笑容。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I'll keep my bag opinions to myself.
beats.chinese: 好啊。袋子这方面的见解，我就自己留着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks into the open bag and spots his paper-wrapped sandwiches beneath the apples.
beats.chinese: 他往敞开的袋子里一看，发现纸包的三明治压在苹果下面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, lovely. I've put the apples on my sandwiches. All that fuss about the bag, and I've flattened my lunch.
beats.chinese: 哦，这下好了。我把苹果放在三明治上了。光顾着讲究袋子，午饭倒给压扁了。

choices.english: I'll give you some room to sort that out.
choices.chinese: 我让开一点，你整理吧。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Have a good day.
choices.chinese: 那不打扰你了。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Clive supports the bag's weight and holds one handle within reach. You feel the thick, soft canvas without taking the bag.
beats.chinese: Clive自己承住袋子的重量，把一根提手递到你手边。你没有接过袋子，只摸了摸厚实柔软的帆布。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There, that rounded edge. That's the bit I like. Some of them feel like carrying your shopping by a shoelace.
beats.chinese: 就是这儿，这道圆润的边。我喜欢的就是它。有些袋子提起来，简直像用鞋带拎东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Once you release the handle, he gathers both handles into one hand and turns along the clear aisle.
beats.chinese: 你松开提手后，他把两根提手拢进一只手，转向畅通的通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, these apples need to get home. Enjoy your look round.
beats.chinese: 好了，该把这些苹果带回家了。你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Clive stops rubbing the fabric and lowers the bag.
beats.chinese: Clive不再捻那块布，把袋子放低。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair point. A plain cotton bag carries apples perfectly well. I get carried away with handles and seams.
beats.chinese: 说得对。普通棉布袋装苹果也完全够用。我一说起提手和缝线就容易来劲。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rolls the handles together once, settles his grip and steps back to leave the aisle open.
beats.chinese: 他把提手拢着卷了一下，握稳袋子，往后退开，留出通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave your shopping decisions alone. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 你买东西怎么选，我就不掺和了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You give him more room. Clive keeps the bag suspended in one hand and carefully draws out the sandwich parcel with the other.
beats.chinese: 你往旁边让开一点。Clive一手提着袋子，另一手小心地抽出三明治纸包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. Nothing's escaped the paper. That's something.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。好在没什么从纸包里漏出来。还算不错。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He places the parcel on top of the apples and folds the bag's opening loosely over it.
beats.chinese: 他把纸包放到苹果上面，再把袋口松松地折拢。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Lunch on top, heavy things underneath. I'll get this lot home now. Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 好了。午饭在上，重东西在下。我这就把这些带回家。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Clive takes his hand away from the bag's opening and lets the sandwiches stay where they are.
beats.chinese: Clive把手从袋口移开，三明治还是留在原处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. I'll eat the evidence when I get home.
beats.chinese: 你也是。我回家就把证据吃掉。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives you a brief wave, secures the bag against his hip and starts along the aisle between the tents.
beats.chinese: 他朝你轻轻挥了下手，把袋子稳稳贴在胯侧，沿着帐篷间的通道走开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A slightly thinner sandwich won't spoil my afternoon. Cheerio.
beats.chinese: 三明治薄一点，还不至于毁了我的下午。再见啦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another market day at Union Square, Clive stands at the edge of the aisle between the tents, clear of the moving crowd, holding an open coffee flask. He recognises you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 又一个开市日，Clive站在联合广场市集帐篷间的通道边，不挡来往人流，手里握着已经打开的保温杯。他认出你，笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again! Brought this coffee from home. It's cooled down nicely. Just the temperature I like.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了！这咖啡是从家里带来的。现在已经不烫了，正是我喜欢的温度。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a small sip and opens his mouth to say more about the coffee. Then he looks back into the flask, still wanting another sip, and stops with a satisfied smile.
beats.chinese: 他喝了一小口，张了张嘴，本来还想继续推荐这咖啡。随后他低头看看杯里，自己还没喝够，便带着满意的笑容收住了话头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This is worth sipping slowly. I'll stand here and enjoy it for a bit. Enjoy your look round.
beats.chinese: 这口值得慢点喝。我先站这儿享受一会儿，你慢慢逛。

causality.presenceReason: Clive在玩家出现前已来市集买苹果，并带着自备的三明治午饭。
causality.placeAttitude: 他喜欢逛市集，也会对随身用品的触感和做工格外起劲。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须久留的任务，购物袋已稳稳提好，他可以结束闲聊后带着苹果和午饭回家。
causality.currentGoal: 把买好的苹果带回家，临走前因宽提手的手感而停下来端详，并想向近处的人分享这点好处。
causality.currentState: 心情轻松、愿意聊天，注意力被提手细节吸引，暂时忽略了袋内午饭被苹果压住。
causality.contactTrigger: 他站在通道边稳稳提着袋子，用拇指感受宽提手，看到近处的玩家后，以“要是你正打算买购物袋”为前提主动推荐，并介绍自己叫Clive。没有碰撞、避让或道歉，也没有假定玩家需要购买或直接递出物品。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留兼职安装窗帘轨道、重视手感、热衷小享受、容易长篇推荐及忽略别人预算的特点。他在玩家表示兴趣后才邀请触摸，并立即接受明确拒绝。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家询问优点后，他兴致更高，谈起提手、价格和针脚并邀请触摸。aa让玩家触摸提手后带苹果离开。ab接受预算差异，停止推介并道别。玩家直接拒绝后，他立即收住推荐，转而发现午饭被压住。ba获得空间后把三明治移到苹果上，整理完离开。bb不再整理，以吃掉证据的小玩笑告别。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Steeplechase Pier at Coney Island, Harvey Lindqvist sits on a bench with a notebook. He came to sketch an imaginary island and rest his knees. As you come near, he lifts his canvas bag off the seat.
beats.chinese: 在康尼岛的 Steeplechase Pier 栈桥上，Harvey Lindqvist 正拿着笔记本坐在长椅上。他来画一座虚构的岛，也让膝盖歇歇。你走近时，他把帆布包从座位上拿开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Seat's free if you want it. My bag's been getting more rest than I have. I'm Harvey.
beats.chinese: 想坐就坐，这儿空着。我的包歇得比我还够。我叫 Harvey。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the bag between his shoes and holds down a curling notebook page with his palm.
beats.chinese: 他把包放在两脚之间，用手掌压住被风掀起的本子页面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My knees called off the rest of my walk. How's your day treating you?
beats.chinese: 我的膝盖宣布，今天剩下的路不走了。你今天过得怎么样？

choices.english: I'll sit, thanks. My only complaint is this wind.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，那我坐会儿。我唯一想抱怨的就是这风。

choices.english: Thanks, I'll stay standing. No complaints to trade.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我站着就好。没什么烦心事可聊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harvey shifts his notebook onto his own knee as you sit. He looks toward the water, then back at the page lifting under his hand.
beats.chinese: 你坐下时，Harvey 把笔记本挪到自己膝上。他看看海面，又看看手底下被风吹起的纸页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, it gets right in your ears. Though my client left a cushion outside all winter and blamed my stitching for the mold. I think I've got you there.
beats.chinese: 是啊，直往耳朵里灌。不过我的客户把靠垫在外头放了一冬天，长了霉还怪我的针脚。这一局我可比你惨。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pins the page with two fingers. A penciled coastline shows beneath his hand.
beats.chinese: 他用两根手指钉住纸页，手底下露出一段铅笔画的海岸线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Forty years sewing boat canvas, and apparently I also control the weather.
beats.chinese: 缝了四十来年船用帆布，原来我还得管天气。

choices.english: I'm not entering a contest. I'll leave you to your drawing.
choices.chinese: 我可没打算比赛谁更惨。你接着画吧，我走了。

choices.english: You win on cushions. What's on that page?
choices.chinese: 靠垫这件事算你赢。那页画的是什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harvey leaves the cleared seat alone. His pencil pauses above the notebook as he looks up at you.
beats.chinese: Harvey 没再招呼你坐下。他的铅笔停在本子上方，抬头看着你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nothing at all? A late bus would count. I'm fairly generous about what qualifies.
beats.chinese: 一点儿都没有？公交晚点也算。我这儿的标准挺宽松。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns a page, revealing crossed-out dialogue, then turns back to his drawing.
beats.chinese: 他翻过一页，露出几行划掉的对白，随后又翻回画稿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I brought an island to draw and a radio play to fix. Naturally, I've started collecting somebody else's troubles instead.
beats.chinese: 我带着本子来画岛，还想改改广播剧。结果倒好，又开始打听别人的烦心事了。

choices.english: Really, I'd rather just look at the water.
choices.chinese: 真的，我只想看看海。

choices.english: A radio play? Give me one line.
choices.chinese: 广播剧？来一句听听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harvey's pencil stops. He moves his elbow back onto his side of the bench as you rise.
beats.chinese: Harvey 的铅笔停住了。你起身时，他把胳膊肘收回自己那一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. You mentioned the wind and I dragged a moldy cushion into it.
beats.chinese: 也是。你说的是风，我硬扯进来一个发霉的靠垫。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives you a brief nod as you step away along the pier, then lowers his pencil to the coastline.
beats.chinese: 你沿栈桥走开时，他朝你点了点头，随后落笔继续画海岸线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care. I'll keep the rest of the upholstery complaints to myself.
beats.chinese: 慢走。剩下那些软垫套的牢骚，我自己留着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harvey angles the notebook so you can see without moving closer. The island has three harbors and a narrow strip of hills.
beats.chinese: Harvey 把本子转了个角度，你不用凑近就能看清。纸上的岛有三个港湾，还有狭长的一带山丘。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: An island. Made it up. I keep putting the towns too close together, then there's nowhere left for anybody to get lost.
beats.chinese: 一座岛，编的。我老把城镇画得太近，结果连个能让人迷路的地方都没剩下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He adds one small inlet, closes the notebook, and puts it in his bag. He stands carefully, leaving the bench to you.
beats.chinese: 他添了一处小海湾，合上本子，装进包里。他小心地站起来，把长椅留给你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough geography for me. Enjoy the seat. My knees have approved a short walk.
beats.chinese: 今天的地理就画到这儿。你慢慢坐。我的膝盖批准再走一小段。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harvey lowers the notebook to his lap and looks toward the sea rather than waiting for another answer.
beats.chinese: Harvey 把本子放低到腿上，转眼望向海面，没有再等你解释。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. No further questions from the complaints department.
beats.chinese: 好，牢骚受理处不再追问。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shifts his bag fully beneath the bench, then returns to drawing. His pencil begins adding short marks along the island's shore.
beats.chinese: 他把包完全挪进长椅底下，重新画起来，沿着岛岸添上一道道短线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave you to the water. I've got six miles of imaginary beach to finish.
beats.chinese: 你看海吧。我还有六英里想象出来的沙滩没画完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harvey turns back to the dialogue page. He straightens on the bench and raises his voice just enough for you to hear.
beats.chinese: Harvey 翻回写着对白的那一页。他在长椅上坐直，稍稍提高声音，刚好让你听见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Captain, the island's gone.
beats.chinese: 船长，岛不见了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his chin for the captain's voice, then closes the notebook with a small finishing nod.
beats.chinese: 他压低下巴，准备换成船长的嗓音，又合上本子，轻轻点头作为收场。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Turn the map over. That's the captain's entire contribution. My two friends make me play him. Thanks for the audience. I'll let you get back to the view.
beats.chinese: 把地图翻过来。这就是船长的全部贡献。我那两个朋友非让我演他。谢谢捧场，你接着看风景吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Steeplechase Pier, you see Harvey on a bench with several handwritten pages. He recognizes you and lifts a hand, keeping the loose sheets pinned beneath his notebook.
beats.chinese: 在 Steeplechase Pier ，你看见 Harvey 坐在长椅上，拿着几页手稿。他认出你，抬手打招呼，同时用本子压住散页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've managed to name both villains Frank. Very efficient, until they have a scene together.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我居然把两个反派都起名叫弗兰克。倒是省事，直到他俩要演对手戏。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He crosses out a name and writes another above it, shielding the paper with his forearm.
beats.chinese: 他划掉一个名字，在上面写了个新的，用小臂挡住纸页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One's Leonard now. Same crooked boat dealer, different stationery. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 现在有一个叫伦纳德了。还是那个黑心船商，换套信纸而已。见到你挺好。

causality.presenceReason: Harvey 在玩家到来前已来栈桥画虚构岛屿，顺便歇膝盖，包中也带着待改的广播剧。
causality.placeAttitude: 他愿意来海边消磨一阵，喜欢画海岸，却会抱怨风和自己的膝盖。
causality.stayingConstraint: 膝盖需要短暂休息，让他暂留长椅。没有必须等候玩家或完成工作的安排。
causality.currentGoal: 休息时添几笔地图，有余力再改广播剧对白。
causality.currentState: 今天有闲聊兴致，待人热乎，却忍不住搜集并比较别人的烦心事。
causality.contactTrigger: 玩家走近长椅，他主动拿走占座的包，自报名字并询问近况。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留船用帆布与游艇软包缝纫职业、具体而干涩的笑话、抱怨竞赛习惯，以及地图和广播剧爱好。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 中玩家指出比赛倾向并离开，他认账收口。ab 中玩家转问地图，他展示后起身结束休息。ba 中玩家重申只想看海，他停止追问并画图。bb 中玩家点播对白，他演两个声音后主动结束小表演。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程只使用照片明确的木栈面、长椅和海面。包、纸笔及剧稿均为他随身携带，不转移到其他设施。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Terrence Boyle has come to Steeplechase Pier to read some food manga before heading home. He sits on a bench, his bag at his feet, and looks up from the page toward the sea.
beats.chinese: Terrence Boyle 来到康尼岛的 Steeplechase Pier，打算回家前读会儿美食漫画。他坐在长椅上，包放在脚边，目光从书页移向海面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: How long are they going to argue about this soup?
beats.chinese: 这锅汤还要吵多久？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He says it under his breath, then notices you nearby. He lifts the open manga slightly to show what he means.
beats.chinese: 他低声嘀咕完，才注意到附近的你，便稍稍举起摊开的漫画，解释自己在说什么。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: In the manga. They've been arguing about soup for pages. I'm Terrence, by the way.
beats.chinese: 我是说漫画里。他们已经为汤吵了好几页了。对了，我叫 Terrence。

choices.english: What manga are you reading?
choices.chinese: 你在看什么漫画？

choices.english: I'm just here to look at the water.
choices.chinese: 我只是来看看海。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Terrence tilts the manga cover toward you, keeping a finger between the pages.
beats.chinese: Terrence 把漫画封面朝你倾了倾，一根手指还夹在书页间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Food manga. This guy takes three pages to slice an onion. Somehow I'm completely invested.
beats.chinese: 美食漫画。这家伙切个洋葱用了三页。我居然看得特别投入。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shifts the manga, revealing a small closed sketchbook underneath it.
beats.chinese: 他挪了挪漫画，露出下面一本合着的小素描本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I coordinate pet food sample shipments. Been talking about a manga-style sample box for months. The fun version has a cat chef. The practical version needs somewhere to put the shipping label.
beats.chinese: 我负责宠物食品试吃装的发货协调。漫画风包装盒这事，我念叨好几个月了。有趣的版本里有只猫厨师。实际能用的版本，还得留地方贴运单。

choices.english: Did that box ever get made?
choices.chinese: 那个盒子后来做出来了吗？

choices.english: Is that a sketchbook? Could I have a look?
choices.chinese: 那是素描本吗？能看看吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You look toward the water near the bench. Terrence rests a hand across the open pages.
beats.chinese: 你在长椅附近望向海面。Terrence 把一只手搭在摊开的书页上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I've read this page three times. The water keeps winning.
beats.chinese: 也好。这一页我已经读三遍了，还是海更吸引我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances down at the open manga and laughs through his nose.
beats.chinese: 他低头瞥了眼摊开的漫画，轻轻哼笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two chefs arguing about soup for twelve pages. At this point I'd serve it cold and let them complain about something new.
beats.chinese: 两个厨师为了汤吵了十二页。换我就直接凉着端上去，让他们换个话题抱怨。

choices.english: Now I want to hear what was wrong with the soup.
choices.chinese: 这下我倒想听听，那汤到底有什么问题。

choices.english: I'll keep walking. Enjoy the soup argument.
choices.chinese: 我继续走走。你慢慢看他们吵汤吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Terrence's answer comes quickly. Then he lowers the manga onto his knees.
beats.chinese: Terrence 答得很快，随后把漫画放低，搁在膝头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Dana built it. We work together. I helped pack the first shipment. She got that little cat apron right.
beats.chinese: Dana 做出来了。我们是同事。第一批货我帮着装的。那只猫的小围裙，她做得真不错。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens a phone note headed 'Box idea,' scrolls past an unfinished list, then locks the screen. His smile fades a little as he picks the manga up again.
beats.chinese: 他打开手机里标题为“盒子点子”的笔记，划过一份没写完的清单，又锁上屏幕。重新拿起漫画时，他脸上的笑意淡了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mine's mostly bullet points. Hers actually shipped. Good work. Anyway, I'd better find out whether this onion survives.
beats.chinese: 我这儿基本还是几条提纲。她那个已经发出去了。做得真好。好了，我得接着看看这颗洋葱能不能活下来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Terrence rests a palm on the closed sketchbook. His voice stays easy.
beats.chinese: Terrence 把一只手掌搭在合着的素描本上，语气仍然轻松。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, I keep that one to myself. Mostly hands. Coworkers holding scanners, pulling tape, that sort of thing.
beats.chinese: 啊，那本我留着自己看。主要画手。同事拿扫描器、扯胶带之类的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the manga in his bag, opens the sketchbook toward himself, and positions his free hand on his knee. He begins drawing its curled fingers.
beats.chinese: 他把漫画收进包里，将素描本朝自己打开，另一只手放在膝头，开始画微微蜷起的手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one's available without a warehouse shift. Enjoy the view. I'm going to catch that thumb before I move it.
beats.chinese: 这只手不用去仓库上班也能画到。你慢慢看海，我趁拇指还没挪窝，赶紧画两笔。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Terrence lifts one finger from the page, suddenly ready to present the case.
beats.chinese: Terrence 从书页上抬起一根手指，立刻摆出了要讲清来龙去脉的架势。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One says it needs salt. The other says adding salt would insult his teacher. The customer has said nothing. Poor guy's probably eaten the napkin.
beats.chinese: 一个说得加盐，另一个说加盐就是侮辱他的师父。客人一句话都没说。可怜的人，估计已经把餐巾吃了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the page, reads the next panel, and lets out a short laugh. Then he closes the manga around his bookmark and looks out over the sea.
beats.chinese: 他翻过一页，看了下一格，短促地笑了一声。随后把书签夹好，合上漫画，望向海面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He ordered tea. Sensible man. Right, that's enough soup for me. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 他点了茶。明白人。好了，今天的汤看到这儿吧。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the wooden deck. Terrence raises his hand briefly from the book.
beats.chinese: 你沿着木栈面继续往前走。Terrence 暂时把手从书上抬起，挥了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Enjoy the water.
beats.chinese: 谢了。慢慢看海。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his hand to the open manga and finds his place on the page.
beats.chinese: 他把手放回摊开的漫画上，找到刚才读到的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Twelve pages. This had better be very good soup.
beats.chinese: 十二页啊。这汤最好真有那么好喝。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Steeplechase Pier, Terrence Boyle closes a food manga on his knees and recognises you from the bench.
beats.chinese: 在康尼岛Steeplechase栈桥，Terrence Boyle坐在长凳上，合上膝头的美食漫画，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello. Read the whole thing waiting for the chef to win. His grandmother won. She entered at the last minute.
beats.chinese: 噢，又见面了。我一直等着那个厨师赢，整本都读完了。结果他奶奶赢了，最后一刻才报名。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He laughs, turns the book over to look at the cake on the back cover, then tucks it under his arm.
beats.chinese: 他笑起来，翻过书看看封底的蛋糕，才把书夹到腋下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good ending. Terrible book to read before lunch. I want that cake now. See you around.
beats.chinese: 结尾不错。午饭前读它真是失策。我现在想吃那个蛋糕。回头见。

causality.presenceReason: Terrence 下班后的个人出行中，来 Steeplechase Pier 读美食漫画，打算回家前待一会儿。

causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留下的任务，也没有必须完成的阅读量，可以自行结束阅读。

causality.currentState: 当下放松，愿意短聊，开场带着对漫画的投入和幽默。聊到自己迟迟未落实的包装点子时，语气与笑意明显收敛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Steeplechase Pier at Coney Island, Harold Wexler sits with his jacket and a folded theater program on his lap. After watching the evening light on the shorefront rides for a while, he turns toward you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在康尼岛的障碍赛码头，哈罗德·韦克斯勒坐在长椅上，外套和折好的剧场节目册都放在自己腿上。他看了一会儿岸上游乐设施映着的暮光，转向近处的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was only going to read a couple of pages. Now the light's more interesting than the program.
beats.chinese: 刚才还只想翻两页，这会儿光倒比节目册好看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances back toward the rides, keeping the jacket and program on his lap.
beats.chinese: 他又朝游乐设施望了一眼，外套和节目册仍放在自己腿上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Harold, by the way. I stopped here on a whim to take a look.
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫哈罗德。我就是临时起意，停下来看看。

choices.english: I'll sit at the other end for a bit and watch the light.
choices.chinese: 我在长椅另一头坐一会儿，看看这光。

choices.english: I'll stand here. Are you waiting for someone?
choices.chinese: 我站这儿就好。你在等人吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With you seated at the other end, Harold starts to slide farther along the bench.
beats.chinese: 你在长椅另一端坐下后，哈罗德开始往旁边挪。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Let me move over. No, we've got plenty of room.
beats.chinese: 我再挪挪。不用，地方够宽敞。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He settles back into precisely his original spot and plants his shoes beside the same seam in the boards.
beats.chinese: 他又坐回原来的位置，两只鞋重新停在木板上同一条接缝旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Look at that light on the rides. At a theater, I'd have paid for this seat.
beats.chinese: 瞧游乐设施上的光。这要是在剧院，这个位子可得花钱。

choices.english: Do you watch the lighting at the theater too?
choices.chinese: 你在剧院也会留意灯光吗？

choices.english: I'll take a look from the railing. Thanks for the seat.
choices.chinese: 我去栏杆边看看。谢谢你让座。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harold keeps his jacket and program on his lap. He turns slightly toward you without getting up.
beats.chinese: 哈罗德仍把外套和节目册放在腿上。他没有起身，只是稍稍转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, just me. I hadn't planned this stop, but the light looked good.
beats.chinese: 没有，就我一个。本来没打算在这儿停，不过这光看着真不错。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He straightens the folded program on top of his jacket.
beats.chinese: 他把外套上折好的节目册摆正。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I keep a little cash for detours. Today's detour is free, and I brought my own reading. Big spender.
beats.chinese: 我留了点钱，专门花在临时起意的事上。今天这趟不用花钱，读物也是自带的。真够阔气。

choices.english: What are you reading?
choices.chinese: 你在看什么？

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Enjoy the view.
choices.chinese: 那就不打扰了。好好欣赏风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harold turns toward you, lifting the program just enough to reveal its worn fold.
beats.chinese: 哈罗德转向你，稍稍举起节目册，露出已经磨旧的折痕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Constantly. Everyone's watching the lead. I'm wondering who picked that green.
beats.chinese: 老看。大家都盯着主角，我在琢磨是谁选了那个绿色。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the program and looks back toward the shore, a small grin lingering.
beats.chinese: 他放下节目册，重新望向岸上，嘴边还带着一点笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Saw a stage turn deep blue before the curtain rose once. Empty chairs, one bright doorway. That stayed with me longer than the first scene. Anyway, enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 有次开幕前，整个舞台变成深蓝色。空椅子，一扇亮着的门。那个画面比第一场戏留得还久。好了，你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You leave the bench and move to the railing. Harold keeps his jacket on his lap.
beats.chinese: 你离开长椅，走到栏杆边。哈罗德仍把外套放在腿上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. I'll hold down this end.
beats.chinese: 好。我继续守着这一头。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the program, finds a page with his thumb, and settles back against the bench.
beats.chinese: 他打开节目册，用拇指翻到一页，重新靠在椅背上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good evening.
beats.chinese: 祝你今晚愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harold unfolds the program on his lap, keeping its pages out of the breeze.
beats.chinese: 哈罗德在腿上展开节目册，拢着书页，不让风吹乱。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A program from a musical. Couldn't hum you a thing from it. Terrific lighting, though.
beats.chinese: 一本音乐剧的节目册。里面的歌，我一首都哼不出来。不过灯光真棒。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes it, slips it into his jacket pocket, and puts the jacket on. Then he gets up and takes an open spot at the railing.
beats.chinese: 他合上节目册，塞进口袋，穿好外套。随后他站起身，走到栏杆边一处空着的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enough reading. I've come all this way and barely looked at the sea. Enjoy your evening.
beats.chinese: 先不看了。来都来了，海还没看上几眼呢。祝你今晚愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harold gives you a small nod and shifts the jacket so the program can lie flat.
beats.chinese: 哈罗德向你轻轻点头，挪了挪外套，好把节目册摊平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Good evening to you.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。也祝你今晚愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the program and runs one finger down the page until he finds his place.
beats.chinese: 他打开节目册，手指沿着书页往下移，找到了刚才读到的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, there. Lighting credits. That's my page.
beats.chinese: 啊，在这儿。灯光制作名单。这页归我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Steeplechase Pier, you see Harold sitting on a bench, watching the light toward shore. An open theater program rests on his lap. He recognizes you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 在障碍赛码头，你看见哈罗德坐在长椅上，望着岸上的光线。一本打开的剧场节目册放在他腿上。他认出你，笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I was only going to stop for a minute. Think I'll sit a little longer.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。原本只打算停一下。现在想再坐一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the program and leaves it on his lap, turning his attention back to the view.
beats.chinese: 他合上节目册，仍放在腿上，注意力又回到眼前的景色。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Today's schedule has changed. Nothing else lined up for now. You do your thing. I'll watch a little longer.
beats.chinese: 今天的日程改了。暂时没有下一项。你随意，我再看一会儿。

causality.presenceReason: 哈罗德临时在码头停留，想看暮光落在岸上游乐设施上的样子，并带着旧音乐剧节目册消磨片刻。

causality.currentState: 精神轻快，愿意就眼前光线分享一句随口的感受，也能接受对方站着或直接结束交谈。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Washington Square Park, Marisol Ferrante sits on the dry fountain's steps with a paperback after a neighborhood walk. Skateboarders move inside the basin. Keeping the book angled inward, Marisol finishes the last page and looks up at you nearby.
beats.chinese: 华盛顿广场上，Marisol Ferrante在街区散步后，坐在干涸喷泉的台阶上看一本平装书。有人在盆地里滑板。Marisol始终把书朝着自己，看完最后一页后，抬头看向近处的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Quick reading-habit question. Do you ever read the ending first? I've just finished it. I won't say what happens.
beats.chinese: 只问个读书习惯。你会先看结尾吗？我刚看完，内容不会说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol rests the book on their knees, keeping a thumb on the final page and the pages facing inward.
beats.chinese: Marisol把书放在膝上，用拇指压着最后一页，书页仍然朝着自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Marisol. I always start here. Saves three hundred pages of worrying.
beats.chinese: 我叫Marisol。我总是从这里开始看。省得提心吊胆地读上三百页。

choices.english: How do you enjoy a story when you already know the ending?
choices.chinese: 已经知道结尾了，怎么还能享受故事呢？

choices.english: I don't read endings first. I don't want any spoilers.
choices.chinese: 我不会先看结尾。我不想被剧透。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol keeps a thumb on the final page, leaving the book turned away from you.
beats.chinese: Marisol的拇指仍压着最后一页，书页也依然背着你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I notice more. Little clues, odd things people say. Like when the sister—nope, not saying it.
beats.chinese: 我能注意到更多东西。小线索，人物说的怪话。比如那个姐姐——不，不说了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They stop mid-gesture, then place their free hand flat on their knee.
beats.chinese: 手势做到一半，Marisol停了下来，把空着的那只手平放在膝上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I forget people want the worrying part. Do you actually enjoy that?
beats.chinese: 我总忘了，有人就是想要那种悬着心的感觉。你真的喜欢吗？

choices.english: I like finding things out as I go. I'll leave you to your ending and keep walking.
choices.chinese: 我喜欢边读边发现。你慢慢看结尾，我继续走走。

choices.english: Maybe I'll try your way sometime. Go on, start yours.
choices.chinese: 也许哪天我会试试你的读法。你接着看吧，从头开始。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol closes the paperback around one finger, keeping its pages out of view.
beats.chinese: Marisol用一根手指夹住页码，合上平装书，不让书页露出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Absolutely. I schedule events at a Brooklyn bookstore. Other people's endings stay private.
beats.chinese: 当然。我在布鲁克林一家书店安排活动。别人的结尾，我会保密。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They slide a paper bookmark into place and turn the front cover outward.
beats.chinese: Marisol夹好一张纸书签，把封面朝外转过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The cover's safe. There's a summary on the back, so I'll keep that to myself too.
beats.chinese: 封面很安全。封底有内容简介，那个我也不朝着你。

choices.english: I'd like to see the cover, though. Just the title, no summary.
choices.chinese: 不过我想看看封面。只看书名，不听简介。

choices.english: Enjoy your book. I'll keep walking.
choices.chinese: 祝你读得开心。我继续走走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the fountain, Marisol lowers the book and gives you a small wave.
beats.chinese: 你沿着喷泉继续走。Marisol放低书，朝你轻轻挥了挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I keep forgetting that part can be fun for someone else.
beats.chinese: 明白了。我老是忘记，对别人来说那部分也可能很好玩。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn back two pages, keeping the book angled inward.
beats.chinese: Marisol往前翻了两页，书仍然朝着自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your walk. I'm going to read those last two pages again.
beats.chinese: 散步愉快。我再读一遍最后这两页。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol lifts the book slightly, then pauses before opening it.
beats.chinese: Marisol把书稍微举高，翻开前又停了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Try it with something you don't mind experimenting on. A mystery reader once got very cross with me.
beats.chinese: 拿一本你愿意试验的书试试吧。有个爱看推理的朋友曾经为这事气坏了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn to chapter one, smooth the page, and settle the book on their knees.
beats.chinese: Marisol翻到第一章，把书页抚平，将书放稳在膝上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Now I can read the whole thing. Enjoy the square.
beats.chinese: 好了。现在可以从头读完了。祝你在广场逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol holds the front cover steady. The title reads The Missing Tuesday.
beats.chinese: Marisol稳稳举着封面。书名是《消失的星期二》。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The Missing Tuesday. I bought it for the title. I've nearly lost a Tuesday in the events calendar myself.
beats.chinese: 《消失的星期二》。我冲着书名买的。我自己排活动日历时，也差点把一个星期二弄没了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lower the book into the tote at their feet, stretch their fingers, and turn toward the skateboarders in the basin.
beats.chinese: Marisol把书收进脚边的布袋，舒展了一下手指，转头看向盆地里的滑板者。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough pages for a minute. I'm going to watch the boards. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 先歇会儿，不看字了。我看看滑板。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue on your way. Marisol keeps the book closed long enough to wave goodbye.
beats.chinese: 你继续往前走。Marisol先没翻开书，抬手向你道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They open the book at the bookmark and shift it closer to their lap, out of passing sightlines.
beats.chinese: Marisol翻到书签夹着的位置，把书往腿上收了收，避开路人的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Nobody else needs to read this page with me.
beats.chinese: 这样就好。不用让别人陪我一起看这一页。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Washington Square Park, Marisol is on the dry fountain's steps, closing a small handwritten calendar. Skateboarders move inside the basin. Marisol spots you and raises a hand in greeting.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到华盛顿广场时，Marisol正坐在干涸喷泉的台阶上，合起一本小小的手写日历。盆地里有人滑板。Marisol看见你，抬手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm done checking schedules for today. Time to read the middle of my novel.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天不再检查安排了。接下来该读小说中间那一段了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol puts the calendar away and takes out a novel with a bookmark already in place, opening it at the marked page.
beats.chinese: Marisol收好日历，拿出一本已经夹好书签的小说，翻到书签所在的那一页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I already know the ending. Now I get to see how they get there. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 结尾已经知道了，现在轮到看看他们怎么走过去。见到你真好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Washington Square Park, Frank Delgado sits on the fountain steps after his shift proofreading movie captions. He is waiting for his longtime friend Eddie, with his coat folded on his lap. People linger on the steps, and skateboarders keep rolling across the dry basin. You are nearby.
beats.chinese: 华盛顿广场的喷泉台阶上，Frank Delgado 刚结束电影字幕校对的班次，正在等老朋友埃迪，叠好的外套放在腿上。有人在台阶上停留，滑板的人不断滑过无水的盆地。你就在附近。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Been coming here long?
beats.chinese: 常来这里吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frank turns from the skateboarders to look at you. His coat stays folded on his lap.
beats.chinese: Frank 将目光从滑板的人身上移开，看向你。外套仍叠放在他腿上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm waiting for an old friend.
beats.chinese: 我在等一个老朋友。

choices.english: It's my first visit. Who are you waiting for?
choices.chinese: 我是第一次来。你在等谁？

choices.english: I'd rather just watch the skating, thanks.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我想只看看滑板。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frank folds one sleeve over the other on his lap. His answer comes slowly, while his eyes move across the people on the steps.
beats.chinese: Frank 将腿上外套的两只袖子叠好。他慢慢回答，目光扫过台阶上的人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eddie. We've known each other thirty years. We meet here after my matinee caption shift.
beats.chinese: 埃迪。认识三十年了。我做完日场字幕的工作，就在这里和他碰面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His phone lights up. He reads the message, then puts it away without opening anything else.
beats.chinese: 他的手机亮了。他读完消息，没再打开别的内容，就收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He's running a little late. Same as Tuesday.
beats.chinese: 他要晚一点。跟星期二一样。

choices.english: You work on movie captions?
choices.chinese: 你做电影字幕方面的工作？

choices.english: Would you like some company while you wait?
choices.chinese: 等人的时候，要不要一起聊聊？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frank gives a small nod and turns slightly so you both have a clear view of the basin.
beats.chinese: Frank 轻轻点头，稍微侧过身，让你们都能看清盆地。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'm just waiting for my friend Eddie.
beats.chinese: 当然。我只是在等朋友埃迪。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks the loose coat sleeve under the rest of the coat. A skateboard rolls across the dry basin below.
beats.chinese: 他把垂下的袖子塞进叠好的外套下面。下方，一块滑板滚过干燥的盆地。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the skating.
beats.chinese: 慢慢看吧。

choices.english: Stay nearby and watch without starting a conversation.
choices.chinese: 留在附近看滑板，不再开口聊天。

choices.english: Give him a nod and move to another clear part of the steps.
choices.chinese: 向他点点头，移到台阶上另一处空着的地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frank turns back to answer you. He keeps his coat neatly contained on his lap.
beats.chinese: Frank 转头回答你，腿上的外套仍旧叠得整整齐齐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I proofread the accessibility captions. Words, timing, missing sounds. A door slamming matters in some films.
beats.chinese: 我校对无障碍字幕。文字、时间点，还有漏掉的声音说明。有些电影里，摔门声很重要。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A man approaching along the steps raises a hand. Frank lifts his own hand in reply and turns his knees toward him.
beats.chinese: 一个沿台阶走近的男人抬手示意。Frank 也举手回应，把膝盖转向了他。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's Eddie. I'll leave work there for the afternoon. Good talking to you.
beats.chinese: 埃迪来了。今天下午就不聊工作了。很高兴和你聊了几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frank pauses with his hand resting on the folded coat. His reply becomes more formal.
beats.chinese: Frank 的手停在叠好的外套上，顿了一下，回答变得客气而正式。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I'd prefer to wait on my own.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我还是想自己等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws the coat closer and turns toward the people coming along the steps. The space beside him remains open.
beats.chinese: 他把外套往怀里收了收，转向沿台阶走来的人。身旁的位置依然空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Please use the step if you like. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 想坐的话，这里可以坐。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You watch the skateboarders. A man arrives carrying a small paper bag, and Frank immediately raises his hand.
beats.chinese: 你看着滑板的人。一个男人提着小纸袋走来，Frank 立刻举起手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eddie. There you are.
beats.chinese: 埃迪。你来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Eddie offers the bag. Frank's expression softens as he takes a biscuit, then turns fully toward his friend.
beats.chinese: 埃迪递过纸袋。Frank 拿出一块饼干，神情放松下来，完全转向了老朋友。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You remembered the plain ones. Good. The others leave sugar all over my coat.
beats.chinese: 你记得拿原味的。好。别的那几种会把我的外套弄得全是糖。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You nod and move to a different open stretch of the fountain steps. Frank returns your nod without trying to continue the conversation.
beats.chinese: 你点点头，移到喷泉台阶上另一处空地。Frank 也点头回应，没有继续攀谈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you settle farther along, Frank catches a slipping sleeve and gathers his coat. He spots someone among the people on the steps and raises a hand.
beats.chinese: 你在稍远处停下时，Frank 接住滑落的袖子，将外套拢好。他在台阶上的人群中看见了谁，抬手示意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eddie. Over here.
beats.chinese: 埃迪。在这边。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Washington Square Park, you see Frank sitting on the fountain steps, waiting for someone. He recognizes you and gives you a nod.
beats.chinese: 后来再次来到华盛顿广场，你看见 Frank 坐在喷泉台阶上等人。他认出了你，向你点点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Eddie isn't here yet. I'm waiting for him.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。埃迪还没到，我等他。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frank turns his attention back to the people coming and going on the steps. He lets the greeting end there.
beats.chinese: Frank 把目光转回台阶上来往的人，没有继续延长话题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You don't need to wait with me. Enjoy watching the skating.
beats.chinese: 你不用陪着等。慢慢看滑板吧。

causality.presenceReason: Frank 做完日场无障碍字幕校对，按约到华盛顿广场的喷泉台阶等认识三十年的朋友埃迪。
causality.placeAttitude: 他把这里当作与老朋友固定碰面的地点，对陌生人保持礼貌，但不急着扩大交往，也不寻求带路或搭伴。
causality.stayingConstraint: 他与埃迪约在这里见面。交谈分支中，埃迪发消息说会迟到，Frank 继续留在约定地点等候。
causality.currentGoal: 等埃迪到场，开始自己的休息时间。
causality.currentState: 下班后精力平稳，外套从一开始就叠放在腿上。他的注意力主要放在等人上，愿意简短交谈，不愿接受陌生人的陪等邀请。
causality.contactTrigger: Frank 等人时看着无水盆地里持续的滑板活动，直接向附近的玩家询问是否常来，随后说明自己在等老朋友。接触不再由外套占位或腾出台阶触发。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留先问来访资历的习惯、短句语气、字幕校对工作及对老相识的依赖。面对陪聊邀请，他措辞转为正式并直接婉拒。再次见面时，他仍以点头和简短招呼维持礼貌距离，不因见过一次便升级亲密。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家可说明初访并问他在等谁，也可表示只想看滑板。aa 中他简短说明字幕工作，随后迎接埃迪并结束交谈。ab 中他更正式地婉拒陪伴，同时保留玩家使用台阶的自由。ba 中玩家不再聊天，看到他对埃迪明显放松并接过饼干。bb 中玩家移到另一处空着的台阶，双方点头结束接触，Frank 随后看见埃迪并招手。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Washington Square, Beatriz Ocampo is taking a snack break on the fountain steps after trying a newly opened bakery. People linger nearby, and skateboarders ride inside the dry basin. Her paper bag rests securely on her lap as she checks the pastry against the receipt.
beats.chinese: 在华盛顿广场，Beatriz Ocampo刚去过一家新开的面包店，正坐在喷泉台阶上吃点心。附近有人停留，无水的盆地里有人滑板。纸袋稳稳放在她腿上，她对照着小票看了看点心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Plain, not this one. Oh, I'm checking my pastry. I wasn't talking about you. I'm Beatriz.
beats.chinese: 原味，不是这个。哦，我在核对点心，不是在说你。我叫Beatriz。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps the bag on her lap and looks from the receipt to the pastry again.
beats.chinese: 她让袋子稳稳留在腿上，又看了看小票和点心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, wrong one. They're in their first week, though. Everybody's learning where things go.
beats.chinese: 哦，拿错了。不过他们才开业第一周，大家还在熟悉东西都放在哪儿。

choices.english: I'd still be annoyed if I got the wrong order.
choices.chinese: 要是拿错了我的餐点，我还是会不高兴。

choices.english: Is it at least something you like?
choices.chinese: 至少是你喜欢吃的吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatriz folds the receipt once, ready with an answer.
beats.chinese: Beatriz把小票对折了一下，立刻准备接话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They had quite a line, and the person serving looked new—oh, you only said you'd be annoyed. I added the whole defense.
beats.chinese: 当时排队的人挺多，拿餐的那个人看着也像新来的——哦，你只是说你会不高兴。我倒把整套辩护都补上了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sets the receipt on top of the bag and leaves the pastry wrapped.
beats.chinese: 她把小票放在袋子上，没有拆开点心的包装。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I ordered plain. This one's full of raisins. I can be patient and still ask for the right thing.
beats.chinese: 我点的是原味，这个全是葡萄干。我可以有耐心，也可以要求拿到自己点的东西。

choices.english: Exactly. I'd want what I ordered. I'll let you finish your break.
choices.chinese: 对，我也会想拿到自己点的东西。不打扰你休息了。

choices.english: I'd probably give them another try too. I'm going to watch the skating.
choices.chinese: 我大概也会再给他们一次机会。我去看看滑板。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatriz turns the wrapped pastry over. Several raisins show through a gap in the paper.
beats.chinese: Beatriz把包着的点心翻过来。包装纸的缝隙里露出几颗葡萄干。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Raisins. I like them well enough. I just wanted plain today.
beats.chinese: 葡萄干。我倒也不讨厌，只是今天想吃原味。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She starts opening the wrapper, pauses, and folds one corner back into place.
beats.chinese: 她开始拆包装，停了停，又把一个纸角折了回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I keep trying new places. Apparently I also keep giving myself a speech before eating a snack.
beats.chinese: 我总爱试新店。看来我还总爱在吃点心之前，先给自己讲上一通。

choices.english: You could save it for later. I'll leave you to your break.
choices.chinese: 可以留着晚点吃。不打扰你休息了。

choices.english: What makes you try so many new places?
choices.chinese: 你为什么这么喜欢试新店？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatriz slips the receipt into the bag beside the untouched pastry.
beats.chinese: Beatriz把小票放进袋子，塞在还没动过的点心旁边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I'll take it back after my break and ask for the plain one.
beats.chinese: 嗯。休息完我就拿回去，换成原味的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the bag shut and settles it securely against her hip, leaving the step beside her clear.
beats.chinese: 她折好袋口，把袋子稳稳放在身侧，空出了旁边的台阶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for the chat. Enjoy the square.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你陪我聊了几句。祝你在广场逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You move a little farther along the steps to watch the skateboarders. Beatriz unwraps one end of the pastry.
beats.chinese: 你沿台阶挪开一点，去看盆地里的滑板者。Beatriz拆开了点心一端的包装。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They'll get another visit from me. I'll point at the plain one next time.
beats.chinese: 我还会再去的。下回我直接指着原味的点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a bite, catches a loose crumb in the paper, and turns toward the basin.
beats.chinese: 她咬了一口，用包装纸接住掉下的碎屑，转头望向盆地。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy. I'm staying here with my very unexpected raisins.
beats.chinese: 慢慢看。我就在这儿，吃这些意料之外的葡萄干。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatriz closes the wrapper without taking a bite.
beats.chinese: Beatriz没有吃，把包装重新包好了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I will. I'm allowed to stop negotiating with a pastry.
beats.chinese: 那就留着吧。我也该停止跟一块点心讨价还价了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tucks the pastry into the bag and keeps it on her lap. Her hands rest on the folded top.
beats.chinese: 她把点心收进纸袋，放在腿上，双手搭在折好的袋口上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatriz smooths the wrapper around the pastry before putting it away.
beats.chinese: Beatriz把点心外面的包装纸抚平，收回袋子里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I make shadow puppets for a small theater in Brooklyn. I've sat through enough shaky opening nights to want new places to get a second week.
beats.chinese: 我在布鲁克林一家小剧院做皮影人偶。磕磕绊绊的首演看得多了，就总希望新店能撑到第二周。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the bag closed, stands, and gathers it against her side without entering anyone's path.
beats.chinese: 她折好袋口，站起身，把袋子拢在身侧，没有挡住别人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sometimes I get carried away with the excuses. Anyway, that's my break finished. Nice talking with you.
beats.chinese: 有时候我替人找理由会找过头。好了，我也休息够了。很高兴跟你聊天。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Washington Square, you see Beatriz on the fountain steps looking through film choices in a small notebook on her knee. Skateboarders are riding in the dry basin. She recognizes you and raises a hand in greeting.
beats.chinese: 在华盛顿广场，你看见Beatriz坐在喷泉台阶上，翻看膝头小笔记本里的候选电影。无水的盆地里有人滑板。她认出了你，抬手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I'm picking a Tagalog film for the weekend. Today I feel like watching one I already know.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我在挑周末要看的他加禄语电影。今天想重看一部熟悉的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts a check mark beside one title, then closes the notebook.
beats.chinese: 她在一个片名旁打了个钩，然后合上本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No new ones this time. I just want to watch one I like again. It's good to see you.
beats.chinese: 这次不找新的了。我就是想再看一遍喜欢的。见到你真好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Tiong Bahru Market's upstairs open-air dining area, Tan Kim Seng has settled at a table for lunch. As you pass beside it, he looks up from his untouched chicken rice. The next chair is empty, and his shopping bag rests between his feet.
beats.chinese: 在中峇鲁熟食中心楼上的开敞用餐区，Tan Kim Seng刚坐下来吃午饭。你从桌旁经过时，他从没动过的鸡饭前抬起头。旁边的椅子空着，购物袋放在他的两脚之间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lunch is already here, and I'm still thinking about the laksa I didn't buy. I've prepped meals for two hundred people, then I go and do this with my own lunch.
beats.chinese: 午饭已经买好了，我还在想没买的叻沙。两百个人的饭都备过，轮到自己的午饭就这样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He laughs at himself and gestures toward the empty chair.
beats.chinese: 他自己笑起来，朝旁边的空椅子示意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Kim Seng. Sit if you like. I've already ordered, so you won't have to wait through that performance.
beats.chinese: 我叫Kim Seng。想坐就坐。我已经点好了，你不用看我那场点餐大戏。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll sit for a little while.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我坐一小会儿。

choices.english: Thanks, but I'm just passing.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，不过我只是路过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take the empty chair. Kim Seng moves his plate a little closer to himself, keeping your side of the table open.
beats.chinese: 你在空椅子上坐下。Kim Seng把盘子往自己这边挪了挪，给你留出桌面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Chicken rice. A good choice. Although I remembered the laksa about three seconds after ordering.
beats.chinese: 鸡饭，选得不错。不过点完才三秒，我就想起叻沙了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He picks up his spoon, pauses over the rice, then laughs at himself.
beats.chinese: 他拿起勺子，停在米饭上方，又自己笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My wife says I choose trains to photograph faster than I choose lunch. She's right, lah.
beats.chinese: 我太太说，我挑火车拍照都比挑午饭快。她说得对啦。

choices.english: Tell me a little about your train photos, then I'll head on.
choices.chinese: 跟我聊两句你的火车照片吧，然后我就走。

choices.english: I'll just sit quietly for a minute, then head on. Enjoy your food.
choices.chinese: 我就安静坐一分钟，然后就走。你慢慢吃。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You remain beside the table. Kim Seng leaves the empty chair clear and draws his feet and bag farther under his own seat.
beats.chinese: 你没有入座。Kim Seng让那张椅子空着，又把脚和袋子往自己的座位下面收了收。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No problem. Enjoy your walk around.
beats.chinese: 没问题，慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns back to his chicken rice and lifts his spoon, but stops before taking any.
beats.chinese: 他转回去看着鸡饭，举起勺子，却迟迟没舀下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aiyah, now I'm thinking about noodles. This rice hasn't even had a chance yet.
beats.chinese: 哎呀，现在又想吃面了。这盘饭连表现的机会都还没有。

choices.english: Give it one bite before you replace it.
choices.chinese: 先吃一口，再想着换掉它吧。

choices.english: Enjoy your lunch. I'll keep going.
choices.chinese: 午饭吃好，我继续走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kim Seng lowers his spoon and turns toward you for the brief chat.
beats.chinese: Kim Seng放低勺子，转过身来，跟你聊上几句。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Old railway carriages, mostly. I spent decades prepping meals on trains around Malaysia and Singapore. These days I like getting the whole carriage in the picture.
beats.chinese: 主要拍老火车车厢。我在马来西亚和新加坡一带的列车上备餐，做了几十年。现在拍照，我喜欢把整节车厢都拍进去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He finally takes a mouthful of rice. As you get up to leave, he swallows and raises his free hand.
beats.chinese: 他终于吃了一口饭。你起身离开时，他咽下饭，抬起空着的那只手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I still do the prep part-time. Feeding two hundred people, easy. Choosing for myself takes longer. Ha! Take care, ah.
beats.chinese: 我现在还兼职做备餐。喂饱两百个人，容易。给自己选吃的，反而更久。哈！慢走啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kim Seng turns back to his plate, leaving you to your quiet minute.
beats.chinese: Kim Seng转回去面对自己的盘子，让你安静坐一会儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Better eat this while it's warm.
beats.chinese: 当然。趁热吃才好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He eats several mouthfuls without restarting the conversation. When your minute is up and you rise, he moves his bag fully beneath his chair.
beats.chinese: 他接连吃了几口，没有再挑起话题。一分钟后你起身，他把袋子完全收进椅子底下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care. Thanks for the company.
beats.chinese: 慢走。谢谢你坐一会儿作伴。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kim Seng looks from you to his untouched lunch, then gives a short laugh.
beats.chinese: Kim Seng看看你，又看看没动过的午饭，笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One bite, can. You're asking less than my wife. She says finish the plate.
beats.chinese: 一口，可以。你要求比我太太少。她说，要吃完整盘。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a spoonful of rice with a piece of chicken, chews, and nods. He settles closer to the table, ready to continue eating.
beats.chinese: 他舀起一勺饭，配上一块鸡肉，嚼了嚼，点点头。他往桌前坐近一点，准备继续吃。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Wah, the ginger's good. The noodles will have to manage without me. Enjoy your day, ah.
beats.chinese: 哇，姜蓉不错。那碗面只好少我这个食客了。今天过得愉快啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the same dining-area passage. Kim Seng stays at his table.
beats.chinese: 你沿着用餐区同一条通道继续走。Kim Seng仍坐在桌边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. Bye, ah.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。再见啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives a small wave and turns his attention back to the plate. His spoon hovers over the rice before shifting toward the chicken.
beats.chinese: 他轻轻挥了挥手，把注意力转回盘子。勺子在米饭上停了一下，又转向鸡肉。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Chicken first, then.
beats.chinese: 那就先吃鸡肉吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Tiong Bahru Market's upstairs dining area, you spot Kim Seng at a table with his lunch. He recognises you. A bag of market vegetables rests securely beside his feet.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到中峇鲁熟食中心楼上的用餐区，你看见Kim Seng坐在桌边吃午饭。他认出了你，一袋从市场买来的蔬菜稳稳地放在脚边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again! Good to see you. I chose my vegetables quickly today. Just one dish for dinner.
beats.chinese: 又见面了！见到你真好。今天买菜很干脆，晚饭只做一道菜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances at the vegetables in the open bag, smiles, and takes another spoonful of his lunch.
beats.chinese: 他看了一眼敞口袋里的蔬菜，笑了笑，又舀起一口午饭。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No changing my mind today, lah. I'll cook these when I get home. Enjoy your visit, ah.
beats.chinese: 今天不改主意了啦，回家就做这个。慢慢逛啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Tiong Bahru Market's upstairs dining area, Farah Zulkifli is having rice and fried tofu after a cleaning shift at a small dairy plant. She notices you beside her table, where her bag occupies a chair.
beats.chinese: 在中峇鲁熟食中心楼上的用餐区，Farah Zulkifli 刚结束小型乳品厂的设备清洁班次，正在吃米饭和炸豆腐。她注意到桌旁的你，自己的包正占着一把椅子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can sit here if you like. My bag doesn't need its own chair.
beats.chinese: 想坐的话可以坐这里。我的包不用独占一把椅子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the bag on her lap. Beside her meal are two little sauce dishes and an empty blue side plate.
beats.chinese: 她把包放到腿上。饭菜旁摆着两个小酱碟，还有一个空的蓝色小盘。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Farah, by the way. That seat's free.
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫 Farah。这个位子没人坐。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll sit here.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，那我坐这里。

choices.english: Thanks, but I'm not sitting down. Are those little plates yours?
choices.chinese: 谢谢，不过我不坐。那些小碟子是你自己的吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take the cleared chair. Farah moves the empty blue plate between you, keeping her meal on her own side.
beats.chinese: 你坐上腾出来的椅子。Farah 把空蓝盘移到两人之间，自己的饭菜仍留在自己这边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Want a piece of tofu? I've got plenty. This little plate's clean.
beats.chinese: 要不要来块豆腐？我这儿挺多的。这个小盘是干净的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She reaches for a clean spoon, then stops to shift the chilli dish farther from the peanut sauce. She checks the gap once more.
beats.chinese: 她伸手拿起一把干净勺子，又停下来，把辣椒碟移得离花生酱更远些。她还低头确认了一遍间距。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Peanut sauce in this dish. Chilli in that one. Separate spoons too. Aiyah, the tofu's getting a longer introduction than you did.
beats.chinese: 花生酱放这个碟，辣椒放那个碟。勺子也分开。哎呀，豆腐的出场介绍都比你的长了。

choices.english: Yes, please. I'll try a piece on that spare plate.
choices.chinese: 好呀，谢谢。我用那个空盘尝一块。

choices.english: No food, thanks. I'd just like to sit.
choices.chinese: 不用吃的，谢谢。我只是想坐一下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Farah stays seated and turns the empty blue plate so its painted edge is visible. The two sauce dishes remain beside her meal.
beats.chinese: Farah 仍坐着，把空蓝盘转了个方向，让盘边的花纹露出来。两个酱碟依旧放在饭菜旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mine, yes. I collect small plates. Then I bring them out for lunch, so I can claim they're useful.
beats.chinese: 对，我自己的。我收集小盘子，再带出来吃午饭，这样就能说它们有实际用途了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts the blue plate by its edge. A folded cloth for wrapping it sits inside her open bag.
beats.chinese: 她捏着盘沿举起蓝盘。敞开的包里放着一块折好的布，是用来包盘子的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My siblings count them whenever they visit. Very hardworking people when it's my cupboard.
beats.chinese: 我兄弟姐妹每次来都要数一遍。只要是查我的橱柜，他们就特别勤快。

choices.english: Could I look at the empty one? I'll give it straight back.
choices.chinese: 能让我看看那个空盘吗？我马上还你。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your lunch. Enjoy it!
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你吃午饭了。慢慢吃！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Farah puts a piece of tofu on the blue plate with the clean spoon and slides it towards you. Both sauces stay in their separate dishes.
beats.chinese: Farah 用干净勺子往蓝盘里放了一块豆腐，推到你面前。两种酱仍各自放在自己的碟子里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you go. Sauce if you want. Once it's on your plate, you can do whatever you like with it.
beats.chinese: 给你。想蘸酱就蘸。到了你的盘子里，怎么吃都由你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You try the tofu. Farah serves herself a piece, dips it in peanut sauce, and settles back over her rice.
beats.chinese: 你尝了豆腐。Farah 也给自己夹了一块，蘸上花生酱，重新吃起米饭。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good, still crisp. All right, lunch first. I talk too much when I'm hungry.
beats.chinese: 不错，还脆着。好了，先吃饭。我一饿就话多。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Farah draws the spare plate back to her side, leaving the space in front of you clear.
beats.chinese: Farah 把备用小盘收回自己这边，让你面前的桌面保持空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can, of course. No need to eat just because I'm eating.
beats.chinese: 当然可以。不用因为我在吃，你就也得吃。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes one earbud from her bag, puts it in, and returns to her rice. Her other ear remains uncovered.
beats.chinese: 她从包里拿出一只耳机戴上，继续吃饭，另一只耳朵仍空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm putting my music back on. Enjoy the seat.
beats.chinese: 我接着听会儿歌。你坐着歇吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Farah passes you the empty plate, keeping her fingers around its rim. Its blue pattern continues onto the underside.
beats.chinese: Farah 捏着盘沿，把空盘递给你。蓝色花纹一直延伸到盘底。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here. The pattern goes underneath too. Completely wasted on the table, so naturally I wanted it.
beats.chinese: 给。花纹连盘底都有。摆在桌上完全看不见，所以我当然就想要了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You look it over and hand it back. Farah wraps it in the cloth, puts it in her bag, and picks up her spoon.
beats.chinese: 你看了看，把盘子还给她。Farah 用布包好，放进包里，再拿起勺子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Better put it away before I decide I need a matching one. Enjoy your day, ah.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。赶紧收起来，免得我又觉得该买个配套的。祝你今天愉快啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Farah lowers the plate and gives you a small wave from her chair.
beats.chinese: Farah 放下盘子，坐在椅子上朝你轻轻挥了挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks, you too. Glad I moved the bag anyway.
beats.chinese: 谢谢，你也是。反正把包挪开总没错。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You leave the table. Farah keeps the spare chair clear and takes another bite of lunch.
beats.chinese: 你离开餐桌。Farah 没再往空椅子上放东西，继续吃午饭。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye, ah!
beats.chinese: 拜拜啊！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Tiong Bahru Market's upstairs dining area, Farah looks up from her phone at a table and recognises you. A family group chat is filling her screen.
beats.chinese: 在中峇鲁熟食中心楼上的用餐区，坐在餐桌旁的 Farah 从手机上抬起头，认出了你。屏幕上满是家庭群聊的新消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eh, hello! My siblings are organising dinner. Twelve messages, and all we've agreed on is that we're hungry.
beats.chinese: 诶，你好！我兄弟姐妹在商量晚饭。发了十二条消息，唯一达成的共识就是大家都饿了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another message arrives. Farah laughs, types a short reply, and places the phone face down beside her.
beats.chinese: 又来了一条消息。Farah 笑了，打了个简短回复，把手机翻扣在身旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've suggested a time. Let them argue about the food for a bit. Nice to see you, ah.
beats.chinese: 我提了个时间。吃什么就让他们再争一会儿吧。见到你真好啊。
