beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the lower waterfront walkway near the Helix Bridge, Kumaravel Suppiah has stopped during his day-off walk to take a photo for his album. He stays beside the railing as he raises his phone for a selfie, straightening his back and pressing his lips together.
beats.chinese: 滨海湾螺旋桥北端的下层临水步道上，Kumaravel Suppiah趁休息日来散步，停下来给相册拍张照片。他一直站在栏杆旁，举起手机自拍，背一下挺直，嘴唇也抿紧了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could you call out 'Now' for me? I'll press it myself. Without someone telling me, even my selfies look like work-pass photos.
beats.chinese: 能不能替我喊一声“拍了”？我自己按。没人提醒，我连自拍都站得像在拍工作证照片。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his phone and his shoulders immediately relax. Still beside the railing and clear of the passing space, he turns towards you with a laugh.
beats.chinese: 他放下手机，肩膀立刻松了下来。他仍站在栏杆旁，没有占着通行的地方，笑着转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Kumaravel, by the way. Just need a little warning, lah. No worries if you'd rather carry on.
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫Kumaravel。就是想有人提前提醒一下啦。你想继续走也没关系。

choices.english: Does that happen every time you take a photo?
choices.chinese: 你每次拍照都会这样吗？

choices.english: You just want me to say 'Now'?
choices.chinese: 只要我喊一声“拍了”就行？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kumaravel laughs, then turns his phone screen towards himself. With the camera lowered, his face is much less solemn.
beats.chinese: Kumaravel笑起来，把手机屏幕转回自己这边。镜头放低后，他的表情没那么严肃了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Every team photo. Everyone lifts the trophy, I stand like the manager has called me in.
beats.chinese: 每次球队合影都这样。别人举奖杯，我站得像被经理叫去谈话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He starts laughing before he finishes. He raises the phone again, immediately squares his shoulders, then lowers it with a small shake of his head.
beats.chinese: 话还没说完，他自己先笑了。他再次举起手机，肩膀立刻端正起来，随后又摇摇头，把手机放下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Some colleagues try to catch me laughing. I tell them first, lah. No secret pictures. A serious one is fine with me.
beats.chinese: 有些同事专挑我笑的时候偷拍。我就跟他们说，先打个招呼啦，别偷偷拍。严肃一点的照片，我也喜欢。

choices.english: Offer to take one on his phone, wait for his cue, take a single photo, and hand the phone back.
choices.chinese: 提出用他的手机拍一张，等他示意后拍摄，再把手机还给他。

choices.english: Ask which team photos he means, then say goodbye after his answer.
choices.chinese: 问他指的是哪些球队合影，听完后道别。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kumaravel gives you a friendly nod and turns slightly towards the water. He keeps his elbows close so there is room to pass.
beats.chinese: Kumaravel友善地点点头，稍稍转向水面。他收着胳膊，留出通行的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, just that. I'll hold the phone and press it. You don't need to take anything.
beats.chinese: 对，就这样。手机我拿着，也由我来按。你不用接任何东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He raises his phone towards himself again. His shoulders square up and his face becomes serious, though his thumb waits beside the shutter button.
beats.chinese: 他再次举起手机对着自己。肩膀端正起来，表情也严肃了，拇指却还停在快门键旁，等着提醒。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One second, lah. Right, ready. Then I'll put the date in before this becomes another picture labelled 'sometime'.
beats.chinese: 等一秒啦。好了，准备好了。拍完就记上日期，免得又多一张只能标成“某一天”的照片。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 我就不参与了。散步愉快。

choices.english: Give him the cue, then ask whether he labels his photos straight away.
choices.chinese: 喊一声提醒他拍照，然后问他是不是拍完就给照片做标注。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kumaravel hands you his phone with the camera open. He stands beside the railing, smooths his yellow shirt and plants both feet firmly.
beats.chinese: Kumaravel把打开相机的手机交给你。他站在栏杆旁，抚平黄色衬衫，两脚稳稳站好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One second, lah. Shirt first. Right, ready now. Just one.
beats.chinese: 等一秒啦。先弄好衬衫。好了，现在可以了。拍一张就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take one photo and return the phone. He examines his formal pose, lets out a laugh and saves the picture before putting the phone away.
beats.chinese: 你拍了一张，把手机还给他。他看着照片里端正的站姿，笑出声来，保存照片后收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ha! Exactly the face I expected. Keeping that one. Thanks for waiting. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 哈！果然还是这个表情。这张留着。谢谢你等我准备好。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kumaravel locks his phone and slips it into his pocket. He turns back towards you rather than setting up another picture.
beats.chinese: Kumaravel锁上手机，放进口袋，没有继续摆姿势，而是转身朝向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Local basketball teams. I fix scoreboards in indoor sports halls. Twenty-plus years, and I always stay to hear who won.
beats.chinese: 本地篮球队。我在室内体育馆修记分牌。干了二十多年，还是总想留下来听听谁赢了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He chuckles and rubs his chin. After your goodbye, he returns the farewell and turns to look across the water, leaving his phone in his pocket.
beats.chinese: 他笑着摸了摸下巴。你道别后，他也回应了一声，转身望向水面，没再掏手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sometimes I stay longer than the players. All right, take care. I'll leave the picture for another day.
beats.chinese: 有时候我比球员待得还久。好，慢走。照片改天再拍吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You decline and give him a brief wave as you continue along the walkway. Kumaravel lowers his phone to return the wave.
beats.chinese: 你婉拒了，简单挥挥手，沿步道继续走。Kumaravel放低手机，也向你挥了挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye! Enjoy the walk.
beats.chinese: 再见！散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes the selfie himself, enters the date and pockets his phone. Then he sets off along the walkway in the other direction.
beats.chinese: 他自己拍好自拍，输完日期，收起手机，随后沿着步道向另一边走去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good, that's saved.
beats.chinese: 好了，存好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You give him the cue and he presses the shutter himself. He lowers the phone, relaxes his shoulders and starts entering a label. When you ask whether he always does that straight away, he pauses and looks up.
beats.chinese: 你喊了一声，他自己按下快门。他放低手机，肩膀松了下来，开始输入标注。你问他是不是每次拍完都马上标注，他停下来，抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Date and place, straight away. At home I sort them into albums. Otherwise I spend Sunday asking myself which Sunday it was.
beats.chinese: 日期、地点，马上记好。回家再整理进相册。不然整个星期天都得琢磨，那到底是哪个星期天拍的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He laughs, finishes the short label and locks the screen. With the picture filed, he gives you a small farewell nod.
beats.chinese: 他笑了笑，补完简短的标注，锁上屏幕。照片整理好了，他轻轻点头，向你道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There, Marina Bay and the date. That's enough typing for a walk. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 好了，滨海湾，加上日期。出来散步，字就打到这里。很高兴跟你聊聊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later outing along the lower waterfront walkway near the Helix Bridge, Kumaravel Suppiah is browsing old photos on his phone beside the railing. He pauses on a photo of himself standing very stiffly, then looks up, recognises you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 后来一次，在滨海湾螺旋桥北端的下层临水步道上，Kumaravel Suppiah正站在栏杆旁，用手机翻看旧照片。他停在一张自己站得十分僵直的照片上，随后抬头认出你，笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eh, hello again! I was going to delete this one. I'm standing so stiffly. Doesn't look very good, lah. Still, that's very much me.
beats.chinese: 哎，又见面了！这张我原本想删的，站得太僵了。拍得不怎么好看啦。不过，还真像我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He adds the photo to an album for pictures he wants to keep, smiling with satisfaction. Still holding the phone himself, he looks back up at you.
beats.chinese: 他把这张照片加入专门存放想保留的照片的相册，满意地笑了笑。手机仍拿在他自己手里，他又抬头看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Every photo doesn't have to look natural, lah. As long as I recognise myself from that day, I'm happy. Good seeing you again. Take care!
beats.chinese: 不是每张都要拍得自然啦，认得出那天的自己就好。又见到你真好。保重啊！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Marina Bay's lower waterfront promenade near the Helix Bridge, Chua Ah Koon is waiting for his friend Seng before a walk. He keeps a folded umbrella upright against his side as he reads a message on his phone.
beats.chinese: 滨海湾螺旋桥北端的下层临水步道上，Chua Ah Koon正等朋友Seng一起散步。他把折伞竖着贴在身侧，读着手机上的消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A shop repaired it? I replaced this catch myself.
beats.chinese: 店里修的？这个卡扣明明是我换的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His voice is low but clear. Realizing you have heard him, he lowers his phone and turns toward you with a small smile. The umbrella stays close to his side.
beats.chinese: 他的声音不大，却很清楚。意识到你听见了，他放低手机，转向你，微微一笑。伞仍贴在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Waiting for Seng to collect his umbrella. No charge for fixing it, lah. Just want him to get the name right.
beats.chinese: 等Seng来拿他的伞。修理不收钱啦。就是得让他说对是谁修的。

choices.english: Do you often fix things for him?
choices.chinese: 你经常替他修东西吗？

choices.english: Is Seng your walking partner?
choices.chinese: Seng是跟你一起散步的朋友吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ah Koon keeps the folded umbrella upright against his side.
beats.chinese: Ah Koon仍把折伞竖着贴在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Him, neighbours, whoever brings something over. Used to inspect camping gear at a rental shop near Bukit Merah. Retired already.
beats.chinese: 他啊，邻居啊，谁拿东西过来都修。以前在红山附近一家租赁店检查露营装备，已经退休了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets his phone, then takes out a small notebook and checks an entry.
beats.chinese: 他收起手机，取出一本小记事本，查看其中一条记录。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Monday morning, my kitchen table. I even replaced the catch.
beats.chinese: 星期一早上，在我家厨房桌上修的。卡扣都是我换的。

choices.english: A quick message would clear that up.
choices.chinese: 发条消息就能说清楚了。

choices.english: At least the umbrella works now.
choices.chinese: 至少现在伞能用了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ah Koon checks along the promenade for Seng, keeping the umbrella close to his side.
beats.chinese: Ah Koon沿着步道张望，找着Seng，伞一直收在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Old army friend. We walk sometimes. Tuesdays we play badminton. He usually beats me.
beats.chinese: 老战友了。有时一起走走。星期二打羽毛球，他通常赢我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He presses his lips together, then raises one finger.
beats.chinese: 他抿了抿嘴，又竖起一根手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Usually. I still win points. He likes to tell the score very quickly.
beats.chinese: 通常而已。我也有得分的。他报比分的时候倒是讲得特别快。

choices.english: You sound very sure about your points.
choices.chinese: 自己得了哪些分，你好像记得很清楚。

choices.english: Enjoy your walk together. I'll keep going.
choices.chinese: 祝你们散步愉快。我继续往前走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ah Koon opens the message and types slowly with one thumb.
beats.chinese: Ah Koon点开消息，用一根拇指慢慢打字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah Koon replaced the catch. Monday morning. There, short enough.
beats.chinese: Ah Koon换的卡扣。星期一早上。好了，够简短。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sends it, puts his phone and notebook away, and gives you a small nod.
beats.chinese: 他发出消息，收起手机和记事本，朝你轻轻点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No charge for the repair. Just get the name right, lah. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 修理不收钱。把是谁修的说对就行啦。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ah Koon holds his notebook open with his thumb. His voice becomes slower and more precise.
beats.chinese: Ah Koon用拇指压着摊开的记事本，说话慢了下来，字字清楚。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It works because I replaced the catch. Seng can give me credit for that too. Only takes a few words.
beats.chinese: 能用了，是因为我换了卡扣。Seng也可以说清楚这是我修的。又没几个字。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He adds a short note, pockets the book, and shifts a few steps along the railing to continue waiting.
beats.chinese: 他补记了几个字，把本子放回口袋，沿栏杆挪开几步，继续等人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll tell him myself when he gets here. Anyway, don't let me keep you.
beats.chinese: 等他到了，我自己跟他说。好了，不耽误你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ah Koon's mouth opens into a grin. He holds up two fingers.
beats.chinese: Ah Koon咧嘴笑了，举起两根手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two clean serves he couldn't return on Tuesday. Lost the game, yes. Those two points were mine.
beats.chinese: 星期二有两个发球，他干干净净地没接到。比赛是输了，没错。那两分可是我的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his hand and turns back toward the stretch of promenade he has been watching.
beats.chinese: 他放下手，重新望向刚才一直留意的那段步道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enough badminton talk. My shoulder gets tired just remembering. Have a good walk, ah.
beats.chinese: 羽毛球就讲到这里。光回想，肩膀都累了。慢慢逛啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ah Koon nods as you continue along the promenade.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿步道往前走，Ah Koon向你点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Take care, ah.
beats.chinese: 你也逛得愉快。慢走啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns toward the water, keeping the folded umbrella upright against his side.
beats.chinese: 他转向水面，仍把折伞竖着贴在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait here for Seng. He knows where to find me.
beats.chinese: 我就在这里等Seng。他知道来哪里找我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the lower waterfront promenade near the Helix Bridge, Chua Ah Koon recognises you while checking a message beside the railing.
beats.chinese: 在滨海湾螺旋桥北端的下层滨水步道，Chua Ah Koon站在栏杆旁看消息时认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eh, hello again. Seng asked me to lunch. Says nothing needs fixing. I checked.
beats.chinese: 哎，又见面了。Seng约我吃午饭。说没东西要修。我特意问过了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He reads the reply and chuckles, then slips his phone into his pocket.
beats.chinese: 他看完回复笑起来，把手机放进口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He says just come hungry. That part I can manage. Good seeing you.
beats.chinese: 他说空着肚子来就行。这个我办得到。很高兴见到你。

causality.presenceReason: 他已约好在这里把修好的伞还给老战友Seng，再一起散步，因此在玩家出现前就在等人。
causality.placeAttitude: 把临水步道当作普通的会合与散步地点，注意力主要在朋友和手中的伞上。
causality.stayingConstraint: 会合地点已经约定，Seng尚未到，他暂时留在这一段步道等候。
causality.currentGoal: 归还修好的伞，随后与Seng散步。读到修理被归功于店铺的消息后，也想把修理者是谁说清楚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Bondi's rocky shore, Tegan Marsh stands safely beside the route along the coast, looking across the bay. She has a folded jacket under her arm and a bag at her side.
beats.chinese: 在邦迪岩岸，Tegan Marsh站在沿岸路径旁的安全位置，望着海湾。她臂下夹着折好的外套，包收在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd like to move a little this way to see the whole bay. I'll leave this bit of the path clear for you.
beats.chinese: 我想往这边挪一点，看全海湾。这段路我给你留着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shifts a little along the safe edge of the route, keeping her bag and jacket close to her side, then turns towards you.
beats.chinese: 她沿路径的安全边缘挪了一点，把包和外套收在身侧，然后转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Tegan. Came out for a good look at the bay.
beats.chinese: 我叫Tegan，特意过来好好看看海湾。

choices.english: No rush. I've stopped for the view too.
choices.chinese: 不着急，我也停下来看看风景。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll keep going.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我继续往前走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tegan turns slightly towards you, keeping her bag and jacket close to her side. The bay remains open in front of you both.
beats.chinese: Tegan稍稍转向你，把包和外套都收在身侧。你们面前是开阔的海湾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's the whole curve I like. I could spend ages looking across that.
beats.chinese: 我喜欢的是海湾整个弧形的轮廓。这样望过去，我能看好久。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She follows the shoreline with her eyes, then flexes the fingers of her free hand.
beats.chinese: 她的目光沿着海岸线移过去，又活动了一下空着那只手的手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I make tiny plants for architectural models. After a week of little leaves, I wanted a bigger view.
beats.chinese: 我给建筑模型做微型植物。做了一星期的小叶子，就想看看开阔一点的景色。

choices.english: I'll take in the whole bay for a moment.
choices.chinese: 那我也看看整个海湾。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your big view. Enjoy it!
choices.chinese: 那就不打扰你看大风景了。慢慢欣赏！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tegan stays to one side as you continue along the route.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿路前行，Tegan留在一侧，没有挡路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No worries. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 没事，散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She reaches into her bag, checks one pocket, then another. Her sunglasses are resting on top of her head.
beats.chinese: 她伸手翻包，摸了一个口袋，又摸另一个。她的太阳镜就架在头顶上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now, where did those glasses go?
beats.chinese: 咦，眼镜放哪儿去了？

choices.english: They're on your head.
choices.chinese: 在你头顶上。

choices.english: Give a small wave and keep walking.
choices.chinese: 轻轻挥手，继续往前走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You pause to take in the bay. Tegan looks from one end of its curve to the other, her jacket held securely under her arm.
beats.chinese: 你停下来看看海湾。Tegan的目光从弧形海岸的一端移向另一端，外套稳稳地夹在臂下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's a good size for an afternoon off. I like a big old fig tree for the same reason.
beats.chinese: 休息的下午，就适合看这么大的景物。我喜欢高大的老榕树，也是这个原因。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A wave breaks against the nearer rocks, covering the end of her sentence. She laughs and turns her attention back to the water.
beats.chinese: 一阵浪拍在近处岩石上，盖住了她最后几个字。她笑了笑，把注意力转回海面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can't compete with that. I'll let you have a look without me talking over it.
beats.chinese: 可说不过这声音。我就不在旁边叨叨了，你好好看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You say goodbye. Tegan shifts the folded jacket into a firmer hold and turns towards you.
beats.chinese: 你向她道别。Tegan把折起的外套抱稳，转过脸来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Hope you get a good stretch of coast.
beats.chinese: 谢啦，祝你接下来这段海岸走得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives you a brief wave, then faces the bay again, with all her belongings clear of the route.
beats.chinese: 她朝你简短地挥了挥手，重新面向海湾，随身物品都收在通行路线之外。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll be here a bit longer, I reckon.
beats.chinese: 我估计还会在这儿多看一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tegan stops searching her bag and touches the top of her head.
beats.chinese: Tegan停下翻包的动作，伸手摸了摸头顶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, brilliant. Carried them all this way and lost them on myself.
beats.chinese: 哦，真行。一路带过来，结果丢在自己身上了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pulls the sunglasses down over her eyes and closes her bag, laughing at herself.
beats.chinese: 她把太阳镜拉下来戴好，合上包，自己先笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for that. I was about to unpack the whole bag. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 谢谢啊，我差点要把整包东西都掏出来。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You give a small wave and continue along the coast. Tegan returns the wave without trying to stop you.
beats.chinese: 你轻轻挥手，继续沿海岸前行。Tegan也挥手回应，没有叫住你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: See you.
beats.chinese: 回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the bag and pushes a loose strand of hair back. Her fingers catch the sunglasses on her head.
beats.chinese: 她合上包，伸手把一缕散发拨回去，手指碰到了头顶的太阳镜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. There you are.
beats.chinese: 啊，原来在这儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing at Bondi's rocky shore, Tegan is standing clear of the coastal route, watching waves strike the rocks. She recognises you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 在邦迪岩岸，Tegan正站在沿岸路径之外，看海浪拍打岩石。她认出了你，笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello! Good to see you. I was about to head back, then the waves got interesting.
beats.chinese: 哦，你好！很高兴见到你。我本来准备回去了，结果这几道浪又挺好看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns towards the route, then looks back as another wave breaks against the rocks. She stays out of the way.
beats.chinese: 她转向路径，另一道浪拍上岩石时，又回头看了一眼，脚下仍留在不挡路的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One more. That's what I said three waves ago.
beats.chinese: 再看一道。三道浪之前，我说的也是这句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the shore path at Bondi, Declan Vos has paused during a coastal walk to straighten his shoulder bag's strap. He keeps it in front of him, smoothing the front with his thumb.
beats.chinese: 邦迪岸边的步道上，Declan Vos 散步走到这里，正停下来理顺挎包背带。他始终把背带收在身前，用拇指压平正面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi, could you check if there's still a fold at the back of this strap? No worries if you'd rather not. I'm Declan.
beats.chinese: 嗨，能替我看一眼这条背带背面还有没有一折？不方便也没事。我叫 Declan。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns slightly so you can see the back of the strap, keeping the bag against his side and the passing space clear.
beats.chinese: 他稍稍转身，让你能看见背带背面，包仍贴在身侧，也没有占住通行的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got the front flat. Can't quite see the back from here.
beats.chinese: 正面已经压平了。背面我这个角度看不太清。

choices.english: Sure, I'll have a look.
choices.chinese: 可以，我看一眼。

choices.english: No worries. I'm going to look at the bay.
choices.chinese: 没事。我想看看海湾。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You look at the back of the strap. One edge is still folded under. Declan follows your glance, holding the bag close to his side.
beats.chinese: 你看了看背带背面，一侧边缘还折在里面。Declan 顺着你的目光看过去，包仍收在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I repair car seat fabric. Used an offcut for this strap. It's soft enough, but the folded edge keeps turning under.
beats.chinese: 我是修汽车座椅面料的，用了块边角料做这条背带。软是够软，可折边老往里卷。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the edge out, releases it, then immediately catches it again. He starts another explanation before noticing his own hands.
beats.chinese: 他把边缘翻出来，刚松手，又立刻捏住。他接着解释，随后才留意到自己一直没停下的双手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It makes a little ridge against your shoulder. Like a sock seam. Listen to me. You asked about a strap and got the whole repair report.
beats.chinese: 它会在肩膀上硌出一道小棱，像袜子的接缝。瞧我这话多的，你就问了条背带，我把维修报告都讲出来了。

choices.english: I'll leave you to sort it out. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 那你慢慢弄。散步愉快。

choices.english: Leave it for now. Let's look at the waves.
choices.chinese: 先别管它了。看看海浪吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You turn toward the bay. Declan keeps the strap close to himself and turns it over to check the back.
beats.chinese: 你转向海湾。Declan 把背带收在身前，自己翻过来查看背面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah, go on. Plenty to look at.
beats.chinese: 好啊，你看。这里可有得看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a water bottle from his bag and unscrews the lid, keeping both the bag and his elbows close.
beats.chinese: 他从包里拿出水瓶，拧开瓶盖，包和胳膊都收在身边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Came out for a decent walk. So far I've mostly stood here fiddling.
beats.chinese: 本来是出来好好走走的，结果到现在大半时间都站在这里瞎摆弄。

choices.english: Enjoy your walk. I'll stay here.
choices.chinese: 散步愉快。我在这儿待一会儿。

choices.english: I'm heading on. Take your time.
choices.chinese: 我继续往前走了。你慢慢来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You leave Declan to his bag. He gives the twisted edge one more look, then folds the loose end beneath the strap.
beats.chinese: 你准备离开，让 Declan 自己处理挎包。他又看了一眼拧着的边缘，把松垂的一端折进背带下面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. It'll get me home like that.
beats.chinese: 谢了。这样撑到家没问题。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He settles the bag against his hip and drops his hands. As you move on, he stays beside the path to check that the folded end holds.
beats.chinese: 他把包挪到胯侧，放下双手。你继续走时，他留在步道边，看看折进去的带尾会不会再松出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And that's enough of the strap report. Have a good one.
beats.chinese: 背带报告就到这儿了。祝你玩得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You turn toward the waves together. Declan lets the imperfect fold go and slides the bag behind his hip.
beats.chinese: 你们一起转向海浪。Declan 松开那道没理平的折痕，把包挪到胯后。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah, fair call. I can fiddle with that at home.
beats.chinese: 也是，听你的。回家再摆弄就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A wave spreads white water across the nearby rocks. He watches it drain away, then takes a step along the path with his hands free.
beats.chinese: 一道浪把白色水沫铺上近处的岩面。他看着水退下去，随后沿步道迈出一步，双手终于空了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nearly missed that one. Right, I'll get some walking done. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 差点错过这一道浪。好了，我也该走走了。你好好看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You stay facing the bay while Declan takes a drink and puts his bottle away.
beats.chinese: 你留在原地面向海湾，Declan 喝了口水，把瓶子放回包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Reckon I'll actually use my legs now.
beats.chinese: 谢了。这回总该让腿动起来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He settles the bag securely, checks the passing space and resumes his walk along the shore path.
beats.chinese: 他背稳挎包，看清身边通行的位置，继续沿岸边步道散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: See you around. Enjoy the bay.
beats.chinese: 回头见。好好看看海湾吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the path. Declan remains to one side with his open water bottle.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道继续向前。Declan 拿着打开的水瓶，留在一旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Will do. I've finally remembered I brought water.
beats.chinese: 好。我可算想起自己还带了水。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts the bottle in a small farewell and takes a drink. His other hand rests on the bag without adjusting it.
beats.chinese: 他稍稍举起水瓶道别，喝了一口。另一只手搭在包上，没有再调整背带。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Catch you around. Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 有缘再见。走得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Bondi's shore path, you see Declan drinking water beside the path, clear of passing walkers. He recognises you and lowers his bottle.
beats.chinese: 在邦迪岸边步道，你看见 Declan 在步道旁喝水，没有挡住过路的人。他认出了你，放下水瓶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hey. Good to see you. I've had enough of a walk today. Just about ready to head back.
beats.chinese: 哦，嗨。见到你真好。今天已经走够了，正准备回去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the bottle away in his bag and stays beside the path a little longer, looking across the bay.
beats.chinese: 他把水瓶收进包里，仍在步道旁站了一会儿，望着海湾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That was a good walk. Happy to leave it there for today. See you around.
beats.chinese: 今天走得挺舒服，到这儿就够了。回头见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Bondi's rocky shore, Jules Ngata stands clear of the walking route, eating a biscuit and looking across the bay. As you come alongside, a wave breaks over the nearby rocks, well away from where you both stand.
beats.chinese: 邦迪岩岸边，Jules Ngata站在不挡路的位置，吃着饼干，望着海湾。你来到他旁边时，一道浪拍上近处的岩面，离你们站的位置还很远。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I thought the last one was the biggest. Spoke too soon. I'm Jules, by the way.
beats.chinese: 我还以为刚才那道最大。说早了。对了，我叫Jules。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds his biscuit packet shut and puts it securely in his pocket, keeping the biscuit in his other hand. Another wave breaks, and he glances toward it.
beats.chinese: 他把饼干袋口折好，稳稳收进口袋，另一只手仍拿着饼干。又一道浪拍下来，他朝那边看了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That one sounded bigger, anyway. I've stopped eating just to listen. Biscuit's getting neglected.
beats.chinese: 反正那一下听着更大。我光顾着听，连饼干都不吃了。把它冷落了。

choices.english: Do sounds like that interest you?
choices.chinese: 你对这样的声音很感兴趣吗？

choices.english: No worries. I was just going to...
choices.chinese: 没关系。我正打算……

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jules looks toward the rocks again, briefly giving the waves more attention than his biscuit.
beats.chinese: Jules又朝岩面看去，一时顾着听浪，把饼干晾在了一边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Dangerously interesting. I've got a box of odd rattles and squeaky things at home. Very little of it belongs in a kitchen.
beats.chinese: 有意思得有点危险。我家有一盒各种会咔啦响、吱吱叫的怪东西。里面没几样适合放在厨房。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He reaches toward the pocket holding the packet, then catches himself and brings his empty hand back down.
beats.chinese: 他伸手去摸装着包装袋的口袋，随即意识到自己的动作，又把空着的手放了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nearly got the packet out again. Once I start wondering what something sounds like, my hands get ahead of me.
beats.chinese: 差点又把袋子拿出来了。一琢磨什么东西能发出什么声音，我的手就先动起来了。

choices.english: What's the strangest thing in that box?
choices.chinese: 那盒子里最奇怪的东西是什么？

choices.english: Sounds like you're working even on a walk.
choices.chinese: 听着像是散步时也在工作。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jules answers before you can finish. He draws his biscuit close to his chest.
beats.chinese: 你还没说完，Jules就接了话，同时把拿着饼干的手收到了胸前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Keep walking? Yep, I'll shift.
beats.chinese: 接着走？好，我让一下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a small step farther from the walking route, then stops and looks back at you.
beats.chinese: 他又往远离通行路线的方向挪了一小步，随后停住，回头看你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hang on. I finished your sentence for you. Sorry. What were you actually going to say?
beats.chinese: 等等。我替你把话说完了。抱歉。你原本想说什么？

choices.english: I meant stop here and look at the bay. You're not in the way.
choices.chinese: 我是想停在这里看看海湾。你没挡路。

choices.english: Yes, I'm carrying on along the path. Thanks.
choices.chinese: 对，我要沿着这条路继续走。谢谢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jules holds his biscuit halfway to his mouth while considering the contents of his collection.
beats.chinese: Jules把饼干举到嘴边，停在半途，想了想自己的收藏。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A loose plastic eye from an old toy. It rattles. Horrible thing to find when you're looking for a bottle opener.
beats.chinese: 旧玩具上掉下来的一只塑料眼睛，摇起来会响。找开瓶器时翻到那玩意儿，可真够吓人的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He laughs, finishes the biscuit and lowers his hand. He stays beside the route, turning back toward the bay.
beats.chinese: 他笑了，吃完饼干，把手放下来。他留在路旁，重新转向海湾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That one's staying in the box. Anyway, I'll let you enjoy the view. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 那东西还是老实待在盒子里吧。好了，不耽误你看风景。聊得挺开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jules lowers the biscuit and gives a small shake of his head.
beats.chinese: Jules放低饼干，轻轻摇了摇头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, no recording today. I make sound effects for radio drama. Work stays at the studio. I'm just eating a biscuit.
beats.chinese: 哦，今天不录音。我是给广播剧做音效的。工作留在录音室里。我这会儿就是吃块饼干。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He eats the last bite and turns along the walking route, away from the water's edge.
beats.chinese: 他吃完最后一口，转身沿着通行路线走去，与水边保持着距离。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, back to the walking part. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好了，接下来该散步了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jules stops moving aside. There is already room beside the route for both of you to stand without obstructing anyone.
beats.chinese: Jules不再往旁边挪了。路旁原本就有空间让你们各自站着，不妨碍别人通行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, looking. Got it. You can finish your own sentences from here.
beats.chinese: 啊，看海。明白了。接下来你的话都由你自己说完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives an apologetic grin, turns slightly away to leave you space and finally takes a bite of his biscuit.
beats.chinese: 他带着歉意笑了笑，稍稍侧过身给你留出空间，终于咬了一口饼干。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the bay. I'll get back to this before I forget why I'm holding it.
beats.chinese: 慢慢看海吧。我得继续吃了，免得忘了自己拿着它是干什么的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The route ahead remains clear. Jules stays out of it as you continue along the shore.
beats.chinese: 前方的路是通畅的。你沿着岸边继续走，Jules留在不挡路的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Thanks for saying it yourself.
beats.chinese: 好。谢谢你自己把话说完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts the biscuit in a brief farewell, then turns back toward the bay rather than following.
beats.chinese: 他举了举饼干，简短地道别，随后转回去看海湾，没有跟上来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your walk. I've got a bit of lunch to finish. Well, one biscuit.
beats.chinese: 散步愉快。我还有点午饭要解决。好吧，就是一块饼干。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Bondi's rocky shore, Jules Ngata stands beside the safe walking route, clear of passing people. His phone shows the booking page for his next beginner surfing lesson. He recognises you and raises his free hand.
beats.chinese: 邦迪岩岸边，Jules Ngata站在安全通行路径旁，不妨碍来往的人。他的手机停在下一次初级冲浪课的报名页面上。他认出你，抬起空着的那只手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. Been hovering over this booking for a while. The longer I wait, the more ways I find to embarrass myself. Haven't even got in the water yet.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我对着这报名页面犹豫好一阵了。等得越久，越能想出自己会怎么丢脸。这还没下水呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks down, completes the booking himself and checks the confirmation. Then he pockets his phone and looks up with a quick grin.
beats.chinese: 他低下头，自行完成报名，查看了确认信息。随后他把手机收进口袋，抬起头咧嘴一笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Booked. Just a walk today. I'll save getting scared about the next lesson for when I'm actually there.
beats.chinese: 报好了。今天先散步，不提前把下一堂课吓完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Bondi's rocky shore, Poppy Whitlock stands clear of the passing path, holding a phone and a small notebook. On a short stay in Sydney, she's come early to meet a friend for a coastal walk. She types 'Waiting beside the rocks', then starts adding several lines from her notebook.
beats.chinese: 邦迪岩岸边，Poppy Whitlock拿着手机和一本小笔记本，站在不挡往来路径的地方。她暂住悉尼，今天提早来等朋友一起沿岸散步。她输入“岩岸旁等”，接着又开始照着本子补上好几行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A message about where to meet doesn't need the whole walking list, does it?
beats.chinese: 碰头消息里是不是不用连散步清单也发过去？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances over at you, then deletes the extra lines, leaving only the meeting description in the draft. The notebook stays tucked in her other hand.
beats.chinese: 她看向近处的你，随后删去补充的几行，草稿里只留下碰头位置的描述。本子却仍夹在她另一只手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've still made a list for the walk. I'm Poppy, by the way.
beats.chinese: 我还是给散步列了张清单。对了，我叫Poppy。

choices.english: You've planned the walk already?
choices.chinese: 散步你都提前安排好了？

choices.english: Does everything go in that notebook?
choices.chinese: 你什么都往那个本子上记吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Poppy turns the notebook towards herself and counts the entries with one finger.
beats.chinese: Poppy把本子转向自己，用一根手指数着上面的条目。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Only four things. Five if you count meeting here, which I've already ticked. Excellent progress by a stationary woman.
beats.chinese: 才四项。算上在这里碰头就是五项，那项我已经打钩了。一个站着没动的人，进展相当不错。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her phone lights up in her other hand. She reads the message and lets out a short laugh.
beats.chinese: 她另一只手里的手机亮了。她看了一眼消息，短促地笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's nearly here. And she's written 'no itinerary' again. Twice now. Reckon that counts as feedback.
beats.chinese: 她快到了。又写了一遍“别排日程”。已经两遍了。我看这算是反馈了。

choices.english: I'm with her on that. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 这点我站她那边。祝你们散步愉快。

choices.english: I like a plan. What's first?
choices.chinese: 我倒喜欢有计划。第一项是什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Poppy turns past the walking list. Two headings on the next page read 'Tried' and 'Shelved'.
beats.chinese: Poppy翻过散步清单。下一页有两栏，标题分别是“试过”和“搁置”。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Suggestions, mostly. Mum sends courses. Friends send things I apparently need to attend. Nothing gets a yes straight away.
beats.chinese: 主要记各种建议。我妈发课程，朋友发那些据说我非去不可的活动。我都不当场答应。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She spots an old entry and rubs a thumb over its date.
beats.chinese: 她注意到一条旧记录，拇指在日期上蹭了蹭。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. Radio kit weekend. That one's been shelved since March. I install rural broadband for a living, then leave my own little radios in pieces.
beats.chinese: 啊，周末组装收音机。三月起就搁着了。我靠给乡下装宽带吃饭，自己的小收音机却一直散着。

choices.english: How about one radio kit next weekend?
choices.chinese: 那下周末先装一台收音机怎么样？

choices.english: I'll leave your list alone. Enjoy the coast.
choices.chinese: 我就不给你的清单添东西了。好好看看海吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Poppy closes the notebook and puts it in her pocket. The passing path remains clear beside her.
beats.chinese: Poppy合上本子，塞进口袋。她身旁的往来路径一直空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two votes against. Harsh result for a document with such neat ticks.
beats.chinese: 两票反对。钩都打得这么整齐了，这结果有点惨。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks out across the bay, then catches herself checking the time on her phone and lowers it.
beats.chinese: 她望向海湾，接着又忍不住看了眼手机时间，随即把手机放低。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The timekeeping department's apparently staying open. Anyway, enjoy Bondi.
beats.chinese: 看来计时部门还没下班。总之，祝你在邦迪玩得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Poppy reads the first unticked line, then looks directly at the sea in front of her.
beats.chinese: Poppy读了第一条没打钩的内容，又抬头看向眼前的大海。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Look at the water. I've written that down. Good thing I brought instructions.
beats.chinese: 看海。我居然把这也写下来了。幸亏带了说明书。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She ticks the line, then types a short message telling her friend she's beside the rocks. She puts the phone away and lowers the notebook.
beats.chinese: 她给那一行打了钩，又发了条短消息，告诉朋友自己就在岩石旁。随后她收起手机，放低本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, I'll keep the rest for her. Enjoy your own stretch of coast.
beats.chinese: 行，剩下的留给她听。你也好好逛逛这片海岸。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Poppy takes a pencil from the notebook's spine and writes 'one kit, next weekend' under 'Shelved'.
beats.chinese: Poppy从本子书脊处抽出铅笔，在“搁置”栏写下“下周末，一台”。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It goes in here first. No promises. I've already got three wooden cases waiting for radios that don't work.
beats.chinese: 先记在这里。不保证。我已经有三个木壳子，等着装那几台还响不了的收音机。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She notices the same suggestion farther up the page. She stops writing and slides the pencil back into place.
beats.chinese: 她发现同一页上方已经写过一样的建议。她停下笔，把铅笔插回原处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And now it's in twice. Very thorough neglect on my part. Anyway, I'll let you get on. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 现在记了两遍。搁置这件事，我做得可真周全。好了，不耽误你了，慢慢看海。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Poppy shuts the notebook without adding anything. Farther along the same path, a woman raises a hand to her.
beats.chinese: Poppy没有再添内容，直接合上本子。同一条路径稍远处，一位女子朝她举起手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. That page has enough ambition on it already.
beats.chinese: 谢了。那一页的雄心壮志已经够多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Poppy returns the wave. She stays off the path as her friend comes closer.
beats.chinese: Poppy挥手回应。朋友走近时，她仍站在路径旁边，不挡路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my mate. Lovely talking to you. Enjoy the rest of your day.
beats.chinese: 我朋友来了。跟你聊得挺开心。祝你接下来过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later outing at Bondi's rocky shore, Poppy stands away from the passing path with one earbud in. She recognises you and takes it out.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到邦迪岩岸时，Poppy正戴着一只耳机，站在不挡往来路径的地方。她认出你，摘下耳机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hey! Good to see you. Came down for some sea air and brought the ute playlist with me.
beats.chinese: 哦，嗨！见到你真好。下来吹吹海风，结果把皮卡里的歌单也带来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pauses the music on her phone and winds the earbud cable loosely around her fingers.
beats.chinese: 她在手机上暂停音乐，把耳机线松松地绕在手指上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One new song a month, then I absolutely wear it out. This one's only on day four. Anyway, hello properly.
beats.chinese: 每个月找一首新歌，然后拼命循环。这首才听到第四天。好了，正经跟你打个招呼。

causality.presenceReason: 她暂住悉尼，与朋友约好沿岸散步，提前到邦迪岩岸等候。
causality.placeAttitude: 愿意来海边休闲，却习惯把简单散步也排成清单。
causality.stayingConstraint: 朋友正在赶来，她需要留在约定的岩岸碰头位置。
causality.currentGoal: 给尚未抵达的朋友写清碰头位置，同时忍不住把已经列好的散步安排也补进消息。
causality.currentState: 心情轻松、愿意搭话，手上仍忙着清单和消息，没有真正进入休息状态。
causality.contactTrigger: 她在手机里写完“岩岸旁等”，又照着本子补充散步安排，便向近处玩家问碰头消息是否不用附上整张散步清单。随后她删去多余内容，草稿只留下碰头描述，自报姓名，本子仍夹在手里。接触来自她正在处理的日常沟通，不涉及误听、自言自语后的澄清或认错人。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留乡村宽带技师身份、组织欲、自嘲口吻、收音机与木壳爱好，以及建议先记下、不当场承诺的边界。她连碰头消息都想附上安排，呈现其闲不下来的组织习惯，不增加新的永久性格或经历。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家仍可选择散步安排或笔记本两条话题。aa中她收起清单却继续看时间。ab中她照单完成看海，再发送碰头位置描述，保留其余计划。ba中她把建议再次搁置，发现重复后自嘲结束。bb中她不添清单，向走近的朋友挥手并与玩家道别。四个结尾的核心事件保持不变。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程停留在邦迪岩岸旁的往来路径边，不占道、不靠近浪边，也不引入设施或新地点。手机和笔记本均为随身物品，bb中的朋友沿同一条路径走近。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Poppy Whitlock。本次重逢位于邦迪海岸，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Circular Quay, Marlowe Ngata-Ihaia is waiting for a friend under the terminal awning after work. As you come within speaking distance, their phone beeps. They silence it with a small frown.
beats.chinese: 在环形码头，Marlowe Ngata-Ihaia 下班后正在码头廊檐下等朋友。你来到能交谈的距离时，对方的手机响了一声。Marlowe 微微皱眉，把提示音关掉。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's mine. Apparently my phone thinks I haven't had enough beeping.
beats.chinese: 是我的手机。看来它觉得我今天听的提示音还不够多。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe pockets the phone and draws their small shoulder bag closer to their feet, leaving the pedestrian route clear.
beats.chinese: Marlowe 收起手机，把小挎包往脚边拢了拢，留出行人通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm waiting for a friend. There's room here, if you need it.
beats.chinese: 我在等朋友。你要是想在这儿待会儿，有地方。

choices.english: No harm done. Where have you been hearing all that beeping?
choices.chinese: 没关系。你在哪儿听了那么多提示音？

choices.english: Thanks. Is the space beside the column free?
choices.chinese: 谢谢。立柱旁边的位置有人吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe turns towards you, giving the conversation their full attention.
beats.chinese: Marlowe 转向你，专心听你说话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Harbour radio station. I'm a maritime radio operator. Weather, vessel traffic, the odd emergency. I've just finished a shift.
beats.chinese: 港口无线电台。我是海事无线电操作员，处理天气、船舶交通，偶尔也有紧急情况。我刚下班。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their hand briefly touches the pocket holding the phone, then drops back to their side.
beats.chinese: 对方的手碰了一下装手机的口袋，又放回身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Then I go home and repair an old shortwave receiver. A questionable choice of hobby.
beats.chinese: 然后回家修一台旧短波收音机。这爱好选得有点可疑。

choices.english: Does the receiver actually work?
choices.chinese: 那台收音机真的能用吗？

choices.english: I'll let you have a break from talking, then. I'll move on. Take care.
choices.chinese: 那就让你也歇歇嘴吧。我先走了，保重。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe glances at the open space beside the column and moves their bag out of it.
beats.chinese: Marlowe 看了一眼立柱旁的空处，把自己的包挪开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. Come round this side. It's a little quieter here.
beats.chinese: 没人。到这边来吧。这边稍微安静一点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They point out a spot for you, then lower their hand before you choose where to stand.
beats.chinese: 对方指了一个位置，还没等你选好站哪儿，就把手放下了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Listen to me, arranging people already. Anywhere clear of the walkway is fine. I'm keeping this side, though.
beats.chinese: 瞧我，已经开始给人安排位置了。不挡通道就都行。不过我还是待这边。

choices.english: This side works for me. I'll wait here.
choices.chinese: 这边挺合适。我就在这里等。

choices.english: I'll use the other side. Enjoy meeting your friend.
choices.chinese: 我去另一边。祝你和朋友聊得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe gives a small, pleased smile at the question.
beats.chinese: 听到这个问题，Marlowe 露出一点愉快的笑容。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Not yet. Lovely quiet thing so far. Even when it's fixed, the switch will get plenty of rest.
beats.chinese: 还不能。目前是个可爱的安静家伙。就算修好了，开关也会有大把休息时间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Someone under the awning waves to Marlowe. They wave back, lift their bag and turn towards their arriving friend without entering the pedestrian flow.
beats.chinese: 廊檐下有人向 Marlowe 挥手。对方挥手回应，提起包，转向刚到的朋友，没有走进行人通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, there's my friend. Good talking to you. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 啊，我朋友来了。和你聊天很愉快。祝你下午过得好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe nods as you prepare to move on.
beats.chinese: 你准备离开，Marlowe 点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Talking's been fine. Thanks for the chat.
beats.chinese: 聊聊天挺好的。谢谢你陪我说了几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lift their bag fully out of your route. You leave them waiting under the awning.
beats.chinese: 对方把包提起来，彻底让开你要走的方向。你继续前行，Marlowe 留在廊檐下等人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care.
beats.chinese: 保重。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take the space on Marlowe's side of the column. They keep their bag by their own feet rather than between you.
beats.chinese: 你站到立柱靠 Marlowe 的这一侧。对方把包放在自己脚边，没有隔在你们中间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. There's enough room for both of us.
beats.chinese: 好，这里够我们两个人站。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their phone vibrates. Marlowe reads the message and types a short reply giving their friend the meeting location.
beats.chinese: 手机振动了一下。Marlowe 看过消息，简短回复，告诉朋友自己站在哪里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They're looking for me. I'll leave you to your wait.
beats.chinese: 朋友在找我了。我就不打扰你等人了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You choose the other side of the column. Marlowe stays where they are, with the walkway clear between the waiting areas.
beats.chinese: 你选了立柱另一侧。Marlowe 留在原处，两边等候的位置都没有挡住通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. And thanks. We haven't caught up in a while.
beats.chinese: 当然可以。也谢谢你，我们有一阵子没见面了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe gives you a brief wave, then turns their attention back to the people arriving under the awning.
beats.chinese: Marlowe 向你轻轻挥手，随后重新望向来到廊檐下的人群。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Circular Quay, you see Marlowe under the awning, clear of the walkway, eating a late breakfast. They hold a securely wrapped sandwich and look up, recognising you.
beats.chinese: 在环形码头，你看见 Marlowe 在廊檐下、不挡通道的地方吃迟来的早餐。对方拿着包得稳妥的三明治，抬头认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm taking my time over this today. No rush to fill every spare minute.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天这顿我想慢慢吃，不赶着把空档填满。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe takes a bite of the sandwich, keeping the wrapper secure in their hand. They swallow before looking up at you again.
beats.chinese: Marlowe 咬了一口三明治，手里稳稳地拿着包装。对方咽下后，才再次抬头看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll finish my breakfast first. It's good to see you.
beats.chinese: 我先把早餐吃完。见到你很好。

causality.presenceReason: Marlowe 下班后已在环形码头廊檐下等朋友，不是为了遇见玩家才到场。
causality.placeAttitude: 把码头当作方便会合的地点，主动选择立柱旁相对安静的位置，并不把公共交通空间当成绝对安静的场所。
causality.stayingConstraint: 朋友尚未抵达，Marlowe 需要留在约定的廊檐区域等候。
causality.currentGoal: 关掉自己手机的提示音，在不挡通道的位置等到朋友。
causality.currentState: 刚结束无线电值班，对电子提示音有些厌烦，但仍愿意友善交谈。
causality.contactTrigger: 玩家来到交谈距离时，Marlowe 自己的手机响起，对方主动认领声音并开口。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留海事无线电职业、直接温和的表达、修复旧短波收音机的爱好，以及先替别人安排安静位置的小毛病。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 聊到收音机，朋友抵达后由 Marlowe 结束谈话。ab 玩家告辞，Marlowe 礼貌让路。ba 玩家选择同侧等候，Marlowe 回复朋友位置后结束闲聊。bb 玩家另选位置，Marlowe 接受并转回等人。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有动作均在同层廊檐、立柱及行人通道旁完成，不增加座椅、楼梯、店铺或其他设施。重逢时 Marlowe 在通道之外吃早餐，始终不挡行人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Circular Quay, Kai Brennan-Tuilagi stands under the awning near a column, clear of the pedestrian lane. He arrived early for a ferry on purpose. As you come within speaking distance, he notices the sign behind his head.
beats.chinese: 环形码头的廊檐下，Kai Brennan-Tuilagi站在立柱附近，避开行人通道。他特意提早来等船。你来到能听见他说话的距离时，他注意到自己脑后正对着一块标识。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Need to see that sign? I might be in the way.
beats.chinese: 要看那块标识吗？我可能挡着了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He points over his shoulder, leaving his feet where they are until he knows whether you need the space.
beats.chinese: 他朝肩后指了指，暂时没有挪脚，等着确认你是否需要他让开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Kai, by the way.
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫Kai。

choices.english: Yes, please. I can't quite see past you.
choices.chinese: 麻烦让一下，我这里看不太清。

choices.english: No, thanks. I'm just having a look around.
choices.chinese: 不用，谢谢。我只是随便看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kai takes a short step sideways along the awning, keeping out of the pedestrian lane. The sign is now unobstructed.
beats.chinese: Kai沿着廊檐往旁边挪了一小步，仍然避开行人通道。标识现在没有遮挡了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you go.
beats.chinese: 这下能看见了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances at his watch, then lowers his arm without reaching for anything else.
beats.chinese: 他瞥了眼手表，随即放下手臂，没有再去拿别的东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Early for my ferry. Managed that again.
beats.chinese: 来早了，等船呢。又来早了。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll check the sign and be on my way.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。我看一下标识就走。

choices.english: I'm going to walk along here. Want to join me for a bit?
choices.chinese: 我准备沿着这里走走。要一起走一小段吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kai lowers his hand. He stays beside the column rather than moving into your path.
beats.chinese: Kai放下手，仍待在立柱旁，没有走到你面前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Thought my head was covering half of it.
beats.chinese: 好。我还以为自己的脑袋挡住一半了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks briefly along the covered walkway, then rests two fingers against his temple.
beats.chinese: 他朝廊檐下的通道望了一眼，又把两根手指轻轻抵在太阳穴旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got a while before my ferry. Came early.
beats.chinese: 离我要坐的船还早。我提前来了。

choices.english: Do you usually get here this early?
choices.chinese: 你一般都会这么早到吗？

choices.english: I could suggest something to do while you wait.
choices.chinese: 我可以给你出个主意，等船时找点事做。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kai keeps the sightline clear while you check the sign.
beats.chinese: 你查看标识时，Kai留在旁边，没有挡住你的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No trouble.
beats.chinese: 不麻烦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: When you move on, he gives a small nod and settles back beside the column.
beats.chinese: 你继续往前走时，他轻轻点了下头，又在立柱旁站定。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: See you.
beats.chinese: 回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kai's answer comes before you have finished indicating the walkway.
beats.chinese: 你示意通道方向的手势还没做完，Kai就开口回答了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nah. I'm staying here.
beats.chinese: 不了。我就待这儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He catches his own clipped tone and gives you a brief, open-handed wave as you begin your walk. He does not follow.
beats.chinese: 他察觉自己的语气有些生硬。你开始往前走时，他张开手掌，简短地挥了挥手，没有跟上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for asking, though. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 不过，谢谢你叫我一起。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kai lowers his hand from his temple and turns towards you to answer.
beats.chinese: Kai把手从太阳穴旁放下，转过脸来回答你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Usually. Early for work, too. I handle problem parcels at a courier depot.
beats.chinese: 一般都早到。上班也一样。我在快递站处理那些出了问题的包裹。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He smooths a folded edge of his jade scarf, then lets his hands fall to his sides.
beats.chinese: 他抚平翡翠绿围巾的一道折边，随后让双手垂在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My mates stopped asking me to pick up coffee on the way. Kept telling them I'd already arrived. Anyway, I'll let you look around.
beats.chinese: 朋友们都不再叫我顺路带咖啡了。每次问，我都已经到了。好了，你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kai shakes his head before hearing a suggestion. His reply is a little sharper than his greeting.
beats.chinese: 还没听到具体建议，Kai就摇了头。回答比刚才打招呼时生硬了一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, thanks. I've got nothing to fit in.
beats.chinese: 不用，谢谢。我没打算往这段时间里塞什么事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives a small shrug and turns back towards the open walkway, ending the conversation without moving you along.
beats.chinese: 他轻轻耸肩，把脸转回通道方向，结束了交谈，也没有催你离开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing at Circular Quay, you spot Kai beside a column under the awning. He recognises you and gives a small nod.
beats.chinese: 在环形码头，你看见Kai站在廊檐下的立柱旁。他认出你，轻轻点了下头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Didn't come early on purpose today. Still got a bit of time.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天没特意早到，倒还有一点空。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances at a sign, then looks away. He settles where he is, clear of the pedestrian lane, with both hands empty. His phone stays put.
beats.chinese: 他看了一眼标识，便移开视线。他避开行人通道，在原地站定，双手空着，没有拿出手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait here. You go at your own pace.
beats.chinese: 我就在这儿等。你按你的节奏。

causality.presenceReason: Kai特意提前到环形码头等自己要乘的渡船，享受出发前没有任务的空档。
causality.placeAttitude: 他把这里当作可以安稳站一会儿的交通场所，没有游览或帮助陌生人的计划。
causality.stayingConstraint: 尚未到他准备乘船的时候，他选择留在廊檐下等候，不愿为了填时间另排行程。
causality.currentGoal: 不挡通道地等船，保留这段空闲。
causality.currentState: 精神平稳，愿意礼貌交谈，但没有主动结伴或找事做的打算。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Circular Quay, Talia Bregman waits beside a column, clear of the pedestrian route. She is meeting her friend Jo for a ferry outing and has brought her a folded secondhand jacket.
beats.chinese: 在环形码头，塔莉娅·布雷格曼站在立柱旁等人，没有挡住行人通道。她约了朋友乔一起坐渡轮，还给乔带来一件叠好的二手外套。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Jo! Over here! I've brought your jacket!
beats.chinese: 乔！这边！我把你的外套带来了！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She waves directly at you, then lowers her hand. She looks at you again and gives a short laugh.
beats.chinese: 她朝你直挥手，随后放下手，又看了你一眼，短促地笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hang on. I've got the wrong person. I'm Talia Bregman. Sorry, that was a very confident mistake.
beats.chinese: 等等。我认错人了。我叫塔莉娅·布雷格曼。抱歉，认错了还那么有把握。

choices.english: Wrong person, but hello. Is the jacket for your friend?
choices.chinese: 确实认错了，不过你好。外套是给你朋友的吗？

choices.english: I'm not Jo. I'm just passing through.
choices.chinese: 我不是乔。我只是从这里经过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Talia shifts the folded jacket onto one arm, keeping it out of the walkway.
beats.chinese: 塔莉娅把叠好的外套挪到一条胳膊上，没有让它伸到通道里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yep. Op-shop find. Jo wanted a short jacket with big pockets. Those details I remembered perfectly.
beats.chinese: 对，二手店淘来的。乔想要一件有大口袋的短外套。这些细节我倒是记得一清二楚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts one corner to reveal a large pocket, then catches a loose sleeve before it slips.
beats.chinese: 她掀起一个角，露出大口袋，又接住了一只快要滑下去的袖子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I work in lost property at a bus depot. Three years matching people's things. Then I come out here and get the actual person wrong.
beats.chinese: 我在公交车场管失物招领。干了三年，天天核对物品和失主。结果一到这里，倒把人认错了。

choices.english: I'd like to see the jacket, if you don't mind.
choices.chinese: 如果方便，我想看看这件外套。

choices.english: No need to unfold it. I'll stand a little farther along. Enjoy your outing.
choices.chinese: 不用展开了。我到旁边站一会儿。祝你们玩得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Talia lowers the jacket against her side and leaves the route ahead of you clear.
beats.chinese: 塔莉娅把外套放低，贴在身侧，没有挡住你前面的路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Sorry for calling you over.
beats.chinese: 明白。抱歉，刚才朝你喊了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She steps back beside the column and gathers the dangling sleeve into the fold.
beats.chinese: 她往后退到立柱旁，把垂下来的袖子收进折好的外套里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll let you get on. Have a good day.
beats.chinese: 不耽误你了。祝你今天愉快。

choices.english: Give her a quick farewell wave and keep walking.
choices.chinese: 向她挥手道别，继续往前走。

choices.english: Before I go, how did you decide I was Jo?
choices.chinese: 走之前问一句，你怎么会觉得我是乔？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Talia unfolds the jacket in front of herself. Its short hem and two deep pockets are easy to see.
beats.chinese: 塔莉娅在自己身前展开外套。短短的衣摆和两个深口袋都清楚地露了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here you go. Good pockets. I nearly kept it, which would have made this a fairly awkward handover.
beats.chinese: 你看。口袋真不错。我差点就自己留下了，那这次见面交衣服可就有点尴尬了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A woman approaches and calls Talia's name. Talia confirms that the woman is Jo, then folds the jacket and passes it to her.
beats.chinese: 一位女士走近，喊了塔莉娅的名字。塔莉娅确认她就是乔，随后叠好外套，交到她手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Jacket delivered to the right person. Nice meeting you. We're off!
beats.chinese: 好了，外套交到对的人手里了。认识你很高兴。我们走啦！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You move a little farther along, outside the pedestrian flow. Talia keeps the jacket folded rather than opening it.
beats.chinese: 你往旁边挪了一段，站在人流之外。塔莉娅没有展开外套，仍把它叠好抱着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Enjoy your day too.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。也祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns back towards the passing crowd, then gives you one small farewell nod without coming closer.
beats.chinese: 她转回身，看向来往的人群，又朝你轻轻点头道别，没有再靠过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait right here. Bye!
beats.chinese: 我就在这里等。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You give Talia a quick wave and continue along the pedestrian route.
beats.chinese: 你朝塔莉娅简单挥了挥手，沿着行人通道继续往前走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye!
beats.chinese: 再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She returns the wave from beside the column, then checks a message on her phone without following you.
beats.chinese: 她站在立柱旁挥手回应，随后查看手机上的消息，没有跟上来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, Jo. Different column. Of course.
beats.chinese: 哦，乔。原来在另一根柱子旁。好吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Talia turns back to you, eyebrows raised. The jacket stays tucked under her arm.
beats.chinese: 塔莉娅扬起眉毛，转回身看你。外套仍夹在她的胳膊下面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You looked familiar for half a second. Unfortunately, I got a whole sentence out in that half-second.
beats.chinese: 有那么半秒钟，我觉得你很眼熟。不巧的是，那半秒钟够我把一整句话喊出来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She laughs, then checks her vibrating phone. A message from Jo says she is delayed.
beats.chinese: 她笑了笑，随后查看振动的手机。乔发来消息，说自己要晚点到。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's running late. Right, I'll wait here and keep my hand down. Nice meeting you. Bye!
beats.chinese: 她要晚点来。好吧，我就在这里等，手也不乱挥了。认识你很高兴。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Circular Quay, Talia stands beneath the awning, comparing a note on her phone with the signs. She notices you and raises a hand.
beats.chinese: 在环形码头，塔莉娅正站在廊檐下，对照手机里的记录和现场标识。她注意到你，抬手打招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again! Talia, in case that helps. I think we've met. Tell me if I've done it again.
beats.chinese: 又见面啦！我是塔莉娅，提醒一下。我觉得我们见过。要是又认错了，直接告诉我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With the meeting point checked, she puts her phone away and rests a hand against the column beside her, clear of the pedestrian route.
beats.chinese: 核对好会合地点后，她收起手机，把一只手搭在身旁的立柱上，没有挡住行人通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm meeting a friend here today. Got the spot confirmed. I'll wait by this column this time, instead of wandering about looking. Good to see you!
beats.chinese: 我今天约了朋友在这里见面，位置已经确认好了。这回我就在这根柱子旁等，不到处找了。见到你真好！

causality.presenceReason: 塔莉娅先到环形码头等朋友乔，准备一起坐渡轮，并把替乔淘到的二手外套带来。
causality.placeAttitude: 她把这里当作普通的会合和出行地点，愿意聊天，但注意力也在等朋友上。
causality.stayingConstraint: 她与乔约在这里见面，需要留在附近等候，没有必须拉住玩家的理由。

causality.currentState: 今天精神轻快，招呼打得比辨认人更快，发现错误后直接承认。
causality.contactTrigger: 她把经过的玩家错认成乔，主动挥手喊人，随后察觉认错并自报姓名。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留热情、认脸不准、记物品细节、坦率纠错及二手外套爱好，通过一句日常闲聊保留公交车场失物招领工作。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Under the canopy at Circular Quay, Geoffrey Blythe stands beside a column, waiting for his daughter. He looks from a sign to you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在环形码头的廊檐下，Geoffrey Blythe站在立柱旁等女儿。他看了看一块标识，又望向近处的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can still see that sign from here, can't you? Sorry, I've just checked it myself.
beats.chinese: 从这里还能看见那块标识，对吧？抱歉，我自己刚刚才确认过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stays beside the column. His fingers tap the pocket of his coat while he looks down at the space between you.
beats.chinese: 他仍站在立柱旁，手指轻拍着外套口袋，低头看看你们之间的空地。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Geoffrey Blythe. I'm meeting my daughter here. She knows where I am. I keep looking anyway.
beats.chinese: 我叫Geoffrey Blythe。我跟女儿约在这里。她知道我在哪儿，可我还是忍不住一直看。

choices.english: Yes, you can see it. Have you been waiting long?
choices.chinese: 对，能看见。你等很久了吗？

choices.english: Yes, you can. There's plenty of room to stand here, too.
choices.chinese: 对，能看见。这里站着也很宽敞。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Geoffrey checks the pedestrian passage once more, then turns back to you. A small cloth bag hangs from his wrist.
beats.chinese: Geoffrey又看了一眼行人通道，随后转回身来。他手腕上挂着一个小布袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Only because I'm far too early. Checked the meeting place twice before I left, too. Sorry, you didn't need the whole report.
beats.chinese: 是我来得太早了。出门前还确认了两遍见面地点。抱歉，没必要跟你汇报这么细。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts the bag slightly. Through its open top, a cup wrapped in a tea towel is visible.
beats.chinese: 他稍稍提起布袋。从敞开的袋口，可以看见一只用茶巾包着的杯子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thirty-one years checking park fountains in Manchester. Hard habit to lose. I've brought my daughter a cup to look at. Upside-down fish all round it.
beats.chinese: 我在曼彻斯特巡查公园饮水台，干了三十一年。这习惯不好改。我带了只杯子给女儿看，上面印了一圈倒着的鱼。

choices.english: I'd like to see those fish.
choices.chinese: 我想看看那些鱼。

choices.english: What kept you checking after you retired?
choices.chinese: 退休之后，是什么让你还一直检查呢？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Geoffrey looks at the clear passage, then checks the gap beside his shoes again.
beats.chinese: Geoffrey看了看畅通的行人通道，又低头确认了一遍鞋边的空隙。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. Plenty. I was about to ask you again, wasn't I? Sorry.
beats.chinese: 对，很够。我刚才是不是又要问一遍了？抱歉。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a small logbook halfway out of his pocket. Seeing its filled page, he quickly closes it and pushes it back.
beats.chinese: 他从口袋里抽出半本小记录簿。看见写满的那一页，他又赶紧合上，塞了回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't work here. Retired parks man. I could stand closer to the column and leave this bit clear.
beats.chinese: 我不在这里工作，以前是干公园维护的，已经退休了。我可以再靠近柱子一点，把这块地方空出来。

choices.english: Yes, by the column would be better. Thank you.
choices.chinese: 好，靠柱子站会更好。谢谢。

choices.english: I'll carry on. Enjoy seeing your daughter.
choices.chinese: 我先走了。祝你和女儿见面愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Geoffrey stays beside the column and unwraps the cup over his open bag, keeping it out of the pedestrian passage.
beats.chinese: Geoffrey留在立柱旁，在敞开的布袋上方解开茶巾，没有把杯子伸进通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Every fish upside down, except that little one by the handle. Took me two days to spot him.
beats.chinese: 看，除了把手旁边那条小鱼，其他全是倒着的。我过了两天才发现它。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the cup once so the small fish is visible, then wraps it securely and lowers it into the bag.
beats.chinese: 他转了一下杯子，让那条小鱼露出来，随后重新包好，放回袋中。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've collected odd cups since 1998. My daughter says this one's particularly dreadful. Good to meet you. I'll let you get on.
beats.chinese: 我从1998年就开始收集怪图案的杯子了。女儿说这只尤其难看。很高兴认识你，不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Geoffrey lowers the cloth bag. His fingers stop moving against his coat pocket.
beats.chinese: Geoffrey放下布袋，原本在外套口袋上轻敲的手指停了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's an old incident behind some of it. I don't talk about that. Sorry, I'd rather leave it there.
beats.chinese: 有一部分跟过去的一件事有关。那件事我不谈。抱歉，我想就说到这里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the loose corner of the tea towel into the bag and settles it against his leg. He turns to face the passage where he is waiting.
beats.chinese: 他把茶巾露出来的一角折进袋里，让袋子贴在腿边，转身朝向自己等人的那条通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for stopping a moment. I'll wait here for my daughter. Take care.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你停下来聊了几句。我就在这里等女儿了。慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Geoffrey moves closer to the column, leaving more space between himself and the pedestrian passage.
beats.chinese: Geoffrey往立柱边挪了挪，让自己与行人通道之间多留出一些空地。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There we are. Thanks for saying so.
beats.chinese: 这样就好了。谢谢你直接说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens his logbook, makes a short entry, then turns the page quickly when he notices how full it is. He closes the cover against his palm.
beats.chinese: 他打开记录簿，简短记了一笔。看见那页已经写得很满，他迅速翻过去，把本子合在掌心里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Writing down where I'm standing now. Yes, I know. Anyway, I won't keep you. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 连自己站在哪儿都记下来了。嗯，我知道。好了，不耽误你了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the pedestrian passage, Geoffrey stays beside the column rather than following.
beats.chinese: 你沿着行人通道继续走，Geoffrey留在立柱旁，没有跟上来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. She'll be pleased I haven't wandered off looking for her.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。她会很高兴我没有为了找她又到处乱走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He begins to lean forward for another look, catches himself and straightens. His hand returns to his coat pocket.
beats.chinese: 他刚要探身再张望一次，便察觉了自己的动作，重新站直，手又放回外套口袋上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye, then. And thanks for answering.
beats.chinese: 那就再见了。也谢谢你回答我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Circular Quay, Geoffrey Blythe stands beside a column under the canopy. He recognises you and gives a small wave.
beats.chinese: 在环形码头，Geoffrey Blythe正站在廊檐下的立柱旁。他认出了你，轻轻挥了挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. My daughter knows where I'm standing. I still keep wanting to look round the column.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。女儿知道我站在哪儿，可我还是总想绕到柱子那边看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His hand touches the coat pocket holding his logbook. His gaze shifts towards the side of the column again.
beats.chinese: 他的手碰了碰装着记录簿的外套口袋，目光又朝立柱侧边移去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I know she can find me. I'll wait a bit longer. Hope your day goes well.
beats.chinese: 我知道她找得到我。我再等一会儿。祝你今天顺利。

causality.presenceReason: Geoffrey提前来到环形码头，与女儿约在立柱旁会合，还带了收藏杯给她看。
causality.placeAttitude: 这里是普通会合地点。他认可约定，却忍不住反复确认标识、张望柱侧，难以安心等候。
causality.stayingConstraint: 女儿知道他在立柱旁，他需要留在约好的位置。这不限制玩家离开。
causality.currentGoal: 等女儿到来，同时反复确认从站位能否看见标识，以及自己是否留出了通道空间。
causality.currentState: 今天来得过早，手脚闲不住。待人温和，明知刚确认过仍想再问，随即羞赧道歉，不要求玩家照看自己。
causality.contactTrigger: 他站稳在立柱旁，向近处玩家询问从这里是否仍能看见标识，尚未得到回答便承认自己刚确认过。随后说明正在等女儿，女儿知道他的位置，他却仍忍不住张望。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: It is a weekend at Glebe Markets, with stalls on the school grounds. Rio Castellanos has come looking for a zip pouch for their loose belongings. At the edge of an aisle, a playing card slips from their pocket and lands beside your shoe.
beats.chinese: 周末的格里布市集在学校场地上开市。Rio Castellanos 来找一个装零碎物件的拉链袋。在通道边，一张扑克牌从 Rio 的口袋滑出，落在你鞋边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's mine. I'm Rio. I'll pick it up.
beats.chinese: 那是我的。我叫 Rio。我来捡。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rio tucks the rest of the deck into its box and pauses at the edge of the aisle, looking at the fallen card.
beats.chinese: Rio 把其余的牌塞进牌盒，停在通道边，看着掉落的那张牌。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could you give me a little room?
beats.chinese: 能给我让一点地方吗？

choices.english: Of course. [Step aside.]
choices.chinese: 当然。[往旁边让开。]

choices.english: [Pick up the card and offer it back.] Here you go. Do you do card tricks?
choices.chinese: [捡起牌，递回去。] 给你。你会变纸牌魔术吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rio retrieves the card and straightens up, leaving the middle of the aisle clear.
beats.chinese: Rio 捡起牌，直起身，仍然让通道中央保持畅通。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I came for a zip pouch. I measured my phone so I'd get the right size.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我来找个拉链袋。还量了手机尺寸，免得买错大小。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rio checks one pocket, checks it again, then opens their bag.
beats.chinese: Rio 摸了一个口袋，又摸了一遍，接着打开随身包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now I just need the paper with the measurements.
beats.chinese: 现在只差找到记尺寸的那张纸了。

choices.english: You'll need another pouch for the paper.
choices.chinese: 你还得再买个袋子装那张纸。

choices.english: I'll leave you to look. Have a good day. [Continue along the aisle.]
choices.chinese: 那你慢慢找。祝你今天愉快。[沿通道继续走。]

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rio accepts the card by its corner and slides it into the deck. Their shoulders relax a little.
beats.chinese: Rio 捏住牌角接过牌，把它插回整副牌里，肩膀稍稍放松。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. A few little tricks. Dennis gets restless in my pocket.
beats.chinese: 谢了。会几个小把戏。Dennis 在我口袋里待不住。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rio lifts the card box slightly, keeping their hands close so other shoppers can pass.
beats.chinese: Rio 稍稍举起牌盒，双手收在身前，让其他顾客可以经过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Dennis is the deck. Want one quick trick, or shall I put him away?
beats.chinese: Dennis 就是这副牌。想看个很快的小魔术，还是让我把它收起来？

choices.english: Yes, I'll watch one quick trick.
choices.chinese: 好，我看一个小魔术。

choices.english: No trick, thanks. Why Dennis?
choices.chinese: 不用表演，谢谢。为什么叫 Dennis？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rio stops searching and gives a small, reluctant smile.
beats.chinese: Rio 停下翻找，忍不住露出一点笑意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Don't. I'd actually buy it. Then I'd need somewhere to put that.
beats.chinese: 别说了。我真会买。然后又得找地方放它。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A folded paper is caught under the bag strap. Rio pulls it free, checks the numbers and zips the bag shut.
beats.chinese: 一张折好的纸卡在包带下面。Rio 抽出纸，核对数字，把包拉好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Phone-sized. No room for a second pouch. Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 找到了。按手机尺寸买。装不下第二个袋子。逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the aisle, Rio remains at its edge with the bag open.
beats.chinese: 你沿着通道继续走，Rio 留在边上，包还敞着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for making room.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你刚才让开。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rio reaches towards the same pocket again, catches the movement and switches to the other one. They glance up to say goodbye.
beats.chinese: Rio 又伸向刚才那个口袋，中途停住，换了另一个，随后抬头向你道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good day.
beats.chinese: 祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rio stays at the edge of the aisle and holds up a card showing the ace of clubs.
beats.chinese: Rio 留在通道边，举起一张梅花 A。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ace of clubs. Keep an eye on the spots.
beats.chinese: 梅花 A。盯着上面的花色图案。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rio turns the card face down, taps it with the box and turns it over. It is now the two of clubs. They return it to the deck and close the box.
beats.chinese: Rio 把牌翻到背面，用牌盒轻敲一下，再翻回来。现在是梅花二。Rio 把牌放回去，合上牌盒。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two clubs. An extremely slow way to get a full deck. Thanks for watching.
beats.chinese: 梅花二。照这个速度凑齐一副牌，可得等很久。谢谢捧场。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rio closes the box without taking out another card.
beats.chinese: Rio 没再抽牌，直接合上牌盒。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No big reason. I name my things. My skates are the twins.
beats.chinese: 没什么特别原因。我会给自己的东西起名字。我的轮滑鞋叫双胞胎。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rio puts the deck in a zipped pocket, checks that it is closed and turns towards the stalls.
beats.chinese: Rio 把牌放进带拉链的口袋，确认拉好，然后转向摊棚。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Dennis gets the secure pocket now. He's had enough freedom. Enjoy looking around.
beats.chinese: 现在给 Dennis 换个牢靠的口袋。它已经自由活动够了。你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Glebe Markets, Rio Castellanos stands beside a stall, holding a zip pouch they are considering. They recognise you and lift their free hand briefly.
beats.chinese: 在格里布市集，Rio Castellanos 站在摊边，手里拿着一个正在考虑的拉链袋。Rio 认出了你，空着的手略微抬了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi again. I remember the measurements today. This zip doesn't pull smoothly with one hand, so I'll leave this one.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天尺寸记得很清楚。不过这个拉链单手拉起来不顺，我就不买这个了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rio returns the pouch to its place on the stall, folds the measurement note and puts it away. They close their bag without hurrying, keeping the aisle clear.
beats.chinese: Rio 把拉链袋放回摊位原处，折好尺寸记录，收进包里，再从容地合上包，始终让出通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The size is right. That doesn't mean I have to buy it. I'll keep looking. Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 尺寸合适也不一定就要买。我再看看，你慢慢逛。

结构校验、模型复核与正式编辑批准分别记录；本条保持草稿状态。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Glebe Markets, weekend shoppers move between canopies on the school grounds. Warwick Selby, here to look for old film scores on vinyl, stands at the edge of an aisle with a folded list held securely in his hand. He lets a group of shoppers pass, then turns to you nearby.
beats.chinese: 格里布周末市集开市了，顾客在学校场地的摊棚间走动。Warwick Selby来这里找老电影原声黑胶，站在通道边，手里稳稳拿着一张折起的清单。他让过一拨顾客，随后转向近处的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have you seen any stalls selling old film scores on vinyl today? No trouble if you haven't. I'm still looking.
beats.chinese: 你今天有见到卖老电影原声黑胶的摊吗？没见到也没事，我还在找。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps the list in his hand and draws his tote closer to his side, leaving room for passing shoppers.
beats.chinese: 他仍把清单拿在手里，将手提袋收近身侧，给经过的顾客留出空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Warwick Selby. Looking for film scores. Writing a list was supposed to keep the search manageable.
beats.chinese: 我叫Warwick Selby，来找电影原声。本来以为写张清单，就能少找一点。

choices.english: What's on the list?
choices.chinese: 清单上都有什么？

choices.english: Good luck with the search. I'm just passing through.
choices.chinese: 祝你找得顺利。我只是路过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Warwick opens the sheet. Record titles fill one side. On the reverse is a neatly ruled catalogue plan.
beats.chinese: Warwick展开纸。一面写满唱片名，背面是一张画得整整齐齐的编目计划。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The Third Man, among others. This is left over from a record catalogue I made with the bloke who helped fix our film society's projector.
beats.chinese: 有《第三人》，还有几张。这张纸是之前做唱片目录时剩下的。当时有个人和我一起做，他还帮我们电影协会修过放映机。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His finger stops beside a name on the reverse. He rotates the sheet to read it.
beats.chinese: 他的手指停在背面的一个名字旁，又把纸转过来读了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Martin. We finished in March. I know exactly where he lives. Haven't called once since the catalogue was done.
beats.chinese: Martin。我们三月做完的。我知道他住在哪里。目录做完后，一次电话都没打。

choices.english: You could call him without a project. I'll leave you to your list.
choices.chinese: 没有项目也可以给他打电话。我不耽误你看清单了。

choices.english: Tell me about one record, then I'll move on.
choices.chinese: 给我讲一张唱片吧，讲完我就走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Warwick folds the list down to its original size and keeps it in his hand.
beats.chinese: Warwick把清单折回原来的大小，拿在手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws his tote closer to his side, clear of passing shoppers. A decorative cord knot is wrapped around one handle.
beats.chinese: 他把手提袋收近身侧，给经过的顾客留出空间。袋子的一侧提手上绕着一个装饰绳结。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bag's ten years old. That knot has had three revisions. The bag has been very patient.
beats.chinese: 袋子用了十年。那个结已经改了三版。袋子倒是一直很有耐心。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰了。再见。

choices.english: Three revisions? Is the knot finished now?
choices.chinese: 改了三版？现在这个结算打完了吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Warwick looks at Martin's name again as you finish saying goodbye.
beats.chinese: 你道别时，Warwick又看了一眼Martin的名字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He's got a sewing machine that sticks. I could take a look at the feed dogs, check the plate, get it moving again.
beats.chinese: 他有台缝纫机老卡住。我可以看看送布牙，检查一下针板，让它重新转起来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a pencil from his pocket and writes SEWING MACHINE beside the name. Then he folds the list and turns his attention back to the stalls.
beats.chinese: 他从口袋里掏出铅笔，在名字旁写下“缝纫机”，随后折起清单，把注意力转回摊位。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That gives me something to ring him about. Good meeting you.
beats.chinese: 这下有事可以给他打电话了。很高兴认识你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Warwick folds the catalogue side inward, leaving The Third Man visible at the top.
beats.chinese: Warwick把目录那面折到里面，只露出顶上的《第三人》。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The Third Man. Mostly zither. Very exposed sound. You hear the scrape as well as the note.
beats.chinese: 《第三人》。主要是齐特琴，声音很直接，除了音符，连拨弦的摩擦声都听得见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He hums a few wordless notes, taps the title once, and pockets the sheet as you move on.
beats.chinese: 他轻轻哼了几个音，点了一下片名。你继续往前走时，他把清单收进口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the one I'm hoping for. Thanks for the chat. Enjoy the rest of your visit.
beats.chinese: 我最想找到的就是这张。谢谢你陪我聊几句，接着慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You say goodbye and continue along the aisle. Warwick stays beside the same canopy, out of the flow of shoppers.
beats.chinese: 你道别后沿通道继续走。Warwick留在原来那顶摊棚旁，没有挡住来往顾客。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. Mind how you go.
beats.chinese: 再见，慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives a brief wave, opens his list again, and runs a finger down the record titles.
beats.chinese: 他简短地挥挥手，重新打开清单，手指沿着唱片名往下移。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Six titles. That ought to be enough.
beats.chinese: 好，六张。应该够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Warwick glances down at the knot, keeping the tote close to his leg.
beats.chinese: Warwick低头看了看绳结，手提袋仍收在腿侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It holds, so it qualifies. I can see one turn I'd change, but I'm leaving it tied here.
beats.chinese: 系得牢，就算合格。有一圈我还想改，不过在这里就不拆了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He presses the knot once with his thumb, then closes his hand around the handle and turns back towards the stalls.
beats.chinese: 他用拇指按了一下绳结，随后握住提手，转身重新面向摊位。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Loose cord in a busy aisle would be a poor fourth version. Enjoy your wander.
beats.chinese: 第四版要是变成通道里拖着的一根散绳，那就不怎么样了。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Glebe Markets, Warwick stands beside a canopy with two record sleeves partly visible in his tote. He recognises you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 另一个周末，在格里布市集，Warwick站在摊棚旁，手提袋里露出两张唱片封套。他认出你，笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've bought two recordings of the same film score. I wanted to compare them. That was my argument.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我买了同一部电影原声的两个录音版本，想对比着听。我就是这么说服自己的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts the tote slightly, feels its weight, and lowers it beside his leg.
beats.chinese: 他稍稍提起袋子，掂了掂重量，又把它放回腿侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The argument sounded better before I had to carry both. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 还没开始拎的时候，这理由听起来更充分些。见到你真好。
