beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The weekend market is open on the school grounds at Glebe Markets. Beside you at a stall selling used books, Nyarai Chirwa holds an old cookbook. A closed sketchbook is tucked inside her bag.
beats.chinese: 周末，格里布市集在学校场地上开市。你身旁的旧书摊边，Nyarai Chirwa拿着一本旧烹饪书。合上的素描本已经收在她的包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Someone's doubled the ginger. Another cook has written a very firm objection. This book's had a lively kitchen life.
beats.chinese: 有人把姜加倍，另一位厨师写下了坚决的反对意见。这本书在厨房里过得挺热闹。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks up from the open book and gives you a small smile, keeping herself and her bag clear of the aisle.
beats.chinese: 她从摊开的书页上抬起头，对你微微一笑，人和包都避开了通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Nyarai. Two kinds of pencil on this page. The cooks didn't agree, either.
beats.chinese: 我叫Nyarai。这页上有两种铅笔字。做饭的人也没谈拢。

choices.english: What recipe were you looking at?
choices.chinese: 你刚才在看什么食谱？

choices.english: Is that a sketchbook in your bag?
choices.chinese: 你包里那本是素描本吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nyarai turns the open cookbook slightly toward you, showing the heading for a ginger cake recipe. Her sketchbook stays in her bag.
beats.chinese: Nyarai把摊开的烹饪书稍稍转向你，给你看姜味蛋糕食谱的标题。素描本仍收在包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A striped ginger cake. I paint show-jumping poles for work, so apparently I can't leave stripes alone.
beats.chinese: 条纹姜味蛋糕。我工作就是给马术场地障碍赛的横杆刷漆，看来下了班也绕不开条纹。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She points to two different sets of pencil notes beside the printed ingredients, keeping the book in her own hands.
beats.chinese: 她指着印刷配料旁两种不同的铅笔笔迹，书仍拿在自己手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One doubled the ginger. Someone else wrote 'absolutely not' beside it. Strong views survived the cake.
beats.chinese: 一个人把姜加倍。另一个在旁边写了“绝对不行”。蛋糕没留下，意见倒留下了。

choices.english: Would you try the printed recipe or the pencil version?
choices.chinese: 你会试印刷版，还是铅笔改过的版本？

choices.english: I'll leave you to choose. Enjoy the baking.
choices.chinese: 那你慢慢选。祝你烘焙愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nyarai puts the cookbook back on the pile and takes the notebook from her bag. Its cover lifts slightly, and she presses it closed with her palm before turning back to you.
beats.chinese: Nyarai把烹饪书放回书堆，从包里取出本子。封面微微翘开，她用手掌把它按好，才转回来看你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. Pencil portraits. They stay shut until they're finished.
beats.chinese: 是，铅笔肖像。没画完之前不打开给人看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the closed sketchbook against her side. Her grip relaxes, and she gives a small, crooked smile.
beats.chinese: 她把合上的素描本贴在身侧，手指松了些，嘴角露出一点歪歪的笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: An unfinished nose gets enough criticism from me.
beats.chinese: 一个没画完的鼻子，光被我挑毛病就已经够受了。

choices.english: Fair enough. I'll look at the cookbooks.
choices.chinese: 明白。那我看看这些烹饪书。

choices.english: Understood. Enjoy the market.
choices.chinese: 明白了。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nyarai follows the printed ingredient list with her finger, then checks where the pencil changes begin.
beats.chinese: Nyarai用手指顺着印刷的配料看下来，又核对铅笔改稿从哪里开始。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Print first. Then I'll know whose fault it is when I change it. No point borrowing two people's argument.
beats.chinese: 先试印刷版。之后我再改，出问题就知道怪谁。没必要连两个人的争执也借来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the cookbook and keeps it apart from the browsing pile, ready to ask the seller its price.
beats.chinese: 她合上食谱，先拿在手里，准备向摊主问价。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I like the notes, though. Someone used this properly. Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 不过我喜欢这些笔记。有人实实在在用过这本书。你逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nyarai checks the ingredients once more and closes the cookbook, keeping one finger between the pages.
beats.chinese: Nyarai又看了一遍配料，随后合上书，留一根手指夹在那一页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ginger and treacle. All right. I'll risk washing another cake tin.
beats.chinese: 姜和糖蜜。行吧，大不了再多洗一个蛋糕模。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She offers the cookbook to the stallholder, who takes it and begins serving her. Nyarai turns briefly toward you.
beats.chinese: 她把烹饪书递给摊主，摊主接过书，开始接待她。Nyarai朝你转了转头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one's coming home with me. Have a good browse.
beats.chinese: 这本我要带回家了。你慢慢挑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you turn to the cookbooks, Nyarai gathers her bag and sketchbook out of the browsing space.
beats.chinese: 你转向烹饪书时，Nyarai把包和素描本收拢，腾出挑书的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go ahead. I'll give you some room.
beats.chinese: 你看吧。我给你让点地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She settles at the edge of the stall, clear of passing shoppers. She opens the sketchbook toward herself and begins moving a pencil across the page.
beats.chinese: 她站到摊位边缘，避开来往的顾客，把素描本朝向自己打开，开始落笔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll draw for a bit. Happy hunting.
beats.chinese: 我先画一会儿。祝你淘到好书。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nyarai slips the closed sketchbook into her bag and checks that its corners are tucked inside.
beats.chinese: Nyarai把合上的素描本放进包里，确认几个角都收了进去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. I've spent long enough on that cake recipe.
beats.chinese: 你也是。我在那道蛋糕食谱上花的时间够多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves away from the books, lets two shoppers pass, then turns along the same aisle with her bag over her shoulder.
beats.chinese: 她离开书堆前的位置，让两位顾客先过，再背好包，沿着同一条摊间通道往前走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. I'll see what else is here.
beats.chinese: 好了。我去看看这里还有些什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Glebe Markets, Nyarai stands beside a stall canopy with a closed sketchbook in her hand. She looks up and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 另一个周末，在格里布市集，Nyarai站在摊棚旁，手里拿着合上的素描本。她抬头认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I thought I'd draw for a bit today, then carry on looking at books.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。今天我想先画一会儿，再接着淘书。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Keeping clear of passing shoppers, she opens the sketchbook toward herself and studies an unfinished page without turning it toward you.
beats.chinese: 她避开来往的顾客，把素描本朝向自己打开，查看尚未完成的那一页，没有转过来给你看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm keeping this to myself for now. I'll finish these few lines. Enjoy your browse.
beats.chinese: 这会儿还不拿出来给人看。我先画完这几笔，你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The weekend market is open on the school grounds at Glebe Markets. Fay Kettering has come to browse after a morning clearing behind a cabinet. Beside the aisle, she is reading an old receipt. She looks up at you nearby.
beats.chinese: 周末的格里布市集已在学校场地开市。Fay Kettering上午清理了柜子后面的角落，现在过来随便逛逛。她站在通道边读一张旧收据，抬头看向近处的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This isn't today's bill. I brought it along to keep reading.
beats.chinese: 这不是今天的账。我是带出来继续看的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps the receipt in her hand and looks again at the faded print, clear of the passing shoppers.
beats.chinese: 她把收据拿在手里，又看向上面褪色的字，没有挡住来往的顾客。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Six brass hooks. I want to see what I needed all six for.
beats.chinese: 六个黄铜挂钩。我想看看，当时什么东西要用上整整六个。

choices.english: “Is that an old shopping list?”
choices.chinese: “是以前的购物清单吗？”

choices.english: “I'll leave you to your reading.”
choices.chinese: “那我不打扰你看了。”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Fay holds the receipt by its uncreased edge. Other shoppers continue along the aisle.
beats.chinese: Fay捏着收据上没有折痕的一边。其他顾客继续沿通道走动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hardware receipt. I worked in a shop in western Sydney for years. These days I breed guppies and bettas, part-time.
beats.chinese: 是五金店的收据。我以前在悉尼西区一家店里干了很多年。现在兼职繁育孔雀鱼和斗鱼。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the faded print towards the light without moving into the flow of shoppers.
beats.chinese: 她把褪色的字转向亮处，没有挪进来往的人流里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Found it behind a cabinet. I meant to clear one corner. So far I've mostly been reading.
beats.chinese: 在柜子后面找到的。本来想清理一个角落。到现在主要是在读东西。

choices.english: “What did you buy?”
choices.chinese: “你当时买了什么？”

choices.english: “Have your fish won any prizes?”
choices.chinese: “你养的鱼得过奖吗？”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Fay looks up from the receipt and gives you a small nod.
beats.chinese: Fay从收据上抬起目光，朝你轻轻点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I'll carry on, then.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。那我接着看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stays beside the aisle while a few shoppers pass, her attention returning to the paper.
beats.chinese: 她留在通道边，等几位顾客走过去，目光重新落回纸上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll finish this, then have a look round.
beats.chinese: 看完这张，再接着逛。

choices.english: “Enjoy your look round. I'll leave you to it.”
choices.chinese: “慢慢逛，那我不打扰了。”

choices.english: “You could throw it away.”
choices.chinese: “可以扔掉嘛。”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Fay angles the receipt so the short list is visible to you.
beats.chinese: Fay把收据转了个角度，让你看见上面那张短短的清单。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Six brass hooks and a bag of sand. The hooks are probably holding something up. The sand has had more exercise than I have.
beats.chinese: 六个黄铜挂钩，还有一袋沙。挂钩大概还挂着什么东西。那袋沙的运动量比我还大。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives a small laugh, folds the receipt into her bag and turns towards the stalls.
beats.chinese: 她轻轻笑了一声，把收据折好放进袋里，转身朝向摊棚。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I use it for tossing sandbags at the community hall. Right, I'd better actually look at this market. Thanks for stopping to talk.
beats.chinese: 我拿它装沙袋，在社区活动厅玩投掷。好了，得认真逛逛这个市集了。谢谢你停下来聊聊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Fay lowers the receipt. Her reply comes quickly, with none of the detail she was offering a moment ago.
beats.chinese: Fay放下收据。她很快答了话，不再像刚才那样多说细节。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't enter judged shows.
beats.chinese: 我不参加评奖的展赛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the paper away without looking at it again, gathers her bag handles and moves on along the aisle.
beats.chinese: 她没再看那张纸，直接收好，拢起袋提手，沿通道继续走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll be moving on. Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 我接着逛了。逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Fay puts the folded receipt securely inside her bag and makes room for another shopper to pass.
beats.chinese: Fay把折好的收据放稳，又让出空当，给另一位顾客经过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Plenty to look at.
beats.chinese: 你也是。有不少东西可看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: When the aisle clears, she joins the moving shoppers and turns her attention to the stalls.
beats.chinese: 通道空下来后，她随着顾客往前走，把注意力转向摊位。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Might get past the paperwork now.
beats.chinese: 这下也许能看点账单以外的东西了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Fay glances at the receipt in her hand.
beats.chinese: Fay看了一眼手里的收据。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could. I've only read the front.
beats.chinese: 是可以。我才读完正面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns it over and settles beside the aisle, clear of passing shoppers. Her attention shifts to a few handwritten figures on the back.
beats.chinese: 她把纸翻过来，在通道边站定，没有挡住来往顾客。她的注意力落到背面几行手写数字上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My old stock notes. This may take a minute. I'll get back to this.
beats.chinese: 我以前写的库存记录。可能得看一会儿。我接着看了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Glebe Markets, Fay stands beside the aisle between the stalls. She recognises you and gives a brief wave.
beats.chinese: 另一个周末，在格里布市集，Fay站在摊间通道边。她认出你，简短地挥了挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Two plain buttons. That's what I'm here for today.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。两颗素面纽扣。今天就是来找这个的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances at her cuff to check the style she needs, then lowers her hand.
beats.chinese: 她看了一眼自己的袖口，确认需要的样式，随即放下手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Once I've got them, I'm heading home. I'm not looking at every stall today. Enjoy your wander.
beats.chinese: 买到就回去，今天不打算每摊都看。你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Elizabeth’s Bookshop in Newtown, Mabel Fenwick is looking for pictures of rooms to inspire her miniature film sets. She holds a large open book upright against her front and glances towards you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在纽镇的 Elizabeth’s Bookshop，Mabel Fenwick 正在找室内图片，为她的微缩电影布景寻找灵感。她把一本摊开的大书竖着收在身前，朝近处的你看了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh! This room photo even shows all the corners. That's what I'm after!
beats.chinese: 哦！这张房间图居然把墙角都拍全了。我正找这个！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps the book close to her jacket, leaving the aisle clear. A folded sheet covered in small handwriting protrudes from her pocket.
beats.chinese: 她仍把书收在外套前，让通道保持畅通。一张折过的纸露在口袋外，上面写满了小字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's reference for my own miniature film sets. I'm Mabel. Came in for one book. Somehow I've brought a list with three versions of it.
beats.chinese: 这是给我自己做的微缩电影布景找参考。我叫 Mabel。本来就想找一本书，不知怎么带来了三个版本的书单。

choices.english: What sort of book are you looking for?
choices.chinese: 你想找什么样的书？

choices.english: I'll leave you to your book.
choices.chinese: 那我就不打扰你看书了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mabel stays close to the shelves and opens the folded sheet above the book. Tiny additions run along both margins.
beats.chinese: Mabel 靠着书架站好，把折纸摊在书上。两边页边都挤着补写的小字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Rooms with plenty of detail. I make little stop-motion films. A chair, a crooked door, someone having a terrible eleven seconds.
beats.chinese: 想找细节多的房间图片。我做些定格小短片。一把椅子，一扇歪门，再让某个角色倒霉十一秒。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She follows one handwritten arrow, turns the sheet over, then turns it back. The same book description appears three times.
beats.chinese: 她顺着一个手画的箭头看过去，把纸翻到背面，又翻回来。同一段选书要求写了三遍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here. Tiny rooms. Tiny rooms again. And tiny rooms with windows. That's apparently a separate category.
beats.chinese: 这里，小房间。又是小房间。还有带窗的小房间。看来这得单算一类。

choices.english: Are your films online anywhere?
choices.chinese: 你的短片在网上能看到吗？

choices.english: You could just cross out the repeated bits.
choices.chinese: 你可以直接把重复的部分划掉。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mabel gives you a quick smile, keeping the book close to her beside the shelves.
beats.chinese: Mabel 朝你笑了一下，仍站在书架旁，把书收在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Enjoy your browse.
beats.chinese: 好呀。祝你逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She unfolds her list against the book. Her finger stops at three identical entries, and she gives a small snort.
beats.chinese: 她把书单摊在书上，手指停在三个完全一样的条目旁，忍不住轻轻笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Three reminders for one thing. Apparently I don't trust the first two.
beats.chinese: 一件事提醒三遍。看来前两遍我都信不过。

choices.english: Give a small nod and continue along the aisle.
choices.chinese: 轻轻点头，继续沿通道走。

choices.english: Pause. “Three reminders should do it.”
choices.chinese: 停一下。“提醒三遍应该够了吧。”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mabel shakes her head with a quick smile. She folds the list and tucks it fully into her pocket.
beats.chinese: Mabel 笑着迅速摇摇头，把书单折好，完全塞进口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, no. I don't put them online. I like choosing who gets to see my plasticine disasters.
beats.chinese: 哦，没有。我不把它们放到网上。我的橡皮泥灾难片给谁看，我想自己挑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens the book to an illustrated room and studies a small doorway near the edge of the page.
beats.chinese: 她把书翻到一幅室内插图，仔细看着页面边缘的一扇小门。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The latest one ends with a door falling on the landlord. Eleven seconds, including the credits. Anyway, I'll have a look through this. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 最新那部的结尾是一扇门砸中了房东。算上片尾字幕，十一秒。好啦，我再翻翻这本。很高兴和你聊了几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mabel takes a short pencil from her pocket and positions its point over a repeated entry. She hesitates, then turns the sheet over.
beats.chinese: Mabel 从口袋里摸出一截铅笔，把笔尖对准一个重复条目。她犹豫了一下，又把纸翻到了背面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, that would be quicker. Only this one mentions windows, and that one's got the size beside it...
beats.chinese: 对，那样是快些。只是这条提到了窗户，那条旁边又写了尺寸……

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She returns the book to its gap in the shelf and starts copying a fresh list on the back of the old one.
beats.chinese: 她把书放回书架原来的空位，开始在旧书单背面重新抄写。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll make one clean version. Ah, I've put windows in twice already. Right. I'll let you browse.
beats.chinese: 我重写一份整齐的。啊，窗户已经又写了两遍。好啦，不耽误你看书了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the aisle with a small nod. Mabel keeps herself and the book close to the shelves.
beats.chinese: 你轻轻点头，继续沿通道走。Mabel 仍靠着书架，收好手里的书。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Happy browsing.
beats.chinese: 慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the list around her finger, puts it away, and opens the book again. Her attention settles on the page.
beats.chinese: 她用手指抵着书单把它折好，收进口袋，再次打开书，把注意力放回书页上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, there it is. The room with the little door.
beats.chinese: 哦，找到了。有小门的那个房间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mabel looks down at the three entries, then up at you with an exaggeratedly doubtful expression.
beats.chinese: Mabel 低头看看那三个条目，又抬头看你，脸上故意摆出一副很不相信的表情。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You'd think so. I can ignore a list at quite a high level.
beats.chinese: 按说是够了。不过，无视书单这件事，我很有水平。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pockets the paper, returns the large book to its place, and pulls out a smaller volume from beside it.
beats.chinese: 她把纸收进口袋，将大书放回原处，又抽出旁边一本小些的书。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, this one's got tiny kitchens. Completely off-list. Excellent. Enjoy your browse.
beats.chinese: 哦，这本里有小厨房。完全不在清单上。太好了。祝你逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Elizabeth’s Bookshop in Newtown, Mabel Fenwick compares a photograph on her phone with a page in a book. She recognises you beside the shelves.
beats.chinese: 在纽镇Elizabeth’s书店，Mabel Fenwick拿手机照片对照书页，在书架旁认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Bought an old picture frame last week. There's a mark on the back I can't make out. It may be the maker. It may be a scratch.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。上周买了个旧相框。背面有个印记看不清，可能是制造者，也可能就是道划痕。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She enlarges her photograph, finds no match and returns to the book's index.
beats.chinese: 她放大照片，没找到对应图样，又翻回书的索引。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No luck yet. Still a nice frame. I'll keep looking a minute. Enjoy your browse.
beats.chinese: 还没找到。相框还是好看的。我再查一会儿。你慢慢看书。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Inside Elizabeth’s Bookshop in Newtown, Barry Whitmore stands beside the shelves with books on moths and sock knitting. With you nearby, he looks up from the covers.
beats.chinese: 在纽镇的 Elizabeth’s Bookshop，Barry Whitmore 站在书架旁，手里拿着飞蛾和袜子编织各一本书。你就在附近，他从封面上抬起头来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I am leaving familiar subjects alone today. No more of those.
beats.chinese: 今天我不再拿熟悉的题材了。那些先不看了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He briefly lifts the moth book so you can see its cover, without offering it to you. The sock-knitting book remains in his other hand.
beats.chinese: 他稍稍举起飞蛾那本书，让你看见封面，没有递过来。另一本袜子编织书还拿在他另一只手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Moths should qualify. Though I must admit I am still holding a book on knitting socks.
beats.chinese: 飞蛾应该算陌生题材。不过我得承认，我手里还拿着一本织袜子的书。

choices.english: I'll leave you to choose.
choices.chinese: 那你慢慢选。

choices.english: What are you looking for?
choices.chinese: 你在找什么书？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Barry stays beside the shelf and looks down at the two covers.
beats.chinese: Barry 仍站在书架旁，低头看看两个封面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Certainly. I came in for something different and somehow collected another knitting book.
beats.chinese: 当然。我本来想找点新鲜的，不知怎么又拿了本编织书。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts the knitting book slightly. A photograph of a patterned sock fills its cover.
beats.chinese: 他稍稍举起编织书，封面上是一只花纹袜子的照片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I already knit socks. That one is cheating.
beats.chinese: 我本来就织袜子。选这本算作弊。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Enjoy your book.
choices.chinese: 那就不打扰了。祝你看书愉快。

choices.english: Why is another knitting book cheating?
choices.chinese: 为什么再看一本编织书就算作弊？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Barry turns the books so you can see their covers, keeping them out of the aisle.
beats.chinese: Barry 把书转向你，让你看见封面，同时没有占住通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Something I know nothing about. Knitting was a poor attempt. Moths are a much better prospect.
beats.chinese: 找点我完全不懂的东西。编织这个选择不怎么样。飞蛾就有希望多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the moth book, then holds the closed knitting book towards you without releasing it.
beats.chinese: 他翻开飞蛾那本书，又把合着的编织书递向你，但没有松手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, we will try a page each. You can have knitting. That settles the next five minutes.
beats.chinese: 好，我们各看一页。编织这本给你。接下来五分钟就这么安排了。

choices.english: You have arranged that rather quickly. I'll browse on my own.
choices.chinese: 你安排得可真快。我还是自己看吧。

choices.english: One page, all right. I'm not agreeing to buy anything.
choices.chinese: 好吧，就一页。我可没答应买书。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You turn your attention away from Barry. He keeps the two books in his hands and stays beside the shelf.
beats.chinese: 你把注意力从 Barry 身上移开。他仍拿着两本书，站在书架旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. Enjoy your browse.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。你也慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He returns the knitting book to its gap and opens the moth book. His attention settles on a photograph.
beats.chinese: 他把编织书放回原来的空位，翻开飞蛾那本书，目光落在一张照片上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye, then.
beats.chinese: 那就再见了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Barry lowers the knitting book but keeps a finger between its pages.
beats.chinese: Barry 放低编织书，一根手指还夹在书页之间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I spent nearly forty years arranging flower-market transport. Same routes before dawn. Retirement was meant to widen things a little.
beats.chinese: 我安排花市运输干了快四十年。天不亮就跑那些固定路线。退休了，总该把日子过得宽一点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances once more at the sock cover, then returns that book to its place. He keeps the moth book against his side.
beats.chinese: 他又看了一眼袜子封面，随后把书放回原处，把飞蛾那本留在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I do like making socks, though. I will finish the pair at home. Enjoy your browse.
beats.chinese: 不过，我确实喜欢织袜子。家里那双我还是会织完。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Barry immediately draws back the offered book. His reply is a little louder, though his expression stays cheerful.
beats.chinese: Barry 立刻收回递出的书。回答的音量高了一点，脸上却依旧乐呵呵的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Five minutes is hardly an expedition. But yes, I did allocate yours without asking.
beats.chinese: 五分钟又算不上出远门。不过，是，我没问就把你的时间安排了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the moth book and moves a short distance along the clear aisle, leaving you access to the shelves where he stood.
beats.chinese: 他合上飞蛾那本书，沿着畅通的过道挪开一小段，把刚才身旁的书架留给你看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I will leave you to your own selection. Good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 那你自己选。午安。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Barry hands you the knitting book. You each read one page beside the shelves, with the aisle left open.
beats.chinese: Barry 把编织书交给你。你们各自在书架旁看了一页，没有占住通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Agreed. One page. The wallet is not involved.
beats.chinese: 说定了，就一页。这事不牵涉钱包。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After the page, you hand the book back. Barry returns it to its original gap and closes his own book.
beats.chinese: 看完一页，你把书交还给他。Barry 把它放回原来的空位，也合上了自己手里的书。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mine had an enormous moth. That will do for a first inspection. Thank you for the company. I will carry on here.
beats.chinese: 我这页有只大得惊人的飞蛾。初步了解就到这里。谢谢你作伴，我接着在这儿看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Elizabeth’s Bookshop in Newtown, Barry Whitmore stands beside the shelves with a book on an unfamiliar subject in one hand. He is typing a message to Dennis on his phone with the other. He recognises you and looks up with a broad smile.
beats.chinese: 在纽镇的 Elizabeth’s Bookshop，Barry Whitmore 站在原来的书架旁，一手拿着一本陌生题材的书，另一手正用手机给 Dennis 写消息。他认出你，抬起头，满脸笑容。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again! I want something new for my next catch-up with Dennis. I am suggesting we each bring a book we have never read.
beats.chinese: 又见面了！我想给下次和 Dennis 碰面添点新鲜事。我正准备提议，我们各带一本从没读过的书。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Barry sends the message, then starts typing a follow-up about which book they will read first and when they will swap. His attention returns to the phone as he opens a book list and scrolls through the titles.
beats.chinese: Barry 发出消息，随即又开始补写一条，安排两人先读哪本、什么时候交换。他的注意力又回到手机上，打开一份书目，继续往下查看书名。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He has not replied yet. I have already worked out which book comes first.
beats.chinese: 他还没回。我倒已经把先读哪本排好了。

causality.presenceReason: Barry 为打破熟悉的阅读选择，来到纽镇的 Elizabeth’s Bookshop 寻找自己不了解的题材，已经拿起飞蛾书和袜子编织书。
causality.placeAttitude: 他把书店视为寻找新事物的地方，却仍被自己熟悉的袜子编织吸引。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留下的外部义务。他尚未选定要继续看的书，因此暂时留在书架旁。
causality.currentGoal: 找一个真正陌生的题材，抵抗再选熟悉内容的冲动。
causality.currentState: 精神积极，愿意主动搭话，容易把短暂交谈直接升级为共同计划。此时没有挡路，也不需要玩家帮忙。
causality.contactTrigger: Barry 已站在书架旁，主动向近处的玩家宣告今天不再拿熟悉题材的书，亮出飞蛾书但不递出，随后承认另一手仍拿着袜子编织书。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留花市运输协调员的退休身份、求新倾向、织袜爱好、直接且爱安排的口吻。追问路线中未经同意便分配五分钟阅读，具体呈现其越俎代庖。保留悉尼、Petersham、Dennis 和每周网球等原有背景。重逢时，他热情招呼玩家，同时为与 Dennis 的下次碰面提出交换新书的计划，在对方尚未回复时便开始安排阅读顺序，延续其慷慨又爱提前替人安排的活力。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家先表示不参与时，Barry 仍补充自己的选书矛盾，玩家可结束交谈或追问。aa 中双方礼貌告别，他放回编织书并独自读飞蛾书。ab 中他透露职业经历与选书矛盾，放回编织书后结束交谈。玩家先追问时，他擅自分配阅读任务。ba 中玩家拒绝，他先略大声辩一句，再承认未经询问便安排了对方的时间，收回书并移开。bb 中玩家接受一页的限度，两人完成短暂阅读并归还书，各自继续。重逢不预设他已经学会克制，也不向玩家分派任务。他发出给 Dennis 的提议后，注意力很快被后续阅读安排和书目吸走。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有动作均在店内两侧书架之间的可见区域完成。初遇时 Barry 已靠书架站立，不存在挡路或让行的接触前提。展示、取还书与短距离移位均保持通道畅通，无新增设施。重逢仍在原书架旁，他拿书、用手机发消息和查看书目，不转移到其他场景。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Barry Whitmore。本次重逢位于纽镇独立书店，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Elizabeth’s Bookshop in Newtown, Cass Nguyen-Tran is browsing plant photographs after work. She stands beside the shelves with an open book, humming as you come within earshot.
beats.chinese: 在纽镇的 Elizabeth’s 书店，Cass Nguyen-Tran 下班后正翻看植物图片。她站在书架旁，手里摊着一本书。你来到近处时，能听见她轻轻哼歌。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello. I’m Cass. I’ve had this song in my head all afternoon.
beats.chinese: 哦，你好。我叫 Cass。这首歌在我脑子里转了一下午了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks back at the page and hums another few notes, then catches herself and looks up.
beats.chinese: 她低头看书，又哼了几个音，随后反应过来，抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hang on. Is the humming bothering you?
beats.chinese: 等一下。我哼歌是不是打扰到你了？

choices.english: It’s fine. Is that a gardening book?
choices.chinese: 没关系。那是园艺书吗？

choices.english: I’d prefer quiet, thanks.
choices.chinese: 我想安静一点，谢谢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cass keeps a thumb between the pages and glances at the cover.
beats.chinese: Cass 用拇指夹住书页，瞥了一眼封面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mostly plant pictures. I sharpen garden tools in Marrickville. Looking at things that need no sharpening makes a nice change.
beats.chinese: 主要是植物图片。我在 Marrickville 做园艺工具磨刃。换着看看不需要磨的东西，挺好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens the book again at a photograph of a fern.
beats.chinese: 她重新翻开书，停在一张蕨类植物的照片上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That’s a fern. Beyond that, I make the names up. Small Green Steve.
beats.chinese: 这是蕨类。再具体的名字，我就自己编了。绿色小史蒂夫。

choices.english: Can I see Small Green Steve?
choices.chinese: 能让我看看绿色小史蒂夫吗？

choices.english: I’ll leave you to your book and your tune.
choices.chinese: 那你继续看书、哼歌，我自己逛逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cass stops humming and lowers the book slightly.
beats.chinese: Cass 停下哼唱，把书稍稍放低。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Thanks for saying.
beats.chinese: 当然。谢谢你直接说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the open book closer to herself, leaving the nearby spines visible.
beats.chinese: 她把摊开的书收近身前，让旁边的书脊露出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can move along if you need these books.
beats.chinese: 你要看这几本的话，我可以往旁边挪。

choices.english: Yes, could I get to the books beside you?
choices.chinese: 好，能让我看看你旁边的书吗？

choices.english: No need. I’ll leave you to your book.
choices.chinese: 不用了。你继续看吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cass angles the open book towards you without stepping into the aisle.
beats.chinese: Cass 把摊开的书朝你倾斜，没有迈到通道中间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There he is. Very leafy. Terrible at conversation.
beats.chinese: 就是他。叶子挺多，不怎么会聊天。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After holding the photograph steady for a moment, she turns the book back towards herself and closes it.
beats.chinese: 她稳稳地展示了一会儿照片，随后把书转回自己面前，合上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I’ll look through a few more. Steve’s got some competition.
beats.chinese: 我再翻翻别的。史蒂夫有竞争对手了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cass nods and lowers her gaze to the book, leaving you to browse independently.
beats.chinese: Cass 点点头，低头看书，让你自行浏览。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. I’ll keep it low.
beats.chinese: 好。我会小声点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She hums the remaining phrase softly, finishes it, and turns the page.
beats.chinese: 她轻轻哼完剩下的乐句，随后翻了一页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Finally got to the end. Enjoy looking round.
beats.chinese: 好了。总算哼完了。你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cass checks the visible aisle and moves a few steps along the same shelf, taking her book with her.
beats.chinese: Cass 看了看眼前的通道，拿着书沿同一排书架挪开几步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you go. Those are all clear.
beats.chinese: 好了。这几本前面都空出来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She settles beside a different section of the shelf and returns to the photographs without humming.
beats.chinese: 她在书架另一段旁站定，继续看图片，没有再哼歌。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I’ll carry on down here.
beats.chinese: 我就在这边接着看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cass stays beside the same shelf, with the aisle open beside her.
beats.chinese: Cass 留在原来的书架旁，身边的通道保持畅通。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. I’m happy here.
beats.chinese: 好，那我就在这儿看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens the book fully again and silently follows a picture caption with her finger.
beats.chinese: 她重新摊开书，用手指沿着图片说明往下看，没有出声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good browse.
beats.chinese: 你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Elizabeth’s Bookshop in Newtown, you spot Cass beside the shelves, holding a closed book. She recognises you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 在纽镇的 Elizabeth’s 书店，你看见 Cass 站在书架旁，手里拿着一本合上的书。她认出你，笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I’m a bit tired after work today. Only got through a few pages.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。今天下班有点累，只翻了几页。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She returns the book to the gap it came from and stays quietly beside the shelf.
beats.chinese: 她把书放回原来的空隙，仍安静地站在书架旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That’s enough browsing for today. Good to see you. I’m heading off.
beats.chinese: 今天看这些够了。见到你挺好，我准备走了。

causality.presenceReason: Cass 下班后已在书店翻看植物图片，来这里是为了随意浏览，不是在等玩家。

causality.currentState: 初遇时下班后放松、愿意简短交谈，注意力仍主要在书上，没有主动表演的打算。重逢当天则有些疲倦，只翻了几页便准备离开，仍愿意温和地打个招呼。
causality.contactTrigger: 玩家来到能听见哼唱的位置，Cass 打招呼后又下意识哼了几声，才停下来询问是否打扰。

causality.reactionAndChange: aa 应请求展示植物照片，短暂分享后结束交谈。ab 留在原处低声哼完乐句，双方各自浏览。ba 接受安静要求并沿书架让出取书位置。bb 停止哼唱、留在原处默读，礼貌结束互动。重逢时她说明疲倦，把书放回原处，简短告别，不要求玩家继续交谈。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有动作都发生在照片支持的书架、陈列与可见通道内。初遇只取放书和沿原书架挪动。重逢只在架边持书、归还书并停留，说准备离开，但不转移到新场景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Elizabeth’s Bookshop in Newtown, Dulcie Fairweather is comparing two lettering books close to the shelves. She came looking for one with clear examples. As you come near, she points to the subtitle on one cover.
beats.chinese: 在纽镇的 Elizabeth’s Bookshop，Dulcie Fairweather 正贴近书架比较两本字体书。她来找一本范例清楚的书。你来到近处时，她指了指其中一本封面上的副标题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That says 'complete alphabets', doesn't it? Just checking I haven't misread the subtitle. No need to stop if you're on your way.
beats.chinese: 这个写的是“完整字母范例”，对吧？我想确认不是我把副标题看岔了。你要是正要过去，不用特意停下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives you a moment to look, then lowers the book beside the other one, keeping both close to the shelf.
beats.chinese: 她留了片刻让你看清，然后把书放低，与另一本并在一起，两本都收在书架旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two books, neither quite the one. Very efficient of me.
beats.chinese: 两本书，哪本都差一点。我这效率可真高。

choices.english: Just passing, thanks.
choices.chinese: 我只是经过，谢谢。

choices.english: What are you choosing between?
choices.chinese: 你在比较哪两种书？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dulcie stays beside the shelf with both books lowered, leaving you room to pass.
beats.chinese: Dulcie 放低两本书，仍站在书架旁，留出让你通过的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Through you go. These can keep me occupied for ages.
beats.chinese: 请过。这两本够我琢磨好一阵了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances from one cover to the other, then gives a small, undecided shake of her head.
beats.chinese: 她看看这本的封面，又看看那本，轻轻摇了摇头，还是拿不定主意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I did promise myself I'd actually choose something.
beats.chinese: 我还答应过自己，这回一定要选定一本呢。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll carry on. Walk past her along the aisle.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，那我先走了。沿着通道从她身旁走过。

choices.english: Does either have what you came for?
choices.chinese: 这里面有你原本想找的吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dulcie lifts the books a little, keeping them out of the passage. Both covers are facing her.
beats.chinese: Dulcie 把两本书稍稍举起，没让它们伸进通道。两本的封面都朝着她自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one's got complete alphabets. That one's clearer about spacing.
beats.chinese: 这本有整套字母。那本把字距讲得更清楚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks at the plain backs facing you, pauses, and turns the books so you can see their covers.
beats.chinese: 她看见朝着你的都是没什么内容的封底，停了一下，把两本书转过来，让你看见封面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, wait, you couldn't see either. Alphabets in my left hand, spacing in my right. Years selling calligraphy paper, and I still skip the obvious bit.
beats.chinese: 不，等等，你刚才哪本都看不见。左手这本是字母，右手这本讲字距。卖了那么多年书法纸，我还是会漏掉这种明摆着的步骤。

choices.english: Could I look at the alphabet book, if you're finished with it?
choices.chinese: 如果你看完了，我能看看那本字母书吗？

choices.english: I'll leave you to choose. Enjoy your browse.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你挑了，慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You pass Dulcie along the clear aisle. She stays close to the shelves until you are past her.
beats.chinese: 你沿着空出的通道从 Dulcie 身旁走过。她靠着书架，等你通过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're welcome. Enjoy the books.
beats.chinese: 不客气，慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers one book and opens the other, keeping its pages close to her body.
beats.chinese: 她放低其中一本，翻开另一本，把摊开的书页收在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. One at a time, Dulcie.
beats.chinese: 好了，Dulcie，一次看一本。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dulcie considers your question and checks the contents pages of both books once more.
beats.chinese: Dulcie 想了想你的问题，又各看了一遍两本书的目录。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Only half of it in each. I wanted complete letters and clear spacing in the same book.
beats.chinese: 每本都只有我要的一半。我想找一本既有完整字母、又把字距讲清楚的书。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes both books and returns them to the gaps beside her, one at a time.
beats.chinese: 她合上两本书，一本一本放回身旁书架上的空位。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave these here. I've enough nearly-right books at home. Thanks for stopping.
beats.chinese: 这两本就留在这里吧。家里那种差一点合意的书已经够多了。谢谢你停下来聊两句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dulcie closes the alphabet book and holds it out within easy reach, without extending it across the aisle.
beats.chinese: Dulcie 合上那本字母书，在你方便接取的位置递过来，没有把书横伸到通道里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Certainly. I'm finished with this one. Here you are.
beats.chinese: 当然，这本我看完了。给你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take the book you asked to see. Dulcie keeps the spacing book and turns back towards its shelf.
beats.chinese: 你接过刚才提出想看的书。Dulcie 留下讲字距的那本，转身面向它原来的书架。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have another look through this one. Enjoy yours.
beats.chinese: 我再翻翻手上这本。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dulcie lowers both books and gives you a quick smile.
beats.chinese: Dulcie 放低两本书，朝你利落地笑了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. You've caught the slowest part of my day.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。你正好赶上我今天最磨蹭的时候。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She returns the alphabet book to its gap and opens the spacing book, leaving the passage clear.
beats.chinese: 她把字母书放回原来的空位，翻开讲字距的那本，仍让通道保持畅通。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one's worth a proper read. I'll get on with it. Enjoy your browse.
beats.chinese: 这本值得仔细看看。我接着看了。你也慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Elizabeth’s Bookshop in Newtown, Dulcie recognises you between the shelves. A phone vibrates in her hand, and she glances at its screen.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到纽镇的 Elizabeth’s Bookshop 时，Dulcie 在书架间认出了你。她手里的手机振动起来，她低头看了一眼屏幕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. My grandchildren have picked a very quiet place to ring me.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我孙辈可真会挑时候，偏等我到了这么安静的地方才打来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She declines the call and carefully types a short message, holding the phone close so she stays clear of the aisle.
beats.chinese: 她挂断来电，认真输入一条简短消息，把手机收在身前，没有占住通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I'll ring them when I'm outside. One of them has a new haircut. That'll need the camera.
beats.chinese: 好了，等我到外面再回电话。有一个刚换了发型，那可得开摄像头看。

causality.presenceReason: Dulcie 在玩家到来前已进店寻找范例清楚的字体书，正比较两本各有所长的书。
causality.placeAttitude: 她享受翻书，也会因挑剔而迟迟选不定，对自己的磨蹭带点干脆的自嘲。
causality.stayingConstraint: 她还没决定是否留下其中一本，暂时在原书架旁翻看，没有必须拉住玩家的理由。
causality.currentGoal: 找到兼有完整字母范例与清楚字距说明的书。
causality.currentState: 精神利落、愿意简短交谈，注意力主要仍在选书上。
causality.contactTrigger: 她已贴近原书架，见玩家来到近处，指着一本书封面的副标题，请对方确认是否写着完整字母范例。她只想核对文字，不要求书法知识，并明确允许玩家不停车回答，随后说起两本书都差一点合意。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留退休书法纸经销商身份、热心而利落的表达，以及解释时跳过显然步骤、发现后直接补正的习惯。核对副标题是一个具体的小问题，不把玩家拉进专业评审，也不假定玩家正在挑同类书。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家表示只是经过时，她礼貌留出通过的空间，也不强求回答。玩家追问时，她介绍两本书的区别，发现封面朝向自己后自行转正并补充说明。aa 玩家通过，她留在原处逐本翻阅。ab 她确认两本均不合要求，将两本放回。ba 她把已看完的字母书交给主动提出想看的玩家。bb 她放回字母书，专心阅读字距书。四条路径均结束当下交谈。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全部动作发生在两侧有书架与陈列的可见通道内。她起初已贴近书架，指认封面、放低书本、转书、归架和递书均在原书架旁完成，保持通道可供他人通过，不增加设施或进入其他区域。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatrice Ng is having coffee after table tennis on the bounded roadside terrace on Gertrude Street in Fitzroy. Her sports bag sits beside her feet. She shifts forward in her seat, ready to get up.
beats.chinese: 在菲茨罗伊 Gertrude Street 有实体围挡的路侧露台上，Beatrice Ng 打完乒乓球，正在喝咖啡。运动包放在她脚边。她往座位前沿挪了挪，准备起身。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm coming out this way.
beats.chinese: 我从这边出来一下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stays seated while people pass on the pavement behind the terrace. A folded sheet of handwritten scores rests on her lap.
beats.chinese: 露台后方的人行道上有人经过，她仍坐着等候。她腿上放着一张折过的手写比分纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just stretching my legs. I've finished playing.
beats.chinese: 就是起来活动活动腿脚。球已经打完了。

choices.english: How did the game go?
choices.chinese: 球打得怎么样？

choices.english: Would you like a hand with the bag?
choices.chinese: 要我帮你挪一下包吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatrice unfolds the score sheet, then presses it flat against her knee a little harder than necessary.
beats.chinese: Beatrice 展开比分纸，在膝上把它抹平，手上的力气稍微大了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lost the deciding game. Eleven-nine. I'm having coffee before I congratulate her again.
beats.chinese: 决胜局输了，十一比九。我先喝杯咖啡，再去恭喜她一遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her finger stops over the final score. She gives a short chuckle.
beats.chinese: 她的手指停在最后一局的比分上，短促地笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I did congratulate her once. Quite promptly, too.
beats.chinese: 我已经恭喜过一遍了。而且说得挺及时。

choices.english: Two points. That sounds close.
choices.chinese: 就差两分，听着很接近。

choices.english: I'll leave the score alone, then. Enjoy your coffee.
choices.chinese: 那我就不聊比分了。慢慢喝咖啡。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatrice reaches for both handles before you have touched the bag.
beats.chinese: 你还没碰到包，Beatrice 就先抓住了两根提手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got it.
beats.chinese: 我自己来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts it onto her lap, trapping the score sheet underneath. She pauses, then eases her grip.
beats.chinese: 她把包提到腿上，比分纸被压在下面。她顿了一下，松了松抓着提手的手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you, though. I'll wait until there's room.
beats.chinese: 不过，还是谢谢你。我等外面空一点再出来。

choices.english: All sorted. Enjoy your coffee.
choices.chinese: 那就好了。慢慢喝咖啡。

choices.english: I was only offering. I saw you reaching for it.
choices.chinese: 我只是问问。看你正伸手拿包。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatrice turns the sheet slightly so the final score is visible from the pavement.
beats.chinese: Beatrice 把纸稍微转过来，让人在人行道上也能看清最后的比分。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Close, yes. Then I served into the net. Excellent timing.
beats.chinese: 是接近。然后我一个发球下网。时机选得真好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She laughs, folds the sheet away and lifts her cup, ending the brief score review.
beats.chinese: 她笑了，把纸折好收起来，端起杯子，结束了这次简短的赛况回顾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She took her chances. Fair win. Right, this coffee's had quite enough time to cool.
beats.chinese: 她把机会抓住了，赢得没话说。好了，这咖啡也晾得够久了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatrice folds the score sheet with the numbers facing inward.
beats.chinese: Beatrice 把比分朝里，将纸折了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, let's. The paper's getting more attention than the coffee.
beats.chinese: 好，就不聊了。我看这张纸的时间都比喝咖啡多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the sheet in her bag and takes a sip. Her free hand gives you a small farewell wave.
beats.chinese: 她把纸放进包里，喝了一口咖啡，用空着的手轻轻挥了挥，向你道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The bag stays on Beatrice's lap, clear of the pavement. She settles its handles flat.
beats.chinese: 包留在 Beatrice 腿上，不再靠近人行道。她把提手放平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I will. Thanks for offering.
beats.chinese: 好。谢谢你刚才愿意帮忙。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives you a brief nod, then reaches around the bag for her cup.
beats.chinese: 她朝你点了点头，随后绕过腿上的包，伸手去拿杯子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatrice looks at the bag handles, then back at you. Her shoulders drop slightly.
beats.chinese: Beatrice 看看包的提手，又看看你，肩膀稍微放松下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You were. I answered rather sharply. Sorry.
beats.chinese: 是，你只是好意。我刚才回得有点冲。抱歉。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the score sheet into her bag and waits until the pavement is clear. Then she stands with the bag in one hand and raises her free hand in farewell.
beats.chinese: 她把比分纸收进包里，等人行道空下来，才提着包站起身，用空着的手向你道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, a quick stretch. Thanks, and enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好了，起来活动一下。谢谢，祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Gertrude Street terrace, Beatrice recognizes you from her seat as she takes a sip of coffee.
beats.chinese: 在 Gertrude Street 的露台，Beatrice 正坐着喝咖啡，看见你便认了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Won fair and square today. She made me work for every point.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天赢得干干净净，每一分都得自己拼。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the score sheet she has already checked and puts it in her bag. Then she lifts her cup again, smiling.
beats.chinese: 她把已经核对过的比分纸折好，收进包里，笑着重新端起杯子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now I've won, I won't spend all afternoon going over it. I can enjoy my coffee.
beats.chinese: 赢了就不用复盘一下午了。可以好好喝咖啡了。

causality.presenceReason: Beatrice 打完社交乒乓球后，已独自在 Gertrude Street 的路侧露台喝咖啡休息，随身带着运动包和自记比分。

causality.stayingConstraint: 她还没喝完自己的咖啡，只打算起身活动腿脚。露台后方的人行道有人经过，她先坐着等空当，不需要玩家让路、陪伴或代劳。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Gertrude Street, Nomvula Dlamini has paused beside the terrace boundary, clear of passing pedestrians. After her shift, she is finishing a paper puzzle for her niece's school. Holding the pages together, she looks up at you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在 Gertrude Street，Nomvula Dlamini 停在人行道靠露台边界的一侧，没有挡住行人。她刚下班，正在完成一张给侄女学校用的纸上谜题。她把纸页拢在一起，抬头看向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could I try one clue on you? Just your first thought. You don't need to solve the whole sheet.
beats.chinese: 能请你听一句谜题提示吗？说说第一反应就行，不用解整张。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps the pages facing herself and rests her pencil against them, waiting to write.
beats.chinese: 她仍把纸页朝着自己，将铅笔搭在纸上，暂时没有动笔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Nomvula. It has stations, but no trains. What comes to mind?
beats.chinese: 我叫 Nomvula。它有台，却没有火车。你会想到什么？

choices.english: A radio? Do you make the puzzles yourself?
choices.chinese: 收音机？这些谜题是你自己设计的吗？

choices.english: A radio, I think. Go ahead and finish your sheet.
choices.chinese: 我觉得是收音机。你继续把这张题写完吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nomvula smiles at your answer and starts changing a clue number. With you beside her, she hesitates and writes the same number twice. She turns the pages face down and puts the pencil in her bag.
beats.chinese: 听见你的答案，Nomvula 笑了笑，开始修改提示的编号。你在旁边，她迟疑了一下，把同一个号码写了两遍。她把纸翻到背面，将铅笔放进包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, for my niece's school. I mix clay three mornings a week. Apparently I also need unpaid paperwork.
beats.chinese: 是啊，给我侄女的学校用。我每周有三个上午调配陶土。看来还嫌不够，又给自己找了份没报酬的文书活。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the sheets together, leaving the unfinished puzzle out of sight, and turns her attention fully to you.
beats.chinese: 她把几张纸折在一起，收起没做完的谜题，把注意力转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: At home I build little electronics kits too. I can get those wrong without any paperwork.
beats.chinese: 我在家还会组装些小电子套件。那些就算做错了，也不用留下纸面记录。

choices.english: What sort of electronics kits?
choices.chinese: 什么样的电子套件？

choices.english: I'll let you get back to your puzzle. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 那不打扰你做谜题了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nomvula nods at your answer, rests the sheets against her bag and takes up her pencil. She writes a number, pauses, then crosses it out.
beats.chinese: 听见你的答案，Nomvula 点点头，把纸垫在包上，拿起铅笔。她写下一个数字，停了停，又把它划掉。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A radio, yes. I've given two different clues the same number. Efficient. Completely useless.
beats.chinese: 对，是收音机。我给两条不同的提示编了同一个号码。真省事，也真没法用。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She starts correcting the number, notices you beside her, and caps the pencil instead.
beats.chinese: 她刚要改正号码，注意到你还在旁边，便改为给铅笔套上笔帽。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I need to do the writing on my own. Happy to talk if I put the pencil away first.
beats.chinese: 写东西时我得自己来。先把铅笔收起来的话，我也愿意聊。

choices.english: Of course. I'll be on my way. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 当然。那我先走了，再见。

choices.english: Put it away, then. Hello properly, Nomvula.
choices.chinese: 那就先收起来吧。正式打个招呼，你好，Nomvula。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With the puzzle folded away, Nomvula's free hand begins tracing the small rectangular shape of a circuit board.
beats.chinese: 谜题收好后，Nomvula 空出的那只手比画起一块小长方形电路板的轮廓。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Little radios, mostly. I built one that buzzed beautifully. Receiving a station took another evening.
beats.chinese: 主要是小收音机。有一台嗡嗡响得特别好听。至于收到电台，又花了我一个晚上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She laughs, settles the folded papers inside her bag, and adjusts the strap to continue her walk.
beats.chinese: 她笑起来，把折好的纸放稳在包里，整理好肩带，准备继续走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I enjoyed that. I'd better get moving before I give you the full history of the buzzing. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 聊得挺开心。我得走了，不然要把那阵嗡嗡声的来龙去脉都讲给你听了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nomvula takes the pencil back out, then holds it against the folded papers while you part.
beats.chinese: Nomvula 重新拿出铅笔，把它按在折好的纸上，与你道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. There's only one clue left. I've said that three times already.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。只剩最后一条提示了。这话我已经说过三遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives you a small wave. Once you have moved on, she unfolds the sheet and returns to the unfinished clue.
beats.chinese: 她向你轻轻挥手。等你离开后，她才展开纸，继续处理那条没写完的提示。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 再见。很高兴跟你聊了几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nomvula lowers the papers rather than trying to work through the farewell.
beats.chinese: Nomvula 放低手里的纸，没有一边告别一边继续写。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. And thanks for understanding.
beats.chinese: 谢谢，也谢谢你体谅。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She waves goodbye as you leave. With nobody waiting beside her, she uncaps the pencil and changes the second six to a seven.
beats.chinese: 你离开时，她挥手道别。身旁没有人等着了，她拔下笔帽，把第二个六改成七。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Seven. There you are.
beats.chinese: 七。这就对了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nomvula puts both the pencil and the papers deep into her bag, then holds out her empty hands with a grin.
beats.chinese: Nomvula 把铅笔和纸都放进包里深处，笑着摊开空空的双手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello properly. Now I can manage that without crossing anything out.
beats.chinese: 正式你好。现在说这句话，总算不用涂掉重来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the bag and settles its strap on her shoulder, choosing to continue her walk with the puzzle unfinished.
beats.chinese: 她合上包，将肩带放稳，决定把谜题留着，继续走自己的路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm heading on. Glad we got a hello in before I numbered you seven. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 我要接着走了。幸好先打了招呼，没把你也编成七号。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing along Gertrude Street, Nomvula stands beside the terrace boundary, clear of passing pedestrians. Her puzzle is already in her bag. She recognises you as she reaches for her pencil.
beats.chinese: 另一天，在 Gertrude Street，Nomvula 站在露台边界旁，没有挡住行人。谜题已经收进包里。她正要拿出铅笔，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've handed in today's puzzle sheet.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天那一页谜题已经交出去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the pencil back into her bag and turns towards you with a smile.
beats.chinese: 她把原本要拿出的铅笔放回包里，笑着转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No more puzzle changes today. I've got time for a chat.
beats.chinese: 今天不改题了，我有空聊两句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Gertrude Street in Fitzroy, June Whitfield has stopped beside the terrace boundary after a cup of tea on her way home from dance class. Her bag is packed. Clear of passing pedestrians, she quietly counts through a few dance steps, with her cardigan over one arm.
beats.chinese: 在菲茨罗伊的 Gertrude Street，June Whitfield 上完舞蹈课回家，途中喝了杯茶。她停在露台边界旁，包已经收好，开衫搭在一只手臂上。她避开来往行人，轻声数着几个舞步的拍子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm not hurrying anyone along. Just trying to remember that last bit. I'm June Whitfield.
beats.chinese: 我不是在催谁走。就是想记住刚才那一段。我叫 June Whitfield。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: June stops counting and takes the cardigan off her arm, ready to put it on. She stays close to the terrace boundary.
beats.chinese: June 停下数拍，把搭在手臂上的开衫拿下来，准备穿上。她仍靠着露台边界站着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was heading home. Somehow there's always one more thing to do before I get going.
beats.chinese: 我正准备回家呢。不知怎么，每次要走了，总还有一件事没做完。

choices.english: Packing up always seems to take longer than it should.
choices.chinese: 收拾东西好像总比想象中费时间。

choices.english: Of course. I'll give you a little room.
choices.chinese: 明白。我往旁边让一点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: June shifts closer to the terrace boundary, keeping the pavement clear. She pauses with the cardigan in her hands.
beats.chinese: June 朝露台边界靠了靠，留出人行道。她拿着开衫，手上的动作停了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Especially after dancing. I stay to fold the tables, then get talking. Everyone else manages to go home.
beats.chinese: 尤其是跳完舞以后。我留下来折叠桌子，接着就聊起来了。别人倒是都能顺利回家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips one arm into the cardigan, then raises a finger to add something. Her other hand still holds the empty sleeve.
beats.chinese: 她把一只手臂伸进开衫，又竖起一根手指，想补上一句。另一只手还拿着没穿上的袖子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We tried a new turn this morning. I went the wrong way. Then I did it again, just to be certain.
beats.chinese: 今天上午我们学了个新的转身。我转反了。然后又来了一遍，确认自己确实转反了。

choices.english: Go on. How did the next try go?
choices.chinese: 接着说呀。下一次怎么样？

choices.english: I'd better head on. Nice meeting you, June.
choices.chinese: 我该走了。很高兴认识你，June。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You give June room beside the terrace boundary. She slips her arms into the cardigan.
beats.chinese: 你在露台边界旁给 June 腾出一点空间。她把双臂伸进开衫袖子里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. That's me nearly ready to go.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我这就差不多能出发了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She straightens the cardigan and settles her closed bag against her side.
beats.chinese: 她理好开衫，把已经拉好拉链的包安稳地贴在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thirty-odd years fixing lockers at a sports centre. The dance steps are taking a bit longer to get the hang of.
beats.chinese: 我在体育中心修了三十多年的储物柜。学会这些舞步，倒是还得多花点时间。

choices.english: All sorted. Enjoy the rest of your afternoon, June.
choices.chinese: 这下好了。祝你下午过得愉快，June。

choices.english: Did things get trapped in the locker doors too?
choices.chinese: 储物柜的门也会夹住东西吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: June rests a hand on her closed bag, still holding the empty sleeve. She counts three beats against the bag with her fingertips.
beats.chinese: June 把手搭在拉好的包上，手里仍拿着那只没穿上的袖子。她用指尖在包上敲了三拍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: On the third try I faced the right way. A beat late, but I could finally see the same wall as everyone else.
beats.chinese: 第三次总算朝对方向了。虽然慢了一拍，好歹跟大家看的是同一面墙了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks down at the sleeve in her hand, laughs and slips her other arm into it. She settles the bag's strap on her shoulder.
beats.chinese: 她低头看见手里的袖子，笑了笑，把另一只手臂伸了进去。随后把包带在肩上放稳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And I've been holding this the entire time. Right, home for me. Lovely having a chat. Bye now.
beats.chinese: 这件衣服我居然一直拿到现在。好了，我该回家了。聊得很开心，再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At your goodbye, June lowers her raised finger. Her cardigan is still only halfway on.
beats.chinese: 听见你道别，June 放下竖起的手指。她的开衫还只穿了一半。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Lovely meeting you. Off you go.
beats.chinese: 当然。很高兴认识你。快去吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She draws the bag fully against herself, leaving your way clear. As you head on, she starts pulling on the other sleeve.
beats.chinese: 她把包完全收拢到身前，给你留出路。你继续前行，她开始穿另一只袖子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll get this on before my next birthday. Probably.
beats.chinese: 下个生日之前，我应该能把它穿好。大概吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With the bag shut and the cardigan on, June no longer has anything hanging loose. She gives you a small wave.
beats.chinese: 包已经拉好，开衫也穿上了，June 身上不再有松垂的东西。她轻轻朝你挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Thanks for the bit of space.
beats.chinese: 你也是。谢谢你给我腾地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the pavement. June stays beside the terrace boundary to straighten a twisted cuff.
beats.chinese: 你沿着人行道继续走。June 留在露台边界旁，理好扭着的袖口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye now. Home for me too, in a minute.
beats.chinese: 再见啦。我也马上就回家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: June rests a hand on her closed bag. Her answer comes with a small, familiar nod.
beats.chinese: June 把一只手搭在拉好的包上，带着熟悉的神情轻轻点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sleeves, mostly. People would pull harder, and the sleeve would stay exactly where it was. Very determined things, sports tops.
beats.chinese: 大多是袖子。大家越拽越用力，袖子还是纹丝不动。运动上衣这东西，倔得很。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks that both straps are secure, then turns along the pavement, keeping out of other pedestrians' way.
beats.chinese: 她检查两根包带都已收好，随后沿人行道转过身，避让着其他行人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Anyway, I'm retired. No more arguments with other people's clothes. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 不过，我已经退休了。不用再跟别人的衣服较劲了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Gertrude Street, you see June Whitfield beside the terrace boundary, her cardigan already on. She recognises you and raises a hand.
beats.chinese: 在 Gertrude Street，你看见 June Whitfield 站在露台边界旁，开衫已经穿好了。她认出你，抬手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I'm heading home a bit earlier today. I won't stop for a chat this time.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我今天想早点回家，这次就不停下来聊了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She settles the bag securely on her shoulder and turns towards home, leaving room for people passing on the pavement.
beats.chinese: 她把包在肩上背稳，朝回家的方向转过身，给人行道上经过的人留出空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lovely to see you. Enjoy the rest of your day. Bye now.
beats.chinese: 很高兴又见到你。祝你今天接下来过得愉快。再见啦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Gertrude Street, beside the bounded roadside terrace, Toby Ashworth is waiting for his brother to meet him for coffee after work. He stands clear of passing pedestrians. He reads a new message on his phone and laughs.
beats.chinese: 在 Gertrude Street 有实体边界的路侧露台旁，Toby Ashworth 下班后正等弟弟来喝咖啡。他站在不妨碍行人的位置，读完手机上刚收到的消息，笑出了声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He says he'll be here any minute. That's a pretty flexible minute.
beats.chinese: 他说马上到。这个“马上”弹性挺大。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his phone and glances along the pavement, then looks towards you nearby.
beats.chinese: 他放低手机，沿人行道望了望，又看向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: At this rate, I'll finish my apprenticeship before he gets here.
beats.chinese: 照这个速度，等他到了，我都该出师了。

choices.english: Has the rest of your day gone like that?
choices.chinese: 你今天其他时候也这么不顺吗？

choices.english: How long have you been waiting?
choices.chinese: 你等多久了？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Toby stays beside the terrace boundary, out of the pedestrian flow. He shifts his bag on his shoulder.
beats.chinese: Toby 留在露台边界旁，没有挡住人行道。他调整了一下肩上的包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm a first-year irrigation apprentice. This morning a sprinkler got me in the face. Knocked me halfway across the oval.
beats.chinese: 我是第一年的灌溉技术学徒。今早一个喷头喷了我一脸，把我冲得飞过了半个球场。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts a hand to demonstrate, then catches himself and starts again, counting events on his fingers.
beats.chinese: 他抬手想比画一下，又停住，掰着手指重新讲起经过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hang on, I've started at the good bit. First my supervisor said, 'Stand back.' Then I decided one little step would do.
beats.chinese: 等等，我直接从精彩的地方讲起了。先是主管说，往后站。然后我觉得退一小步就够了。

choices.english: Halfway across the oval? Really?
choices.chinese: 飞过半个球场？真的？

choices.english: You can skip the full replay. Hope the coffee goes better.
choices.chinese: 不用从头重演啦。希望喝咖啡能顺利点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Toby checks the time on his phone, still standing clear of passing pedestrians.
beats.chinese: Toby 看了眼手机上的时间，仍站在不妨碍行人的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ten minutes. I've made it sound like three weeks already.
beats.chinese: 十分钟。我已经把它说得像三个星期了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He switches off the screen and holds the phone loosely at his side.
beats.chinese: 他关掉屏幕，把手机松松地握在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My brother's running late. I'll give him another five minutes before I check.
beats.chinese: 我弟弟迟到了。我再等五分钟，然后再问问他。

choices.english: You don't have to keep me entertained.
choices.chinese: 你不用一直逗我开心。

choices.english: I'll leave you to wait. Hope he gets here soon.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你等人了。希望他快到了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Toby pauses with one finger raised. His storytelling voice drops into a plain, matter-of-fact tone.
beats.chinese: Toby 举着一根手指停下来，讲故事的腔调忽然变得平平实实。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I stepped back once. The wet face was real, though.
beats.chinese: 没有。我就往后退了一步。不过被喷了一脸是真的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his hand. His brother approaches along the pavement, and Toby raises a hand in greeting.
beats.chinese: 他放下手。弟弟沿着人行道走来，Toby 抬手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I added the distance. There's my brother now. Cheers for the chat.
beats.chinese: 距离是我加的。我弟弟来了。谢谢你陪我聊两句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Toby stops counting on his fingers and lets his hand fall.
beats.chinese: Toby 不再掰着手指数经过，把手放了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I was about to give the sprinkler a speaking part.
beats.chinese: 行啊。我都快给那个喷头安排台词了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts his phone away and turns his attention back to the people approaching along the pavement.
beats.chinese: 他收好手机，重新留意起沿人行道走来的人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll save the full version for my brother. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 完整版留给我弟弟听吧。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Toby slips his phone into his pocket. His shoulders settle, and he gives a small, tired smile.
beats.chinese: Toby 把手机放进口袋，肩膀松下来，露出一个有点疲倦的微笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good, because that's about all I've got. Long shift.
beats.chinese: 那就好，我也差不多没词了。今天这班够长的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He settles the strap of his bag on his shoulder, ending the exchange without starting another story.
beats.chinese: 他调整好包的肩带，没有再接着讲另一个故事。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to give my mouth a minute off. Take care.
beats.chinese: 我要让嘴巴也歇一分钟。保重。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Toby glances along the pavement once more, then gives you a small wave.
beats.chinese: Toby 又沿人行道望了一眼，随后向你轻轻挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I'll ask him how far away he is.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我问问他还有多远。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the pavement. Toby stays beside the terrace and types a message to his brother.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿人行道往前走。Toby 留在露台旁，打字给弟弟发消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Have a good one.
beats.chinese: 谢啦。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another evening beside the Gertrude Street terrace, Toby has his sports bag over his shoulder, ready to head to five-a-side. He notices you and smiles in recognition.
beats.chinese: 另一个傍晚，在 Gertrude Street 的露台旁，Toby 背着运动包，正准备去踢五人制足球。他注意到你，认出来后笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello! I'm tired today. No stories from me this time.
beats.chinese: 哦，你好！今天有点累。这回就不讲段子了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the time on his phone, puts it away and turns to continue along the pavement.
beats.chinese: 他看一眼手机上的时间，把手机收好，转身准备沿人行道继续走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have a run around, see if that wakes me up. Good to see you. Catch you later.
beats.chinese: 去跑一跑，看看精神回不回来。见到你真好。回头见。

causality.stayingConstraint: 弟弟尚未到达，他自愿留在不妨碍行人的位置等候，没有必须与玩家继续交谈的理由。
causality.currentGoal: 确认弟弟还有多久到，并在原处等他会合。
causality.currentState: 工作后有些疲惫，看完弟弟的新消息仍笑出声，习惯把等待讲得夸张，但能接受省略重播或停止逗趣。
causality.contactTrigger: 弟弟发来马上到的消息，Toby 看后笑出声，向附近的玩家顺口评论这个“马上”很有弹性。接触不再依赖滚落物品、取回或致歉，水瓶不参与动作，也没有松盖或事故。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留一年级运动草坪灌溉学徒身份、工作中的喷头经历、逐层铺陈并重启故事的说话习惯，以及夸大事故后用平直语气承认事实的毛病。疲惫时愿意停止表演，不因玩家不想听完整版而不悦。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家询问当天是否同样不顺，进入喷头故事。aa 中追问夸张距离，他承认只退了一步，弟弟到场后结束交谈。ab 中玩家不需要完整重播，他接受并转回等人。玩家询问等候时长，进入 b，他承认只等了十分钟。ba 中玩家表示不必逗自己开心，他坦言班次很长并收住话头。bb 中玩家告辞，他留下发消息询问弟弟还有多远。
causality.spatialContinuity: 初遇及各分支均在 Gertrude Street 露台实体边界旁、后方正常人行道上发生，不进入座位区或车道，不挡住行人。aa 的弟弟沿人行道到来。重逢仍在同一露台旁，Toby 最后沿人行道离开，没有切换到球场或其他新场景。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Toby Ashworth。本次重逢位于菲茨罗伊街边露台，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In Hosier Lane, Ted Callaghan is noting wall colours for his monthly handmade card before his theatre shift. As he turns with his notebook, his shoulder bag bumps your arm.
beats.chinese: 在霍西尔涂鸦巷，Ted Callaghan正趁剧院上班前，为每月制作的手工卡片记录墙上的颜色。他拿着笔记本转身时，肩包碰到了你的手臂。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. My bag. I'll pull it in.
beats.chinese: 抱歉。是我的包。我把它收好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws the bag against his hip and gathers the loose strap in one hand.
beats.chinese: 他把包贴紧胯侧，用一只手拢住松垂的背带。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Out of the way now.
beats.chinese: 好了。这下不挡着了。

choices.english: No harm done. What are you making notes about?
choices.chinese: 没事。你在记什么？

choices.english: Sorry. Do you need me to move?
choices.chinese: 不好意思。需要我让开吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ted holds his notebook at his side. Its open page has a few colour words and small pencil rectangles.
beats.chinese: Ted把笔记本拿在身侧。摊开的那页上写着几个颜色词，还用铅笔画了几个小方框。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A blue for a card. I paint one every month.
beats.chinese: 给卡片找一种蓝色。我每个月都画一张。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks from a blue patch on the wall to the word he has underlined.
beats.chinese: 他看看墙上的一块蓝色，又看看本子上划了线的那个词。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Marianne gets the finished card. She gets spared this bit.
beats.chinese: 画好了寄给Marianne。这一段就不让她受累了。

choices.english: Every month? How long have you been doing that?
choices.chinese: 每个月？你这样做多久了？

choices.english: I'll leave you to your colours. Bye.
choices.chinese: 那不打扰你找颜色了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ted shifts his bag farther behind his hip without asking you to change position.
beats.chinese: Ted把包又往胯后挪了一些，没有要求你换位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. That was my bag. You're fine where you are.
beats.chinese: 不用。是我的包碰了你。你站那里没问题。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shortens the strap, then rests his pencil against the notebook.
beats.chinese: 他调短背带，随后把铅笔搭在笔记本上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just getting a colour down before work.
beats.chinese: 就是上班前记个颜色。

choices.english: Sorry again. I thought I was blocking you.
choices.chinese: 还是不好意思。我以为挡着你了。

choices.english: All right. I'll look at the wall here, then.
choices.chinese: 好，那我就在这里看看墙上的画。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ted keeps his pencil poised over the page while he answers.
beats.chinese: Ted回答时，铅笔仍悬在纸页上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Since 2004. She teaches school. Sends enough words back for both of us.
beats.chinese: 从2004年开始。她是老师。回信的字数够我们两个人用了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He adds one final word, closes the notebook and takes a step along the lane with his bag held close.
beats.chinese: 他补上最后一个词，合起笔记本，把包收在身侧，沿巷子迈出一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Theatre shift. I run the surtitles, so I can't wander in halfway through. Good talking.
beats.chinese: 好了。该去剧院上班了。我负责操作字幕，可不能演到一半才晃进去。聊得挺好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the lane. Ted stays beside the patch of blue, keeping his bag clear of people passing.
beats.chinese: 你沿着巷子继续走。Ted留在那块蓝色旁边，把包收好，避开经过的人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye. Nearly finished here.
beats.chinese: 再见。我这儿也快记完了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his pencil, crosses out one colour word and writes another beneath it.
beats.chinese: 他落下铅笔，划掉一个颜色词，在下面另写了一个。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Grey-blue. There we go.
beats.chinese: 灰蓝色。这就对了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the second apology, Ted's voice loses its conversational lift.
beats.chinese: 听到第二次道歉，Ted的语气平了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's settled. No need to go over it.
beats.chinese: 已经说清了。不用再说了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks his watch, closes the notebook and turns along the lane, holding the bag firmly against his side.
beats.chinese: 他看了看表，合起笔记本，转身沿巷子走去，把包牢牢贴在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I need to get to work. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 我得去上班了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You turn to examine the wall where you are. Ted angles his notebook towards himself and resumes his notes.
beats.chinese: 你留在原处，转头看墙上的画。Ted把笔记本转向自己，接着做记录。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Enjoy your look.
beats.chinese: 好。慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His pencil lead snaps against the page. He pockets it and presses the notebook shut with his thumb.
beats.chinese: 铅笔芯在纸上折断了。他把笔收进口袋，用拇指按合笔记本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That decides it. Enough notes.
beats.chinese: 这下不用犹豫了。记得够多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Hosier Lane, you spot Ted beside the graffiti-covered wall, holding an unfinished monthly card. He looks up and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 在霍西尔涂鸦巷，你看见Ted站在涂鸦墙边，手里拿着一张尚未完成的月度卡片。他抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Just one patch of colour left this time. Have to get to work now, though.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。这次只差最后一块颜色。不过现在得去上班了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks his watch, slips the card between the pages of his notebook and closes it.
beats.chinese: 他看了看表，把卡片夹回随身的笔记本里，合上本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The colour can wait till tomorrow. Work can't.
beats.chinese: 颜色可以明天定，上班不能。

causality.presenceReason: Ted上班前已到巷中，为每月手绘卡片记录墙面配色。

causality.stayingConstraint: 稍后要去剧院操作字幕，只能短暂停留。
causality.currentGoal: 记下合适的蓝色，再去上班。
causality.currentState: 专注、时间有限，起初愿意简短交谈。
causality.contactTrigger: Ted转身时肩包碰到玩家手臂，由他先道歉并收好包。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In Melbourne's Hosier Lane, Desmond Achebe waits beside the graffiti-covered wall. His wife, Adaeze, chose this meeting place for after his shift at a CBD travel agency.
beats.chinese: 墨尔本的霍西尔涂鸦巷里，Desmond Achebe正在涂鸦墙边等人。他在市中心的旅行社下班后，要在这里和妻子Adaeze碰面，地点是她选的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Adaeze chose the meeting place. I've numbered the sections I want to look at. She says I've put the lane on a timetable.
beats.chinese: Adaeze选的碰面地点。我给想看的墙面分了号。她说我把整条巷子都排上时间表了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the numbered boxes in his notebook, then looks along the wall, keeping the walking space clear.
beats.chinese: 他核对笔记本里编了号的方框，又沿墙望去，没有占用通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Desmond. Just collecting colour ideas while I wait for her.
beats.chinese: 我叫Desmond。等她的时候，顺便记点配色想法。

choices.english: A timetable for the wall? I can stop for a moment.
choices.chinese: 看墙也有时间表？我可以停一会儿。

choices.english: Thanks, but I'm just passing.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，不过我只是路过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Desmond turns the open notebook so you can see its three numbered boxes.
beats.chinese: Desmond把摊开的本子转向你，露出三个编号方框。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Three sections. Quite manageable before Adaeze gets back. She's gone for a walk without numbering it.
beats.chinese: 三段。Adaeze回来前看得完。她散步去了，没给路程编号。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He points at the wall directly ahead, then a little farther along it. His pencil hovers over the first box.
beats.chinese: 他先指向正前方的墙面，又指了指旁边一块。铅笔停在第一个方框上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This bit first, then that bit. Otherwise we keep going back over things. We'll start here.
beats.chinese: 先看这一块，再看那一块。否则总要来回看。我们从这里开始。

choices.english: All right. This bit first, for a moment, then I'll go.
choices.chinese: 好吧。先看这里，看一会儿我就走。

choices.english: I'd rather look on my own, thanks.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我还是想自己看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Desmond tucks the notebook securely under his arm and steps back towards the wall.
beats.chinese: Desmond把笔记本夹稳，往墙边退了退。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'm waiting for Adaeze, my wife. No fixed time. Her suggestion.
beats.chinese: 当然。我在等我太太Adaeze。没定具体时间。她提议的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks his watch, lowers his wrist, then raises it for another look.
beats.chinese: 他看了一眼手表，放下手腕，接着又抬起来看了一遍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I agreed to 'after a walk'. Should have asked how long a walk.
beats.chinese: 我答应了“散完步之后”。当时该问问，要散多久。

choices.english: Enjoy the wait. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 那祝你等得愉快。再见。

choices.english: Does checking twice make the walk shorter?
choices.chinese: 多看一遍手表，她就能少走一会儿吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: For a moment, you and Desmond look at the same section of wall. He keeps his pencil poised above the page.
beats.chinese: 你和Desmond一起看了片刻同一块墙面。他始终握着铅笔，笔尖悬在纸上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could use those colours in a leaf print. Getting them onto the kitchen table is another negotiation.
beats.chinese: 这些颜色可以用在叶片拓印上。至于能不能把颜料摆上厨房餐桌，还得另行协商。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He makes a note and ticks the first box. As you leave, he lowers the notebook and gives you a small wave.
beats.chinese: 他记了几笔，在第一个方框里打钩。你离开时，他放下笔记本，朝你轻轻挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for the company. Enjoy the rest of your day.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你陪我看了一会儿。祝你今天过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You stay to look on your own. Desmond draws his pointing hand back.
beats.chinese: 你留下来自己看墙上的涂鸦。Desmond收回了指向墙面的手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I've managed to give someone a timetable for looking at a wall.
beats.chinese: 当然。我居然连别人看面墙，都给排上时间表了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He returns to his numbered boxes, keeping the notebook turned towards himself and leaving you room.
beats.chinese: 他重新看向那些编号方框，把笔记本朝向自己，也给你留出了空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Anyway, I'll leave you to it. I've got my own list to finish.
beats.chinese: 总之，你慢慢看。我自己的清单还没记完呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the lane. Desmond stays beside the wall rather than following.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿巷子往前走。Desmond留在墙边，没有跟过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I'm allowing myself a very generous waiting period.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我给自己安排了一段相当宽裕的等待时间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives a brief wave, then opens his notebook and rests his pencil against the page.
beats.chinese: 他简短地挥了挥手，随后翻开笔记本，把铅笔抵在纸页上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. Take care.
beats.chinese: 再见。路上顺利。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Desmond looks from his watch to you. The corner of his mouth lifts.
beats.chinese: Desmond的视线从手表移到你脸上，嘴角扬了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Only if she's walking in circles. Mind you, she'd do that if she knew I was counting.
beats.chinese: 除非她在绕圈走。不过话说回来，要是知道我在计时，她还真可能这么干。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He laughs, checks the watch once more, then folds his arms with the notebook held against his side.
beats.chinese: 他笑了一声，又看了一眼手表，然后抱起双臂，把笔记本夹在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There I go again. Anyway, don't let me delay you. Have a good day.
beats.chinese: 瞧，我又来了。好了，不耽误你了。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In Hosier Lane, Desmond is passing through with a record in its sleeve tucked under his arm. He recognises you and pauses beside the wall, clear of the walking space.
beats.chinese: 另一天，Desmond夹着一张装在封套里的唱片经过霍西尔巷。他认出了你，在墙边停下，没有挡住通行的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. Got the record player turning at the right speed at last.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。总算把唱片机的转速修对了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He adjusts his grip on the sleeve and taps its edge with one finger.
beats.chinese: 他调整了一下夹着唱片的姿势，用一根手指轻敲封套边缘。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One record to test it. I've written that on my list so I can't pretend I meant three. Anyway, good to see you.
beats.chinese: 就一张，拿回去试机器。我特意写进清单了，免得自己硬说原本想拿三张。总之，见到你真好。

causality.currentGoal: 等Adaeze散步回来，按自己预设顺序看三段墙面并记颜色。
