beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In Hosier Lane, Jesse Palmer is waiting beside a graffiti-covered wall, his bag securely on his shoulder. He came straight from his boatshed shift, early for a meeting with a gym mate. His phone vibrates, and he reads the message.
beats.chinese: 在霍西尔涂鸦巷，Jesse Palmer正站在涂鸦墙旁等人，背包稳稳地背在肩上。他刚结束船棚的工作，比约好的健身伙伴早到了。手机振动了一下，他低头读消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Another set. Good.
beats.chinese: 又加一组。挺好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He says it quietly, then glances towards you nearby and lowers his phone.
beats.chinese: 他说得很轻，随后看向附近的你，放低手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's for training later. I'm not complaining.
beats.chinese: 说的是等会儿训练，不是在抱怨。

choices.english: Sounds like a hard session.
choices.chinese: 听着训练很狠。

choices.english: Are you waiting for your training partner?
choices.chinese: 你在等训练伙伴吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jesse looks down at the training message, then back at you.
beats.chinese: Jesse低头看了一眼训练消息，又看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hard's putting it gently. Say it straight. Is that too much?
beats.chinese: 说练得狠还是客气了。直说吧。这安排是不是太狠了？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps his phone in his hand and looks along the lane.
beats.chinese: 他把手机握在手里，沿着巷子望了望。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm waiting for a bloke from my rowing gym. He picked here.
beats.chinese: 我在等划船机健身房的一个朋友。地方是他选的。

choices.english: Yes. That sounds like too much for one session.
choices.chinese: 是。一次练这么多，听着太狠了。

choices.english: I said what I meant. No need to make it harsher.
choices.chinese: 我想说的已经说了。不用再加重语气。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jesse settles beside the wall, clear of passing people, with his bag still on his shoulder.
beats.chinese: Jesse在墙边站定，避开来往的人，背包仍背在肩上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Gym mate. I've come from the boatshed. I repair oars on the Yarra.
beats.chinese: 健身伙伴。我刚从船棚过来，在雅拉河边修船桨。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks along the lane, then checks the time on his phone.
beats.chinese: 他沿着巷子望了望，又拿手机看了一眼时间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He said he'd be here first. That's already wrong.
beats.chinese: 他说他会先到。这句已经说错了。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Enjoy your session.
choices.chinese: 那不打扰了。祝你练得愉快。

choices.english: Is he tough to train with?
choices.chinese: 跟他一起练很辛苦吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jesse gives one short nod.
beats.chinese: Jesse简短地点了下头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair. It is a lot.
beats.chinese: 说得对。量确实大。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the added set on his phone, then lowers it and moves closer to the wall.
beats.chinese: 他在手机上看了看追加的那组训练，随后放低手机，往墙边靠了靠。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm still doing it. Cheers.
beats.chinese: 我还是要练。谢了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jesse pauses with his phone still in his hand.
beats.chinese: Jesse停了一下，手机还握在手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You said it sounded hard.
beats.chinese: 你说的是听着练得狠。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stops pressing the question and turns his attention to his phone.
beats.chinese: 他没有再追问，把注意力转向手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave it there. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 那就说到这儿。下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jesse steps nearer the wall as you continue along the lane.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿着巷子走，Jesse又往墙边让了让。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. It'll be a hard one.
beats.chinese: 谢了。今天会练得很狠。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the training message again, and a small grin appears.
beats.chinese: 他又看了一遍训练消息，嘴角露出一点笑意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Extra intervals. Good.
beats.chinese: 加练间歇。好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jesse lowers his phone. He answers more readily now.
beats.chinese: Jesse放低手机，这回回答得很干脆。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He's sixty. Beats me in every sprint. Doesn't clap when I finish, either.
beats.chinese: 他六十岁了。每次冲刺都赢我。我练完了，他也不会鼓掌。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He spots a man farther along the lane and raises a hand. The man waves back, and Jesse starts towards him, keeping his bag close.
beats.chinese: 他看见巷子另一头的一个男人，抬手示意。对方也挥了挥手，Jesse便把背包贴着身体，朝他走去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's him. Exactly who I want to train with. See you.
beats.chinese: 就是他。我就想跟这种人练。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In Hosier Lane, Jesse Palmer is studying a photograph on his phone beside the wall. He recognises you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 在霍西尔巷，Jesse Palmer站在墙旁看手机照片。认出你后，他笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Looked like a bare twig for months. Two new shoots this morning. My bonsai's finally doing something.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。几个月看着都像根秃树枝。今天早上冒了两个新芽。我的盆景总算有动静了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He enlarges the green tips, pleased, then saves the photograph with the date.
beats.chinese: 他放大绿色的芽尖，满意地看了看，再把照片记上日期保存。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll probably take another picture tomorrow. It'll look exactly the same. Won't stop me. Enjoy your day.
beats.chinese: 明天大概还要拍。肯定看不出变化，也拦不住我。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In Hosier Lane, Tobias Marsh is waiting for his flatmate after work. Near you, his phone suddenly plays a loud voice message complaining about changes to a family curry recipe.
beats.chinese: 霍西尔巷里，Tobias Marsh下班后正在等室友。离你不远的地方，他的手机突然大声播放起一条语音，抱怨家传咖喱的做法被改了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry about the volume. My aunt's got opinions about dinner. I'm Tobias, by the way.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，声音太大了。我阿姨对晚饭很有意见。对了，我叫Tobias。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stops the message and lowers the volume. Keeping clear of people passing through, he slips closer to the graffiti-covered wall.
beats.chinese: 他关掉语音，调低音量，往涂鸦墙边靠了靠，给来往的人留出通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm meeting my flatmate here. Thought I'd check my messages while I waited.
beats.chinese: 我约了室友在这儿碰头。想着等人的时候看一下消息。

choices.english: What did you change in the curry?
choices.chinese: 你把咖喱怎么改了？

choices.english: No worries. Have you just finished work?
choices.chinese: 没关系。你刚下班吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tobias turns the phone over in his hand, leaving the unfinished message paused.
beats.chinese: Tobias把手机在手里翻了个面，那条没听完的语音还暂停着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Chickpeas instead of lentils. Less chilli, more tomato. She says I've changed half the recipe.
beats.chinese: 用鹰嘴豆代替扁豆。辣椒少一点，番茄多一点。她说我把半张食谱都改了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He taps the recording button, draws breath, then cancels without sending anything.
beats.chinese: 他按下录音键，吸了口气，又取消了，什么也没发出去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nah but, she hasn't tasted this batch. She's already sent two messages.
beats.chinese: 不是，可她这次都还没尝呢。已经发了两条消息了。

choices.english: She has a point. You have changed the recipe.
choices.chinese: 她也有道理。你确实改了食谱。

choices.english: What do you like about your version?
choices.chinese: 你喜欢自己这个版本的什么地方？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tobias pockets his phone. He stays beside the wall, leaving the route through the lane clear.
beats.chinese: Tobias把手机放进口袋，仍站在墙边，没有挡住巷里的通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah. I'm an apprentice at a water rescue equipment shop. Came straight here.
beats.chinese: 对。我在一家水上救援装备店当学徒。下班就直接过来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rubs a small patch of packing tape adhesive from his thumb.
beats.chinese: 他搓了搓拇指上残留的一小块封箱胶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Had a delivery to check. Everything counted and put away before I left, so that was good.
beats.chinese: 今天有批到货要核对。走之前都点清楚、归好位了，挺顺的。

choices.english: Sounds like you got everything sorted.
choices.chinese: 听起来你把事情都处理妥当了。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your wait. Enjoy dinner.
choices.chinese: 那就不打扰你等人了。晚饭吃得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tobias answers quickly, his fingers tightening around the phone.
beats.chinese: Tobias立刻接话，握着手机的手指收紧了一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nah but, I never said it was her recipe exactly. I told her what I'd changed.
beats.chinese: 不是，可我也没说跟她的做法一模一样啊。我都告诉她改了什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lets out a short laugh and loosens his grip. Then he lifts the phone, ready to finish listening privately.
beats.chinese: 他短促地笑了一声，松了松手，随后拿起手机，准备自己听完语音。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hers is good. I always have seconds. Anyway, I'll hear her out. See you.
beats.chinese: 她做的是好吃。我每次都要再添一份。行吧，我先听她说完。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tobias stops turning the phone over and holds it loosely at his side.
beats.chinese: Tobias不再翻弄手机，松松地把它拿在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The chickpeas stay whole. And with less chilli I can actually taste the tomato. Still figuring out how much, though.
beats.chinese: 鹰嘴豆煮完还是一颗颗的。辣椒少了，也能吃出番茄味。不过具体放多少，我还在试。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens a recipe note and changes the tomato quantity, then locks the screen and gives you a small farewell nod.
beats.chinese: 他打开食谱备忘录，改了番茄的用量，随后锁上屏幕，轻轻点头向你道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Keeping the chickpeas, anyway. Right, I'll let you get on. Enjoy your wander.
beats.chinese: 反正鹰嘴豆是要留着的。好了，不耽误你了。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tobias gives a small nod at your comment.
beats.chinese: 听到你的话，Tobias轻轻点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Yeah, got it done.
beats.chinese: 谢了。嗯，都弄好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His phone rings. He checks the name on the screen and raises a hand in farewell before answering.
beats.chinese: 手机响了。他看了一眼屏幕上的名字，先抬手向你道别，再接起电话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my flatmate. See you around.
beats.chinese: 我室友打来的。回头见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tobias smiles and puts his hands in his pockets.
beats.chinese: Tobias笑了笑，把双手放进口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Hope yours is good too.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。也祝你晚饭吃得好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns towards the graffiti and studies a patch of overlapping paint, staying close to the wall as people pass.
beats.chinese: 他转向涂鸦，打量着一块层层覆盖的颜料。有人经过时，他仍贴着墙边站着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: See you. I'll have a look at this while I'm here.
beats.chinese: 再见。既然来了，我也看看这些。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Hosier Lane, Tobias recognises you near the graffiti-covered wall. He has been checking a message on his phone.
beats.chinese: 在霍西尔巷，涂鸦墙边的Tobias认出了你。他刚才正在看手机消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hey. Good to see you. My cousin said to meet by the graffiti. Really narrowed it down.
beats.chinese: 哦，嗨。见到你真好。我表亲说在涂鸦旁边碰头。这范围缩得可真小。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He smiles and sends a message describing his white hair and knitted top, then pockets the phone.
beats.chinese: 他笑了笑，发消息描述了一下自己的白发和针织上衣，随后把手机收起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sent a description. I'll stay here so we don't end up walking past each other.
beats.chinese: 把我的样子发过去了。我就在这儿等，省得两个人走岔了。

causality.presenceReason: Tobias下班后已到霍西尔巷，按约等室友，利用等候时间查看家人的晚饭消息。
causality.placeAttitude: 把巷子当作方便碰头、顺便看涂鸦的公共地方，没有导览或工作任务。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In the covered aisles of Queen Victoria Market, Alan Prescott stands beside a clothing stall, comparing packs of socks. He came to replace his worn-out pairs. Noticing you nearby, he lowers the pack in his hand.
beats.chinese: 在维多利亚女王市场的棚内，Alan Prescott 站在服饰摊旁，比较着几包袜子。他是来替换家里穿破的袜子的。注意到你就在附近，他放低了手里的那包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Want a look here? I can shift. Been arguing with these socks long enough.
beats.chinese: 想看看这边吗？我可以让让。我跟这些袜子较劲够久了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Alan moves a little along the stall, leaving the display clear without stepping into the central aisle. He turns a striped pack over.
beats.chinese: Alan 沿着摊位挪开一点，让出看货的位置，也没有退进中央通道。他把一包条纹袜翻了个面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Came for plain socks. Keep checking the colours like I'm picking the team.
beats.chinese: 本来是来买素色袜子的。却一直挑颜色，跟我在选球队阵容似的。

choices.english: The colours matter that much?
choices.chinese: 颜色有那么重要吗？

choices.english: Thanks. I'll just have a look.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。我就看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Alan holds the striped pack beside a plain one. His thumb catches the edge of a knitted beanie sticking out of his jacket pocket.
beats.chinese: Alan 把条纹袜和素色袜并排拿着。拇指碰到了夹克口袋里露出的一截针织帽边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They're my local amateur footy side's colours. Lost again, the hopeless lot.
beats.chinese: 是我支持的本地业余澳式足球队的颜色。又输了，这帮不争气的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the plain socks back, then draws the beanie halfway out of his pocket. Its stripes match the pack he kept.
beats.chinese: 他放回素色袜，又把帽子从口袋里抽出一半。帽子的条纹和他留下的那包袜子颜色相同。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Knitted this for Saturdays at the ground. Apparently I'll need socks for that too.
beats.chinese: 这帽子是织来周六去球场戴的。看来我还得为这事买双袜子。

choices.english: Can I have a look at the beanie?
choices.chinese: 能让我看看那顶帽子吗？

choices.english: If they keep losing, they sound pretty useless.
choices.chinese: 要是一直输，听着确实挺没用的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Alan stays to one side of the display. He brings two packs together to compare their labels.
beats.chinese: Alan 留在陈列区的一侧，把两包袜子凑在一起比较标签。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Righto. Plenty of room.
beats.chinese: 好。地方够。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He returns the striped pack, keeps the plain one, then reaches for the striped pack again. His hand stops halfway.
beats.chinese: 他放回条纹袜，留下素色袜，接着又伸手去拿条纹袜。手伸到一半停住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Same size. Different colour. Shouldn't take all morning.
beats.chinese: 尺码一样。颜色不同。不至于选上一上午吧。

choices.english: You've made that sound like a difficult decision.
choices.chinese: 听你这么一说，这决定还挺难做。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Bye.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你挑了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Alan pulls out the beanie and holds it where you can see it, keeping it in his own hand.
beats.chinese: Alan 抽出帽子，拿到你能看清的位置，仍旧自己握着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here. Supposed to be a spare, though it seems to live in my pocket.
beats.chinese: 喏。本来是顶备用帽，结果像是住在我口袋里了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns it once to show the whole pattern, then tucks it away and turns back to the socks.
beats.chinese: 他把帽子转了一下，让整圈花纹都露出来，随后收回口袋，转身继续看袜子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mostly I knit jumpers, with the match on the radio. Anyway, better sort these out. Enjoy your look round.
beats.chinese: 我主要织套头衫，边织边听比赛广播。好了，得把袜子挑定了。你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Alan lowers the beanie back into his pocket. His expression tightens, and he puts the striped socks down carefully.
beats.chinese: Alan 把帽子塞回口袋，神情绷紧了一点。他仔细放下那包条纹袜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hang on. They work all week and turn up to play. Useless is a bit much.
beats.chinese: 等一下。他们上了一周班，还照样来踢球。说没用就过了点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives a small nod, then turns his attention to the labels, closing the conversation without taking up any more space.
beats.chinese: 他略一点头，随后把注意力转回标签，结束了交谈，也没有多占地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll complain about the score all day. Leave the blokes out of it. Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 比分我能抱怨一整天。别连人一起贬了。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Alan looks at his hovering hand and lets it drop. A short laugh escapes him.
beats.chinese: Alan 看了看自己悬着的手，把它放下，短促地笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Forty years sandblasting and re-coating bakery trays. Retired now, and a pair of socks has got me stuck.
beats.chinese: 给烘焙托盘喷砂、重新涂层，干了四十年。现在退休了，倒让一双袜子难住了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He returns the remaining pack to the display and folds his empty shopping bag under his arm. He turns along the central aisle, leaving without choosing either pair.
beats.chinese: 他把手里剩下的袜子放回陈列处，将空购物袋折好夹在腋下。他转向中央通道，两种都没选就走了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Got a pair at home with some life left. That'll do for today. Cheers.
beats.chinese: 家里还有一双能撑些时候。今天先这样。再会。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Alan lowers his half-raised hand and gives you a brief nod goodbye.
beats.chinese: Alan 放下抬到一半的手，向你轻轻点头道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Enjoy your look round.
beats.chinese: 再见。你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He leaves the striped pack where it is and checks the size on the plain socks once more. His attention settles fully on the purchase.
beats.chinese: 他没再动条纹袜，又核对了一遍素色袜的尺码，注意力完全回到购物上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Plain ones. Yes. Made a decision. Nobody touch anything.
beats.chinese: 素色的。对。决定了。谁也别动啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In the covered aisles of Queen Victoria Market, Alan is beside a clothing stall, examining a knitted hat from the display. He looks up and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 在维多利亚女王市场棚内，Alan 正站在服饰摊旁，拿着一顶在售的毛线帽端详。他抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. Just seeing how they've put the colours together. Not buying one.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。就看看人家怎么配色。不打算买。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the hat back where he found it and moves a little farther along the display, still looking at the clothes.
beats.chinese: 他把帽子放回原处，沿着陈列处往前挪了点，继续看着摊上的衣物。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Colours work well on that one. Got wool at home. I'll knit my own.
beats.chinese: 这顶颜色配得不错。家里还有毛线，我回去自己织。

causality.presenceReason: Alan 在玩家出现前已到 棚内服饰摊挑袜子，准备替换家里穿破的旧袜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In the covered aisles of Queen Victoria Market, Harriet Voss is browsing the clothing stalls for a replacement work apron. Her old apron is folded neatly over her arm, with her bag at her side.
beats.chinese: 在维多利亚女王市场的棚内，Harriet Voss正在服饰摊位间寻找替换的工作围裙。旧围裙整齐地搭在她手臂上，包放在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: These two are marked the same size, aren't they? The lengths look different.
beats.chinese: 这两条标的是同一个尺寸，对吗？长度看着不一样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks from the labels on two aprons for sale to you nearby, keeping clear of the central aisle.
beats.chinese: 她看看两条在售围裙的标签，又看向旁边的你，没有占着中央通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've brought my old one to compare. I'm looking for a replacement.
beats.chinese: 我带了旧的来比一比，想找条替换的。

choices.english: Yes, the same size. Those lengths do look different.
choices.chinese: 对，是同一个尺寸。长度看着确实不一样。

choices.english: I can't quite see the labels. I'll give you some room.
choices.chinese: 我看不太清标签。我给你腾点地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harriet turns towards you, leaving the clothes alone while she speaks.
beats.chinese: Harriet转向你，暂时不再看衣服，开口说话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can I tell you why I'm replacing this one? I use it in my natural dye workshop in Brunswick. The side seam came apart after two washes.
beats.chinese: 我能说说为什么要换掉这条吗？我在布伦瑞克开天然染色工坊，工作时穿它。才洗了两次，侧缝就开了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts the damaged edge of the apron on her arm and presses her lips together at the uneven stitching.
beats.chinese: 她提起臂弯里围裙破损的一边，看着歪斜的针脚，抿了抿嘴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I bought it in a hurry. Apparently it was sewn in one too.
beats.chinese: 我买得匆忙。看来做它的人也挺匆忙。

choices.english: Go on. What made you choose it?
choices.chinese: 接着说，你当时为什么挑了它？

choices.english: I'd probably mend it again, but I'll leave you to look.
choices.chinese: 换我可能还会再补补。不过，你慢慢挑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With the space you have offered, Harriet settles the bag close against her leg rather than spreading its contents out.
beats.chinese: 有了你腾出的空间，Harriet把包贴着腿放好，没有把里面的东西摊开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. That's enough room. I won't unpack the workshop.
beats.chinese: 谢谢，这点地方就够了。我不会把整个工坊都摊出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the folded apron into her bag and closes it, leaving the clothes in front of her within your reach too.
beats.chinese: 她把叠好的围裙放进包里，合上包，也给你留出了伸手查看面前衣物的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can look here too, if you want. I'm still deciding.
beats.chinese: 你想看这边的衣服也尽管看。我还没拿定主意。

choices.english: I'll move on. Good luck with the search.
choices.chinese: 我继续逛了。祝你找到合适的。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll have a look at the clothes here too.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。我也看看这里的衣服。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Given the invitation to continue, Harriet becomes more animated. She lifts the apron just far enough to show its two large pockets.
beats.chinese: 听到你请她接着说，Harriet明显来了兴致。她稍稍提起围裙，露出两个大口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The pockets. One for my notebook, one for all the pencils I lose. I pictured a very organised woman.
beats.chinese: 因为口袋。一个放记录本，一个放那些老被我弄丢的铅笔。我当时想象自己会变得特别有条理。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pats one pocket. A pencil drops into the bottom of her bag. She looks down, then folds the apron away.
beats.chinese: 她拍了拍一个口袋，一支铅笔掉进包底。她低头看了一眼，把围裙叠起来收好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Well, there's one accounted for. Thanks for listening. I'd better get back to looking.
beats.chinese: 好吧，这下找到一支了。谢谢你听我说。我该接着挑了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harriet looks once more at the repaired section, then folds the damaged edge firmly out of sight.
beats.chinese: Harriet又看了一眼补过的地方，随后把破损的边折进去，收得严严实实。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've mended it three times. This one's finished.
beats.chinese: 我已经补过三次了。这条就到此为止吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the apron in her bag, closes it and turns her attention to the clothing, giving you a small, friendly nod.
beats.chinese: 她把围裙放进包里，合上包，把注意力转回衣服，友好地朝你轻轻点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the market. I'm going to be fussy for a bit.
beats.chinese: 逛得开心。我得仔细挑一会儿了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you move on, Harriet keeps her bag tucked beside her and raises a hand in farewell.
beats.chinese: 你继续往前逛。Harriet把包拢在身侧，抬手向你道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Enjoy your look round.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。慢慢逛，逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns back to the stall and bends slightly to read a label on a garment, leaving the central aisle clear.
beats.chinese: 她转回摊位，微微俯身看一件衣服的标签，没有占着中央通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Pockets first.
beats.chinese: 好了。先看口袋。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You turn to the clothes at the same stall. Harriet shifts her bag to her other side to leave you more room.
beats.chinese: 你转向同一摊位的衣服。Harriet把包换到另一侧，给你多留些地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you go. Plenty of room for both of us.
beats.chinese: 这下好了。我们两个人看，地方也够。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks a garment's label, releases it and moves a little farther along the same stall to continue her own search.
beats.chinese: 她看了看一件衣服的标签，松开手，沿着同一摊位挪开一点，继续找自己的东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll look along this end. Happy browsing.
beats.chinese: 我去看这头。你慢慢挑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In the covered aisles of Queen Victoria Market, Harriet Voss is looking at clothes when she recognises you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在维多利亚女王市场棚内，Harriet Voss正在看衣服，认出了附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello, good to see you. I've got nothing I need to buy today. I just feel like taking my time and looking.
beats.chinese: 你好，见到你真好。今天没什么一定要买的，我就想慢慢看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds up a garment to look at its colour, then puts it back without checking each seam or turning over the label.
beats.chinese: 她拿起一件衣服看看颜色，随后便放回原处，没有逐道检查缝线，也没翻看标签。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Everything doesn't have to be useful today. I'll keep having a wander.
beats.chinese: 今天不用每件东西都有用。我接着随便逛逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In the covered aisles of Queen Victoria Market, Sunny Aparo is beside a clothing display, ten minutes early to meet a friend. They've just replied to a message and glance towards you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在维多利亚女王市场棚内，Sunny Aparo站在服饰摊位旁，比和朋友约好的时间早到了十分钟。他们刚回完消息，望向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just agreed to find some trousers for my mate. Got here ten minutes early so I could have a look for myself.
beats.chinese: 刚答应替朋友找裤子。我明明早来十分钟，是想自己逛的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sunny lowers their phone with a small sigh, keeping their folded shopping bag close to their side and leaving the central aisle clear.
beats.chinese: Sunny轻轻叹了口气，放低手机，把折好的购物袋收在身侧，没有占用中央通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Sunny. Just waiting for him here. Didn't think I'd be starting his shopping before he arrived.
beats.chinese: 我叫Sunny。在这里等他。没想到他人还没到，我就先替他找起东西了。

choices.english: A shopping mate, or someone from work?
choices.chinese: 是一起逛街的朋友，还是同事？

choices.english: All good. I'll leave you to your quiet minute.
choices.chinese: 没事。你慢慢享受这会儿清静吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sunny turns slightly towards you, keeping the bag tucked under one arm.
beats.chinese: Sunny微微转向你，把购物袋夹在一只胳膊下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Workmate. I'm an apprentice repairing hospital meal trolleys. We do occasionally discuss other things.
beats.chinese: 同事。我是修医院送餐推车的学徒。我们偶尔也聊点别的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their phone buzzes again. Sunny opens the message and scrolls through the requested trouser colour and cut. Their smile fades a little.
beats.chinese: 手机又震了一下。Sunny打开消息，往下看朋友对裤子颜色和版型的具体要求，脸上的笑淡了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. Dark trousers, straight legs, no turn-ups. He's sent a whole list of details.
beats.chinese: 啊。深色、直筒、裤脚不翻边。他发来了一整串要求。

choices.english: What were you going to look for yourself?
choices.chinese: 那你自己原本想看什么？

choices.english: I'll leave you to the list. Nice meeting you.
choices.chinese: 那你慢慢找清单上的东西。很高兴认识你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sunny's shoulders drop a little. They keep their place beside the display rather than moving into the aisle.
beats.chinese: Sunny的肩膀稍稍放松下来。他们仍站在摊位旁，没有挪到通道里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. I've got a few minutes before my mate gets here.
beats.chinese: 谢啦。朋友还有几分钟才到。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn back to the T-shirts, then move a little to one side so the display is easy to reach.
beats.chinese: 他们转回去看T恤，又让开一点，方便别人看货。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're welcome to look too. I'm only taking up space, really.
beats.chinese: 你也可以看。我其实就是在这儿待一会儿。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll have a quick look beside you.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。我就在旁边看两眼。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll carry on along the aisle.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。我继续沿着通道逛吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sunny looks from the message to the T-shirts in front of them.
beats.chinese: Sunny看看消息，又看看面前的T恤。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A T-shirt for going out. Most of mine have oil on them. Very useful for repairs. Less good for dinner.
beats.chinese: 买件出门穿的T恤。我大部分衣服都有油印。修东西时很合适，吃饭就差点意思。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They pocket the phone and lift a shirt by its hanger to check the size. Their attention settles on their own shopping, and your exchange ends.
beats.chinese: 他们收起手机，提起衣架看尺码，注意力回到自己的购物上，交谈就此结束。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll find his stuff after this. One shirt for me first. See you round.
beats.chinese: 看完这个再找他的东西。先给自己挑一件。回头见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sunny gives a small nod, then notices another line at the bottom of the message.
beats.chinese: Sunny轻轻点了点头，又发现消息最下面还有一行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Oh, he's sent the trouser size. Right.
beats.chinese: 我也是。哦，裤子尺码也发来了。行吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their mouth tightens briefly. They put the folded bag away and turn towards the trousers on display while you continue along the central aisle.
beats.chinese: 他们短暂地抿了抿嘴，收好折着的袋子，转身去看摊上的裤子。你继续沿着中央通道往前走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: At least he's remembered he's got legs. That saves a message.
beats.chinese: 至少他还记得自己有两条腿。省得我再发消息问了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You look at the shirts beside Sunny. They check a size label without offering advice about your choices.
beats.chinese: 你在Sunny旁边看衣服。他们检查尺码标签，没有对你的选择指手画脚。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, that one's tiny. I'm already dressed. Don't need a second skin.
beats.chinese: 啊，这件真小。我已经穿着衣服了，不用再添层皮。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sunny returns the hanger neatly and turns towards the aisle to watch for their friend, leaving the display available to you.
beats.chinese: Sunny把衣架放好，转向通道看朋友有没有来，把看货的位置留给你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nothing for me there. I'll watch for my mate. Enjoy your look.
beats.chinese: 这里没我想要的。我等朋友去了。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the aisle. Sunny stays beside the clothing display and raises a hand in farewell.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿着通道走。Sunny留在服饰摊位旁，抬手向你道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yep, see you. Enjoy having a look.
beats.chinese: 好，回头见。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With a small grin, Sunny sends their friend a message saying where they are, then puts the phone away.
beats.chinese: Sunny咧嘴笑了笑，发消息告诉朋友自己在哪儿，随后收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. He can find me for once.
beats.chinese: 好了。这回让他来找我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In the covered aisles of Queen Victoria Market, you see Sunny standing beside a clothing stall. Their hands are empty, and they recognise you as you come near.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到维多利亚女王市场棚内，你看到Sunny空着手站在服饰摊位旁。你走近时，他们认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hey! My mate's not here yet. I fancy a quiet minute first.
beats.chinese: 噢，嗨！朋友还没到。我想先安静待一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sunny takes out their phone, puts it away in their pocket, and turns their attention back to the clothes. They stay where they are, without adding an explanation or an apologetic smile.
beats.chinese: Sunny拿出手机，收进口袋，把注意力转回眼前的衣服。他们留在原处，没有继续解释，也没有赔笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good to see you. Just a hello today.
beats.chinese: 见到你很高兴。今天就先打个招呼。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In the covered aisles of Queen Victoria Market, Billie Hartnett is checking a package against handwritten pillow measurements beside a household-goods stall. She came to replace some ill-fitting pillowcases. With her tote held close to her side, she looks up toward you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在维多利亚女王市场的棚内，Billie Hartnett 正站在日用品摊旁，对照手写的枕头尺寸核对一件商品的包装。她来替换几只不合尺寸的枕套。她把布袋收在身侧，抬头看向站在附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've measured the pillows this time. Finally, I don't have to guess what 'standard' means.
beats.chinese: 这次我量过枕头了，终于不用猜“标准”是什么意思。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her tote stays close to her side as she glances at the paper with a pleased little smile.
beats.chinese: 她的布袋始终收在身侧。她看了看纸条，露出一点得意的笑容。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Billie, by the way. I trusted the word 'standard' far too much on my previous attempt.
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫 Billie。上回买的时候，我实在太相信“标准尺寸”这几个字了。

choices.english: What happened with the standard ones?
choices.chinese: 那些标准尺寸的枕套怎么了？

choices.english: Are you nearly finished shopping?
choices.chinese: 你快买完了吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Billie turns toward you, keeping herself and her bag beside the stall and clear of the central aisle.
beats.chinese: Billie 转向你，自己和袋子都留在摊位旁，没有占着中央通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Too short. I checked the receipt, then the label, then finally the actual pillows. A very thorough investigation in the wrong order.
beats.chinese: 太短了。我先查收据，再查标签，最后才量枕头。调查得很仔细，顺序完全反了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She unfolds the paper once, then again. Two measurements occupy one corner of a much larger page.
beats.chinese: 她把纸展开一折，又展开一折。整张大纸上，两组尺寸只占了一个角。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Length, width, and a reminder on the back. I've somehow made buying pillowcases require two sides of paper.
beats.chinese: 长、宽，背面还有一条提醒。我居然把买枕套这件事写满了纸的正反两面。

choices.english: What's important enough to go on the back?
choices.chinese: 什么提醒这么重要，还得写到背面？

choices.english: I'll skip the full report, but good luck. Bye, Billie.
choices.chinese: 完整报告我就不听了，不过祝你顺利。再见，Billie。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Billie looks from her paper to the household goods, then back to the paper.
beats.chinese: Billie 从纸条看到摊上的日用品，又低头看回纸条。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I haven't bought anything yet. I only need pillowcases, but I've already looked at tea towels twice.
beats.chinese: 还什么都没买呢。我只需要枕套，可是已经看了两遍擦碗布了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the page into a smaller rectangle, leaving the measurements visible.
beats.chinese: 她把纸折成小小的长方形，只露出尺寸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One thing on the list. I thought that would make this quicker.
beats.chinese: 清单上就一样东西。我原以为这样会快一点。

choices.english: I'll let you concentrate. Bye, Billie. Continue along the aisle.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你专心挑了。再见，Billie。沿通道继续走。

choices.english: Could you find a pair that size for me too?
choices.chinese: 你能顺便也帮我找一对这个尺寸的吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Billie turns the page over. Three heavily underlined words sit in the middle.
beats.chinese: Billie 把纸翻过来。纸中央写着三个画了重重下划线的词。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Check packet quantity. I also managed to buy one pillowcase for two pillows. That was a separate discovery.
beats.chinese: 核对包装数量。我还成功地给两个枕头只买了一个枕套。那是另一次发现。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She laughs at the large sheet, folds it down to pocket size, and turns her attention to the packaged household goods.
beats.chinese: 她看着那张大纸笑了，把它折到能放进口袋的大小，然后把注意力转向摊上带包装的日用品。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, you've now heard the entire case history. I'll check the packets. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 好了，全部案情你都听完了。我去核对包装。很高兴和你聊聊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Billie stops with one corner of the page lifted, then gives a quick, amused nod.
beats.chinese: Billie 正掀起纸的一角，听完便停住了，带着笑意点点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. That was becoming a surprisingly long answer about pillowcases.
beats.chinese: 当然可以。一个关于枕套的回答，居然被我说了这么长。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the paper without showing the reverse and resumes checking the goods beside her.
beats.chinese: 她没有再展示背面的内容，把纸折好，继续查看身旁的商品。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Hope you enjoy the market. Bye!
beats.chinese: 谢谢。祝你逛得愉快。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the central aisle, Billie stays beside the household-goods stall.
beats.chinese: 你沿中央通道继续走，Billie 留在日用品摊旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Bye!
beats.chinese: 谢谢。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives a brief wave, lowers her hand, and checks her measurements against a package label.
beats.chinese: 她简短地挥挥手，放下手后，拿纸上的尺寸核对一件商品的包装标签。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Pillowcases. Yes. That's what I came for.
beats.chinese: 枕套。对。我就是来买这个的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Billie pauses with the folded measurements in her hand. Her smile remains, but she shakes her head.
beats.chinese: Billie 拿着折好的尺寸纸条停了一下。她仍然笑着，但摇了摇头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll stick to my own shopping today, sorry.
beats.chinese: 不好意思，今天我就只买自己的东西了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the measurements into her tote's outer pocket and turns back toward the goods, keeping the bag close.
beats.chinese: 她把尺寸纸条塞进布袋外侧的口袋，转身继续看商品，袋子始终收在身边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hope you find what you need. I'll get on with mine.
beats.chinese: 希望你能找到需要的东西。我接着挑我的了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In the covered aisles of Queen Victoria Market, you see Billie beside a household-goods stall, holding a shopping record she has finished checking. She looks up and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到维多利亚女王市场棚内，你看见 Billie 站在日用品摊旁，拿着已经核对好的购物记录。她抬头认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello! I've got everything I came for today, and I'm still within my budget.
beats.chinese: 啊，你好！今天要买的都买齐了，而且还在我的预算里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the record and puts it in her tote without reading out the individual amounts. She looks pleased and gives you a smile.
beats.chinese: 她把记录折好放进布袋，没有逐项报出金额。她一脸满足，朝你笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll spare you the calculations this time. I'll let you get on with looking around.
beats.chinese: 具体怎么算的我先不展开，你也逛你的。

causality.presenceReason: Billie 在玩家出现前已到 棚内日用品摊，带着枕头尺寸，准备购买枕套来替换先前不合尺寸的枕套。
causality.placeAttitude: 她把采购当作值得认真完成的小事，也会被其他日用品吸引。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须久留的外部约束，她尚未核对完尺寸与包装数量，自愿继续挑选。
causality.currentGoal: 买到尺寸合适、数量正确的枕套，避免重复之前的失误。
causality.currentState: 今天心情轻快，对事先量尺寸颇为得意，忍不住向附近的人分享，也容易把简单回答说得过长。
causality.contactTrigger: 她在 棚内日用品摊旁对照尺寸核对包装，主动向附近的玩家宣布自己这次量过枕头，终于不用猜标准尺寸的含义。略不合时宜但真诚的小成就分享本身促成交流，没有擦碰或其他身体侵入，布袋始终收在身侧。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留她郑重分享生活小进步、坦承失误、过度解释的习惯，以及不因有条理就替陌生人跑腿的边界。重逢时她仍乐于宣布日常成果，但主动省略逐项计算的长篇说明。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家追问标准尺寸的问题后，a 中她说明枕套太短并展示尺寸纸。aa 中玩家继续追问，她展示数量提醒后结束闲聊去核对包装。ab 中玩家婉拒长篇说明，她收住话头继续挑选。玩家询问是否快买完后，b 中她坦承尚未购买且被擦碗布分心。ba 中玩家离开，她挥手后独自核对标签。bb 中玩家请她代找商品，她礼貌拒绝并回到自己的采购。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全部活动限于维多利亚女王市场棚内服饰与日用品摊区及中央通道。初遇时她在日用品摊旁核对包装，随身袋收在身侧，不碰玩家、不堵通道。重逢仍在日用品摊旁，只使用有明确用途的购物记录和布袋，不引入其他设施。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Billie Hartnett。本次重逢位于维多利亚女王市场，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the upper gallery overlooking the State Library of Victoria's La Trobe Reading Room, Robin Castellano is practising the room's name in a small notebook. They came for a quiet look at the room. You are nearby on the same gallery.
beats.chinese: 在维多利亚州立图书馆俯瞰拉筹伯阅览室的上层书廊，Robin Castellano正拿着小本子，练写阅览室的名字。他们原本是来安静看看这间阅览室的。你就在同层书廊的附近。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me. Could I check something?
beats.chinese: 打扰一下。能确认件事吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin keeps the notebook close against their chest, clear of the view and the passage. They lower their voice without stepping closer.
beats.chinese: Robin始终把本子收在胸前，没有挡住视线或通道。他们没有走近，只是压低了声音。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: La Trobe. There's a space in the middle, isn't there?
beats.chinese: La Trobe，中间留空格，对吧？

choices.english: Yes, there's a space. What are you writing it for?
choices.chinese: 对，中间有空格。你写这个是做什么用的？

choices.english: Yes, there's a space.
choices.chinese: 对，中间有空格。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Keeping the notebook close, Robin tilts it just enough to show two handwritten words, La Trobe.
beats.chinese: Robin仍把本子收在身前，只稍稍倾斜，露出手写的两个词，La Trobe。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Practising a heading. I check rail timetables part-time. Hard to leave the spacing alone.
beats.chinese: 练个标题。我兼职检查铁路时刻表的可读性。总忍不住盯着间距看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their finger hovers over the gap between the words, then moves to the capital T.
beats.chinese: 他们的手指停在两个词的空隙上方，接着移向大写字母T。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Too much space there. And that T needs a shorter top. Then the whole line—
beats.chinese: 这里空得太多。那个T上面一横也得短一点。这样整行就——

choices.english: I only meant what the notebook was for.
choices.chinese: 我只是想知道这个本子是做什么用的。

choices.english: I'd leave it uneven. I like it that way.
choices.chinese: 我会留着这种不齐整的样子。我挺喜欢的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin gives a small nod and looks down at the words in the notebook.
beats.chinese: Robin轻轻点头，低头看了看本子上的字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I'm trying out the spacing.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我在试字距。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They shut the notebook and hold it at their side, then turn towards the reading room below.
beats.chinese: 他们合上本子，垂手拿在身侧，随后转向下方的阅览室。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have a look at the room now.
beats.chinese: 我现在看看阅览室。

choices.english: I'll look from here. I'd prefer no chat, thanks.
choices.chinese: 我就在这里看看。想安静待着，谢谢。

choices.english: I'm just passing. You can keep that spot. Continue along the gallery.
choices.chinese: 我只是路过。你留在这里就好。沿书廊继续走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin's finger stops above the page. They lower the notebook.
beats.chinese: Robin的手指停在纸页上方，随后放低本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. A lettering notebook. That was the short answer.
beats.chinese: 对。练手写字的本子。简短回答就该是这个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin closes it, puts it in their coat pocket and turns towards the reading room below.
beats.chinese: Robin合上本子，装进外套口袋，转身看向下方的阅览室。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came up for a look. Better get round to it. Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 我本来是上来参观的。也该看看了。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin looks at the heading again. Their raised eyebrow stays raised.
beats.chinese: Robin又看了一眼标题，挑起的眉毛没有放下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't like it. I'll do mine again.
beats.chinese: 我不喜欢。我这个得重写。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn to a fresh page and begin a new heading, keeping the notebook close.
beats.chinese: 他们翻到空白页，重新写起标题，仍把本子收在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Anyway, thanks for saying what you thought. Enjoy the room.
beats.chinese: 不过，谢谢你说实话。慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You stay to look down into the reading room. Robin gives a brief nod.
beats.chinese: 你留在原处，俯瞰阅览室。Robin简短地点点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Certainly.
beats.chinese: 当然。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin slips the notebook into their pocket. As they turn towards the room, their pen starts to slide after it. They catch it against their coat.
beats.chinese: Robin把本子放进口袋。转身看向阅览室时，钢笔也跟着往下滑，他们把笔按在外套上接住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nearly lost that.
beats.chinese: 差点掉了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the same gallery. Robin keeps the notebook tucked against their side while you pass.
beats.chinese: 你沿着同一层书廊继续走。你经过时，Robin把本子收在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. Thanks.
beats.chinese: 好。谢谢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Once you are clear, Robin opens the notebook again, keeping it close in front of them.
beats.chinese: 等你走过，Robin再次打开本子，仍把它收在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good visit.
beats.chinese: 祝你参观愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the upper gallery overlooking the La Trobe Reading Room, you see Robin Castellano looking down into the room. They recognise you and give a small nod.
beats.chinese: 在俯瞰拉筹伯阅览室的上层书廊，你看见Robin Castellano正望着下方。他们认出了你，轻轻点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've got a song stuck in my head.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。有首歌在我脑子里转个不停。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin taps two fingers against their folded arm, notices the movement and stops.
beats.chinese: Robin用两根手指敲着交叠的手臂，察觉这个动作后停了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Family song swap. My niece chose six minutes of drums. I preferred the silence before it.
beats.chinese: 家里每周交换歌曲。侄女选了六分钟的鼓声。我更喜欢播放前那段安静。

causality.presenceReason: Robin先来上层书廊安静观看阅览室，顺手在随身本子上练写La Trobe。
causality.placeAttitude: 把这里当作可以安静观看的公共阅览空间，主动压低声音，本子始终收在身前，不挡视线或通道。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留下的任务，只需避免占用他人观看和通行的空间。
causality.currentGoal: 看看阅览室，并完成自己本子上的手写标题，眼下想确认La Trobe中间是否有空格。
causality.currentState: 独自专注于字距，愿意为一个小事实主动开口。玩家表示兴趣后会多讲文字细节，没有兴趣则收起本子看阅览室。
causality.contactTrigger: Robin在同层书廊练写名称时，压低声音向附近玩家确认La Trobe中间是否留空格，没有靠近、碰撞或妨碍观看。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留简短直白的说话方式、铁路时刻表可读性兼职、手写兴趣、容易讲起排版的缺点及不假装喜欢的态度。保留Ballarat铁路工作经历与迁居墨尔本的背景。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家确认空格并追问用途后，Robin解释练字与兼职工作，继而多讲字距。aa被提醒后收起本子，转去看阅览室。ab坦率保留审美分歧，另起一页重写。玩家只确认空格时，Robin仅补充自己在试字距，随后收本看阅览室。ba接受不聊天的要求，收本看景并接住滑落的笔。bb让玩家经过后留在原处，重新打开本子继续练字。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有分支都在照片所示同层上层书廊内，仅有原地观看、转身和沿书廊经过，不添加设施或跨层路线。本子始终贴近身体，不伸入他人视线或通行范围。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Robin Castellano。本次重逢位于维州图书馆阅览室，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the upper gallery overlooking the State Library of Victoria's La Trobe Reading Room, Walter Bishop studies the arrangement of the desks below. He holds his open sketchbook low and speaks quietly to you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在维州图书馆俯瞰拉筹伯阅览室的上层书廊，沃尔特·毕晓普正观察下方书桌的排列。他把摊开的草图本放得很低，向附近的你低声开口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd like to use those arrangements, without making the film look like a floor plan.
beats.chinese: 我想把这些排列画进去，又不想把短片画成平面图。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks down at his page, keeping the sketchbook low against his blue work vest.
beats.chinese: 他低头看看纸页，草图本始终低低地贴在蓝色工装背心前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm making a little stop-motion film with pegboard figures. These patterns might work in it.
beats.chinese: 我在用洞洞板上的图形做一部定格动画短片。这些图案也许用得上。

choices.english: Are you making an animation?
choices.chinese: 你在做动画吗？

choices.english: I'd just like to look quietly.
choices.chinese: 我只想安静地看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter turns the notebook toward himself. A page of geometric sketches sits beside a list of names and numbers.
beats.chinese: 沃尔特把笔记本转向自己。一页几何草图旁边，列着一些名字和数字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Stop-motion. Pegboard figures. I used to inspect ferry cables, so having things stay where I put them is quite a pleasure.
beats.chinese: 定格动画，用洞洞板上的图形来拍。我以前检查渡船缆索，所以东西能老实待在我放的位置上，还挺让人高兴。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He adds a small mark beside a name, checks the total, then finds a finished drawing.
beats.chinese: 他在一个名字旁添了一小笔，核对总数，然后翻到一张画好的图。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two Thursday dinners. That's an hour holding my lamp. Right, there's one finished frame here, if you'd like a look.
beats.chinese: 吃了两顿周四晚饭，得给我扶一小时灯。好了，这儿有一帧画完的，你想看可以看看。

choices.english: Yes, I'd like to see the drawing.
choices.chinese: 好，我想看看那张图。

choices.english: I'll skip the drawing. Do they agree to those lamp shifts?
choices.chinese: 图就不看了。他们同意来扶灯吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter gives a small nod, keeping the notebook low against his body.
beats.chinese: 沃尔特点点头，仍把笔记本低低地收在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course.
beats.chinese: 当然。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks a sequence of tiny drawings, counts them with his pencil, and crosses out a number.
beats.chinese: 他查看一串小图，用铅笔逐个点数，划掉了一个数字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Six frames, not eight. Counted the same two twice. That's mine.
beats.chinese: 六帧，不是八帧。同样的两帧数了两遍，是我算错了。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你了。

choices.english: Six frames of what?
choices.chinese: 什么东西的六帧？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter holds the notebook low between you. The drawing shows blue peg shapes arranged around an open centre.
beats.chinese: 沃尔特把笔记本放低，展示在你们之间。画上的蓝色插钉图形围着一块空白中心排列。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the frame. The room gave me the arrangement. The blue was settled before I got here.
beats.chinese: 就是这一帧。布局是看这间阅览室想到的。蓝色嘛，来之前就定好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He leaves the page visible for a few moments, then turns it back and makes a small note beneath the drawing.
beats.chinese: 他把那页展示了片刻，随后转回去，在图下记了一小条。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll finish these notes before I lose the measurements. Enjoy the room.
beats.chinese: 我得趁还记得尺寸，把这些记完。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter stops with his fingers on the corner of the drawing. He keeps the notebook facing himself.
beats.chinese: 沃尔特的手指停在画页一角，笔记本依然朝着自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They eat the casserole. I put the lamp time against the dinners. Seems a fair account to me.
beats.chinese: 他们吃了炖羊肉，我就把扶灯的时间记在饭账上。我觉得这账很公平。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the marked total once more, closes the notebook, and puts his pencil away.
beats.chinese: 他又核对了一遍标出的总数，合上笔记本，把铅笔收好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I wouldn't charge you for looking at a drawing, though. Anyway, that's enough notes for this visit. Good day.
beats.chinese: 不过，看一张图我可不会跟你记账。好了，这趟记得够多了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter gives a small nod and folds the notebook shut around his pencil.
beats.chinese: 沃尔特点点头，把铅笔夹进笔记本里，合上本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. I've got the number down now.
beats.chinese: 好，数字已经记好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns his attention back to the arrangement of desks below, with the notebook held at his side.
beats.chinese: 他重新望向下方书桌的排列，把笔记本垂放在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 祝你参观愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter holds his pencil upright beside the notebook, well below anyone's view of the room.
beats.chinese: 沃尔特把铅笔竖在笔记本旁边，高度远低于大家观看阅览室的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A peg turning in a little animation. Six pictures for this bit.
beats.chinese: 小动画里一根插钉在转动。这一段要拍六张。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rotates the pencil in three small steps, then lays it along the notebook's spine.
beats.chinese: 他把铅笔分三小步转动了一下，然后沿着笔记本书脊放好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Like that, a little each time. The peg needs six positions. I only need to count them properly. I'll get back to it.
beats.chinese: 就这样，每次动一点。插钉要摆六个位置，我只要把数点对就行了。我接着记了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the upper gallery above the La Trobe Reading Room, Walter Bishop closes his animation sketchbook and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到拉筹伯阅览室上层的同一片书廊，沃尔特·毕晓普合上动画草图本，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've only settled one thing today. The blue in this design stays.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天只确定了一件事，这个构图里的蓝色不改。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks the sketchbook under his arm and looks back out over the reading room.
beats.chinese: 他把草图本收在臂下，重新望向阅览室。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The rest can wait till tomorrow. That one's settled.
beats.chinese: 别的可以明天再想，这个定了。

causality.presenceReason: 沃尔特来到维州图书馆拉筹伯阅览室的上层书廊，观察下方书桌的几何排列，为洞洞板定格动画记草图。
causality.placeAttitude: 他对室内排列有具体的创作兴趣，想借用构图，又不想让短片看起来像平面图。他愿意安静观看，不承担导览职责，也不要求陌生人评审作品。
causality.stayingConstraint: 双方始终留在照片所示的同层上层书廊，交流压低声音。沃尔特始终把草图本放低，不遮挡视线，也不主动举到用户眼前展示。
causality.currentGoal: 初遇时观察书桌布局，记下动画构图与帧数，完成这次观察笔记。重逢时已决定保留构图中的蓝色，暂时停下草图工作。
causality.currentState: 初遇时专注于创作，愿意向附近的人分享一句具体感想，但不索取评价。用户想安静观看时，他直接接受。他偶有计数疏忽，发现操作错误就直接认账。重逢时平静而坚持已作出的配色决定。
causality.contactTrigger: 沃尔特把草图本放低，观察下方书桌排列，主动向附近的用户低声说出借用布局又不想画成平面图的创作感想，随后说明自己做的是洞洞板定格动画。接触不再由物品侵入空间、挡住视线或道歉触发。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留退休渡船缆索检查员身份、洞洞板与定格动画兴趣，以及把周四晚饭折算为自己项目工时的固执习惯。他会立即承认计数错误，却坚持饭账逻辑。重逢继续通过蓝色不改的决定体现审美上的固执，既有成长、居住与关系经历均不变。
causality.reactionAndChange: 用户询问动画后进入a，沃尔特介绍作品，并提到晚饭折算的扶灯工时。aa在用户明确表示想看后展示完成图，再继续记笔记。ab因用户追问工时是否经过同意，他坚持饭账逻辑，收起本子结束交谈。用户表示只想安静观看后进入b，他直接接受，随后查看自己的帧数并承认算错。ba接受用户不再交谈的选择，合本看向下方书桌。bb回应用户对六帧的追问，用铅笔简短演示逐格转动，再回到记录。重逢内容不改。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程只使用照片所示上层书廊及向下观察阅览室的视线，不转移到其他楼层或新增设施。笔记本和铅笔都是创作观察所用的随身物品。只有aa在用户选择观看后低位展示完成图，bb的铅笔演示也保持低位。重逢双方仍在同层。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Walter Bishop。本次重逢位于维州图书馆阅览室，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Oscar Brightwell is on the upper gallery overlooking the State Library Victoria's La Trobe Reading Room, taking a look after his laundromat maintenance shift. His phone is on silent. He reads a message from a friend asking to bring his flatmate to dinner, then looks towards you nearby.
beats.chinese: Oscar Brightwell 下了自助洗衣店的维修班，来到维州图书馆俯瞰 La Trobe 阅览室的上层书廊看看。他的手机一直调着静音。他看完朋友询问能否带室友来吃饭的消息，随后看向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just been promoted to cooking for three. Haven't accepted the promotion.
beats.chinese: 刚刚升任三人晚饭的厨师。我还没接受这个晋升。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his phone, staying where he is. He keeps his voice low.
beats.chinese: 他放低手机，仍站在原处。他继续压低声音说话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A mate wants to bring his flatmate to dinner. I only want one guest.
beats.chinese: 朋友想带室友来吃饭。我只想招待一个人。

choices.english: Dinner sounds complicated.
choices.chinese: 听起来这顿晚饭挺复杂。

choices.english: No worries. I'd just like to look at the room.
choices.chinese: 没关系。我就想看看阅览室。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Oscar glances at the message again, staying out of your way.
beats.chinese: Oscar 又看了一眼消息，仍站在不挡着你的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One mate's coming over. Now he wants to bring his flatmate. I've got a two-seat table.
beats.chinese: 一个朋友要来吃饭，现在又想带上他室友。我家餐桌就两个座位。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types a short reply with both thumbs, then locks the screen.
beats.chinese: 他用两只拇指打了一条简短的回复，随后锁上屏幕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Told him just him tonight. We can do another night if that doesn't suit.
beats.chinese: 跟他说了，今晚只能他一个人来。不方便的话就改天。

choices.english: Couldn't you just cook a bit more?
choices.chinese: 不能多做一点吗？

choices.english: Fair enough. The frying pan probably needs the other seat.
choices.chinese: 也对。另一个座位大概还得留给煎锅。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Oscar pockets the phone without finishing his reply. He shifts farther to one side of the gallery.
beats.chinese: Oscar 没回完消息就把手机收进口袋，又往书廊一侧挪了挪。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No worries. I'll give you some room.
beats.chinese: 没问题，我给你让点地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks down into the reading room, then checks where he is standing.
beats.chinese: 他朝下方的阅览室看去，又确认了一下自己站的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm staying here a minute. Say if I'm in your way.
beats.chinese: 我还会在这儿看一会儿。挡着你就说。

choices.english: One step to your left would help, thanks.
choices.chinese: 往你左边挪一步就好了，谢谢。

choices.english: You're fine there. I'll move a little farther along. Enjoy the view.
choices.chinese: 你站那儿没问题。我往前走一点。慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Oscar's eyebrows lift. His answer comes out a little sharper than before.
beats.chinese: Oscar 挑了挑眉，回答时的语气比刚才硬了一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can cook more. I don't want two guests.
beats.chinese: 多做点饭没问题。我就是不想同时招待两个人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He presses his lips together briefly, then puts the phone away and turns back towards the reading room.
beats.chinese: 他短暂地抿了抿嘴，把手机收好，转身重新望向阅览室。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That came out sharp. Anyway, dinner's sorted. I'll let you get on.
beats.chinese: 刚才语气有点冲。总之，晚饭安排好了。不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Oscar gives a brief laugh, quiet enough for the gallery.
beats.chinese: Oscar 短促地笑了一声，音量依然适合安静的书廊。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Pan's good company. Doesn't ask to bring anyone.
beats.chinese: 煎锅挺好相处的，也不问能不能再带个人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His phone lights up. He reads the reply, taps a quick response, then moves a few paces along the same gallery.
beats.chinese: 手机屏幕亮了。他看完回复，简短地回了一条，随后沿着同一层书廊走开几步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, he's coming on his own. Better have a proper look before I go and buy the onions. Enjoy yours.
beats.chinese: 好了，他自己来。我得趁去买洋葱前好好看看了。你也慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Oscar takes one step to his left and checks that he has left your view clear.
beats.chinese: Oscar 往自己的左边挪了一步，确认不再挡住你的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yep. Easy enough.
beats.chinese: 行，小事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He leaves his phone in his pocket and faces the reading room.
beats.chinese: 他把手机留在口袋里，面向阅览室。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That reply can wait. Came in to have a look.
beats.chinese: 那条消息可以等会儿再回。我本来就是进来看看的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you move farther along the gallery, Oscar stays where he is and gives you a small nod.
beats.chinese: 你沿书廊往前走了一点，Oscar 留在原处，朝你轻轻点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Enjoy yours too.
beats.chinese: 谢了，你也慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes out his phone and opens his shopping list. The conversation ends as he adds one item.
beats.chinese: 他拿出手机，打开购物清单。随着他补上一样东西，这段交谈也结束了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Onions. Knew there was something.
beats.chinese: 洋葱。就知道漏了点什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the upper gallery overlooking the La Trobe Reading Room, Oscar is quietly looking down into the room. He recognises you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在俯瞰 La Trobe 阅览室的上层书廊，Oscar 正安静地看着下方的阅览室。他认出了附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. No rush to get dinner on after work today.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。今天下班后不用赶着做晚饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He leaves his phone in his pocket and looks down again, following the arrangement of the desks below.
beats.chinese: 他把手机留在口袋里，重新低头看向下方，目光沿着书桌的排列移动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just feel like staying here a bit today.
beats.chinese: 今天就想在这儿待一会儿。

causality.presenceReason: Oscar 做完自助洗衣店维修班后，主动来图书馆看看 La Trobe 阅览室，先于玩家在上层书廊停留。
causality.placeAttitude: 愿意花一点时间看阅览室，也知道这里需要轻声交谈，并非来工作或指导别人。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须久留的任务，之后还要买晚饭食材，只打算短暂停留。
causality.currentGoal: 看一看阅览室，同时回复朋友临时提出的携伴吃饭请求。
causality.currentState: 下班后放松，晚饭消息分散注意力。已经决定只招待一人，准备把边界告诉朋友，受到多做饭建议时语气会略硬。手机静音。
causality.contactTrigger: 看完朋友想携室友吃饭的消息，他向同层附近玩家低声自嘲刚升任三人晚饭厨师却没接受。随后说明自己只想招待一个人，不请玩家审校回复文字或替他决定。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留维修学徒、亲自做饭、两人小餐桌和一次只招待一位朋友的设定，以简短直白的口吻和干幽默呈现边界。保留其招待多人时缺乏把握、偶尔说话偏硬的缺点，不要求玩家替他处理朋友关系。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家接晚饭话题时，他说明朋友想带室友以及自己只招待一人的决定。aa 中玩家建议多做饭，他直接划清人数边界，承认语气偏硬后结束交谈。ab 中玩家接煎锅的玩笑，他回应并收到朋友独自赴约的确认，随后挪开看景。玩家只想安静看景时，他收起手机并让出空间。ba 中玩家要求让出视线，他照做，把回复留待稍后。bb 中玩家自行沿书廊走开，他礼貌道别并补写购物清单。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全部互动都在照片所示、俯瞰阅览室的同层上层书廊完成，只使用站立、侧移和沿书廊走几步，不新增设施或进入其他楼层。初遇开场他始终站在原处，后续仅按分支让位或在同层移动。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Oscar Brightwell。本次重逢位于维州图书馆阅览室，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A woman by the Baldwin Street storefronts switches a stockpot to her other hand. Its handle sticks out into the walking space.
beats.chinese: 鲍德温街的店面前，一个女人换手拎着深锅。锅把伸到了行人走的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mind the handle. Sorry, that sounded like your fault.
beats.chinese: 小心锅把。哎，听着像我在怪你似的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the handle towards her leg. A lid rattles inside.
beats.chinese: 她把锅把转向自己的腿，锅盖在里面撞了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm returning it. I swear it weighed less when I came to borrow it.
beats.chinese: 我来还锅。借的时候拎着可没这么沉。

choices.english: Ask what she cooked in it.
choices.chinese: 问她用这锅做了什么。

choices.english: Give her the space to put it down.
choices.chinese: 往旁边让让，方便她把锅放下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the pot from underneath long enough to flex the fingers she had on the handle.
beats.chinese: 她换只手托住锅底，伸了伸刚才攥锅把的几根手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Chickpeas. Fed eight. I only own a saucepan, and that one's already got nowhere to go.
beats.chinese: 鹰嘴豆，八个人吃。我家就一口小锅，还愁没地儿放呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She grabs the handle again as a couple passes.
beats.chinese: 一对路人经过，她又握紧了锅把。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Every time I feed people, somebody tells me to buy a bigger pot.
beats.chinese: 每次我叫人来吃饭，总有人劝我买口大的。

choices.english: Ask whether she would borrow this one again.
choices.chinese: 问她下次还借不借这口。

choices.english: Suggest cooking in two smaller pots.
choices.chinese: 说也可以分两口小锅做。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She rests the stockpot beside her feet, close to the storefront.
beats.chinese: 她把锅放在脚旁，朝店面那边贴了贴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I told my friend I'd wait out here, which seemed clever before I got here.
beats.chinese: 谢了。我跟朋友说在外头等。来之前还觉得这个安排挺好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She steps in beside the pot and tucks her elbows in to let someone pass.
beats.chinese: 她贴着锅站，收住胳膊肘让过一个人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's room for me or the pot. I'm trying to squeeze in both.
beats.chinese: 站我一个够，放口锅也够。两个一起就有点挤了。

choices.english: Point out the space by her feet and leave her to wait.
choices.chinese: 示意锅在脚边没挡路，让她自己等。

choices.english: Ask whether she could bring it back another time.
choices.chinese: 问她能不能换个时间来还。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She nudges the lid flat with a fingertip.
beats.chinese: 她伸根手指，把锅盖拨平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This exact one. I know how much it'll hold and I know where it goes afterwards.
beats.chinese: 就借这一口。能装多少我心里有数，用完也知道还哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She picks up the pot and turns to face the street beside you.
beats.chinese: 她提起锅，在你旁边转过身，也面朝街上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Stay a minute if you like. I'm waiting anyway.
beats.chinese: 想站会儿就站会儿吧。反正我也得等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She starts to answer, then uses two fingers to mark two spots in the air.
beats.chinese: 她刚要张嘴，又伸两根手指在空中比了两处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One spicy, one plain. I could actually do that. I'd have to borrow the second one, though.
beats.chinese: 一锅辣的，一锅不辣的。还真行。不过第二口还是得借。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She raises the stockpot as she looks along the storefronts.
beats.chinese: 她提起大锅，沿着一排店面望过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to see if she's coming. Thanks for the two pot idea.
beats.chinese: 我去看看她来了没有。分两锅这招，我记下了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slides one shoe under the handle to check how far it sticks out.
beats.chinese: 她把一只鞋伸到锅把下，比了比它伸出来多远。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah. It's out of the way now.
beats.chinese: 嗯，这就不挡路了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shifts her weight back and opens the message thread on her phone.
beats.chinese: 她往后站了站，低头打开手机里的聊天记录。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait right here. Go on, I won't keep you.
beats.chinese: 我就在这儿等。你忙你的，我不耽误你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She reads the last message on her phone, then types with both thumbs.
beats.chinese: 她看了眼手机上最后一条消息，两手拇指敲起字来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She can pick it up tomorrow. I should've offered that in the first place.
beats.chinese: 她可以明天来拿。我一开始就该这么说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She hooks her fingers under the handle and lifts the pot.
beats.chinese: 她勾住锅把，把锅提起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Me and my enormous carry on are going home.
beats.chinese: 行。我要带着这件大行李回家了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another day on Baldwin Street, Beatriz is holding a saucepan lid up to her face. She lowers it when she spots you.
beats.chinese: 另一天在鲍德温街，贝娅特丽丝把一只小锅盖举到脸前。看见你，她就把盖子放了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hey. This is mine. The actual pan is at somebody else's place.
beats.chinese: 哎，是你啊。盖是我的，锅还在别人家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the lid into the side of her bag. It sticks out past the zip.
beats.chinese: 她把盖塞到袋子一侧，边缘露在拉链外面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It was an even trade. I got lunch. I might still have to go get the pan, though.
beats.chinese: 没亏，我蹭了顿午饭。就是锅还得我自己去拿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside a Baldwin Street storefront, a man cups his phone. A voice from the speaker says there are twelve calendars left.
beats.chinese: 鲍德温街的一家店面外，一个男人拢着手机。扬声器里有人说，还剩十二本日历。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Twelve. Can I borrow a guess from you? They're my friend's, for a fundraiser.
beats.chinese: 十二本。能请你猜个数吗？我朋友拿日历做义卖。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the volume down and steps towards the building as two people pass.
beats.chinese: 两个人走过，他调低声音，往店面这侧靠了靠。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I reckon there'll still be six left tonight. She reckons two.
beats.chinese: 我猜今晚还剩六本。她说两本。

choices.english: Ask what could make them sell quicker.
choices.chinese: 问他什么情况下会卖得更快。

choices.english: Ask whether his friend wanted a guess in the first place.
choices.chinese: 问他朋友是不是想听他猜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds up the phone without unlocking it.
beats.chinese: 他抬了抬手机，没有解锁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The rain holding off would help. Nobody wants to carry a paper calendar in a downpour.
beats.chinese: 雨能晚点下就好。下大雨谁还想拎着本纸日历走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rubs a crumb off his sleeve and looks at his phone again.
beats.chinese: 他抹掉袖口一点碎屑，又看了眼手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mind you, she makes things people actually want. I didn't put that in my little calculation.
beats.chinese: 不过，她做的东西确实有人喜欢。我算那笔小账的时候把这点漏了。

choices.english: Suggest giving her a dry day and a wet day guess.
choices.chinese: 建议他按下雨和不下雨各猜一次。

choices.english: Ask whether she told her friends about the sale.
choices.chinese: 问她有没有通知朋友来买。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a second look at the messages above the voice note.
beats.chinese: 他重新看了看语音消息上面的几句话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. She said she'd sold eight already. I skipped right over that bit, didn't I?
beats.chinese: 没。她说她已经卖了八本。我刚才直接跳过这句了，是吧？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the phone in both hands and starts a reply, then stops.
beats.chinese: 他双手捧着手机，刚开始回消息，又停住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can tell her that's good news. I can also keep my six to myself.
beats.chinese: 我可以先说这挺好的。至于六本嘛，我自己记着也行。

choices.english: Let him send the congratulations and drop the bet.
choices.chinese: 让他发句祝贺，猜数的事就算了。

choices.english: Ask whether he wants to remember the number for himself.
choices.chinese: 问他自己要不要记住猜的数。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He unlocks the phone and adds a second line to his note.
beats.chinese: 他解锁手机，在备忘里多记了一行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Six if it pours. Two if it doesn't. Oh, she'll hate me taking her number.
beats.chinese: 下大雨就六本，不下就两本。哎，我抄她的数，她准不乐意。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shows you both lines with the phone held between you.
beats.chinese: 他把手机举到两人中间，给你看那两行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave her name beside the two. She can collect on it later.
beats.chinese: 我把她的名字写在两本旁边。到时候算她猜对。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He scrolls back to the photograph in the chat. A stack of calendars sits on a table.
beats.chinese: 他往回翻到聊天里的照片。桌上叠着一摞日历。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Her sister's in the photo. If her sister's there, half the people she knows will hear about it.
beats.chinese: 照片里有她姐姐。她姐都去了，还不得把认识的人叫去一半。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives the phone screen a light tap with the side of a finger.
beats.chinese: 他用手指侧面轻轻碰了一下屏幕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There goes my six. I'm changing mine to three.
beats.chinese: 得，我那六本算不准了。我改成三本。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types a short reply, taps send and puts the phone away.
beats.chinese: 他打了句短的，点下发送，把手机放回口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eight's good. That's all I sent.
beats.chinese: 八本已经挺好了。我就回了这句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks down Baldwin Street, then moves closer to the storefront.
beats.chinese: 他往鲍德温街那头看了看，又朝店面挪了点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My lunch date should be along. If we get started on the weather, we'll both miss ours.
beats.chinese: 跟我吃午饭的人应该快到了。咱俩要是再聊起天气，饭都得耽误。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the notes app and types a single digit.
beats.chinese: 他打开备忘录，敲下一个数字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If I don't write it down, I'll swear I said four by dinner. I like winning more than I should.
beats.chinese: 要是不记，到了晚饭我准说自己猜的是四本。我是有点太想赢了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He locks the phone without going back to the chat.
beats.chinese: 他没再切回聊天，直接锁了屏。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll tell her well done. If she asks, I never showed you that note.
beats.chinese: 我去夸她一句。她要问，你就当没瞧过我那条备忘。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another day on Baldwin Street, Gordon spots you as he slides a patterned cup into a bag.
beats.chinese: 另一天在鲍德温街，戈登正往袋里放一只带花纹的杯子，一抬头看见了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. I said I'd bring my own cup to lunch. Apparently that wasn't the hard part.
beats.chinese: 嗨。我说午饭自己带杯子。原来带杯子还算简单的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws the cup out again, checking the lip with a thumb.
beats.chinese: 他又把杯子拿出来，拇指摸过杯口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My friend asked if I'd use the nice one or keep it nice in the bag. Fair question.
beats.chinese: 朋友问我，这么好看的杯子到底拿不拿出来喝，还是留袋里继续好看。这话问得挺准。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Baldwin Street, a woman with a cotton bag looks from one storefront to the next. She stops to let you pass.
beats.chinese: 鲍德温街上，一个拎棉袋的女人挨个看店面。见你过来，她停下来让路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can you see a number from there? I told a friend I'd meet her by the green door.
beats.chinese: 你站那儿能瞧见门号吗？我跟朋友说在绿门那儿见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks along the storefronts again. The handles of her bag are twisted together.
beats.chinese: 她又往那排店面看了一遍。棉袋的提手在手里拧着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've been saying green door for years. It's entirely possible the door got on with its life.
beats.chinese: 我都叫它绿门叫了好几年了。也没准人家早换样了，就我还这么叫。

choices.english: Ask what she remembers about the old door.
choices.chinese: 问问她还记得那扇门什么样。

choices.english: Suggest she wait for her friend to send a number.
choices.chinese: 提议等朋友把门号发过来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She straightens two fingers against the side of her bag.
beats.chinese: 她伸出两根手指，在袋子侧面比了比。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Narrow frame. The green went up one side but not the other. You could pick it out from halfway down the street.
beats.chinese: 门框挺窄。绿漆只刷到一边，另一边没刷。离老远就认得出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pulls a folded slip from the pocket of the bag. There are a few door numbers on it.
beats.chinese: 她从袋子的口袋里抽出一张折过的纸条，上面记着几个门号。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got numbers here for deliveries. Of course I didn't write the one I thought I'd always know.
beats.chinese: 这是我送货记的。当然了，我觉得自己这辈子都认得的那个，偏偏没记。

choices.english: Ask her to check the message for a number now.
choices.chinese: 问她要不要先看看消息里有没有门号。

choices.english: Ask if the two doorframes in view would help jog her memory.
choices.chinese: 指给她看眼前两边的门框，问能不能想起点什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sets the cotton bag against her leg and pulls out her phone.
beats.chinese: 她把棉袋贴着腿拎住，腾出手拿手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can ask. She's coming to see my wax wraps, anyway. She hasn't got a great attachment to the door.
beats.chinese: 我问问吧。她本来就是来看我的蜂蜡布，对那扇门倒没什么感情。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As she types, she shifts the bag out of the way of people passing.
beats.chinese: 她边打字边把袋子往里挪，给路过的人让开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to tell her I've stopped walking. That should narrow it down.
beats.chinese: 我跟她说我站住不走了。这样总好找一点。

choices.english: Give her room to wait by the storefront.
choices.chinese: 给她让点地方，让她在店面旁等。

choices.english: Ask whether she'd rather look a little farther along.
choices.chinese: 问她想不想再往前找一小段。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She brings up the text thread and runs one finger up it.
beats.chinese: 她点开消息，用一根手指往上翻。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nope. Just me saying green and her saying okay. That's the two of us thoroughly lost, then.
beats.chinese: 没有。就我说绿门，她说行。得，我俩都没说清楚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sends a new text and drops the slip back into the bag.
beats.chinese: 她又发了条消息，把纸条放回袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait for a number. Forget the green for now.
beats.chinese: 我等她发门号吧。今天就先不管那扇绿门了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She compares the nearer frame with the one beyond it, then turns the slip over.
beats.chinese: 她看看近处的门框，又看看远一点的，把纸条翻了个面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Neither's what I had in my head. But that little gap there, I think I do remember that.
beats.chinese: 都跟我想的不一样。不过中间那点空儿，我好像倒有印象。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She draws two thin rectangles side by side.
beats.chinese: 她并排画了两个细长的方框。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got a minute. You see anything different from where you're standing?
beats.chinese: 我还不急。你从你那边看过去，有没有什么不一样的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stands by the storefront with the bag hanging close to her coat.
beats.chinese: 她靠着店面站好，棉袋贴着外套垂下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll stay put. Last thing she needs is me walking away every time she gets close.
beats.chinese: 我就在这儿等。人家好不容易快走到，我再换地方，那还怎么找。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The phone buzzes once in her hand. She lowers her eyes to it.
beats.chinese: 手机在她手里振了一下，她低头去看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That'll be her. Thanks for letting me get out of everybody's way.
beats.chinese: 多半是她。多谢啊，这下我也不挡人了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks one storefront farther along and types a second message.
beats.chinese: 她朝前面那家店望了望，又打了条消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll look one door down. I ought to tell her that while I'm still in the same place.
beats.chinese: 我就往前找一家。趁我还站在这儿，先跟她说清楚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts the bag by both handles and waits for a passerby to clear the way.
beats.chinese: 她把两个提手一起拎起来，等面前的人走过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, I'm going to go slow. I'll see you around.
beats.chinese: 我走得慢，你先走吧。回头见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another day on Baldwin Street, Aud recognizes you as she brushes a pale mark on her bag.
beats.chinese: 另一天在鲍德温街，奥德正掸袋子上的一块浅印子，一抬头认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I thought I got lunch on it. It's wax from just one of my samples.
beats.chinese: 哎，你好。我还当是午饭蹭上去了。原来就一块样布上的蜡。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens the bag a little. A square of folded cloth is wedged against the side.
beats.chinese: 她把袋口扒开一点。一块叠成方形的布正抵在袋壁上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll turn that one over. Same wrap either way, less of it on the bag.
beats.chinese: 我把这块翻个面吧。一样能包东西，袋子上还能少蹭点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A man by a Baldwin Street window opens his coat to look at a bright green vest in the reflection.
beats.chinese: 鲍德温街一家店的玻璃窗边，一个男人敞开外套，照了照里头那件亮绿背心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Come on, stand up straight. Oh, hey. I was talking to the vest.
beats.chinese: 起来点，别趴着。哦，你好。我跟背心说呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pinches up a corner that has folded under the coat.
beats.chinese: 他捏住被外套压进去的一角，往外扯了扯。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just put that green strip on. I didn't get dressed like this to cover the whole thing up.
beats.chinese: 绿边是我刚缝的。好不容易穿出来，总不能全给盖上吧。

choices.english: Ask how cold he is standing there.
choices.chinese: 问他站在这儿冷不冷。

choices.english: Ask what the green strip is made of.
choices.chinese: 问他那条绿边是用什么做的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pulls the collar up, then leaves the front open.
beats.chinese: 他竖起领子，前襟还是敞着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cold enough. I was hoping you'd tell me I looked too good to feel it.
beats.chinese: 冷啊。我本来还指望你说，我穿得这么好看，肯定顾不上冷。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks his chin down into the collar.
beats.chinese: 他把下巴缩进领子里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Better now. Still got about half a foot of vest showing.
beats.chinese: 这下好点。还能露出半英尺呢。

choices.english: Suggest doing up just the middle button.
choices.chinese: 建议他只扣中间那颗。

choices.english: Say he can button up and enjoy the green himself.
choices.chinese: 说扣严实也行，亮绿色留给自己看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the corner flat between two fingers without pulling the vest off.
beats.chinese: 他两根手指夹住背心一角，把边压平，衣服还穿在身上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Leather off an old sofa. You can't sit on it any more, but you can certainly make people look at it.
beats.chinese: 旧沙发拆下来的皮。坐是坐不了了，拿来让人多看一眼还行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He follows your glance towards the corner, then drops his hand.
beats.chinese: 他顺着你的目光看了看那一角，把手放下了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was about to tell you what colour you ought to wear. You didn't ask me that at all.
beats.chinese: 我刚差点就想告诉你该穿什么颜色。你压根没问这个。

choices.english: Ask how he got the old leather flat.
choices.chinese: 问他怎么让旧皮子平下来的。

choices.english: Leave the colour to him and pass on the look in the window.
choices.chinese: 颜色让他自己定，也不凑过去照玻璃。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He does up the middle button and checks the window again.
beats.chinese: 他扣上中间那颗纽扣，又往玻璃上看了眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There it is. Just enough green at the top. My coat can take it from here.
beats.chinese: 喏，上头露这点绿正好。别的就交给外套了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a step away from the glass as someone approaches the storefront.
beats.chinese: 有人朝店面走来，他从窗前往外让了一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was blocking half the window. Here, let's give it back.
beats.chinese: 刚才半扇窗都让我挡了。来，给人家让出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He does up the coat all the way to his throat.
beats.chinese: 他把外套一路扣到脖子下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm warm already. Green's still in there. I know where I put it.
beats.chinese: 这就暖了。绿的还在里头，我又没忘放哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks one sleeve cuff and starts off along Baldwin Street.
beats.chinese: 他捋了捋一边袖口，顺着鲍德温街走起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My friend's going to make me show her anyway. I'll survive till then.
beats.chinese: 反正我朋友准要我给她看。我先撑到见面再说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns just enough to show the back of the sewn edge.
beats.chinese: 他稍微转了点身，露出缝边的背面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Kept it under a pile of books overnight. The books don't look any different. The leather does.
beats.chinese: 拿一摞书压了一宿。书倒还是原样，皮子平多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lets the edge drop and looks at your face instead of your clothes.
beats.chinese: 他松开皮边，抬眼看你，也没再瞄你的衣服。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's how I did mine. I wouldn't put your good books through it without asking.
beats.chinese: 我自己是这么弄的。要压你那几本好书，我肯定先问一声。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns back to the glass and runs a finger down the strip in the reflection.
beats.chinese: 他转回玻璃前，对着倒影顺了一下那条绿边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair. I can have a whole argument with this thing on my own.
beats.chinese: 行啊。这条边我一个人就够跟它较劲的了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lets the coat fall over the vest and moves out of the walking space.
beats.chinese: 他让外套盖住背心，退到不挡路的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I can fuss with it when I get inside.
beats.chinese: 好了。我进去再跟它慢慢较劲。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another day on Baldwin Street, Emile recognizes you while rubbing a dark mark on a leather cuff.
beats.chinese: 另一天在鲍德温街，埃米尔正搓皮袖口上一道深印子，一抬眼认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. I thought this was fresh. It's where the sofa used to fold.
beats.chinese: 哎。我还以为刚蹭上的。原来是沙发以前折在这儿的印。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stops rubbing and turns the cuff so the mark faces out.
beats.chinese: 他不搓了，把袖口一转，让印子朝外。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Took me long enough to notice. I'm leaving it right there.
beats.chinese: 我折腾半天才看出来。就留它在这儿得了。
