beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A book slides halfway out of a backpack near the steam clock. Gordon catches it with his elbow.
beats.chinese: 蒸汽钟旁，一本书从背包里滑出半截。戈登用胳膊肘接住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oof. That's my daughter's. I'd have heard about it if I dropped it on those bricks.
beats.chinese: 哎哟，我女儿的。真掉砖头上，我可有得听了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the book against the open bag. A drawing of noodles fills part of the cover.
beats.chinese: 他拿书抵住开着的包。封面一半画的是面条。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: D'you read these? Or cook? Anybody in your family put ginger in that kind of broth?
beats.chinese: 你看这种书吗？做饭呢？你家有人给这种汤里放姜吗？

choices.english: Talk about the broth, if we're talking about the broth.
choices.chinese: 就聊汤的话，咱可以聊这个。

choices.english: I'd rather leave my family out of it.
choices.chinese: 我不太想说家里的事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the top of the bag outwards so the book can sit in it upright.
beats.chinese: 他把包顶朝外翻开，腾地方让书直着进去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's good. The drawing's got two fat slices on the board. I'd take the second out before I served it.
beats.chinese: 这样也好。图里案板上有两片厚姜。换我，第二片上桌前就给捞了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sets a finger on the drawing and keeps the book open without pushing it towards you.
beats.chinese: 他一根手指点在图上，本子摊着，没一个劲朝你递。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She lent me this one because she said there'd be fewer things for me to complain about. Not a safe prediction.
beats.chinese: 我女儿借我这本，说里头总该少几处给我挑了。我看这话不好担保。

choices.english: Ask about one detail he liked in the comic.
choices.chinese: 问漫画有哪处他是真喜欢的。

choices.english: Leave the book for his daughter and carry on.
choices.chinese: 把书留给他女儿，先走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stops halfway through closing the zip.
beats.chinese: 他拉到一半，拉链停了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Understood. That was rather a personal question. I do apologise.
beats.chinese: 明白。这问得有点私人了。我真不是故意的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lets out a short breath and finishes closing the bag.
beats.chinese: 他短短吐了口气，把拉链拉完。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've gone all polite on you now. We can start again with the picture on the book. We can also stop.
beats.chinese: 我现在又开始跟你一套一套客气了。可以就从书皮那碗面说起，也可以不聊了。

choices.english: Stay and talk about the drawing instead.
choices.chinese: 留下，只聊那张画。

choices.english: Let him get back to waiting for his daughter.
choices.chinese: 让他接着等女儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves back to the shop side, leaving the walking line clear.
beats.chinese: 他往店面那头让，行人走的线空了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The cook eats over the sink first. My daughter made me go back to that page. Looked like my kitchen apart from being tidy.
beats.chinese: 厨子先在水槽那儿站着吃。我女儿还叫我翻回去看那一页。也就厨房比我家整齐点，别的真像。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts a finger in the book to keep the page for her.
beats.chinese: 他夹了一根手指在书里，要给她留着这页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm glad she got me reading these. I won't say it where she can hear.
beats.chinese: 她拉我看这个，还真挺好。她本人在我可不说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the book shut and checks both straps on his backpack.
beats.chinese: 他把书合着拿好，两根背带都检查了一遍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aye. She might want to actually read her own book again at some point.
beats.chinese: 也是。总有一会儿她想自己把自己的书再读一遍呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sets the book inside and pulls the zip all the way across.
beats.chinese: 他把书放进去，将拉链一拉到底。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give it back without a note full of soup corrections.
beats.chinese: 这回还她，就不附一张全是汤该怎么改的单子了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes the book out and turns to the page with the bowl on it.
beats.chinese: 他抽出书，翻到画碗的那页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. Look at that dirty ring where they set it down. That's what got me. I wipe mine and it does that anyway.
beats.chinese: 好啊。看那碗搁下之后，这里一圈脏印。我就喜欢这一处。我家碗擦过，搁下还是那样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps the book low so you can look without stepping into the stream of people.
beats.chinese: 他把书拿低，你不用迈进人流也看得见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I can say something without asking you another thing.
beats.chinese: 瞧，不再问你一遍，我也会说话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rolls his shoulders once and faces down the pavement.
beats.chinese: 他转了下肩膀，朝人行道望去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. She'll be here when she gets here. I'll put the book in my hands so she can tell I've found it.
beats.chinese: 行。她来了自然就来了。我把书拿手上，她一看就知道找着了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes the book out by the spine and stands a little farther from the clock.
beats.chinese: 他捏着书脊抽出来，站得离钟远了一些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for telling me straight.
beats.chinese: 谢你肯直接跟我说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a different day, Gordon sees you outside the shopfronts and pulls a clean racquet cover a little farther up his shoulder.
beats.chinese: 后来有一天，戈登在沿街店面外看见你，把干干净净的球拍套又往肩上提了一提。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. Went for soup after badminton. Balanced this on my knee for twenty minutes to keep it clean.
beats.chinese: 嗨。打完羽毛球去喝汤。为了别沾着，拍子我放膝盖上端了二十分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the cover over. His own trouser leg has a little dark circle on it.
beats.chinese: 他翻过球拍套。自己一边裤腿上倒有小小一圈深印。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Got the important thing clean. I can wash the other one.
beats.chinese: 要紧的东西是干净的。另一个我还能洗。

causality.presenceReason: 来水街等女儿，刚读过借来的漫画
causality.placeAttitude: 爱在外头边等边聊，容易不知不觉问太细
causality.stayingConstraint: 女儿没到，他该先把借出的书放好
causality.currentGoal: 接住别人拒聊的信号，不冷脸
causality.currentState: 工作少有人说话，一开口又说多了
causality.contactTrigger: 背包张口露出别人的书，玩家正经过，他主动敲敲露出的那角
causality.characterContinuity: 愿意承认越界，给人留退路，不乱保证
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 接受转讲食品疑问。ab 给人留下一位置。ba 少问一句照样聊天。bb 收好书离开

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Léa reaches over a lunch box just as a phone rises across from her on the path.
beats.chinese: 海堤步道边，对面一只手机刚举起来，蕾娅就伸手挡在饭盒上头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, no. Do it after I've tasted it. I made that hot on purpose.
beats.chinese: 别别。等我尝完你再拍，我特地弄得热乎着呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The other person puts the phone down. Léa laughs, then glances your way.
beats.chinese: 那人放下手机。蕾娅笑了，转眼瞧过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. Family habit. At every meal growing up, the food had to sit there while somebody made a speech.
beats.chinese: 吵到你啦，我家带出来的习惯。从小到大，一吃饭就有人讲一大通，菜只能搁旁边晾着。

choices.english: Tell her it smells ready to eat.
choices.chinese: 告诉她闻着已经可以开吃了。

choices.english: Ask if they are waiting for anybody else.
choices.chinese: 问他们是不是还在等谁。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens the first container. A thin breath of steam crosses her wrist.
beats.chinese: 她打开头一个饭盒。一缕热气从她手腕上过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mm. It is. I made three portions. Our third person's still looking for a place to leave the bike.
beats.chinese: 嗯，早该吃了。我带了三人份。第三个人还在找把自行车放哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips a spare lid under the hot one.
beats.chinese: 她拿一个空盖垫住烫的那个。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can put one aside. I don't think we all have to let ours get cold together.
beats.chinese: 我可以单留一份嘛。也用不着大家的非得一块儿凉了。

choices.english: Encourage the two who are there to start.
choices.chinese: 请已经到了的两个人先开吃。

choices.english: Close the third portion tight for the friend.
choices.chinese: 建议把第三份扣严了留给朋友。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the line of the path, then looks at her friend instead.
beats.chinese: 她沿步道望了一眼，又转回来看同伴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, one more. The person here can have theirs any way they like. I don't want to make a speech about not making speeches.
beats.chinese: 还等一个。已经到这位，自己爱怎么吃都行。又不能为了不讲话，先讲一通话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The phone moves once on top of the spare bag, but stays screen down.
beats.chinese: 备用袋上手机动了一下，仍旧扣着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Somebody else can make the big decision about the camera.
beats.chinese: 好了，拍不拍这种天大的事，也可以交给别人想。

choices.english: Ask the friend if they want a quick photo of their own lunch.
choices.chinese: 问旁边那位要不要拍一张自己的午饭。

choices.english: Leave the camera down and let the two eat.
choices.chinese: 手机就那么放着，让两个人先吃。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Léa takes the first spoonful, then puts the lid beneath the box so it stays steady in her lap.
beats.chinese: 蕾娅先吃了一勺，把盖垫在盒底，让盒稳在腿上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, that's good. Now if we took a photo there'd be a great hole in it.
beats.chinese: 哇，真好吃。现在拍的话，中间可挖了一大块了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her friend opens their own box and scrapes a spoon along the corner.
beats.chinese: 朋友也打开自己的盒，拿勺沿盒角刮了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We can do another hole next to it.
beats.chinese: 还可以在旁边再挖一个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pushes down on each corner of the third lid, listening for three little snaps and then a fourth.
beats.chinese: 她把第三个盒盖的角挨个按下去。听着咔、咔、咔了三下，又响第四下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There, I'll keep that inside my jacket a little while. The rest is fair game.
beats.chinese: 好了，这份先贴我外套捂会儿。剩下的可以开动。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slides the closed portion into her bag and leaves the other boxes out.
beats.chinese: 她把扣住的那份滑进袋里，其他盒都留在外头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's going to think we had enormous restraint.
beats.chinese: 那位来了会以为我们忍了好久呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend raises the phone over their own box. Léa has already got a spoon in hers.
beats.chinese: 朋友把手机举到自己盒上头。蕾娅自己这盒里已经插了勺。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Perfect. Mine's got the nice browned bit underneath and I'm not turning it out for proof.
beats.chinese: 好极了。我这盒底下还有块煎焦脆的，就不倒出来给你们证明了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A shutter sound comes just as Léa closes her eyes over the first bite.
beats.chinese: 蕾娅吃上头一口，闭了闭眼，刚好响一声快门。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I hope that was just the stew.
beats.chinese: 但愿就拍了炖菜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The other person's fingers move away from the phone. Two lids come off almost together.
beats.chinese: 旁边人的手指离开手机。两个盖差不多同时打开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Okay, before we talk. One bite. Oh, that's spicier than I meant it to be.
beats.chinese: 行，咱先别说。一口。哟，比我想的辣好多。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Léa reaches into the side of her bag and holds up a bottle of water.
beats.chinese: 蕾娅手伸进袋子侧面，拿了瓶水出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tell me the rest after I get my mouth back.
beats.chinese: 等我嘴缓过来，你再接着说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Later in the week Léa sees you on the seawall and lifts an empty bowl by two fingertips.
beats.chinese: 过了几天，蕾娅在海堤上见到你，俩指尖捏着举起一只空碗。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. My friend gave this back washed. I feel as if I ought to fill it again before either of us changes our mind.
beats.chinese: 嗨，我朋友洗干净还我的。我都觉得，得趁我俩谁也没改主意，再给人装满一次。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tucks the bowl in against her folded jacket.
beats.chinese: 她把碗贴着叠好的外套收住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No picture this time either. We're going to have it with bread.
beats.chinese: 这回也不拍。弄点面包蘸着吃。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A little card lands face down on the seawall path. Ingrid puts the toe of her shoe on it before it can reach the stones.
beats.chinese: 一张小卡片扣在海堤步道上。还没滑到石岸，英格丽先拿鞋尖踩住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got it. It's a name. My sister would probably say it's the wrong name to keep.
beats.chinese: 踩住了，是个人名。我妹大概会说，这名字就不该留着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She picks up the card and knocks a small stone off its corner.
beats.chinese: 她捡起卡片，从角上弹掉一粒小石子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fourteen for dinner. Two cousins haven't spoken since February. Funny how they can both manage to ring me.
beats.chinese: 十四个人来吃饭。有两个表亲从二月就不说话了，倒是都知道打给我。

choices.english: Ask if she wants both of them there.
choices.chinese: 问她是不是希望俩人都来。

choices.english: Ask if either one actually said they weren't coming.
choices.chinese: 问其中有没有谁真的说了不来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the card onto a stack the same size.
beats.chinese: 她把卡片放到同样大的一叠上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. They've each got a chair. They can decide what to do with their mouths.
beats.chinese: 想。椅子一人一把。嘴怎么用，人家自己决定。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks which names are on top.
beats.chinese: 她看看哪几个名字在最上面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My son says put them at opposite ends. I make dinner at one end of the kitchen. I can't keep moving the kitchen.
beats.chinese: 我儿子说把他俩分到两头。我就在厨房一头做饭。总不能再把厨房也跟着挪。

choices.english: Leave both names on the stack.
choices.chinese: 两个名字都留着。

choices.english: Let them pick where to sit.
choices.chinese: 来了自己挑地方坐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She rubs a patch of damp off the side of the card.
beats.chinese: 她抹掉卡片侧面一小块水印。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. One asked what the other would be eating. I said whatever everybody else is eating.
beats.chinese: 没有。有个问另外那个打算吃什么。我说大家吃什么，那人就吃什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The wind presses her sleeve flat against her arm.
beats.chinese: 风把她的袖子平平地压在胳膊上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm not ringing anybody a third time. I've got vegetables to peel when I get home.
beats.chinese: 我不打第三通电话。到家还一堆菜得削皮。

choices.english: Leave the two cousins to sort out whether they come.
choices.chinese: 来不来，让俩表亲自己去想。

choices.english: Suggest putting the cards away and enjoying the walk.
choices.chinese: 建议卡片先收起来，踏实走一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She straightens both cards against her palm and tucks them together.
beats.chinese: 她用手掌托齐两张卡，挨着收好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's it. If either chair's empty I'll put the bread on it.
beats.chinese: 就这样。哪把椅子没人，我拿来放面包。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks across the bend towards the buildings.
beats.chinese: 她越过水边弯道瞧了眼对面一排楼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I like both of them. I'd rather not forget that while I make the potatoes.
beats.chinese: 我俩人都喜欢。总不能煮着土豆，把这个给忘了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She wipes one little seating mark from the back of a card.
beats.chinese: 她从卡背后擦掉一个标座位的小记号。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fine. I'll put fourteen plates down. I know how to do that.
beats.chinese: 好，我摆十四个盘子。这事我会。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The cards go into her inside pocket, all the same way up.
beats.chinese: 卡片都朝一个方向，进了她的内兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If they both want the chair by the radiator, I expect I'll hear them talk at last.
beats.chinese: 俩人要都想坐暖气边，到时候我估计终于能听见他俩说话了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stops rubbing the mark and puts the card straight back.
beats.chinese: 她不再擦那一块，直接把卡放回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. They know where the door is. I'm not walking the afternoon calling about a chair.
beats.chinese: 嗯，门在哪儿他们知道。我不为了一把椅子，整个下午边走边打电话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts both hands in her pockets and looks ahead along the curve by the water.
beats.chinese: 她两手放进兜，沿临水的弯道往前看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have the quiet now, before all fourteen get here.
beats.chinese: 趁十四个人还没来，我先清静点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She presses the stack of cards flat into her pocket and takes her hand away.
beats.chinese: 她把那叠卡片在口袋里压平，抽出了手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I'd only got as far as two cousins and the person who doesn't like draughts.
beats.chinese: 也好，我总共就排了俩表亲和一个怕风的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She starts along the path at a steady walking pace.
beats.chinese: 她顺着步道慢慢走起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's a perfectly decent bit of water here. I might see it now.
beats.chinese: 眼前这片水看着挺好。这会儿总算能看看了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another evening, Ingrid recognizes you on the seawall with a harmonica turned on its edge in her hand.
beats.chinese: 又一天傍晚，英格丽在海堤上认出了你，把口琴竖拿在手上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I tried a new tune today. It has eight bars. The neighbours have had four.
beats.chinese: 你好，今天试了首新的。一共八小节。邻居已经听了四小节。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the harmonica into a coat pocket and leaves her hand there.
beats.chinese: 她把口琴放进大衣兜，手也留在里头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough for Tuesday. For both of us, I think.
beats.chinese: 周二听这点够了。我和邻居都够了。

causality.presenceReason: 沿熟悉海堤走，想好家宴要不要撤席

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter stops his old bike by the curve. A recorded bicycle bell rings once from his pocket.
beats.chinese: 沃尔特把旧自行车停在弯道边。兜里响了一声录下来的车铃。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, nobody's behind you. That's a bell I recorded and forgot to switch off.
beats.chinese: 不好意思，你身后没人。是我录的铃，刚忘关了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes out the recorder and turns it off properly.
beats.chinese: 他掏出录音机，把它彻底关掉。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's meant to be water after the bell. I put it on a tape for a friend. They never said if they'd want it.
beats.chinese: 铃之后还有水声。我给朋友录了盒带子，人家没说要还是不要。

choices.english: Ask what he wanted his friend to hear.
choices.chinese: 问他想叫朋友听到什么。

choices.english: Ask whether he'd leave the tape without asking again.
choices.chinese: 问能不能不再追问，就把带子留给对方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He traces the outside of the cassette case with a thumb instead of opening it.
beats.chinese: 他用拇指沿磁带盒外边划了一圈，没打开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Somebody coming past. Then fifteen seconds where nobody does. We used to stop talking on that bend without deciding to.
beats.chinese: 有人走过。然后十五秒，一个人也没来。我俩走到那段弯道，有时不用商量，就一块安静了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He settles the case on top of the bike bag.
beats.chinese: 他把磁带盒搁在自行车包顶上，放妥。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I thought I'd ask him to listen here. He might like it better at home.
beats.chinese: 原想请他当场听。他也许更想在家自己听。

choices.english: Tell him to mention who he thought of when he recorded it.
choices.chinese: 建议直接说录的时候想到谁了。

choices.english: Leave it up to the friend where to listen.
choices.chinese: 让朋友自己挑在哪儿听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slides the cassette halfway back into the bike bag.
beats.chinese: 他把磁带塞回车包一半。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I asked if he'd come on the ride. He said maybe. If he wants the tape, that's a different question.
beats.chinese: 问他来不来骑车，说也许吧。至于要不要听磁带，那又是一码事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pats the top of the bag once.
beats.chinese: 他在车包顶上拍了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't want to turn those into two maybes in a row.
beats.chinese: 我不想让人家连着说俩也许。

choices.english: Put a note on the tape and let him find it later.
choices.chinese: 在带子上留句话，等朋友以后看。

choices.english: Keep the tape for himself today.
choices.chinese: 今天自己留着带子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the case and takes the little pencilled card out.
beats.chinese: 他打开盒，把里面铅笔写的小卡抽出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's got Tuesday on it. I could put his name. I was the one who wanted him there.
beats.chinese: 上面只写了星期二。还可以添他名字。原本就是我想他在。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He writes slowly, with the case balanced on the bag.
beats.chinese: 他把盒架在包上，慢慢写。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I can give him that much without asking him to come anywhere.
beats.chinese: 好了。不必再约他去哪儿，也能给他听这一点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the case with his thumb on its hinge.
beats.chinese: 他拇指搭着铰链，把盒盖扣下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. I'll give it to him and go back out. I don't stay in the room when people listen to mine. I can hear myself waiting.
beats.chinese: 成，给他我就再出来。别人听我录的，我从不留在屋里。自己干等的声音我都听得见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He wraps the case in a bit of cloth before putting it away.
beats.chinese: 他把盒拿一小块布包好，才收起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The bell's on side one. Everything else can be his surprise.
beats.chinese: 铃在第一面，别的让他自己听出来吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds a blank corner of the label away from the cassette.
beats.chinese: 他把贴纸空着的一个角沿着磁带折开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: For when you've got a quiet minute. No question mark. That'll do.
beats.chinese: 有空安静会儿再听。末尾不加问号。成了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He zips the bag and looks along the seawall.
beats.chinese: 他拉上包，沿海堤望过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can take a ride now that I'm not waiting on an answer.
beats.chinese: 这会儿不用等回话，可以去骑一段了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pushes the tape the rest of the way in and rests a hand on the bicycle seat.
beats.chinese: 他把带子全塞进去，手搭在自行车座上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I might listen to the water myself first. I haven't done that since cutting it.
beats.chinese: 我也许先自己听一遍那段水声。剪完之后自己还没放过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He switches the recorder off again, though its light was already dark.
beats.chinese: 录音机的灯已经暗着，他又把开关拨到关。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can go on ahead. I need to fiddle with this by myself a bit longer.
beats.chinese: 你可以先走，我在这儿自己多摆弄会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a different morning, Walter sees you alongside the seawall. He has a cassette with a crooked label.
beats.chinese: 后来有个早上，沃尔特在海堤旁瞧见你。他手里一盒磁带，标签贴歪了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. Somebody made me one. Eight minutes of the oven at his bakery. He said I could skip his singing at the end.
beats.chinese: 你好。有人给我录了一盒。他面包店烤炉的声儿，八分钟。他说他最后唱的那段，我可以跳过去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns it over and looks carefully at the opposite label.
beats.chinese: 他翻过带子，把另一面的标签细细看过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I played that bit twice.
beats.chinese: 就那段我放了两回。

causality.presenceReason: 沿海堤骑到暂停处，公放前戴好耳机等人
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢记录水声，但不录别人当素材
causality.stayingConstraint: 录音已收，朋友没对邀请给准话
causality.currentGoal: 决定要不要留下这盒磁带作一句问候
causality.currentState: 把犹豫当拒绝比开口容易，一时不知说什么
causality.contactTrigger: 声音发出来不是水，是自行车铃，他误放了几秒，看见玩家就笑

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald takes out a plain wooden handle near the bend in the seawall. A shiny patch catches the light at the thumb end.
beats.chinese: 海堤的弯道旁，埃瓦尔德拿出一个素木柄。拇指那头磨亮的一块正好反了下光。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd know that one in the dark. My friend says he needs a make. I can tell him where the thumb goes.
beats.chinese: 摸黑我都认得。我朋友说得报牌子，我能告诉他的是拇指放哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rolls it once in his hand, then rests it flat.
beats.chinese: 他在手里滚了一下，把木柄平托住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He'll look for another one. Then he'll say I owe him one. We've argued about that for twenty years.
beats.chinese: 他会去帮我找一根，然后说我欠他一次。这事我俩扯了二十年。

choices.english: Ask what he wants a new handle to feel like.
choices.chinese: 问他换一根以后，握着要是什么感觉。

choices.english: Ask whether his friend would really keep score.
choices.chinese: 问他朋友是不是还真会记账。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald sets his thumb in the shiny place.
beats.chinese: 埃瓦尔德把拇指摁进发亮那一块。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Like this. Bit flatter on this side. I can show him the mark without sending him a whole catalogue.
beats.chinese: 就这样，这边扁一点儿。给他看这道印，犯不着把整份目录发过去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds it still against the palm of the other hand.
beats.chinese: 他把木柄贴另一手掌，托稳了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's no writing left. A photograph might be more use than my memory.
beats.chinese: 已经没字了。拍一张兴许比我记得准。

choices.english: Show the flattened bit first.
choices.chinese: 先把磨扁那块给朋友看。

choices.english: Take a picture with the thumb in place.
choices.chinese: 把拇指放原位拍一张。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald pushes the handle farther into his hand until most of it is covered.
beats.chinese: 埃瓦尔德把木柄往手心深处一送，挡住了大半。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. He'd forget the minute I left. I still don't want to say I owe him.
beats.chinese: 不会。我一走，他转头就忘。我还是不想说我欠他的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks at the curve of the stones from the paving.
beats.chinese: 他站在铺装道上，看下面石岸绕过去的线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can do something for somebody if I see it needs doing. I don't need the old number.
beats.chinese: 哪天看别人哪儿要帮，我也可以搭把手。甭记原来那个数。

choices.english: Tell him that's all he needs to say.
choices.chinese: 跟他说，说到这儿就够了。

choices.english: Ask what he'd do if the friend does find another one.
choices.chinese: 问朋友真找到了，他会怎么做。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He raises the handle palm upwards and points with the thumb of his empty hand.
beats.chinese: 他把木柄托起来，用空着那只手的拇指指了指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll show him this. If he can't find it I can use this one another year.
beats.chinese: 就给他看这点。实在找不着，这个再用一年也成。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips the handle away without getting his phone out.
beats.chinese: 他把木柄收好，手机没拿出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I was halfway to buying something I can still use.
beats.chinese: 好。差点就为了个还能用的，又买一个回来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald photographs his thumb on the wood. The rest of his hand takes up half the frame.
beats.chinese: 埃瓦尔德照了张自己在木头上按拇指的样子。手有一半都在画面里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. This bit, I can write. He won't need to know the name of my thumb.
beats.chinese: 好了。我就写这里。拇指可不用报型号吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sends the picture and pushes his phone deep into his pocket.
beats.chinese: 他把图发了，手机塞进兜底。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now we can both forget what the thing's called.
beats.chinese: 这下我俩都可以忘了它叫什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the handle away and leaves both hands where they were, deep in the coat.
beats.chinese: 他把柄收起来，手也原样留在大衣深处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. He can help and still go home without a receipt.
beats.chinese: 也是。帮个忙，回家也不用带张小票。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives the bend ahead an unhurried look.
beats.chinese: 他不紧不慢地望了望前面的弯道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going around the long way. It's bright on the water.
beats.chinese: 我绕远一点儿走。水上亮着呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the handle until it hangs comfortably by his leg.
beats.chinese: 他把木柄放低，舒服地垂在腿旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd take it. Probably bring him something to eat when I've made too much. I'd do that anyway.
beats.chinese: 那就收下。哪回做多了，就给他捎口吃的。本来也会捎。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the handle in his pocket and keeps the thumb outside.
beats.chinese: 他把木柄塞进兜，只把大拇指露在外头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Never know when you've made too much till you've sat down.
beats.chinese: 饭有没有做多，得坐到桌边才知道。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: One evening later, Evald spots you on the paved walk with a covered bowl held flat against his stomach.
beats.chinese: 后来一个傍晚，埃瓦尔德在铺装步道上看到你，把扣了盖的碗平托在肚子前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. Made barley enough for two. I was the only one at home. Again.
beats.chinese: 你好。煮了两人份的大麦。家里就我一个，又做多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks his fingers farther beneath the bowl, where the fabric is warm.
beats.chinese: 他把手指往碗底下垫了垫，托着的布还是暖的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm taking this to a friend. If he calls it even I'll bring less next time.
beats.chinese: 给朋友送去。他要敢说这就算还清了，下回我就少送点。

causality.presenceReason: 带旧柄去跟人比配件前在海堤走路

causality.stayingConstraint: 等朋友前可看清手里的物件但不会许人情债
causality.currentGoal: 确认掉漆的工具能认出来还是要拍照
causality.currentState: 懒得记牌名，对邻居把帮忙记账有点不舒服
causality.contactTrigger: 他在石岸上方铺路侧量另一只手掌的宽，看见玩家手空着便伸出自己的柄

reviewEvidence: 2026-11-22 逐人重写 28 处地点的 101 篇双语初遇及重逢，核对人物卡、站位、四路选择和本地口语。
保留既有 99 篇正文及全部身份和地点绑定，照片沿用 2026-11-15 的验收证明。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the end of a table, a woman starts to move her elbow in a slow arc. Her companion puts a napkin over the spot she would have hit.
beats.chinese: 桌头一个女人正要拿胳膊肘慢慢划个弧。同伴拿餐巾盖在她差一点就要碰到的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Not a debate. I heard you.
beats.chinese: 行，不争。我听见了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers her arm and sees you on the other side of the aisle.
beats.chinese: 她收了胳膊，看见过道另一边的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry you got the end of that. I throw sandbags with her. Apparently there's a time and a place to wave your arm near lunch.
beats.chinese: 不好意思，叫你听见半句。我跟她一队扔沙包的。看来胳膊可以抡，但得看什么时候，桌上有饭的时候就算了。

choices.english: Ask what made her try her teammate's throw.
choices.chinese: 问她怎么会开始学搭档那一抛。

choices.english: Leave the debate there. What's for lunch?
choices.chinese: 别说扔法了，中午吃什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mireille sets her forearm flat on the table beside the napkin.
beats.chinese: 米蕾伊把前臂平放到桌上，就搁在餐巾旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It works for her. I got curious. Half a month later my shoulder's still telling me what it thinks.
beats.chinese: 她那么扔还真扔得好，我就想试。都半个月了，这边肩还天天跟我抗议。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stops halfway to repeating the swing.
beats.chinese: 她抡到一半，自己停住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can tell her I want my old throw back. I don't have to tell her hers is wrong.
beats.chinese: 可以直说我还想用原来的扔法。不用把她那套说成错的。

choices.english: Say that to her while she's here.
choices.chinese: 人就在这儿，告诉她吧。

choices.english: Keep your next practice for trying your own way.
choices.chinese: 下回去练，用自己的扔法再试。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves the napkin back to its owner's side of the table.
beats.chinese: 她把餐巾移回同伴那一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sandwich. I'm hungry enough not to tell you how to hold it. She's got an hour off and I've used some of it on my elbow.
beats.chinese: 三明治。饿得都顾不上管你怎么拿了。她就歇一钟头，已经陪我说了半天胳膊肘。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The other woman glances up from the food counter across the aisle.
beats.chinese: 另一个女人朝过道对面的熟食柜看了眼，抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Look, I can change the subject before she has to give me that face again.
beats.chinese: 瞧，我可以先换一个话题，省得她还得再给我那种脸色。

choices.english: Give them a chance to eat.
choices.chinese: 给她们留点空吃饭。

choices.english: Ask her teammate to choose the next subject.
choices.chinese: 让她同伴挑下一个话题。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mireille turns her chair a little towards her companion without moving it into the aisle.
beats.chinese: 米蕾伊把椅子朝同伴转了一点，没挪到过道里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I gave it two weeks. It hurts. I'm switching back.
beats.chinese: 我试了两礼拜，疼。我打算换回去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her companion slides the napkin back towards her without saying anything.
beats.chinese: 同伴把餐巾往她这边又推了推，没讲话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, there's sauce on my sleeve. That had nothing to do with how I throw.
beats.chinese: 哦，袖子上有酱。这个跟我怎么扔可一点关系没有。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts her elbow just enough to tuck the napkin under it.
beats.chinese: 她只抬一点胳膊肘，把餐巾塞到下面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Next time I'll throw like me and see where it lands. I'll give her way a rest.
beats.chinese: 下回按我自己的来，看落哪儿。她的办法先歇歇。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the bread in her hand where it has come apart at the corner.
beats.chinese: 她瞧了眼手里三明治，角上两片面包分开了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My left hand can hold two things at once. It can start with this.
beats.chinese: 我左手还是能一手拿两样的。先从把这两片夹牢开始。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts two napkins side by side and gets her sandwich out of the paper.
beats.chinese: 她并排放好两张纸巾，把三明治从裹纸里拿出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I've got other things to use my mouth for.
beats.chinese: 好啊，我这张嘴还有别的用处。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her companion takes a bite first. Mireille follows and does not speak with her mouth full.
beats.chinese: 同伴先咬了一口，米蕾伊跟着吃了一口，嘴里有东西时没再说话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's better.
beats.chinese: 这下好多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns to her companion and leaves both hands on the table.
beats.chinese: 她转向同伴，两手都留在桌上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Your turn. No sports. Did the man upstairs stop sanding his floor yet?
beats.chinese: 轮到你了。不说比赛。楼上那人地板磨完了没？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her companion opens both hands wide, and Mireille lets out a laugh before the answer starts.
beats.chinese: 同伴两只手一张，还没说话，米蕾伊先笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. Here we go.
beats.chinese: 啊，看来有得说了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later market day, Mireille spots you and turns a palm sized plastic case so you can see the little screen.
beats.chinese: 过了几天，米蕾伊在市场瞧见你，把个巴掌大的塑料小盒转了转，让你看小屏。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. I made a weather station. It's doing a very good job predicting rain inside my bag.
beats.chinese: 嗨。我做了个气象站。包里要下雨，它已经预报得特别准了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She blots a spot on the inside of her bag with an old receipt.
beats.chinese: 她拿张旧小票往包里一小片湿痕上按了按。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Or I left a bottle open. I'm still collecting evidence.
beats.chinese: 也有可能是我水瓶没拧紧。我还在找证据。

causality.presenceReason: 来市场跟比赛搭档碰头，商量吃点东西再走
causality.placeAttitude: 人多的时候适合停住争执
causality.stayingConstraint: 搭档说这一局不争，必须停
causality.currentGoal: 把练半个月但肩不舒服的事说清
causality.currentState: 很想赢回来，也知道朋友有别的烦心
causality.contactTrigger: 争执被叫停，转身对玩家讲害得人家听了半句

causality.reactionAndChange: aa 承认耗了半个月。ab 下回自己改。ba 只吃饭。bb 求对方聊别的
causality.spatialContinuity: 熟食通道边，不丢沙包，不进摊面
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 后来拿自制气象盒，独立于比赛

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Soren sets his tray in the shade at a shared table. The person across from him covers their eyes with one hand.
beats.chinese: 索伦把托盘往共用桌背阴那侧一放。对面的同伴拿一只手遮住眼睛。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I did it again. Got the one seat where you can see your lunch.
beats.chinese: 我又来了。一坐下就挑了个能看清午饭的好位子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He catches your eye on the other side of the table, and moves the tray off the corner.
beats.chinese: 他看见你在桌子另一边，把托盘往里挪，桌角空了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Is it that bright all along that side, or have I found a particularly bad spot for my mate?
beats.chinese: 那一侧整个都这么晃吗？还是我正好给我朋友剩了最差的那个？

choices.english: Look from the bright side before he moves.
choices.chinese: 先从亮的那一侧看看，再挪。

choices.english: Ask his friend what would suit them.
choices.chinese: 问他同伴想坐哪。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Soren comes around his chair and stands where his companion is sitting.
beats.chinese: 索伦绕过椅子，站到同伴坐的那一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh! Straight off the table. I can't read the little receipt from here.
beats.chinese: 哎哟，桌子反上来的。我站这儿，连小票都读不清。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shifts the tray a few inches to see where the reflection goes.
beats.chinese: 他把托盘挪了一小截，看看那片反光跑哪儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It lands on me if we swap. If I turn my tray, it might take the worst off.
beats.chinese: 换个位子就照我。转一下托盘，兴许不至于那么扎眼。

choices.english: Swap seats for this meal.
choices.chinese: 这顿俩人换着坐。

choices.english: Turn the tray until the glare moves.
choices.chinese: 把托盘转到反光偏开。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks over the top of the stack of napkins at his friend.
beats.chinese: 他越过叠着的一沓纸巾，看向同伴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Where do you actually want to sit? I thought I got us both a spot. I got me a spot.
beats.chinese: 你真想坐哪儿？我刚以为给咱俩都挑好了，就给自己挑了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The other person points towards a quieter table. Soren moves his hands off the tray.
beats.chinese: 另一人指向不那么吵的一桌。索伦两手从托盘上拿开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's a good one. I can live without seeing everybody come in.
beats.chinese: 那儿挺好。不看谁进门我也能吃饭。

choices.english: Move to the quieter table together.
choices.chinese: 俩人一起移到安静那桌。

choices.english: Let his friend have the shaded seat here.
choices.chinese: 让他同伴在这桌背阴的那边坐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Soren pulls his chair clear, waits for his friend to stand, then takes the seat across the table.
beats.chinese: 索伦把椅子拉开，等同伴起身，再坐到对面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Okay. Bright. Very bright. I can see the underside of my eyebrows.
beats.chinese: 成。亮，特别亮。我连自己眉毛底下都看见了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He brings the menu card up and sets it on his side like a little wall.
beats.chinese: 他把菜单卡竖到自己这边，当一堵小墙摆好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That'll do. They can have the good corner.
beats.chinese: 这样成。好角落归人家了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rotates the tray until the bright rectangle on his friend's face goes away.
beats.chinese: 他转动托盘，直到同伴脸上那块亮方印消失。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Oh, now it's in my soup. That's a fair place for it.
beats.chinese: 喏，挪开了。现在照我汤里，搁这儿还算公道。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves the soup nearer his chest and goes back to his seat.
beats.chinese: 他把汤往自己胸前端了端，重新坐下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can look up now. Tell me if I do it again.
beats.chinese: 现在能抬头了。我再弄出来，你就告诉我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts both trays in turn so their friend can take the lighter one.
beats.chinese: 索伦分别抬了抬两只托盘，让同伴拿轻的那个。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lead on. I followed the light like it was going to pick my lunch for me.
beats.chinese: 你带路。我刚跟着光走，好像还能让光替我挑午饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He waits for a clear line in the aisle before following his friend.
beats.chinese: 他等过道空出一条线，才跟在同伴身后。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Next one I notice can be what you like about it.
beats.chinese: 下一桌先让我看看，你喜欢的是哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws the shaded chair out a little and moves his tray to the other side.
beats.chinese: 他把阴处的椅子往外拉一点，自己的托盘挪去对面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's yours. I'm not going to spend lunch telling you how selfless I am about it.
beats.chinese: 这归你了。我不会用整顿饭跟你讲，我让得有多无私。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His friend sits and pushes a napkin towards his new side.
beats.chinese: 同伴坐下，往他新的一侧推来一张餐巾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I can stand the light a lot better if my sleeve's clean.
beats.chinese: 谢了。袖子干净一点，我就更忍得住晃眼了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another day at the market, Soren sees you and lifts his tray from a place in the shade.
beats.chinese: 又一天在市场，索伦瞧见你，把托盘从背阴的位置举起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. I like this table. I asked first today. Nobody wants it because they can't hear each other over the cooler.
beats.chinese: 你好，我喜欢这桌。今天先问过了，没人想坐。冷柜那么响，说话听不清。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps his tray up while a shopper sets a glass down at the end.
beats.chinese: 又一位顾客在桌头搁了个杯子，他先把盘子举着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll sit here if I'm on my own. My sandwich hasn't got much to say.
beats.chinese: 我一个人倒可以坐。我的三明治也没什么话要跟我讲。

保留既有 99 篇正文及全部身份和地点绑定，照片沿用 2026-11-15 的验收证明。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya clears a space at the shared table. A crossword page opens itself right over the spot.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅刚在共用桌空出一块，填字纸自己展开，正盖在那儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, sit if you like. This thinks it's got an invitation. My neighbour said any day would be fine.
beats.chinese: 不好意思，你坐吧。这张纸还以为自己已经有人约了。我邻居说，哪天都成。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya lays the pencilled clues flat against the lunch bag.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅把写了铅笔字的那页压在午饭袋边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Any day usually turns out to be the one day neither of us lives in.
beats.chinese: 说哪天都成，最后就会变成，没有这么一天。

choices.english: Ask which day Priya would actually choose.
choices.chinese: 问普丽娅自己真想选哪天。

choices.english: Ask if they feel like doing it alone this time.
choices.chinese: 问这回想不想自己做掉。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya draws a little circle round the clue number.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅在题号周围圈了一个小圈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sunday at lunch. She can do the top half and leave before she says I'm putting in words that don't exist.
beats.chinese: 周日中午。她做上半页，趁着还没开始说我瞎造词就走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya folds the lower half out of sight.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅把下半张折到看不见的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can ask her for a short one. Or I can get one of my own and stop treating that one like it has two signatures.
beats.chinese: 可以就约小半场。要不我换一份自己做，别老把这张当我俩都签了字。

choices.english: Ask her for half a lunch on Sunday.
choices.chinese: 约周日中午半个午休。

choices.english: Save the bottom half for another time.
choices.chinese: 下半页另留下，改天再填。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya keeps the pen horizontal on the table without writing.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅把笔横在桌上，没落字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Not this one. I like her sounding out a clue like it's got a stone in it. I might have liked that more than the puzzle.
beats.chinese: 这张不想。我喜欢听她念题，一字一字拗得像嘴里有颗石头。没准我喜欢那个比喜欢填字还多。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya draws the paper out from under the bag and folds it once.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅把纸从袋底抽出来，折好一回。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's fine if she can't come. I'd rather know that and have my Sunday.
beats.chinese: 她来不了也成。我宁愿知道来不了，好过自己的周日。

choices.english: Let the puzzle wait through this weekend.
choices.chinese: 这周末先不做这题。

choices.english: Ask her for one day she can really make.
choices.chinese: 请她给个真能来的日子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya types out a time and a short question, then pushes send.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅打出时间，再写个短问句，点了发送。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sunday, twelve, twenty minutes. I nearly added or whenever. I held back.
beats.chinese: 周日十二点，二十分钟。我差点又加一句不然随你，忍住了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya pulls the bag off the corner and frees a bit more space at the table.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅把袋子从桌角拖回来，又腾出一片桌面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now I can eat while she thinks about it.
beats.chinese: 这会儿她可以慢慢想，我可以吃饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya separates the page at its old fold and keeps the upper part in hand.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅沿旧折痕把纸分开，上半页留在手上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll take this round later. She can't tell me I've filled her half in if I've put mine in a different pocket.
beats.chinese: 晚一点拿给她。我这半放另一只兜，就不会被说我把她那半给填了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya slips the other part behind the lunch bag.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅把另一半塞到午饭袋后头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could be quite a while before either half has a full answer.
beats.chinese: 两边要全填完，没准都得好一阵子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya puts the page inside a blank folder and closes it.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅把纸放进空文件夹，一下合拢。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I can make plans with the person who is already here. That's me.
beats.chinese: 也好。我可以跟已经到齐的那个人定个安排。是我自己。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya picks up the fork and opens the lunch box.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅拿了叉子，掀开饭盒。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm very sure I'll be here for this.
beats.chinese: 这顿饭我相当有把握，准到。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya writes one line, stops and adds a question at the end.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅打完一句，停了下，又加了个问句。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I miss hearing you read them. Is there a day you can come for one cup? There. She can say no to one cup.
beats.chinese: 有点想听你念题了。哪天能来喝一杯吗？好了。一杯的话，她说不也容易。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya sends it and brings the food back to the middle of the space.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅点了发送，把饭端回面前空出来的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If I get any day again, I'll leave the page in the drawer.
beats.chinese: 回头要还说哪天都成，我就把这页放抽屉里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Several days later at the market, Priya recognises you and holds a puzzle sheet up by a clean corner.
beats.chinese: 又过几天，在市场碰见你，普丽娅拎着没写字的一角举起张题纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. My neighbour and I put down two different words. Neither of us could get the last letter in the box.
beats.chinese: 你好。我跟邻居填了两个不一样的词。最后一个字母，谁都没填得进去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya shows the pencil marks hanging off opposite sides of one square.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅让你看看，同一格旁边，两道铅笔字从不同边写了出去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We stopped and ate. I like the food here better when we're both wrong.
beats.chinese: 我俩就放着，吃东西了。俩人都猜错的时候，这儿的东西吃着还更香。

causality.presenceReason: 来拱棚市场等邻居，带着一份谜题和朋友吃点东西

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Between two trees on Tatlow Walk, a low note begins, wobbles and stops. Bex is looking up at the branches.
beats.chinese: 塔特洛步道两棵树中间，有个低音刚起来就颤一下、断了。贝克丝正抬头瞧树枝。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That was me. I wasn't calling for help.
beats.chinese: 刚才是我。没在喊救命。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tries the same note again at half the volume.
beats.chinese: 她用一半的声音重新试了那个音。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Choir starts right there. I've started right beside it six times today.
beats.chinese: 合唱第一个音就是这个。我今天已经连着六回唱在旁边了。

choices.english: Offer to count her in once.
choices.chinese: 说可以帮她喊一遍起拍。

choices.english: Ask if she always comes to sing here.
choices.chinese: 问她平常也来这儿唱吗。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves one boot a little so it isn't on a root at the edge of the path.
beats.chinese: 她把一只靴子挪了挪，没再踩在路边那截树根上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Three beats. You can put your hand down on three. Don't make a special face if I miss it.
beats.chinese: 三拍。数到三，你手放下来就行。我要没唱准，你别特地给我个什么脸色。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stops between breaths to let the walkers behind you go by.
beats.chinese: 后面有行人，她先没吸下一口气，等人过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Or I'll try it as a hum. I don't lose where I am as often that way.
beats.chinese: 要不就只哼一声。这样没那么容易找不着调。

choices.english: Count three as agreed.
choices.chinese: 照说好的数三拍。

choices.english: Let the first note come out as a hum.
choices.chinese: 让她先把头一个音哼出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps her mouth closed through the next stretch of footsteps.
beats.chinese: 接下来几声脚步，她都一直闭着嘴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I usually go straight home. I didn't want the first noise I heard there to be the work phone today.
beats.chinese: 不啊。平常直接回家。今天不想进门头一个听见的就是单位打来电话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a note out of her coat and keeps it folded.
beats.chinese: 她从外套抽出张纸，没打开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Anyway. I came to sing a little. I might do that better without an audience.
beats.chinese: 先不说了。我是来唱一点的。没观众兴许唱得还好点儿。

choices.english: Respect that and keep the conversation on the song.
choices.chinese: 不追问单位的事，只聊这首歌。

choices.english: Give her a stretch of the path to herself.
choices.chinese: 把这一段路留给她一个人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bex breathes in on the second beat. The note comes out steadier this time.
beats.chinese: 贝克丝第二拍吸气，这回出来的音稳多了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Got it. Don't do another one. I want to get to the door with a one hundred per cent success rate.
beats.chinese: 中了。别再来一回。我要一路保持百分之百的成功率进门。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds her sheet smaller and puts it into an inside pocket.
beats.chinese: 她把纸再叠小些，放到内兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You counted well. Very little else was required.
beats.chinese: 数得好。真不用再干别的了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She hums with her eyes open, looking at the path, and lets the note go when a walker comes up.
beats.chinese: 她睁眼望着步道哼，见有人走近才停下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Not as wobbly. I'll take it. I can sing an actual word at rehearsal.
beats.chinese: 没那么抖了。可以了，真要唱词，排练再唱。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She rubs the cold tip of her nose once with her wrist.
beats.chinese: 她拿手腕蹭了一下冷冰冰的鼻尖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: More fun than I expected. I was having a very good sulk before.
beats.chinese: 比我想的好玩，刚才我还在这儿生闷气呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts the folded sheet a little with one hand, then brings it down again.
beats.chinese: 她一手把折纸提起来一点，又放了回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's an alto part. You don't hear it on its own much. Probably for a reason.
beats.chinese: 是女低音的声部。平常没几回分开听，大概也是有道理的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tucks the paper away, smiling just on one side.
beats.chinese: 她把纸收了，一边嘴角笑了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll do the rest with the other voices. They don't ask where I've been all day.
beats.chinese: 别的等有人一块唱吧。我一天去哪儿了，他们倒从来不问。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She steps between the last two trees beside the path without leaving the path itself.
beats.chinese: 她走到步道旁最后两棵树之间，脚还留在路上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ta. I'll have one more go after that pair's gone through.
beats.chinese: 谢了，等那俩人走过去，我再试一次。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps her eyes on their feet until the steps have faded.
beats.chinese: 她望着那两人的脚，直到脚步声听不见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Or none. I can still go home.
beats.chinese: 或者不试了。我照样能回家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another morning on Tatlow Walk, Bex sees you and turns a small whittled spoon over in her palm.
beats.chinese: 又一个早上，贝克丝在塔特洛步道看见你，拿掌心翻了翻一把手削的小勺。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. The bowl's on a slight angle. My grandad would've called that a left handed spoon and got on with lunch.
beats.chinese: 你好。勺头有点斜。我姥爷准说这是左撇子勺，然后接着吃他的午饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She grips the handle from both sides, trying each thumb in the little hollow.
beats.chinese: 她两边都握了一遍，试着把两手的拇指分别放进那个小凹里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Might make a right handed one and keep them both.
beats.chinese: 还可以削把右撇子的，两把都留着。

causality.presenceReason: 沿 Tatlow Walk 回去，想趁空复习合唱起音
causality.placeAttitude: 树木把外头声隔开，能听见自己的声
causality.stayingConstraint: 今晚离集合还早，不想接工作电话
causality.currentGoal: 把唱不好的第一个音先试一遍
causality.currentState: 在单位忙到有点顶不住，但自己没开口不谈压力
causality.contactTrigger: 哼错一声正撞上脚步，笑了下，告诉玩家刚才不是谁叫
causality.characterContinuity: 薄面子，能接受具体搭手，不吃同情
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 接一次合唱起拍。ab 改成不求准的哼唱。ba 不谈工作。bb 止步让人过，自己转回家

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A walker calls out that nobody should go any farther. He has both feet on the open path and nothing in his hands.
beats.chinese: 一个散步的人喊着叫大伙儿别再往前了。他两脚踩在敞开的路上，两手空空。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Says who?
beats.chinese: 谁说的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odette stays to the side of Tatlow Walk, looking from his face to the trees ahead.
beats.chinese: 奥黛特站在塔特洛步道边，先看他的脸，又看前面的树。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You saw him turn up, didn't you? I thought he was walking the same as us a second ago.
beats.chinese: 你看见他走过来的吧？我刚瞧着，他跟咱俩一样在散步呢。

choices.english: Ask what he actually saw from farther up the path.
choices.chinese: 问他从前面过来，究竟看见了什么。

choices.english: Wait here without arguing.
choices.chinese: 不和他争，先站一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The man shows the place with an open hand. A branch lies along the path's edge.
beats.chinese: 男人摊开手指出地方。路沿躺着截树枝。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, I see the branch. Is that what he meant? I can believe a tree fell over without believing the whole park shut down.
beats.chinese: 啊，枝子看见了。说的就是那个？说树倒了我信，整个公园都关了我可不信。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odette moves one shoe back from the patch of wet ground.
beats.chinese: 奥黛特把一只鞋从一片湿地边退回来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He might have seen something else. I'll let him get to the end of the sentence this time.
beats.chinese: 他兴许还看见别的了。这回我让人把话讲完。

choices.english: Stop if he has a concrete reason to ask.
choices.chinese: 他要说得出具体的事，就等等。

choices.english: Let him describe the problem without calling it a closure.
choices.chinese: 让他把问题说清，先别叫它封路。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odette stills her hand mid gesture. She watches two other people slow down ahead.
beats.chinese: 奥黛特一下停住手势。前面又有两个人放慢脚步，她看着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. There's no medal for being the first one past him. I came to walk, not outvote a man.
beats.chinese: 也行。第一个从他跟前过去又不发奖牌。我来走个路，也不是来压他一票的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps a space open for people moving up behind her.
beats.chinese: 身后还有人上来，她留着一条空隙。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We can go the way we came, or wait while he tells those folks what he knows.
beats.chinese: 可以原路走，也能等他把知道的告诉那几个人。

choices.english: Turn back while there's still room.
choices.chinese: 趁还有地方，原路返回。

choices.english: Let the new walkers hear him out first.
choices.chinese: 先让刚过来的人听他说完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The man points out a wet branch split across the path farther on. Odette stops moving her front foot.
beats.chinese: 男人指出更前面横拦着一道湿树枝，是劈裂的。奥黛特停下正要往前的那只脚。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. You saw that and I didn't. I should've started by asking where.
beats.chinese: 是该等。你看见了，我没有。我刚该先问在哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lets one other walker come level with her before turning back.
beats.chinese: 她等另一个人走到齐肩的位置才转身。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll go the long way home. It'll do my table tennis legs good.
beats.chinese: 我绕远点回去吧。打乒乓那双腿正好还能多动动。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The man walks back a couple of paces and points at the branch again. Odette leaves him a clear view.
beats.chinese: 男人往回走了几步，再指那截枝。奥黛特让开，让他看清。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. So about three feet of branch. That I can check from here.
beats.chinese: 好，差不多三英尺长一截枝子。这从这儿倒能看清。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds both arms and stays at the tree side of the path.
beats.chinese: 她抱起胳膊，仍站在步道靠树这侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. We can each look before we decide.
beats.chinese: 谢了。大伙儿先自己看一眼，再决定。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odette changes direction without looking for another way through the trees.
beats.chinese: 奥黛特调了个方向，没去树之间瞧还有什么路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I won't have to serve dinner fifteen minutes early just because I got home.
beats.chinese: 也成。也不用就因为我先到家，把晚饭提早一刻钟开。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps to the open strip of the path as more people slow down.
beats.chinese: 有人继续放慢，她还是留在步道敞开的那一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll let him keep his audience.
beats.chinese: 观众留给他吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odette waits until the walker has spoken to the next pair. Her mouth moves once, but she doesn't interrupt.
beats.chinese: 奥黛特等着那人把话讲给后来的一对。她嘴动了一下，没打断。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I asked my one question. They heard him. They get to ask theirs if they like.
beats.chinese: 我那一句已经问了。人家也听着了，真想问什么自己会问。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns to you with a small lift of her shoulders.
beats.chinese: 她转向你，轻耸了一下肩。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Want to stand on the other side while they're talking? Somebody still has to get through.
beats.chinese: 他们还说着，咱先站另一边去？后头人还得过呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another afternoon, Odette sees you on Tatlow Walk with a pot lid sticking out of a cloth bag.
beats.chinese: 改天下午，奥黛特在塔特洛步道看见你。她布袋里冒出一只锅盖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. My housemates said they'd do the dishes. I'm not bringing anything home that's hard to wash.
beats.chinese: 嘿，合租的说今天他们洗盘子。我不会带那种不好洗的东西回去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes the lid out and taps the underside, which is perfectly clean.
beats.chinese: 她取出盖子，敲一下反面，干干净净的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can hold up my end of a bargain. I am absolutely going to leave them the big pot, though.
beats.chinese: 说好的事我能做到。不过那口大锅肯定留给他们。

causality.presenceReason: 在公园走一圈等晚饭时间，手中无器材
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢普通散步说几句，只有别人摆专家架势才追问
causality.stayingConstraint: 不用提前回家代洗盘子
causality.currentGoal: 判断人家领读的是确切消息还是口头传来
causality.currentState: 不耐烦对方用肯定句替人安排，没要求她主持
causality.contactTrigger: 另一个人用很肯定的口气喊大家别经过，奥黛特先问出处，随后侧身跟玩家交流
causality.characterContinuity: 只针对先摆专家立场的人，一次后放过，不对没发言的人盘问
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 有依据就接着走。ab 空口就让他自己说明。ba 礼貌离开。bb 不追着理论但留给人确认机会
causality.spatialContinuity: Tatlow Walk 树间步道，没有封锁或改线路
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一天做自家晚饭的碗勺

保留既有 99 篇正文及全部身份和地点绑定，照片沿用 2026-11-15 的验收证明。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald walks a little way behind you on Tatlow Walk. At the next tree he comes level and lowers a small notebook.
beats.chinese: 埃瓦尔德跟在你身后，沿塔特洛步道走了一小段。到了下一棵树旁，他走到齐肩的位置，放低一本小本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Would you mind a question? I'll ask one first and see if you want the other two.
beats.chinese: 方便问一句吗？我先问一个，看看你还愿不愿听后面两个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns down the top of a page with exactly three question marks on it.
beats.chinese: 他把一页纸的顶端折下去。那页不多不少三个问号。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My neighbour says I ask why before I've heard what. I think I may have proved her point before I got here.
beats.chinese: 我邻居说，我还没听清是什么，就开始问为什么。我一路走过来，倒好像已经证明她说得对了。

choices.english: Ask him your own question first.
choices.chinese: 先反问他一句。

choices.english: Say you don't have time for three questions.
choices.chinese: 告诉他自己没时间聊三个问题。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the notebook loosely and looks sideways long enough to hear you.
beats.chinese: 他虚合上本子，侧脸留出时间听你说。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I'd have to answer before I got to the second one. Fair enough.
beats.chinese: 是啊，轮到我答了，也得答完才能问第二句。这很公平。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps the pen clipped to the front instead of taking it off.
beats.chinese: 他手里的笔还是别在封面，没取下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can tell you what I was going to ask. Or I can see if it still seems worth asking at the end of the walk.
beats.chinese: 我可以说刚想问什么。也可以走到头再看看，那话还值不值得问。

choices.english: Ask him why he changed his mind about the questions.
choices.chinese: 问他为什么对那几句改了主意。

choices.english: Let him pick only one before he starts.
choices.chinese: 让他开口前只挑一句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks the pen under the front cover and slows enough to leave space between you.
beats.chinese: 他把笔塞到封面下面，放慢两步，两人拉开一点空。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I usually need a whole walk to answer my own questions.
beats.chinese: 当然。我答自己那些问题，通常也得走一路才答得完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lets one of the walkers behind catch up.
beats.chinese: 他让后头的人先赶上来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can go on. I'll have a word with myself about it first.
beats.chinese: 你可以先走了。我先自己跟自己说说。

choices.english: Continue on without a question.
choices.chinese: 不问什么，接着走。

choices.english: Ask what he might answer if he tries it himself.
choices.chinese: 问他自己答的话，大概怎么说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald watches the foot of a tree go past before he replies.
beats.chinese: 埃瓦尔德看着走过一棵树根底下，才回话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My neighbour asked what I'd planted. I asked how much light she gets. She looked down at the pot for about ten seconds. Then I finally said mint.
beats.chinese: 我邻居问种的什么，我问她家光照多久。她就低头盯着盆看了约十秒钟。我才总算说了薄荷。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slows again and taps the three marks through the paper.
beats.chinese: 他又放慢了些，隔着纸轻敲那三个印。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That didn't feel very good once I heard it back.
beats.chinese: 自己倒过头来一听，也不大舒服。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts a finger over the bottom two question marks.
beats.chinese: 他用一根手指盖住下头两个问号。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: First one, then. Have you seen any light come down through those trees today?
beats.chinese: 那就头一个。你今天看到有光从那几棵树间漏下来过吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Instead of asking why, he lifts his eyes to the canopy and waits.
beats.chinese: 他抬眼看树冠，等着，没接着问为什么。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give you more than a second for that one.
beats.chinese: 这次我肯定给你多过一秒想。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He steps to the edge and turns a page after you have walked on a little way.
beats.chinese: 他让到路边。等你走远一点，才翻过去一页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's all right. A walk's a walk.
beats.chinese: 没事，散步嘛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He leaves the paper open on a blank page and takes a step of his own.
beats.chinese: 他把本子停在空白那一页，自己也迈了一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I won't make a test of it.
beats.chinese: 不非得考个什么出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the folded page but doesn't turn it round to you.
beats.chinese: 他低头看了那张折过的页，没转给你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd answer yes to the first and I don't know to the next two. That took a long time for very little information.
beats.chinese: 第一句我会答有。后两句，不知道。花这么半天，倒也没说出什么来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the fold back up and shuts the notebook.
beats.chinese: 他把折痕抚回去，合上本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd rather have given that last bit of time to the trees.
beats.chinese: 刚才那点时间，我还不如看看树。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Later in the week Evald recognises you on Tatlow Walk. He lowers a drawing with seven circles in it.
beats.chinese: 过几天，埃瓦尔德在塔特洛步道认出你，放低一张画了七个圈的纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I have six pots, with numbers. This is the seventh, growing in a crack in the balcony where I put nothing.
beats.chinese: 你好。我有六盆，编过号。这是第七盆，阳台缝里自己长的。我在那儿什么都没种。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He traces the one circle without a mark inside.
beats.chinese: 他沿着唯一里面没写东西的那个圈描了一道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm leaving that one out of the experiment. It managed without me this far.
beats.chinese: 这个就不拉进试验了。没我，它都活到现在了。

causality.presenceReason: 沿 Tatlow Walk 去和邻居换共同笔记，短时停留
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢树间走到某处正好能想清一件事
causality.stayingConstraint: 邻居迟些才来，不追问路人自家情况
causality.currentGoal: 决定要不要把练过一遍的问句改成只有一句
causality.currentState: 习惯连问三件，察觉问太多肯撤
causality.contactTrigger: 他在旁数没写下的空位，玩家放低脚步时问能不能先借一个意见
causality.characterContinuity: 问了也肯答，不宣扬对方话，不靠问句困住人
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 接受被反问。ab 选一个问题。ba 放过走路的人。bb 不问对方，让他自己试
causality.spatialContinuity: 沿可见公共步道不进入树丛
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 新的一天是阳台盆栽里自己长出来的第七盆

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ainsley tilts a jar by the bridge wall. A purple leaf floats up against the glass.
beats.chinese: 安斯利在桥边矮墙旁侧了侧瓶子。一片紫叶浮起来，贴到玻璃上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can you see a bubble in that? Don't take the jar. I've made the lid worse once already.
beats.chinese: 看得见里头有个泡吗？瓶不用接。我已经把盖越弄越松过一次了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They bring it upright and dry the rim against a cloth.
beats.chinese: 安斯利把瓶扶正，拿布擦干边缘。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I said I'd take this to my sister. That's before I put it in a bag with a perfectly good book.
beats.chinese: 我说好给我妹带去的。说这话时，我还没把它和一本好好的书搁进一个包里。

choices.english: Check whether there is liquid at the rim.
choices.chinese: 看看瓶口有没有水。

choices.english: Suggest keeping the jar closed until they get home.
choices.chinese: 建议先别开，等回家再说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They hold it still enough to show a clear line between the cloth and the lid.
beats.chinese: 安斯利把瓶拿稳，好让你看清布和盖之间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's dry now. The bubble moves when I make it move. I think I spent five minutes solving the bit I'd done myself.
beats.chinese: 现在干了。泡是我一晃才跟着动。我怕是花了五分钟查自己晃出来的事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The leaf slides back below the surface.
beats.chinese: 那片叶又滑回液面下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave it upright or take it home. The book can travel on its own either way.
beats.chinese: 要么竖着带，要么带回家。书反正要另外拿了。

choices.english: Let them carry it upright by itself.
choices.chinese: 让安斯利竖着单拿罐子。

choices.english: Suggest a closer look back at home.
choices.chinese: 建议拿回家细看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They cover the top of the jar with the dry part of the cloth.
beats.chinese: 安斯利把布干的那面盖到瓶顶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aye. My sister likes the cabbage. I don't think she particularly wants it poured into her hallway.
beats.chinese: 也是，我妹爱吃甘蓝。估计不是特别想要浇在她家走廊里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They feel along a seam inside the bag without putting the jar back.
beats.chinese: 安斯利沿着包里一道接缝摸了摸，没把罐放回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got another at home. She's not waiting on this one to eat.
beats.chinese: 我家还有一罐。她又不至于等这个开饭。

choices.english: Put the problem aside and let them continue the walk.
choices.chinese: 先放下这事，让安斯利接着走。

choices.english: Ask if they'd rather take the other jar next time.
choices.chinese: 问下回要不要带另一罐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the book under one arm and wrap the cloth just round the bottom of the jar.
beats.chinese: 安斯利用胳膊夹住书，只拿布裹了罐底。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That keeps it level. I'll take her the jar and let her decide whether she wants a fault report.
beats.chinese: 这样端得平。瓶先给她，想不想听故障报告由她选。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They take two steps, watching to see if the leaf moves again.
beats.chinese: 安斯利走两步，瞧那片叶还动不动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. It's doing less when I do less.
beats.chinese: 瞧。我少折腾，它倒也少动了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They place the jar carefully in an outer pocket with its top showing.
beats.chinese: 安斯利把罐端端正正放进外袋，盖子还露在口上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll set it on a clean page at home. If it leaves a circle, I'd rather see it there.
beats.chinese: 回家我拿张干净纸垫着。要是渗一圈，也比在这儿看出来好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn back along the connected path.
beats.chinese: 安斯利沿连着桥的路掉头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll tell her to put her lunch on first.
beats.chinese: 我叫她先做午饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They keep the jar wrapped and put the book on the other side of the bag.
beats.chinese: 安斯利让瓶仍裹着，把书放到袋子另一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. I came out to see the river as well. Hadn't looked at it yet.
beats.chinese: 也是，我也是来看河的。到现在一眼都没往那儿瞧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn towards the water with both feet on the path.
beats.chinese: 安斯利双脚留在步道上，身子朝向河水。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have a minute here.
beats.chinese: 就在这儿待会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tie the cloth round the jar lid and check the knot without twisting the lid itself.
beats.chinese: 安斯利拿布在瓶盖外绑住，检查结时没去拧盖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll take her the other one. It's beetroot. She can be quite rude about my beetroot.
beats.chinese: 给她换我家另一罐吧。甜菜根的。她说起我腌的甜菜根，可一点儿不客气。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the jar tight against their coat.
beats.chinese: 安斯利把瓶贴着大衣抱好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I might get this one opened after supper. On my own counter.
beats.chinese: 这瓶晚饭后再开吧。在我自己厨房台面上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another day by the bridge, Ainsley recognises you as they slide a bent spoon under a lunchbox clip.
beats.chinese: 后来有天在桥边，安斯利认出了你，正把一把弯勺插进饭盒的卡扣底下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. That's not a broken spoon. I bent it for this.
beats.chinese: 你好。勺没坏，我就为了开这个才把它掰弯的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The clip pops up. They wipe the handle on a sleeve.
beats.chinese: 卡扣啪一声弹起来。安斯利用袖子擦了擦勺柄。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The box is hers. I'll be keeping the spoon.
beats.chinese: 盒归她。勺我还要用。

causality.presenceReason: 拿试腌的紫甘蓝去看妹妹，中途在桥岸看罐盖
causality.placeAttitude: 在河边光下看清玻璃，喜欢不过多解释
causality.stayingConstraint: 晚点要把罐送出去
causality.currentGoal: 判断里面是漏了还是温差
causality.currentState: 手上有工具也不随便开人家的东西
causality.contactTrigger: 罐子朝亮处一倾，避让后请玩家描述泡走向
causality.characterContinuity: 谨慎、慢，工具只在自己手里，不谈健康
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 承认是自己晃出来。ab 拿回家检查。ba 收好不解谜。bb 给妹妹换个完好的罐

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Callum stands where the bridge joins the path, checking a short list on his phone.
beats.chinese: 卡勒姆在桥接上步道的地方，低头看手机上短短一列字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Morning. If I send bridge, ten, do you read that as a question or an order?
beats.chinese: 早。我发桥头，十点，你看是问一句，还是下命令？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He scrolls to another message and laughs out loud.
beats.chinese: 他翻到另一条消息，出了声地笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Our drummer actually wants to meet later. Took him four texts to get to the part where he said later.
beats.chinese: 我们打鼓的那人其实想晚点见。发到第四条，才把晚点两个字说出来。

choices.english: Ask if anybody else is already on their way.
choices.chinese: 问别人有没有已经动身的。

choices.english: Ask whether he would mind a later walk himself.
choices.chinese: 问他自己介不介意晚点走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the phone up to see the time without putting his glasses on.
beats.chinese: 他把手机举高看时间，没忙着戴眼镜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We've got an hour. Nobody's left, unless they've come out to buy bread. That's loads of warning.
beats.chinese: 还有一个钟头。没人出了门吧，除非人家出来买面包。这给得够早了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He makes a new message, leaving the old one visible above it.
beats.chinese: 他新开一条消息，旧的还在上头露着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can put the new time to everybody, or say he's welcome to catch us after.
beats.chinese: 我可以问大家改到那会儿行不行，也可以让他晚一点追上我们。

choices.english: Give everyone time to reply to the new time.
choices.chinese: 提议先把新时间发下去，让几个人回话。

choices.english: Let the friend join later without moving the meeting.
choices.chinese: 原时间照旧，朋友可以晚点加入。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets his phone and leans his head away from a passing pair.
beats.chinese: 他揣起手机，一对人路过，他偏了偏头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've already had my breakfast. Happy enough to walk now. Happy enough to do it later if we're all doing that.
beats.chinese: 我早饭都吃过了。现在走也行。大伙儿要都改晚点，我也能等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks along the path without changing where he's standing.
beats.chinese: 他脚还站在原地，朝步道上看了看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: What I won't do is tell him he didn't mean it. He said it. Grand.
beats.chinese: 我总不会再说他不是那个意思。人家都明说了，挺好。

choices.english: Keep the original meeting unless the others reply.
choices.chinese: 别人没回之前，先按原来约的走。

choices.english: Say he can acknowledge the message without redoing the plan yet.
choices.chinese: 建议先告诉对方看到了，安排不必马上改完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types a new time, then puts still checking on the next line.
beats.chinese: 他打出新时间，又另起一行说先问问。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Nobody moves till they've seen both lines.
beats.chinese: 成了。两行都得看明白，再出门。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the screen off and gives the bridge a good look at last.
beats.chinese: 他关掉屏幕，总算好好瞧了眼这座桥。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We've got a bit before ten. Are you here for the walk or the view?
beats.chinese: 离十点还有会儿，你是专门来走路，还是来看景的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sends his friend a new message outside the group chat.
beats.chinese: 他退出群聊，另给朋友发一句。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take your time. Ring when you're out. We'll say where we've got to by then.
beats.chinese: 你慢慢来。出来了给我打个电话，到时候告诉你我们走到哪儿了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slides the phone into his pocket without touching the group's time.
beats.chinese: 他把手机滑进兜，群里的时间没改。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's two good walks, if he never catches up.
beats.chinese: 他要一直没追上，那也是各自走得舒服。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He leaves the message open but taps no keys.
beats.chinese: 他开着那条消息，没打字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ten as agreed, then. I don't have to put three people on standby because I've got my phone out.
beats.chinese: 那就还是十点。也不能因为我手机拿手上，就让三个人都等我消息。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a step viewwards on the pavement, away from the crossing line.
beats.chinese: 他在人走过去的路线外又走了一步，朝景那头站了站。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll be here when they turn up.
beats.chinese: 他们来了就能在这儿找着我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types with his forefinger and looks up after sending it.
beats.chinese: 他用食指一点点打字，发完就抬了头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Got you. That's what I said. The rest isn't going to expire in the next minute.
beats.chinese: 我回的明白了。别的又不是再过一分钟就作废。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives the river a look and takes the phone out of his hand.
beats.chinese: 他瞧瞧河面，把手机收得手里不剩东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm glad he asked. He used to just stand there looking pained.
beats.chinese: 他肯问挺好的。以前就光站那儿，脸看着都难受。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Days later, Callum greets you by the bridge with one finger holding open a page of a quiz book.
beats.chinese: 隔了几天，卡勒姆在桥边招呼你，用一根手指撑着问答书的一页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Afternoon. That's an island they put in the wrong water. I got it wrong last Thursday for exactly that reason.
beats.chinese: 下午好。有个岛他们给画到另一片水域里去了。上周四我就是为这个答错的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shuts the book on the map and grins.
beats.chinese: 他把地图那页合上，咧嘴一笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They gave the point back. Didn't get the map fixed, but you can't have everything.
beats.chinese: 那一分倒还我了。图没改。也不能什么都想要。

causality.presenceReason: 在桥头等同伴做已约好的运河步行
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢条款早点说，不喜欢到了跟前把所有人往另一头带
causality.stayingConstraint: 下一拨人未到，尚可提前通知
causality.currentGoal: 让带鼓的朋友说真实想去哪
causality.currentState: 一听新主意先高兴，等不及别人绕弯
causality.contactTrigger: 停下来问玩家自己手上的箭头是不是像命令

causality.reactionAndChange: aa 把改动发给所有人。ab 各走各的。ba 守原定汇合。bb 先给朋友回旋，不另猜动机
causality.spatialContinuity: 桥岸公共路，未透露不确定跨岸路径

reviewEvidence: 2026-11-22 逐人重写 28 处地点的 101 篇双语初遇及重逢，核对人物卡、站位、四路选择和本地口语。
