beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sorcha stands at the edge of the stone path holding a very low stool. They move it in against their stomach when you pass.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡在石路边抱了张很低的小凳。见你要走过，便把它往肚子前收了收。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're not doing anything with this space, are you? I've been asked to consult the public about a stool.
beats.chinese: 你不急着用这块地方吧？我受人所托，要就一张凳子征求公众意见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They show one stool leg and a strip of paper folded over it.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡转出一根凳腿，腿上折着条纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My teammate left it at mine. He wrote approved for corridor use on that. I never approved anything.
beats.chinese: 我队友落我家了。他写的，准许放走廊。我可没准过。

choices.english: Ask whether it actually fits in their hallway.
choices.chinese: 问放走廊里到底碍不碍事。

choices.english: Ask if they can keep the path clear first.
choices.chinese: 提醒索尔卡先别把石路占上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They measure the seat against the width of their forearm, keeping it off the paving.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡用前臂比了比凳面宽度，没往路上放。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It fits. So do my knees, unless you want both things there at the same time.
beats.chinese: 放得下。我膝盖也过得去。两样可不能同时过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn the strip of paper over and find a blank side.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡把那条纸翻过来，有一面还没写字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can put an actual measurement on the back. Or put accepted, pending another eleven drawings.
beats.chinese: 背面可以填个真量出来的数。也可以写初步同意，再等十一张图。

choices.english: Give them a practical test they can do at home.
choices.chinese: 建议回家沿走廊走一趟试试。

choices.english: Encourage extending the joke on the back of the label.
choices.chinese: 建议在纸背面顺着队友的话再逗一句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lift the stool with its legs facing in, leaving the paving clear.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡凳腿朝里把凳提高，让石路全空出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. Fair. I brought it here to give it back, not to have the council round about it.
beats.chinese: 是，应该的。我过来就为还张凳，又没打算请市议会开会。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A group comes towards the lawn corner. They wait for the group to pass.
beats.chinese: 一群人往草坪角上过来，索尔卡等着他们都走过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I won't try to make you stop if you're on your way somewhere.
beats.chinese: 好了。你要赶着去哪儿，不用停下来听我说。

choices.english: Go on and leave them to return the stool.
choices.chinese: 继续走，留索尔卡自己去还凳。

choices.english: Point out where it's easier for people with bags to pass.
choices.chinese: 指出提着包的人从哪边经过更宽敞。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the blank strip into a pocket and keep the stool in both hands.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡把那张空白面朝外的纸条揣进兜，两手托好凳子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll borrow it back one evening. Carry the washing past it. If I lose a sock on the way, it fails.
beats.chinese: 找天晚上我再借回去。抱着一盆衣服走一趟。路上掉只袜子就算没通过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lift the stool a few inches to show where a bag would hit it.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡把凳子往上抬一点，示意提着包会撞在哪儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My hallway may be exactly wide enough for my hallway.
beats.chinese: 我家走廊没准就正好够当条走廊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They take out a pen and write on the back of the slip, which is folded flat against the seat.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡摸出支笔，把字写在折平贴在凳面上的纸背面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Seat accepted. Legs under review.
beats.chinese: 凳面准了。凳腿还在审。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put the label back around the leg and hold the stool up for somebody approaching.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡把纸条套回凳腿，人走近时，把凳举了举让对方看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's all here. I haven't hidden the fourth leg.
beats.chinese: 都在呢。我没偷偷藏掉第四条腿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They settle the stool under one arm and take a step down the clear side of the path.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡把凳夹在胳膊下，朝没人挡的那一侧走了一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll take it down to him. If he tries leaving me another one, I'm not taking delivery.
beats.chinese: 我拿过去给他。他要再留个什么给我，我不签收。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They look past you to a figure approaching from the tower and wave with the free hand.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡越过你看向钟楼那边走来的人，空着的手挥了挥。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's him with the bag. Good. He can carry it himself.
beats.chinese: 拎包那个就是。好啊，让他自己拿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They look down the open side of the path and shift the stool a bit higher against their coat.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡朝石路空的一侧看看，又把凳往大衣上托高一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're right. The legs are sticking out farther than I thought.
beats.chinese: 你说得对。凳腿比我以为的伸出来得远。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They wait for two people with bags to pass before moving again.
beats.chinese: 两个提包的人经过，索尔卡等他们走完，才准备动身。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. That's a real answer. I'll keep that one in mind when I get it home again.
beats.chinese: 谢了，你这说的管用。下回再把凳弄回家，我记着这事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a different day, Sorcha spots you near the lawn with a bundle of folded jerseys. One sleeve hangs below the rest.
beats.chinese: 改天，索尔卡抱着一摞叠好的球衣在草坪边看见你。一截袖子从底下垂下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. There are eight in here. I didn't hide the ninth. There genuinely isn't a ninth.
beats.chinese: 你好。这是八件。第九件我没藏。这回是真没有第九件。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They catch the sleeve with two fingers and fold it back up over the top.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡用两根手指夹起袖子，把它抄到最上头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's what happens when you do it once for a joke. You sound like you're lying for the next eight years.
beats.chinese: 就一次开个玩笑。往后八年说实话，别人都觉得你在编。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Under the trees by the Grand Canal, a man snaps a folded card against his palm. The sound carries along the path.
beats.chinese: 都柏林大运河树下，一个男人用折过的硬纸片在掌心一拍。那声响沿步道传出去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. What did that sound like from there?
beats.chinese: 不好意思，你站那儿听，刚才那声像什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He flattens the crease with his thumb, examining it without looking up.
beats.chinese: 他低着头，用拇指把折痕压平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's supposed to be a door, heard through another door. In my friend's kitchen it sounds like somebody hitting a packet of biscuits.
beats.chinese: 我想要的是隔一扇门听见另一扇门关上。在我朋友家厨房，听着跟拍了包饼干似的。

choices.english: Say which part of the sound you heard first.
choices.chinese: 说先听到的那一下是什么样。

choices.english: Ask why he has to get the sound here.
choices.chinese: 问他为什么要来这儿试这声音。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds up the paper like a tiny partition.
beats.chinese: 他把纸立起来，像一堵小隔板。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The slap, right? There's a second click, but I'd have to ask every listener to stand three feet away to get it.
beats.chinese: 是那声啪吧？还有一下咔嗒。可非得让每个听众都站到三英尺外，才听得清。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sets the card over two handwritten lines.
beats.chinese: 他把纸片盖在手写的两行字上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could take one sound out. Or give the actor something to do at the door.
beats.chinese: 可以拿掉一声。也可以给演员在门边添个动作。

choices.english: Ask him to try it with a single sound.
choices.chinese: 请他试试只留一声。

choices.english: Ask what the actor could do instead.
choices.chinese: 问演员在门边还能做点什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gathers the card in close as a walker comes up behind him.
beats.chinese: 后面有人走近，他把纸片往身前一收。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's quieter than my street, usually. Today people keep coming past, like they're entitled to use their own canal or something.
beats.chinese: 平常比我家那条街静。今天倒不停有人走过去，好像这运河也有他们一份儿似的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks down at the two lines again, then glances at your face.
beats.chinese: 他低头又看了眼那两行，才抬眼瞧你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You don't have to guess. I can get out of everybody's way and do another take at home.
beats.chinese: 你不用猜。我可以先别堵着人家，回家再录一次。

choices.english: Give him room to pack up and walk.
choices.chinese: 让出路，留他自己收拾了走。

choices.english: Tell him you'd never have guessed it was a door.
choices.chinese: 直说你根本听不出是门。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the card shut this time and taps it once against his palm.
beats.chinese: 这回他把纸片捏合，只往掌心拍了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. Much closer. I was putting the loud bit on top of the bit I wanted you to hear.
beats.chinese: 啊，这下像多了。我刚把最大的一声盖到真想让人听的那声上了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws one line through a short note without wiping it out entirely.
beats.chinese: 他在一条短注上划了道线，原字还是看得见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll keep the wrong one written down. My friend'll ask what took me all afternoon.
beats.chinese: 错的也留着。我朋友准要问我一下午干什么去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the card into a coat pocket and writes directly underneath the two lines.
beats.chinese: 他把硬纸片揣进外套兜，直接在那两行下面添字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She can try the handle and find it's already locked. Then I don't need anybody to hear the other door at all.
beats.chinese: 可以让她按把手，发现门已经锁上了。那另一扇门的声音根本就不用听见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He reads what he has written, lifts the pencil and crosses the original sound out.
beats.chinese: 他读了遍新添的字，抬起铅笔，把原来的音效划了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The actor'll like that. She wouldn't have to go up against a packet of biscuits.
beats.chinese: 演员准喜欢。总不用跟一包饼干抢戏了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slides the card and the script into the same inside pocket.
beats.chinese: 他把硬纸片和剧本都塞进同一个里兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. The wardrobe at home doesn't go anywhere. I can use that.
beats.chinese: 也是。我家衣柜又跑不了。用那个就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He heads off on the same side of the water and checks the pocket once with his hand.
beats.chinese: 他沿这一侧的岸走了，手又按了下兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm done making that racket here.
beats.chinese: 不在这儿弄那动静了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the card still for a beat and looks along the paths on either side of the water.
beats.chinese: 他把纸片拿稳了片刻，沿运河两岸望了望。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair. I told you what it was meant to be too early. I should play it to somebody who hasn't heard a word about it.
beats.chinese: 也是。我太早跟你说得像什么了。得找一个压根没听过这事的人放给他听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets the card and waits for a space on this bank of the canal.
beats.chinese: 他揣好纸片，等这一侧岸边腾出空当。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No offence if I don't play it a fourth time.
beats.chinese: 第四遍我就不放给你听了，别介意啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A few mornings later, Cian sees you on the canal path and turns off his phone with a short laugh.
beats.chinese: 又过了几天，清早在运河步道上，基安看见你，笑了一下把手机摁灭。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I wrote down a thing I was sure of on Wednesday. Changed my mind by Thursday. I've got both dates right there.
beats.chinese: 你好。我周三记了一条自己肯定没错的事。周四就改口了。俩日期都记在那儿呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slides the phone into his inside pocket and pats it once.
beats.chinese: 他把手机滑进里兜，在外头拍了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to give myself till Friday before I form another opinion.
beats.chinese: 下一个事，我先忍到周五再表态。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beside the canal a woman stops walking and reads a line from her phone. She gets as far as I've decided and pulls a face.
beats.chinese: 运河边，一个女人停下来读手机上的一行字。刚读到我已经决定了，就皱起了脸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's for a woman I play with. Listen to me, like I'm resigning from cabinet.
beats.chinese: 给一块儿打球的朋友。你听我这腔，跟要从内阁辞职似的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She rolls the phone once between her hands.
beats.chinese: 她把手机在两手间翻了个面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The taster's over. She wants to do the next class. I want my Tuesdays back and maybe a game if it's dry.
beats.chinese: 体验课上完了。她想接着上。我想把周二拿回来，天晴的话也许还能打打球。

choices.english: Ask whether they'd still play together without the class.
choices.chinese: 问不上课了，两个人还能不能一起打。

choices.english: Ask if she actually wants to give up Tuesdays.
choices.chinese: 问她自己是不是真舍得把周二交出去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She wipes a spot off the screen with the heel of her hand.
beats.chinese: 她用手掌根抹了下屏幕上的一点印子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We could. We both have a bat. She's miles better already, and I can make her laugh hard enough to miss.
beats.chinese: 能啊，拍子都有。她已经比我强一大截了。我倒能把她逗得漏球。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks down the path and steps closer to the trees.
beats.chinese: 她沿路看了看，往树这一侧站了站。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd love to ask. I don't want it to sound as if I'm asking her not to go on.
beats.chinese: 我当然想约。就怕听着像不许她接着上。

choices.english: Suggest inviting the friend to one game with no strings.
choices.chinese: 建议单约一场球，不搭上课的事。

choices.english: Suggest saying each can keep the part she likes.
choices.chinese: 建议直接说她俩各玩自己喜欢的那部分。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the phone face down on her palm.
beats.chinese: 她把手机扣在手心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I can spend Tuesday blowing three bad notes on the harmonica. Just don't give me a fourth one for homework.
beats.chinese: 不想。我周二可以在家用口琴吹三个破音。就别给我留第四个音当作业了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stops smiling for a second and looks down at the water.
beats.chinese: 她有那么一下没笑，低头看着水。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's nice. I'm going to miss her. That's all I've actually got to say, isn't it?
beats.chinese: 她人挺好。我会想她。我要说的其实就这个吧？

choices.english: Let her leave the class without explaining why.
choices.chinese: 让她不报就不报，不用给个原因。

choices.english: Ask if she could simply tell her friend she'll miss her.
choices.chinese: 问她能不能单说一句，以后少见面会想她。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She deletes the first line and types a day and a question mark.
beats.chinese: 她删了第一行，只打了个日子，加个问号。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Saturday, if it stays dry? That's an invitation. Look how short they are when you don't write a speech first.
beats.chinese: 周六，天不下雨就来？这不就约上了。前头不写稿子，能省这么多字呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sends it and slides the phone into her sleeve until it reaches her hand.
beats.chinese: 她点了发送，让手机沿袖口滑到手边，再抓牢。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I hope she brings the good bat. I want to borrow it when she's not looking.
beats.chinese: 但愿她带那把好的。我想等她没看见的时候偷借一下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She jams a thumb against the space bar, deletes a long line and starts over.
beats.chinese: 她的拇指在空格上按了按，删掉一长行，从头来过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tell me how it goes. I wrote that. I actually want to know. I don't want a place in the class.
beats.chinese: 上得怎么样跟我说一声。我写这个。是真想听，就不想给我也报个名。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She presses send and turns to take a step farther along the bank.
beats.chinese: 她发完消息，转身沿岸边走了一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We can meet out of spite next time there's a rain day.
beats.chinese: 下回偏赶上下雨，我俩还要见一面，气死那个天。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the phone away without opening the sign up form again.
beats.chinese: 她没再点进报名表，就把手机收了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Grand. I don't ask her to give up her course. She doesn't need my Tuesday either.
beats.chinese: 行。我不劝她放弃那课。她也不缺我一个周二。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a breath, looks up through the trees and starts moving.
beats.chinese: 她吸了口气，透过树枝往上瞧了眼，迈开步子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I might go home and blow the three notes now. Apologies to my floor.
beats.chinese: 我可能这就回家吹那三个音。先给楼下赔个不是。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes the phone back out and holds down the voice button.
beats.chinese: 她又把手机拿出来，按住语音键。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll miss you on Tuesdays. I'm not paying for another class to see you. What're you doing Friday?
beats.chinese: 以后周二见不着你了，我还挺想你的。可我不想交下一期学费才见着你。周五有事吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sends the message before playing it back. She raises her head and presses her lips together.
beats.chinese: 她没听回放就发了出去。她抬起头，抿了抿嘴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah well. She knows my voice. She'll know I meant it.
beats.chinese: 算啦。她听得出来，我是真这么想。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another day, Deirdre spots you by the canal with a little harmonica resting across her knuckles.
beats.chinese: 隔天，迪尔德丽在运河边瞧见了你。她手指节上横托着一把小口琴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. I can do the first note of that tune my sister likes. Imagine the pleasure of hearing only that much.
beats.chinese: 嗨。我会吹我姐喜欢的那曲子的头一个音了。你想想，只听到这儿得多高兴啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the harmonica into a cloth sleeve and pats it flat.
beats.chinese: 她把琴装进布套，拿手拍了拍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm leaving it there. She can hum the rest herself.
beats.chinese: 我见好就收。剩下的她自己哼吧。

causality.presenceReason: 来步道走过一段再回家，能当面找练球朋友说清
causality.placeAttitude: 树下像自己暂时不必达标的空当
causality.stayingConstraint: 朋友要等，但报名今天就得定
causality.currentGoal: 拒绝交钱上后续级别，又不伤一块玩的朋友
causality.currentState: 说得快，听见人劝上进就不想笑了
causality.contactTrigger: 她看着退报名的页面发出声，跟经过的人借一句听听自然不自然
causality.characterContinuity: 工作计时严，爱好不考级，不拿自己的休闲方式教训别人
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 送一声邀请去玩。ab 分开各玩。ba 确认不用报。bb 意识到想见朋友而不是想上课
causality.spatialContinuity: 同岸铺路上，不打球不跨运河
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 后日吹口琴没有假定认识她的朋友

reviewEvidence: 2026-11-22 逐人重写 28 处地点的 101 篇双语初遇及重逢，核对人物卡、站位、四路选择和本地口语。
保留既有 99 篇正文及全部身份和地点绑定，照片沿用 2026-11-15 的验收证明。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the canal path, Robin holds up a piece of paper with two blotches printed on it. A loose leaf rests inside the fold.
beats.chinese: 运河步道上，罗宾举着一张纸，上头印了两团斑。折缝里夹着一片散叶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Does that look like a rabbit to you? Don't worry. It's not a picture somebody's child made.
beats.chinese: 你看像兔子吗？甭担心，这不是谁家孩子画的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn the paper sideways. The leaf slides against their finger.
beats.chinese: 罗宾把纸横过来。那片叶子滑到了手指边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It came off that. My friend said rabbit. I said a dog getting out of a bath. They'd like me to stop asking now.
beats.chinese: 这片叶子印的。我朋友说是兔子，我说是条从水盆里往外爬的狗。那人现在叫我别再问了。

choices.english: Have a look and say what you see in it.
choices.chinese: 端详一下，说你看出像什么。

choices.english: Ask why it matters which animal it is.
choices.chinese: 问是哪个动物有什么要紧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin looks at the two blotches from your side of the paper.
beats.chinese: 罗宾跟你从纸的同一侧看那两团斑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. We might not even be looking at the same end. I'd make a poor witness. I'd already decided which legs were wet.
beats.chinese: 也是。咱俩看的也许都不是同一头。换我做证肯定不行，我连哪几条腿是湿的都定好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They pull a second scrap from the fold, printed in lighter ink.
beats.chinese: 罗宾从夹层里又抽了张纸片，上面的墨淡些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got another print that came out cleaner. Do you want another look, or have you had your fill of it?
beats.chinese: 还有张印得清楚点。想再瞧一眼，还是已经看够了？

choices.english: Compare the marks on both bits of paper.
choices.chinese: 把两张纸上印的东西比着看看。

choices.english: Leave one vote and skip the second print.
choices.chinese: 只说这一眼的看法，第二张就不看了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin holds the paper still instead of tilting it again.
beats.chinese: 罗宾拿稳那张纸，没再来回转。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It doesn't. That's the part my friend could get their head round and I couldn't.
beats.chinese: 不重要。我朋友明白的就是这一点。我偏没转过弯来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They look down where the wind has pushed a little heap of leaves against the path.
beats.chinese: 风把一点落叶卷到路旁，罗宾低头看着那一小堆。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came for another leaf. I promised I wouldn't send another picture of this one.
beats.chinese: 我是来捡另一片的。答应人家这张不再拍去烦了。

choices.english: Take them at their word and leave the picture alone.
choices.chinese: 就按说好的，不接着说这幅图。

choices.english: Look at the fallen leaves instead.
choices.chinese: 改看地上的落叶。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin lines up the two sheets by one edge. The fainter print shows an extra little mark beside the larger one.
beats.chinese: 罗宾把两张纸的一边对齐。印得淡的那张，大斑旁边多出一个小点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, that's ink from my thumb. That's where I was getting the front leg. I'd better take the dog back.
beats.chinese: 噢，那是我拇指上的墨。我还把它当条前腿。那条狗我收回吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They fold the lighter sheet over the dark one and let the original leaf sit loose.
beats.chinese: 罗宾把浅色那张叠到深色那张上，原来那片叶子松松地夹在里面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It doesn't have to be a rabbit now. It's definitely not getting out of a bath.
beats.chinese: 倒也不用非是兔子。反正不是从澡盆里出来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin writes a small question mark in a notebook and closes it before you see what else is there.
beats.chinese: 罗宾在本上写了个小问号，趁你还没看见别的就合起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's your vote. It's allowed to be a question mark.
beats.chinese: 这就当你这一票。可以投问号。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the lighter print out of sight behind the darker one.
beats.chinese: 罗宾把印得淡的那张往另一张背后一藏。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll want to ask again tomorrow. Remind me not to, if I'm stupid enough to try it on you.
beats.chinese: 明天我还想问的。我要真傻到再来问你，记得叫我打住。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin folds the paper with the print on the inside and puts it in a coat pocket.
beats.chinese: 罗宾把纸折好，印子朝里，放进外套兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Leave it. It's been a long week for the rabbit.
beats.chinese: 算啦。那兔子这礼拜也够累的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They keep to the path and move far enough for another walker to come through.
beats.chinese: 罗宾没离开步道，只往边上打了个身，让后面一个人过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to pick great big plain leaves now.
beats.chinese: 接下来我挑长得普普通通的大叶子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin crouches at the path edge and turns one fallen leaf over by the stem.
beats.chinese: 罗宾在路边蹲下来，捏着梗把一片落叶翻了个面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here's a good one. Hole right through it. No creature will come of that unless I get very bored.
beats.chinese: 这片好。破了个穿过去的洞。除非我实在太闲，不然印不出什么活物来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They slip it into an empty bit of the paper fold without taking out the phone.
beats.chinese: 罗宾把它塞进纸缝空着的一截，也没往出拿手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll see what comes out. I won't be canvassing the neighbourhood.
beats.chinese: 回家看看印出来什么样。这回不挨家挨户问了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another morning, Robin recognizes you along the canal with a pale leaf held by its stem.
beats.chinese: 改天早上，罗宾在运河边认出了你，手里拿着片颜色浅的叶子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I brought this all the way home yesterday and found something I'd rather not ink on the back of it.
beats.chinese: 你好。昨天我一路把它拿回家，翻过来才发现，背面有样东西我可不想沾一身墨。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn it over. A thin empty snail shell sits against a crumpled edge.
beats.chinese: 罗宾把叶子翻过来。皱起来的边上卡着一枚薄薄的空蜗牛壳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I had a bit of paper ready. Some things I can just look at.
beats.chinese: 纸我都备好了。算了，有的东西看看就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife has stopped on roller skates under a tree by the canal. A stiff card rests across one wrist.
beats.chinese: 运河旁树荫下，艾芙穿着轮滑鞋站定。一张硬卡片搭在手腕上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can you get past? Good. Can you see any shine on the bottom of this, while you're there?
beats.chinese: 能过去吗？那好。你站那儿顺便看看，这底下还反不反光？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She angles the card. The palm of her other hand covers the top half.
beats.chinese: 她把卡片斜过来，另一只手用掌心盖住上半截。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The bit you can see is finished. I'm trying to find out if it's dry before I put it away.
beats.chinese: 露出来这部分写好了。我想看看墨干没干，好收起来。

choices.english: Look only at the finished part.
choices.chinese: 只看已经写好的部分。

choices.english: Ask if she wants to wait instead of putting it away.
choices.chinese: 问她要不要再晾一会儿才收。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the card as still as she can. One of her wheels moves an inch, then stops.
beats.chinese: 她尽量拿稳卡片。一个轮子往前移了一小截，又停下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. The curve's still shining where I went over it again. I'd rather see it smudge on a test card than on the proper one.
beats.chinese: 对。我补写那一弯还亮着。宁可在试的这张上糊，也别糊在正式那一张。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a loose sheet of paper out from behind the card.
beats.chinese: 她从硬卡背后抽出一张散纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That could keep it off the rest of the packet. There's one stroke I'd like to try again when I've got a desk.
beats.chinese: 可以靠它跟别的纸隔开。还有一笔，等回去有桌子了我想再试。

choices.english: Ask her to use the divider and leave the stroke as it is for now.
choices.chinese: 请她用纸隔开，先别再动那一笔。

choices.english: Ask which stroke she'd like to redo.
choices.chinese: 问她想重写的是哪一笔。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She straightens a knee and checks how far the shadow of the tree falls across the path.
beats.chinese: 她撑直一边膝盖，看树影一直落到步道哪儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I have a few minutes. I took it out because I liked it better than I expected to. Then I started looking for things wrong with it.
beats.chinese: 还有几分钟。我是觉得写得比我想的好，才拿出来。结果一拿出来，又开始挑毛病了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A phone across the path comes up at face height and she turns the card towards her coat.
beats.chinese: 步道另一侧有人把手机举到脸那么高。她转了转硬卡，朝着自己大衣。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't want a picture going anywhere till I've decided what I'm showing.
beats.chinese: 我没决定给人看哪一部分之前，不希望有图传出去。

choices.english: Tell her she doesn't need to show anyone the whole sheet.
choices.chinese: 说没有必要给谁看整张。

choices.english: Offer to make room for her to skate on.
choices.chinese: 把路让开，方便她接着滑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the loose paper to make a raised edge and slips it alongside the ink.
beats.chinese: 她把散纸折出一条翘起来的边，从有墨的地方旁边塞进去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. It won't touch. And I won't take it out to look while I'm moving. I've done that once.
beats.chinese: 行，这样碰不上。我也不会滑起来又抽出来看。那种事干过一回了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the packet vertically by the unmarked margin, tucked close against her side.
beats.chinese: 她拿住没字的纸边，把纸竖着贴到身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait till I'm home. Then I can decide if I still like it.
beats.chinese: 等到家再看。到时候再说还喜不喜欢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves the covering hand only a little and touches the blank margin with a nail.
beats.chinese: 她盖着卡片的手只挪了一点，用指甲碰了碰无字的边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. The end is thicker than the next one. I'll mark the back. No point putting ink on ink here.
beats.chinese: 喏，末尾比下一笔粗。我背面记一下就好。在这儿拿墨盖墨没意思。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the card with the ink facing her and taps the spot on the reverse.
beats.chinese: 她转了下字卡，把字朝自己，从背面点了点那一处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for looking at the bit I meant. That helped.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你只看了我指的那一块。这下心里有数了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts the top card as far as her chest and keeps the rest behind it.
beats.chinese: 她把最上面那张提到胸前，剩下的都挡在背后。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I've one line here I'm happy with. That's enough to take out with me.
beats.chinese: 不用。现在有一行我自己看着舒服。带出来给人看看也够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances at that line once more, then lets the whole packet sit closed between her hands.
beats.chinese: 她又瞟了眼那一行，让纸整叠合在两手间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I used to say it was nothing. That took three evenings.
beats.chinese: 以前我准说没什么。可这花了我三个晚上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She waits for two walkers to clear the path before sliding the card between the papers.
beats.chinese: 她等两个行人把路走空，才把硬卡滑进纸页间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Stand there a second, if you don't mind. My first push always goes farther than I think.
beats.chinese: 谢了。方便的话你在那儿停一下。我头一下蹬出去，总比自己想得远。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pushes off along the tree side of the path. Her second glide is shorter.
beats.chinese: 她从树这一侧蹬了出去。第二下滑得短些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There we go. I've got it now.
beats.chinese: 哎，成了。我站得住了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A later Sunday by the canal, Aoife recognizes you as she holds a damp envelope away from her coat.
beats.chinese: 后来一个周日，艾芙在运河边认出了你。她拿着一只湿信封，尽量不蹭着大衣。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I wrote today's date on this three times. First two were lovely. Wrong month.
beats.chinese: 你好。今天的日期我写了三遍。头两遍可漂亮了，月份写错了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tilts the envelope and watches one bead of water slip off the corner.
beats.chinese: 她把封口斜过去，看一颗水珠从角上滑下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one's right. The rain can have the flourish.
beats.chinese: 这遍是对的。花笔先让雨水带走吧。

causality.presenceReason: 穿滑轮在尚宽松的时段沿湖停下看字样
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢在室外一站才看清墨色，走累了可以就此停
causality.stayingConstraint: 练完之后要收稿，随时能离开
causality.currentGoal: 检验一张还没干透的字卡，把未成篇和已完稿分开
causality.currentState: 对东西没做完就要对外展示有点戒备
causality.contactTrigger: 她站稳，问过玩家有没有挡路，再请对方看光下成品边缘
causality.characterContinuity: 手工进度自己定，不让人随便拍，听见具体意见会接
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 给成稿加垫。ab 给未成一处记号，留待回家。ba 拒拍但承认自己做得不错。bb 保持距离后继续滑
causality.spatialContinuity: 运河同岸步道，停稳后拿纸，未走近水侧

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Light comes through the arcade roof. A man folds a newspaper twice to make room as you pass a shop front.
beats.chinese: 日光从拱廊的玻璃顶照下来。你经过一家店门口，一个男人连折两下报纸，给你让了点空。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. It takes up more room than I do when it's open.
beats.chinese: 不好意思。这报一摊开，比我占地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He starts to open it again, then sees a message on his phone.
beats.chinese: 他刚要再摊开，瞧见手机来了条消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My friend says we need a proper morning. Last time I read this while he fixed a reel. I thought that was a proper morning.
beats.chinese: 我朋友说，咱得好好过个早上。上回我读报，他修钓鱼轮。我觉得那早上已经挺好了呀。

choices.english: Ask if his friend might want to talk this time.
choices.chinese: 问他朋友这回是不是有话想说。

choices.english: Ask whether he wants to finish the paper first.
choices.chinese: 问他想不想先把报看完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He squares the pages against his forearm, still standing out of the flow.
beats.chinese: 他人在过道边，用前臂把报纸的毛边磕齐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Might do. He uses a lot of words when he wants to say one. Take him all morning to get to it sometimes.
beats.chinese: 也许吧。他有一句想说的，前头能垫一大堆。有时候一上午才说到那一句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He brings up the message and holds the paper steady under one arm.
beats.chinese: 他点开消息，胳膊底下把报纸牢牢夹住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could ask. Or I could leave him to say where he wants to go first.
beats.chinese: 我可以问问。也可以先让他说打算去哪儿。

choices.english: Suggest asking if he's coming to talk.
choices.chinese: 提议直接问问他想不想说说话。

choices.english: Suggest letting the friend pick where to meet.
choices.chinese: 提议让朋友先挑地方碰面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks at the bit of the front page that remains visible.
beats.chinese: 他低头瞧了瞧头版还露着的那一截。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd like ten minutes. I don't mind if he gets here first, though. I can put it away.
beats.chinese: 我想看十分钟。他先到了也没什么，可以把报收起来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Footsteps cross the tiles in front of the next shop. He draws in his elbow.
beats.chinese: 下一家店跟前有几声脚步走过。他把胳膊往里收了收。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can wait till he turns up. It's his mouth. He'll open it when he's ready.
beats.chinese: 可以等人来了再说。他的嘴嘛，想好了自然会张。

choices.english: Leave the matter there and let him wait.
choices.chinese: 不接着猜，让他自己等。

choices.english: Suggest reading a little until his friend arrives.
choices.chinese: 提议人在来之前先看一点报。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gets the phone to his ear. The paper stays folded tight now.
beats.chinese: 他把手机贴到耳边。报纸这会儿夹得紧紧的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Are you after a chat? Yeah. No, the paper can come home with me.
beats.chinese: 想找我说说话？嗯。没事，报纸我能带回家看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He listens for a while and then ends the call without saying much more.
beats.chinese: 他听了一阵，没再多讲什么，挂了电话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He was trying to ask that since Wednesday. I'd have said yes on Wednesday.
beats.chinese: 从周三就想问我了。周三问我，我也会说行啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types a short question using the paper as a rest for his wrist.
beats.chinese: 他垫着报纸的边，用手机打了句短话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You pick, I said. If we end up walking, I'll probably get told on the way.
beats.chinese: 我说你挑。要是约到一块儿走走，他准会在路上告诉我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A reply flashes on his phone. He grips the newspaper under his arm and gets ready to go.
beats.chinese: 手机上亮了一条回复。他把报夹紧，准备走了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Grand. I'll keep my hands warm on the way over. That suits me.
beats.chinese: 行。走过去还能暖暖手，挺好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the phone in his pocket and leaves the newspaper folded.
beats.chinese: 他把手机放进兜，报纸还叠着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I'll just say morning when I see him. We'll get past that in our own time.
beats.chinese: 也是。见面先说声早。往下聊什么，我俩自己慢慢来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes one step towards the shop side to clear the passage.
beats.chinese: 他朝店面那一侧再让了一步，把过道空出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go on through. He knows where I said I'd be.
beats.chinese: 你过去吧。他知道我说在哪儿等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens just the inner pages, making a narrow rectangle of the newspaper.
beats.chinese: 他只翻开里头两页，把报折成长长窄窄的一条。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll read this. It can wait at the fold when he's ready.
beats.chinese: 我先看这篇。人一来，就折在读到的地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His eyes move down the column. He holds a page down with the side of a thumb.
beats.chinese: 他沿着那栏往下看，用拇指侧面摁住一页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, it's yesterday's. Still happened, I suppose.
beats.chinese: 噢，昨天的。事倒反正已经出了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: One Saturday later, Ruairi sees you under the arcade's glass roof with half a newspaper rolled into a tube.
beats.chinese: 后来一个周六，鲁艾里在拱廊玻璃顶下面看见你，手里半份报卷成了筒。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. Gave a friend the other half. He said he could still hear me turning the pages.
beats.chinese: 嗨。另一半给我朋友了。他说还是听得见我翻报纸。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He loosens the roll and looks at the torn edge where it separates from the other half.
beats.chinese: 他把卷松开，瞧了瞧跟另一半分开的毛边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He'll live. I've listened to him untangle a fishing line for forty minutes.
beats.chinese: 没事，他受得了。我还听过他解钓鱼线，解了四十分钟呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Peadar stands clear of the stalls with a twisted length of cord lying across his fingers.
beats.chinese: 皮达尔在离摊面一步的地方站着，一截拧过的细绳横在手指上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Would you call that one knot? Don't ask the woman who sells it. I asked her twice already.
beats.chinese: 这算一个结吗？别去问摊主。我已经问过人家两回了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He brings two loose ends towards each other without letting go.
beats.chinese: 他把两只松散的绳头往一起靠，手没松。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I said two, on account of the ends. She says I've counted a knot and its shadow.
beats.chinese: 我说是两个，你看有俩头。人家说我把一个结和它的影都数进去了。

choices.english: Check which ends belong to the same piece of cord.
choices.chinese: 看看两个头是不是同一根绳上出来的。

choices.english: Ask whether it matters if there's one or two.
choices.chinese: 问一个还是两个有什么要紧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He thumbs the cord flat. One part pulls a little against the other.
beats.chinese: 他用拇指把绳压平，一截微微牵动了另一截。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, that's the same bit coming round again. I suppose this end could be tucked in and nobody would count it.
beats.chinese: 噢，这是同一段又绕回来了。把这一头塞进去，估计就没人会数上它。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the cord in his palm instead of tugging on it.
beats.chinese: 他只把绳托在掌心，没用手拉。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd like to hear myself say she was right. Or I could tie my own and find out first.
beats.chinese: 我倒想听听我自己承认人家说对了。要不先拿自己的打一个看看。

choices.english: Encourage him to concede it himself.
choices.chinese: 让他自己去认个输。

choices.english: Ask him to try it later on his own cord.
choices.chinese: 建议改天拿自家的绳试一个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns one end around his finger and lets it go.
beats.chinese: 他把一头绕到指头上，又放下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, it matters if I'm paying by the knot. I'm not. I'm paying for the cord.
beats.chinese: 哎，要是按结收钱，那就重要。又不是。卖的是绳。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves a pace out of the way of two shoppers looking in at the stall.
beats.chinese: 两个顾客朝摊里看，他往外让开一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm not cross. Does it look as though I'm cross? I sometimes look that way when I'm having a lovely time.
beats.chinese: 我没生气。看起来像吗？我有时候玩得可开心了，脸上也那样。

choices.english: Tell him he can keep the joke if he drops the count.
choices.chinese: 跟他说，玩笑照开，几个结就别数了。

choices.english: Let him take the cord and think it over another day.
choices.chinese: 让他先拿着绳走，改天再想。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He flattens the two ends once more and turns back to the stall.
beats.chinese: 他又压平两头，转回摊子那边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're right about the knot. I had to have a good look at the shadow, though.
beats.chinese: 结你说对了。可它那个影，我总得看明白了吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The stallholder turns her hand over once. He stands aside with a quick grin.
beats.chinese: 摊主翻了翻手掌。他飞快咧嘴一笑，让到旁边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Don't ask me what she meant by that. I'll only start on the hand now.
beats.chinese: 你别问我人家那手什么意思。不然我又该去琢磨她的手了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the cord into a coil that fits in his palm.
beats.chinese: 他把绳绕成小小一捆，收进掌心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll use two colours at home. Then I can see which one I've decided isn't really there.
beats.chinese: 我回去用两种颜色打。到时候就看得出，我把哪一根说没了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gathers the knot into a pocket without altering it.
beats.chinese: 他没动那个结，直接揣进兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have to admit it if the same thing comes out. That's between me and the cord.
beats.chinese: 打出来一样，我就得承认。这事先算我跟绳子说好的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks from one end of the cord to the other and lowers both hands.
beats.chinese: 他从一个绳头看到另一个，两手一块儿放了下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're right. That's a bit of a rotten question. All I really wanted was to untie it.
beats.chinese: 你说得对，问得挺烂的。我其实就想把它拆了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts his chin towards the stall and puts the cord away.
beats.chinese: 他朝摊子那儿抬抬下巴，收好细绳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll buy a straight one as well. Can't be too careful with a thing that already works.
beats.chinese: 我再挑根直的吧。心里有点数，别把本来好好的也折腾坏了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips the cord into a pocket and steps out of the unbroken line of shoppers.
beats.chinese: 他把绳揣兜，从不断经过的顾客旁边退开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. I've had plenty of time here. I'll see if I even care about it tomorrow.
beats.chinese: 行。在这儿看得可够久的。看我明天还想不想得起来吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gets as far as the next shop before glancing back.
beats.chinese: 他走到下一家店门口，才回头了一次。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I might. No need to tell her that now.
beats.chinese: 也没准还想。先不用告诉人家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another day in the arcade, Peadar recognises you and unfolds a little list from his shirt pocket.
beats.chinese: 又一天在拱廊里，皮达尔认出了你，从衬衫口袋里摸出一张小单子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. Three old film scores I'd like to hear again. I put the films in brackets because I couldn't tell the composers apart.
beats.chinese: 嗨。三部老片的配乐，我想再听听。片名写括号里了，光看作曲的人我分不清。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He runs a finger down the list, stopping at the only empty pair of brackets.
beats.chinese: 他的指头沿单子往下，到唯一一对空括号那儿停住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now I've forgotten the film as well. Still humming the blasted thing.
beats.chinese: 现在连片子也忘了。就那破曲子还在脑子里哼着。

causality.placeAttitude: 爱和人来回抬两句杠，过道挤的时候也让开

causality.currentGoal: 弄清两家在争什么再认输
causality.currentState: 开始只想闹着玩，被人当成真要挑毛病也会尴尬
causality.contactTrigger: 手里的绳头数着数着卡住，问旁边的人

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Fionnuala stands off the centre of the arcade, holding the lining of a bag out through a gap at its seam.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉让开拱廊中间，把袋子的里布从开线口翻了一点出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can you see daylight through that? It's mine. I turn people's bags inside out for them only by appointment.
beats.chinese: 透光吗？这是我自己的。别人的包，我可得先约好才给人翻个底朝天。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn the opening towards the glass roof until one thin patch lights up.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉把口子转向玻璃顶，有一小块薄的地方透出亮。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I made it out of a curtain. I like how it sits now. I'd rather not make another whole bag for a hole this size.
beats.chinese: 原来拿窗帘改的。这包现在挎着正舒服。我可不想为这么大一点洞，从头再做一个。

choices.english: Ask what they'd want to keep if they changed the lining.
choices.chinese: 问换里子的话，哪些地方还想照旧。

choices.english: Ask if the outer bag needs any changes at all.
choices.chinese: 问外面这一层是不是完全可以不动。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put a thumb against the corner where a seam doubles back.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉拇指按在接缝转回去的一个角上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This bit. It's got the fold from the bottom of the curtain. It's the only bit that still looks like the old thing.
beats.chinese: 这儿。留着窗帘下摆原先那道折。也就这块还能瞧出原来是什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They take a small swatch from a pocket and hold it alongside the hole.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉从兜里拿出一块小布样，对在洞旁边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can set something behind it, or I can just close the tear. It doesn't have to disappear.
beats.chinese: 可以在底下衬一块，也可以把口子缝上。本来也不用缝得看不出来。

choices.english: Compare their swatch with the old fabric.
choices.chinese: 拿带来的布样跟旧布比一比。

choices.english: Suggest closing only the tear and leaving the rest alone.
choices.chinese: 提议只把破口缝上，别的不动。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They let the lining fall back inside and put the strap on one shoulder.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉放开里布，让它落回袋子里，带子挂到了肩上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't think so. My brother wouldn't touch the ones we grew up with. I used to think he was daft about it. Now I've got this.
beats.chinese: 我看不用。我哥连我俩从小看到大的那套东西都不肯动。我原来老觉得他犯傻，现在我自己有这么个包了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They touch a folded corner of the swatch but don't lift it.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉碰了下布样折出来的角，没拿起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's his piece of cloth. I said I'd bring it back. It isn't mine to take a corner off.
beats.chinese: 这块布还是他的呢，我说过要还。我可不能随便剪人家一角。

choices.english: Set his sample aside and plan around their own material.
choices.chinese: 建议先把哥哥的布样留好，只考虑自己的布。

choices.english: Ask if they'd rather keep looking without matching anything today.
choices.chinese: 问是不是可以先接着逛，今天不用非配上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lay the swatch along the weak seam with the folded side over the hole.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉把布样沿着磨薄的接缝贴过去，让折起来那边遮住破口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That would sit lovely. I'll ask if I can have a sliver, now I've got a reason besides saving the bag.
beats.chinese: 贴在这儿挺好看。等我问能不能要一小条。这回有别的理由了，我就喜欢配成这样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put the swatch away without pinning it to the bag.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉把布样收好，没拿什么东西别在袋上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If he tells me no, I've still got the hole. It won't get bigger before dinner.
beats.chinese: 我哥要说不给，洞还在这儿呢。吃晚饭前也大不了哪儿去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They gather the broken edges with two fingers. The old crease is still visible.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉两根手指收拢裂开的边。旧折痕还是看得见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A few stitches there'll do. I don't mind leaving the old bit in view.
beats.chinese: 这儿缝几针就好了。原来那块露着也没关系。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They close the bag and tug the strap straight where it crosses their shoulder.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉把包口收拢，将肩头那截带子拉直。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I can get back to carrying things in it instead of making a project out of it.
beats.chinese: 得，又能拿来装东西了，不用再把它当个大工程。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They fold the borrowed cloth inwards and put it into a separate pocket.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉把借来的布往里叠，单放进另一只口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He'll have it back whole. I've got a bit of my own curtain left where the hem doubles over.
beats.chinese: 给我哥原样拿回去。我那窗帘还有点边角，正好有个折双层的下摆。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the torn lining under the bag's top edge.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉把破里布塞进袋口的上沿下面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll look at that at home. I know what I've got to cut now.
beats.chinese: 到家再翻翻。我现在知道该裁哪一块了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put the swatch away and swing the bag back so it lies flat against one hip.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉收起布样，把袋子往后挪，让它贴着一侧胯骨。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I came because I like looking at colours. That doesn't have to end in a repair.
beats.chinese: 也是。我来是喜欢看看颜色。也不用每回看完都非修个什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They let another shopper go first, then follow the central passage towards the next row of small shops.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉让另一位顾客先过，随后沿着中央过道朝下一排小店走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I might find something I like that isn't good for anything.
beats.chinese: 没准我能看上点自己喜欢、又一点用也没有的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another afternoon under the glass roof, Fionnuala sees you with a short brown envelope pinched shut in one hand.
beats.chinese: 改天午后，玻璃顶下，菲诺拉瞧见你，单手捏着一只短棕色信封。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. Dried chillies. I cut one off the plant with my best scissors yesterday. Had to clean them before I could so much as touch a sleeve.
beats.chinese: 你好，干辣椒。昨天我拿最好的剪刀剪了一只。还得先擦干净，不然碰个袖子都是辣的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They ease the flap open just enough for you to see a dark red tip.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉把封口揭开一点点，刚能让你看见露出来的一角深红。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Today I used the kitchen pair. See? I can learn when there's a decent incentive.
beats.chinese: 今天用的厨房那把。看吧，真把我辣着了，我还是能长记性的。

causality.presenceReason: 来看一块自己袋子可能用的内衬
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢看平常能拿来用的布
causality.stayingConstraint: 买不成也得先还朋友的布样
causality.currentGoal: 搞清什么部分动，什么部分原样留
causality.currentState: 提出法子快，险些又替人决定
causality.contactTrigger: 她把自己旧袋撑开，看见人走过便问是不是从一边看得更清楚
causality.characterContinuity: 改东西先征得同意，不轻贱出于喜欢保存完整的行为
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 拿旧样对自己袋子比。ab 只修外露破口。ba 不拆掉别人的顶边。bb 继续逛且不碰别人布
causality.spatialContinuity: 拱廊通道与店面外侧，没有进私人工作区
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 今天说的是剪辣椒误拿剪刀

reviewEvidence: 2026-11-22 逐人重写 28 处地点的 101 篇双语初遇及重逢，核对人物卡、站位、四路选择和本地口语。
保留既有 99 篇正文及全部身份和地点绑定，照片沿用 2026-11-15 的验收证明。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Saoirse stops to flip through a stack of thin publications in a bag. A loose slip sticks out of the centre.
beats.chinese: 瑟莎停下来翻包里一叠薄刊。中间支出一张没订进去的纸片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have you seen one of these today? It says this Friday. There's no date, and the copy I was sent has Tuesday written across it.
beats.chinese: 你今天见过这种单子吗？上面写这周五，不写几号。别人给我那张还划上了星期二。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the slip where the light from the arcade roof catches the print.
beats.chinese: 她把纸片举到拱廊顶的光刚好能照清字的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I promised the magazine would turn up at two shops. Nobody asked me to promise an event at either of them.
beats.chinese: 我答应两家店送刊过去。可没人叫我连活动也给人保证了。

choices.english: Ask where the slip came from.
choices.chinese: 问单子是从哪儿来的。

choices.english: Ask which part she's sure she has to deliver.
choices.chinese: 问哪些东西是她已经确定要送的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She finds a tiny name at the foot of the slip and pinches the paper there.
beats.chinese: 她在纸最底下找到一个小小的名字，用手捏住那个位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: From the printer, by way of two people. I can ask the person whose name is here. She's the one who has to stand there either way.
beats.chinese: 印厂传出来的，中间又过了两个人。我可以问名字印在这儿的这位。不管星期几，她都是那个得到场站着的人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She separates the slip from the publications and holds the two things side by side.
beats.chinese: 她把传单从刊里抽出来，两样并排拿着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If I can't reach her, these can still go. The slip can stay with me.
beats.chinese: 找不着她，这些刊还是可以送。单子我留下。

choices.english: Suggest taking the slip to the person on it.
choices.chinese: 建议拿着单子直接去问上头那个人。

choices.english: Suggest delivering the magazines without the slip.
choices.chinese: 建议送刊时先别夹传单。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the address on a delivery label inside the bag.
beats.chinese: 她看了看包里一张送货标贴上的地址。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: These. I can put them on the right counter today. I don't know where I'm supposed to get two people to agree about a Friday.
beats.chinese: 这些刊。今天我能放到该放的柜台上。可我上哪儿找那俩人把周五的事说成一个样？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sets the magazines neatly back into the bag.
beats.chinese: 她把几本刊齐齐整整地放回包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't need a guess off you either. You've probably got your own things to do.
beats.chinese: 你也用不着替我猜。你自己兴许还有事要做呢。

choices.english: Say you'll leave it with her without guessing.
choices.chinese: 说不猜了，留她自己处理。

choices.english: Ask what she'll say if a shopkeeper asks about the event.
choices.chinese: 问要是店主问起活动，她会怎么回。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the notice into an outer pocket and checks that its corner is still visible.
beats.chinese: 她把通知塞进外袋，又确认还有一角露着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll put it in front of her. If she reads Friday and looks surprised, I'll know enough for this morning.
beats.chinese: 我拿给她本人看。她要瞧见周五两个字就愣住，我上午能弄清这些也就够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns away from the stall she's beside and glances down the central passage.
beats.chinese: 她从身旁的摊子转开，沿中央过道望过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's about two streets away now, if she hasn't finished her tea.
beats.chinese: 她现在离这儿差不多两条街。只要她那杯茶还没喝完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She removes the slips one at a time. She keeps the bare magazine covers face up.
beats.chinese: 她把单子一张张抽走，刊物不再夹着纸，封面朝上收好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll take these as they were printed. If the Friday is real, I'll come back with an actual date.
beats.chinese: 就照印出来的原样送。周五要是靠谱，我再带写明日期的来一趟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pats the stack against the side of the bag and draws the strap up to go.
beats.chinese: 她把那摞东西在袋边拍齐，提好肩带准备走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've done worse circuits for much worse paper.
beats.chinese: 比这差的纸，我还替人跑过更冤的路呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the flap over the notice and moves out of the light from the roof.
beats.chinese: 她扣好袋盖压住通知，往旁边走出顶棚照下来的那片光。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fine. We don't know. That's something I can work with.
beats.chinese: 行，就是还不知道。这句倒可以照实说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She passes one shop front and slows at the next without taking the slip out.
beats.chinese: 她走过一家店，又在下一家门前放慢，没把单子拿出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll get these into the shops first.
beats.chinese: 我先把这些刊送进去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps one cover accessible with her fingers between it and the next.
beats.chinese: 她把手指隔在头两本中间，让第一本随时能抽出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll say I brought the magazines. If they want to ask about the event, I'll give them the organiser's name, if she's happy with that.
beats.chinese: 就说刊我送来了。要问活动，我可以给办活动的人名字，只要她乐意。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the bag so it doesn't brush a display as she sets off.
beats.chinese: 她把包转了个向，动身时没蹭到陈列上的东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll make the bit I know about easy to find. The rest can wait.
beats.chinese: 我知道的这部分，先让人找得到就行。剩下的等着吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A later day in the arcade, Saoirse notices you and pulls out a single folded sheet instead of opening the whole bag.
beats.chinese: 后来有一天在拱廊里，瑟莎瞧见你，只抽出一张折好的纸，没把整个包都打开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. I've got a copy with the middle pages in the wrong order. I kept one because the joke at the end is better when it comes first.
beats.chinese: 嗨。有一份中间几页订反了。我特地留了一份，末尾那个笑话放到头上，倒更好笑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shows you the corner where one page number jumps out of sequence.
beats.chinese: 她指给你看页角，正好有一个页码没接上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can have this one if you like. There's no reason for it to be in my bag going round all morning.
beats.chinese: 你想要就拿去。我也犯不着揣着它满街兜一上午。

causality.presenceReason: 逐店送纸刊，找当事人核对小印刷品送达
causality.placeAttitude: 知道哪个店喜欢何种刊物，愿意花脚力说清
causality.stayingConstraint: 今天还要再跑几个店，不做中间人的关系协调
causality.currentGoal: 把传岔的通知在送之前停下来核对
causality.currentState: 不想又遇到已经过期的消息
causality.contactTrigger: 过道放慢，亲自向拿到传单的玩家问在哪儿领的
causality.characterContinuity: 核对触达，不转述别人关系矛盾，不靠猜
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 带去询问发行者。ab 留空封面不放错传单。ba 两人都不再推断。bb 当面解释自己只送刊
causality.spatialContinuity: 沿小店这侧停，来去由过道走，传单是自带的
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 重逢是刊物印错次序的新情况，无需读过上次传单

reviewEvidence: 2026-11-22 逐人重写 28 处地点的 101 篇双语初遇及重逢，核对人物卡、站位、四路选择和本地口语。
保留既有 99 篇正文及全部身份和地点绑定，照片沿用 2026-11-15 的验收证明。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Mount Eden, Arthur Pemberton stands in the marked viewing area outside the crater, his bag over his shoulder. He came to look across Auckland, but has been reading a book he carried up. He closes it and turns towards you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在伊甸山，Arthur Pemberton站在火山口外缘标示的观景区域，肩上背着包。他本来是来看奥克兰远景的，却一直在读随身带来的书。他合上书，转向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Before I came up, I told myself I'd look at the view for ten minutes first. Opened the book and never did. Right. Officially starting now.
beats.chinese: 上来前跟自己说好了，先看十分钟风景。书一打开，就没执行。好了。现在正式开始。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks across the city, keeping a finger between the pages. A moment later, he glances down at the cover.
beats.chinese: 他望向城市，一根手指仍夹在书页间。过了一会儿，他又低头瞥了眼封面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Arthur, by the way. It's a book about beekeeping. I've reached the bit about moving beehives. Quite a lot to think about, apparently—the straps alone...
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫Arthur。这是本养蜂的书。我读到搬蜂箱那部分了。原来要操心的事还真不少，光是绑带就……

choices.english: What's interesting about the book?
choices.chinese: 这本书有什么有趣的地方？

choices.english: I'd just like to look at the skyline from here.
choices.chinese: 我只想从这里看看城市远景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Arthur turns the cover towards you without handing the book over. A folded handwritten list sticks out near the back.
beats.chinese: Arthur把封面转向你，没有把书递过来。靠后的书页里露出一张折起来的手写清单。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Found it on a bottom shelf, beside something about drains. You should read it. There's a chapter on moving beehives that—oh, it gets very particular.
beats.chinese: 在最底下那层书架找到的，旁边是本讲排水管的书。你该读读。有一章讲搬蜂箱，那个细致劲儿——哦，真是什么都讲究。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He finds the chapter, then laughs before he has finished scanning the page.
beats.chinese: 他翻到那一章，还没看完那一页，自己先笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I drive a mobile library van around Auckland. Apparently that qualifies me to worry about loading bees. I haven't even asked whether you like bees.
beats.chinese: 我在奥克兰开流动图书馆的车。看来这就够资格让我操心怎么装运蜜蜂了。我甚至还没问你喜不喜欢蜜蜂。

choices.english: Give me the short version of the beehive chapter.
choices.chinese: 简单说说搬蜂箱那章吧。

choices.english: Bees aren't really my thing. I'll carry on along the marked path.
choices.chinese: 我对蜜蜂实在没什么兴趣。我继续沿着标示的步道走走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Arthur nods, keeping the closed book in his hands and his finger between the pages.
beats.chinese: Arthur点点头，手里仍拿着合上的书，手指夹在书页间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll keep the bees to myself.
beats.chinese: 当然。蜜蜂的事我就留着自己琢磨吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the book and takes out a folded list. His eyes move from the first item to the skyline, then back to the open page.
beats.chinese: 他翻开书，抽出一张折好的清单，视线从第一项移到城市远景上，又落回翻开的书页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ten minutes looking, then a chapter. That was the arrangement. I've started with the chapter and lost track of the ten minutes.
beats.chinese: 先看十分钟风景，再读一章。原本是这么安排的。我先读了那一章，十分钟早就不知道去哪了。

choices.english: I'll look from here. Enjoy your book.
choices.chinese: 我就在这里看。你慢慢读吧。

choices.english: I'll look from the other side. Enjoy the view.
choices.chinese: 我去另一边看。你也慢慢看风景吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Arthur holds the book against his chest rather than reading the whole page aloud.
beats.chinese: Arthur把书靠在胸前，没有整页念出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You move them when the bees are home, secure the hive, and keep enough air getting through. Rather more to organise than a box of crime novels.
beats.chinese: 要等蜜蜂都回巢再搬，把蜂箱固定好，还得保证通风。比搬一箱犯罪小说要操心多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He starts to turn another page, catches himself, and closes the book. His attention returns to the skyline.
beats.chinese: 他刚想再翻一页，便停住手，把书合上，重新望向城市远景。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That was the short version. I nearly gave you the equipment list as well. Thanks for listening. I'll let you have the view now.
beats.chinese: 简短版就这些。我差点连设备清单都讲给你听。谢谢你听我说。现在不打扰你看风景了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the marked crater-rim path. Arthur keeps his book close and stays in the viewing area.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿着火山口外缘标示的步道前行。Arthur把书收在身前，留在观景区域里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I do tend to recommend whatever's currently in my hand.
beats.chinese: 完全理解。我总爱推荐自己手里正拿着的那一本。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives a small wave, then reopens the chapter with an unmistakably pleased expression.
beats.chinese: 他轻轻挥了下手，又翻开那一章，脸上的兴致一点也藏不住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your walk. I'm going to finish this bit about the straps.
beats.chinese: 慢慢逛。我得把讲绑带的这一段读完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You look out across the city. Arthur stays nearby, with his bag on his shoulder.
beats.chinese: 你望向城市远景。Arthur留在附近，包仍背在肩上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I'll leave you to it.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。那就不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks the list into the back of the book and opens his chapter again, holding the pages close so they do not flap.
beats.chinese: 他把清单塞回书后，重新翻开那一章，收拢书页，免得纸张翻动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One more page for me. Possibly two. I wouldn't trust my estimate.
beats.chinese: 我再看一页。也可能两页。我的估计不太可信。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You choose the view from the other side of the viewing area. Arthur stays where he is, keeping his bag on his shoulder.
beats.chinese: 你选择从观景区域的另一侧看风景。Arthur留在原地，包依旧背在肩上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I might actually put this away.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我还真该把这本书收起来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the list once more, puts it inside the closed book, and stows both in his bag. He looks out across Auckland.
beats.chinese: 他把清单又折了一下，夹进合上的书里，一起收进包中，然后望向奥克兰远景。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. The city gets its ten minutes. Enjoy the view over there.
beats.chinese: 好了。该给这座城市十分钟了。你在那边慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Mount Eden, Arthur stands in the marked viewing area with a closed book in his hands. He recognises you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 在伊甸山，Arthur站在标示的观景区域，手里拿着一本合上的书。他认出你，笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I'm not going to recommend this one today.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。今天我不准备推荐这本。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the book at the marked page and scans a few lines. Then he closes it, puts it in his bag, and looks across the city.
beats.chinese: 他把书翻到夹着书签的那一页，扫了几行，随后合上书，收进包里，望向城市远景。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm not enjoying it much myself. Still want to know what happens next, though. That's how it keeps me reading. I'll look at the city for a bit, then decide whether to carry on.
beats.chinese: 我自己也读得没什么滋味。不过，还是想知道后面会怎样。就这么一直读下去了。我先看一会儿城市，再决定要不要接着读。

causality.presenceReason: Arthur原本就上伊甸山看奥克兰远景，随身带的养蜂书使他在玩家到达前便读了起来。
causality.placeAttitude: 他喜欢这里的城市远景，但眼下对书中搬运蜂箱的细节更着迷，看景计划因此被自己搁置。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须久留的任务。他自行安排看景和阅读，全程停留在火山口外缘标示步道与观景区域，不占用通行空间。
causality.currentGoal: 原计划先看十分钟风景再读一章，现在合上书，打算正式开始看景，却又忍不住提起蜂箱运输。
causality.currentState: 心情轻松，注意力容易被书吸走，愿意主动短聊，也接受对方只想看景，不需要玩家陪聊或替他安排。
causality.contactTrigger: Arthur在标示观景区域合上养蜂书，主动向附近的玩家说起自己没有执行先看十分钟风景的计划，随后忍不住提到蜂箱运输。接触不再依赖包占位置、致歉或让位。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留流动图书馆司机身份、奥克兰生活背景、清单习惯、冷幽默与偏离计划的乐趣。他仍会没问兴趣就推荐自己正在读的书，被拒绝也不介意。重逢时坦言一本书读得没滋味，不勉强推荐，也没有因此失去想知道后续的好奇心。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家选聊书后，a继续介绍养蜂书并暴露推荐不看对象的习惯。aa按玩家要求简述蜂箱运输，克制继续展开的冲动并结束交谈。ab接受玩家对蜜蜂没兴趣，玩家沿标示步道继续走，他留下读书。玩家选择只看景后，b接受这个边界。ba回应玩家让他继续读书的选择，停止展开话题，自行阅读。bb承接玩家去观景区域另一侧看景的选择，Arthur留在原地，自行收书，真正开始看景。两条结局都不再依赖让位。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有互动只在火山口外缘标示步道和观景区域内进行，遵循场所用途，不进入火山口，不增设设施，不阻挡通行。包一直随身携带，书与清单均为自带物品。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Arthur Pemberton。本次重逢位于伊甸山观景步道，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Mount Eden's marked crater-rim viewing area, Indira Sparrow is taking a break from sorting watch parts. A coin slips from their fingers and stops near your shoe, within the viewing area.
beats.chinese: 在伊甸山火山口外缘标示的观景区域，Indira Sparrow 正趁着休息，暂时远离整理手表零件的工作。一枚硬币从他们指间滑落，停在你鞋边，仍在观景区域内。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my coin by your shoe. Could I reach past you? I'm Indira.
beats.chinese: 你鞋边那枚硬币是我的。我能从你旁边伸手捡一下吗？我叫 Indira。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Indira points to the coin and waits, keeping out of your space.
beats.chinese: Indira 指了指硬币，留在原地等着，没有挤进你身边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came up for the view. Apparently I brought a very small escape artist.
beats.chinese: 我是上来看风景的。看来还带了一位特别小的逃脱大师。

choices.english: Step aside. Go ahead. Can you actually do a trick with it?
choices.chinese: 往旁边让开。捡吧。你真能用它变魔术吗？

choices.english: Step aside. Go ahead. I'd rather just look at the view.
choices.chinese: 往旁边让开。捡吧。我只想看看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Indira retrieves the coin and straightens up, leaving room for people to pass.
beats.chinese: Indira 捡起硬币，直起身，给其他人留出通行的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Absolutely. You don't need to lend me anything. I've got enough to keep track of.
beats.chinese: 当然。你什么都不用借给我。我需要记住去向的东西已经够多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They open a small prop pouch. Beside a second coin is a notebook. They touch each item, then check the first coin again.
beats.chinese: 他们打开随身的小道具袋。另一枚硬币旁边放着一本小册子。他们逐一碰了碰里面的东西，又检查了一次手里的硬币。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Coin, spare coin, notebook. Right. Now I'm ready.
beats.chinese: 硬币、备用硬币、小册子。好，这下准备好了。

choices.english: Let's see the trick.
choices.chinese: 来，表演一下吧。

choices.english: Actually, what's the notebook for?
choices.chinese: 对了，那本小册子是做什么用的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Indira picks up the coin and moves to one side within the marked viewing area.
beats.chinese: Indira 捡起硬币，在标示的观景区域内往旁边挪开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I sort tiny watch parts all day. You'd think I could keep hold of one big coin.
beats.chinese: 当然。我整天都在整理小小的手表零件。按说一枚这么大的硬币，总该拿得住吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put the coin in a zipped pocket, close it, then run a finger over the zip a second time.
beats.chinese: 他们把硬币放进有拉链的口袋，拉好，又用手指沿着拉链摸了一遍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. All yours. The view, I mean.
beats.chinese: 好了，归你了。我是说，风景。

choices.english: Watch parts? Is that your job?
choices.chinese: 手表零件？那是你的工作吗？

choices.english: Thanks. I'll stay here and look.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。我就在这里看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Indira closes the pouch and holds the coin up. Their quick patter begins as it passes between their hands.
beats.chinese: Indira 合上道具袋，举起硬币。硬币在双手间移动，他们也开始利落地说起表演台词。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One coin, no sleeves involved. The sleeves demanded too much money.
beats.chinese: 一枚硬币，袖子完全不参与。袖子的出场费太高了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The coin vanishes, then appears behind their own ear. They bow briefly, put it beside the spare and count both twice before closing the pouch.
beats.chinese: 硬币消失了，随后又从他们自己的耳后出现。他们简短地鞠了一躬，把硬币放回备用硬币旁边，数了两遍才合上袋子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And that's the whole show. Thanks for watching. I'll let you get back to Auckland.
beats.chinese: 表演到此结束。谢谢观看。接下来就不耽误你看奥克兰了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Indira puts both coins away and takes out the notebook instead. A thumb holds most of its pages shut.
beats.chinese: Indira 收好两枚硬币，转而拿出小册子，拇指压着大部分书页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Things I've lent out. Mara, case knife, three weeks. I did ask yesterday. Very casually.
beats.chinese: 记借出去的东西。Mara，开表刀，三周。我昨天确实问过了。问得特别随意。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They half-turn another page, stop and close the notebook firmly. It goes back into the pouch without any names being added.
beats.chinese: 他们翻起下一页的一半，又停住，利落地合上册子。册子放回袋里，没有添上任何名字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, that's enough public accounting. Enjoy the view. I'm putting this away before I check another entry.
beats.chinese: 好了，公开查账就到这里。慢慢看风景吧。我得赶紧收起来，免得又查下一条。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Indira turns back toward you, keeping their hands away from the zipped pocket.
beats.chinese: Indira 转回身看向你，双手离开了拉好拉链的口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: First-year watchmaking apprentice. Mostly sorting parts by size and finish. Sorting confetti with feelings, I call it.
beats.chinese: 我是制表学徒，第一年。主要按尺寸和表面处理给零件分类。我管这叫给有情绪的纸屑分类。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They glance across the city, then turn along the marked path to leave the viewing area.
beats.chinese: 他们朝城市望了一眼，随后转向标示的步道，准备离开观景区域。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Anyway, I've had my break. Better get going before I start sorting the contents of my pockets. Enjoy it up here.
beats.chinese: 好了，休息够了。得赶紧走，免得开始给口袋里的东西分类。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Indira stays to one side, leaving your sightline clear.
beats.chinese: Indira 留在一旁，没有挡住你的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No problem. Sorry about the coin interruption.
beats.chinese: 没问题。抱歉，刚才那枚硬币打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck both hands into their hoodie pocket and turn toward another part of the skyline. The conversation ends without a demonstration.
beats.chinese: 他们把双手插进连帽衫口袋，转头望向城市远景的另一边。交谈就此结束，没有魔术表演。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll keep the rest of my change to myself. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 剩下的零钱我会管好的。慢慢看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Mount Eden, you see Indira in the marked viewing area, looking at an open notebook with a phone in their other hand. They look up and recognize you.
beats.chinese: 后来一次到伊甸山时，你看见 Indira 站在标示的观景区域，正看着摊开的借物册，另一只手拿着手机。他们抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I was just about to ask where something I lent out is being kept. Again. Very casually, obviously.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我正想问问，借出去的一件东西现在放在哪儿。再问一次。当然，得问得特别随意。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their thumb pauses above the phone screen. They check the location already written beside the entry, then close the notebook, put it and the phone away, and turn toward the city.
beats.chinese: 他们的拇指停在手机屏幕上方。他们核对了一下条目旁已经记下的位置，随后合上借物册，把册子和手机收好，转身望向城市。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's already in the book. I don't need to ask again today. Right. These next few minutes are for the view.
beats.chinese: 册子里已经记着了。今天不用再问一次。好，接下来这几分钟留给风景。

causality.presenceReason: Indira 整理手表零件之余来伊甸山休息、看城市远景，随身带着平常使用的硬币道具袋。

causality.currentState: 有精力表演，也能礼貌接受拒绝。硬币失手后会反复确认物品已收妥。
causality.contactTrigger: 硬币停在玩家鞋边，Indira 为伸手取回而先征求让位。

causality.reactionAndChange: aa 完成硬币表演后反复清点并收场。ab 转为简短展示借物记录，主动合册结束。ba 说明学徒工作后结束休息并离开。bb 接受不交谈的选择，留在一旁独自看景。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有捡拾、表演和交谈均在标示观景区域内，留出通行空间。仅 ba 沿已有标示步道离开，不切换新场景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After a morning checking equipment at an indoor climbing gym, Beryl Hutchinson has come to Mount Eden with her housemate. They are in the marked crater-rim viewing area. Her housemate is studying the skyline. Beryl stands clear of the path and speaks to you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在室内攀岩馆检查了一上午器材后，贝丽尔·哈钦森陪室友来到伊甸山。她们待在火山口外缘标示的观景区域，室友正仔细看着城市远景。贝丽尔站在不挡步道的位置，向附近的你开口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She wants to look a bit longer. I said I'd stay with her. I won't hurry her.
beats.chinese: 她还想多看一会儿。我答应陪着，不催她。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beryl stays where she is and glances towards her housemate, a little farther along the viewing area.
beats.chinese: 贝丽尔仍站在原处，朝观景区域稍远处的室友看了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've finished looking. She's being very thorough.
beats.chinese: 我已经看够了。她看得很仔细。

choices.english: It's a wonderful view. I can see why she's taking her time.
choices.chinese: 景色真好。我能理解她为什么要慢慢看。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it, then.
choices.chinese: 那我就不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beryl looks across the crater towards the city again. Her expression barely changes.
beats.chinese: 贝丽尔又越过火山口望向城市，表情几乎没变。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's a city from higher up. Five minutes does me.
beats.chinese: 就是从高处看城市。看五分钟我就够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She notices her housemate turning towards another part of the skyline and settles her bag strap more securely on her shoulder.
beats.chinese: 她注意到室友转向另一侧的城市远景，便把肩上的包带往稳妥处提了提。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's enjoying it, though. I said I'd wait.
beats.chinese: 不过她看得挺开心。我说了会等她。

choices.english: I'll have a look for myself, then.
choices.chinese: 那我自己看看。

choices.english: What made you come along?
choices.chinese: 那你怎么会陪她来？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beryl gives a small nod. She stays in her place within the viewing area, clear of the path.
beats.chinese: 贝丽尔轻轻点头，仍站在观景区域内不挡步道的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 好。慢慢看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances towards her housemate, who is still looking out over the city, then rests a hand on her bag strap.
beats.chinese: 她朝仍在远眺城市的室友看了一眼，把一只手搭在包带上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll be here a while yet. She's found something else to look at.
beats.chinese: 我还得待一会儿。她又找到别的地方看了。

choices.english: Have you been up here long?
choices.chinese: 你们上来很久了吗？

choices.english: All right. I'll carry on. Enjoy your afternoon.
choices.chinese: 好，那我继续走了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beryl turns sideways so that her shoulder no longer cuts across your view of the city.
beats.chinese: 贝丽尔侧过身，不再让自己的肩膀挡着你看城市。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go ahead. I'll keep my opinion over here.
beats.chinese: 看吧。我把我的意见留在这边。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves a little farther along the marked viewing area and takes a water bottle from her bag, turning her attention away from the conversation.
beats.chinese: 她沿着标示的观景区域稍稍挪远，从包里取出水瓶，把注意力从交谈中移开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You've got a clear view there.
beats.chinese: 你站那儿看，不挡视线。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beryl watches her housemate for a moment before answering. She makes no move to call her back.
beats.chinese: 贝丽尔看了室友片刻才回答，没有招呼她回来的意思。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She sat through my swim yesterday. Forty slow widths. Her turn to choose.
beats.chinese: 昨天我游泳，她一直坐着等。慢慢游了四十趟短边。这回轮到她选。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her housemate turns and lifts a hand. Beryl returns the gesture and walks over to her, staying within the viewing area.
beats.chinese: 室友转过身，抬手示意。贝丽尔也抬了抬手，留在观景区域内朝她走去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. Ready now. Enjoy your look.
beats.chinese: 啊。她看好了。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beryl checks her watch with a quick turn of her wrist.
beats.chinese: 贝丽尔转了下手腕，迅速看了一眼表。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eighteen minutes. We came after my shift at the climbing gym. Equipment checks.
beats.chinese: 十八分钟。我在攀岩馆下班后过来的。做器材检查。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers her wrist and turns towards the crater, letting the conversation end rather than adding another question.
beats.chinese: 她放下手腕，转向火山口，没有再问什么，让谈话就此结束。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm giving the watch a rest now. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 现在让手表歇会儿。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beryl gives you a nod as you turn to continue along the marked path.
beats.chinese: 你转身准备沿标示步道继续走，贝丽尔向你点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too.
beats.chinese: 你也是。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the path, she faces her housemate again and adjusts the bag resting against her hip.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道继续走，她重新面向室友，调整了一下贴在胯边的包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave her to it.
beats.chinese: 就让她慢慢看吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Mount Eden, you see Beryl standing in the marked crater-rim viewing area, clear of the path. She recognises you and gives a small nod.
beats.chinese: 后来再次来到伊甸山，你看见贝丽尔站在火山口外缘标示的观景区域，没有挡着步道。她认出了你，轻轻点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. A bit tired after work today. I'll stop here a minute before I carry on.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天下班后有点累。在这儿歇一会儿再走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks quietly across the crater towards the city without adding anything. After a short rest, she starts along the marked path and turns her head towards you.
beats.chinese: 她安静地越过火山口望向城市，没有再说什么。歇了一小会儿，她沿标示步道迈步离开，转头看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough of a rest. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 歇够了。散步愉快。

causality.presenceReason: 贝丽尔在攀岩馆结束上午的器材检查后，陪室友上伊甸山看城市远景。
causality.placeAttitude: 她看五分钟便觉得足够，对远景兴趣有限，但不妨碍室友慢慢欣赏。
causality.stayingConstraint: 她答应陪室友看完，因此没有独自离开，也没有催促。
causality.currentGoal: 在标示观景区域等室友结束这次停留。
causality.currentState: 工作后耐心有限、话不多，但保持礼貌，也愿意简短回应。重逢时的疲倦只是当天工作后的状态。
causality.contactTrigger: 她始终站在观景区域内不挡步道的位置，向附近玩家平直地说室友还想多看一会儿，自己答应陪着、不催她，再补充自己已经看够。没有碰撞、空间侵入或需要玩家处理的意外。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留她精确、直白、忠于约定的性格，通过十八分钟和四十趟短边体现说话习惯，通过冷淡评价风景显露扫兴的缺点。她不假装享受等待，也不要求玩家陪她。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家赞美景色后，a保留她直白而扫兴的回应。aa中她收起意见、挪开喝水，让玩家自行观景。ab中她说明陪伴的具体缘由，随后应室友示意过去。玩家表示不打扰时，b礼貌回应，不要求玩家留下。玩家仍可追问等了多久，进入ba，或告辞进入bb。ba中她准确报时并简述工作，随后不再看表，结束交谈。bb中她回应祝福，继续留在原处等室友，不再提及碰撞或道歉。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程位于火山口外缘标示步道与观景区域。初遇时她站定且不挡路，后续仅在区域内小幅移动。重逢时在观景区域休息，再沿标示步道离开，不进入火山口，不新增设施或跨越限制。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Beryl Hutchinson。本次重逢位于伊甸山观景步道，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。
