beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Mount Eden's marked crater-rim viewing area, Wren Tualagi-Fahey turns toward you nearby. He is taking a short walk after a repair visit and hasn't kept track of the time.
beats.chinese: 在伊甸山火山口外缘标示的观景区域，Wren Tualagi-Fahey 转向附近的你。他做完一次上门维修，来散一小会儿步，一直没留意时间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could you tell me the time? I'm not meeting anyone. Just wondering how long I've been walking.
beats.chinese: 方便告诉我现在几点吗？我没赶约会，只想知道这趟走了多久。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives you a brief smile, then glances toward the crater.
beats.chinese: 他朝你简短地笑了笑，随后望向火山口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Wren, by the way. I'll have a look at the crater, then head home.
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫 Wren。我再看看火山口就回家。

choices.english: Sure. Just out for a short walk, then?
choices.chinese: 可以。那就是出来走一小会儿？

choices.english: I'm not sure of the time. I'll take a look at the city.
choices.chinese: 我不太清楚现在几点。我看看城市那边。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You tell Wren the time. He stays where he is, with room for others to pass. He loosens his shoulders.
beats.chinese: 你告诉 Wren 现在的时间。他留在原处，给其他人留着通行的空间，活动了一下肩膀。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Yes. I fix smart door locks part-time. Finished a job and fancied a bit of air.
beats.chinese: 谢了。是啊。我兼职修智能门锁。刚做完一单，想出来透透气。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances across the crater.
beats.chinese: 他朝火山口那边望了望。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Home after this. I live on my own, so there's nobody asking what's for dinner.
beats.chinese: 看完就回家。我一个人住，没人追着问晚饭吃什么。

choices.english: No dinner negotiations. That sounds handy.
choices.chinese: 不用商量晚饭吃什么，倒挺省事。

choices.english: Wouldn't a dog make home less lonely?
choices.chinese: 养只狗，家里会不会没那么孤单？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You turn toward the city. Beside you, Wren takes one more look at it.
beats.chinese: 你转向城市那边。Wren 在你旁边，又朝城市望了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No worries. I came up for the view. Spent the first few minutes looking at my shoes.
beats.chinese: 没事。我是来看风景的。结果头几分钟一直在看自己的鞋。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts one foot just enough to inspect the loose lace, then plants it firmly again.
beats.chinese: 他稍稍抬起一只脚，看了看松开的鞋带，又稳稳地放下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That'll need tying before I go. The city can wait a second.
beats.chinese: 走之前得把它系好。城市可以等我一下。

choices.english: The buildings look very close together from here.
choices.chinese: 从这里看，那些楼挤得真近。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你了。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wren gives a short laugh and takes a water bottle from his pocket.
beats.chinese: Wren 短促地笑了一声，从口袋里拿出水瓶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ha. Toast has never asked me to cook something else.
beats.chinese: 哈。吐司可从没要求我换道菜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He unscrews the cap and raises the bottle slightly in farewell, settling into his water break.
beats.chinese: 他拧开瓶盖，略微举起水瓶，算是道别，接着开始喝水休息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, a drink for me. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 好了，我喝口水。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wren's smile disappears. His answer comes quickly.
beats.chinese: Wren 收起笑容，回答得很快。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm not lonely. And I'm not taking a dog home.
beats.chinese: 我不孤单。而且我不打算带只狗回家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pauses, then turns toward the marked path, leaving your view clear.
beats.chinese: 他顿了顿，转向标示的步道，没有挡住你的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I like visiting them, with the owner's okay. That's plenty for me. Anyway, enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 主人同意的话，我喜欢逗逗它们。这样就够了。好了，你慢慢看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wren bends to tie his lace, then straightens and looks toward the skyline you mentioned.
beats.chinese: Wren 弯腰系好鞋带，直起身，朝你说的城市天际线望去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They do. Down there, I always seem to need the building three streets further on.
beats.chinese: 是挺挤。在下面的时候，我要去的楼却总像是还隔着三条街。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the knot with a small tug of his foot, then turns to look into the crater.
beats.chinese: 他轻轻动了动脚，确认鞋带系牢，随后转身看向火山口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my city-gazing done. I'll have a look this way. Cheers.
beats.chinese: 城市我看够了。我看看这边。回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wren nods and bends to deal with the loose lace.
beats.chinese: Wren 点点头，弯腰处理松开的鞋带。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Got my look in already.
beats.chinese: 谢了。我已经看过一阵了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He ties the lace, checks it, and starts along the marked path without drawing you away from the view.
beats.chinese: 他系好鞋带，检查了一下，便沿着标示的步道离开，没有再分散你看风景的注意力。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All sorted. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 弄好了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Mount Eden's marked viewing area, Wren is looking at his phone. He recognises you and raises a hand in greeting.
beats.chinese: 在伊甸山标示的观景区域，Wren 正看着手机。他认出了你，爽快地抬手打招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again! My neighbour's just sent a close-up of their cat. Ha. I'm saying hello back.
beats.chinese: 又见面了！邻居刚发来一张家里猫的近照。哈。我正回一句问候。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He smiles as he sends the message, then puts his phone away and stays where he is, leaving room for others to pass.
beats.chinese: 他笑着发完消息，把手机收好，仍留在原处，给其他人留着通行的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nice to see the cat, even on a screen. No repair jobs today. I'll take my time on this walk.
beats.chinese: 隔着屏幕看一眼也挺高兴。今天没维修，我还想慢慢走。

causality.presenceReason: Wren 完成一次上门维修后，先来伊甸山短暂散步、看景，再回家。
causality.placeAttitude: 他喜欢在这里短暂停留，看城市和火山口，也会在没有维修安排时特意放慢散步的节奏，独自享受这段时间。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须等候的人或事务，也没有要赶的约会，只打算短暂停留。始终留在标示步道和观景区域，不进入火山口。
causality.currentGoal: 维修结束后透气，问清当前时间以了解自己走了多久，再看看火山口便回家。
causality.currentState: 心情平常，愿意为一个具体问题主动搭话并简短介绍自己，但不寻求长时间陪伴。谈到独居被理解为孤独时，会立刻变得生硬。
causality.contactTrigger: 他散步时没留意时间，于是在标示观景区域向附近玩家询问现在几点，并说明自己没有要赶的约会，只想知道走了多久。玩家可以告诉他时间并追问散步安排，也可以表示不清楚、转而看城市。他不要求玩家查手机。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留西奥克兰成长及现居奥克兰的经历、兼职智能门锁售后维修、喜欢短接触和独居、干脆幽默、尊重宠物主人许可及拒绝养宠物的边界。主动问时间不代表需要陪伴，独居也没有被改写成待解决的问题。重逢时简短回复邻居发来的猫照片，延续他喜欢动物又不要求持续陪伴的相处方式。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家答应告知时间并询问是否只出来短走后，a 先落实报时，再由 Wren 致谢并说明维修后的散步及回家安排。aa 因玩家理解独居便利而开玩笑，以喝水结束交谈。ab 被孤独假设触动，直接划清养狗边界后离开。玩家表示不清楚时间、选择看城市后，b 接受对方不知道，顺着视线再看一眼，注意到鞋带需要系好。ba 接住城市观察，系好鞋带后转看火山口并道别。bb 接受玩家结束交谈的意愿，系好鞋带便沿步道离开。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全部互动发生在火山口外缘标示的步道与观景区域，只使用城市远景、火山口和随身物品。玩家看城市无需 Wren 让位，人物不进入火山口，不增加设施，也不阻挡通行。重逢时只在原处查看并回复手机消息，没有实际接触动物或转移场景。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Wren Tualagi-Fahey。本次重逢位于伊甸山观景步道，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At North Wharf in Wynyard Quarter, Tane Ropata has been waiting ten minutes for a mate and their planned waterfront walk. They raise a hand toward you, then hesitate.
beats.chinese: 在温亚德码头街区的 North Wharf 岸边，Tane Ropata 已经等了朋友十分钟，两人原本约好沿水边散步。他们朝你抬起手，随即迟疑了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you are. Oh, sorry. Thought you were my mate.
beats.chinese: 你可来了。哦，不好意思。认成我朋友了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their phone vibrates. Tane reads the screen and lets out a short breath, staying clear of people using the public walkway.
beats.chinese: 手机振了一下。Tane 看了看屏幕，短短地呼出一口气，站在不妨碍公共步道通行的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Another queue update. Brilliant. I'm Tane, anyway.
beats.chinese: 又来汇报排队进度了。真行。对了，我叫 Tane。

choices.english: Your mate sounds very committed to that queue.
choices.chinese: 看来你朋友是铁了心要排这个队。

choices.english: No worries. Waiting here seems better than being in the queue.
choices.chinese: 没事。在这里等，总比在队里排着好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tane lowers the phone. Their voice settles back into an even pace.
beats.chinese: Tane 放低手机，语速又恢复了平稳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Usually I'd agree. They won their first table-tennis match on Thursday. I've been allowing a bit of extra nonsense.
beats.chinese: 平时我也这么想。他们星期四第一次赢了乒乓球比赛。我就多容忍他们胡闹一点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the phone into a pocket. As they recall the score, their speech speeds up.
beats.chinese: 他们把手机塞进口袋。说起比分时，语速快了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eleven–nine, from eight–three down. Kept getting the serve back. They keep calling it luck, which is getting annoying.
beats.chinese: 十一比九，八比三落后追上来的。发球一直都接回去了。他们非说是运气，听得我都有点烦了。

choices.english: Coming back from eight–three takes more than luck.
choices.chinese: 从八比三追上来，可不只是运气。

choices.english: What do you do when you're not waiting for your mate?
choices.chinese: 不等朋友的时候，你是做什么的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tane glances along the shore, then back at the phone.
beats.chinese: Tane 沿着岸边望了一眼，又看向手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah. I'd complain the whole time in there. Held a mate's place for forty minutes once, though. That was different.
beats.chinese: 是啊。真排进去，我能从头抱怨到尾。不过有一次我替朋友占了四十分钟的位置。那是另一回事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They read a new message and briefly hold up two fingers.
beats.chinese: 他们读了一条新消息，短暂地竖起两根手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two minutes, apparently. That's their third two minutes.
beats.chinese: 据说还有两分钟。这已经是第三个两分钟了。

choices.english: Good luck with those two minutes. Bye. Continue along the walkway.
choices.chinese: 祝你顺利等完这两分钟。再见。沿步道继续走。

choices.english: I'll look at the water over here. No need to keep talking.
choices.chinese: 我在这边看看水景就好，不用一直陪我聊天。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tane nods immediately, looking more animated than they did while checking the messages.
beats.chinese: Tane 立刻点头，神情比刚才查看消息时生动多了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Exactly. They used to miss every short serve. Practised those for weeks, then got four back in that last game.
beats.chinese: 就是。他们以前每个短球都接不到。练了好几个星期，最后那局接回去了四个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Someone farther along the walkway waves. Tane waves back and turns toward their approaching mate.
beats.chinese: 步道前方有人挥手。Tane 挥手回应，转向正走近的朋友。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There they are. I'm making them tell the score properly this time. Good talking to you.
beats.chinese: 来了。这次得让他们好好把比分讲清楚。跟你聊得挺好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tane answers without hesitation, their voice returning to its earlier level.
beats.chinese: Tane 没有迟疑便回答了，声音恢复了先前的平稳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Apprentice accordion bellows repairer. Two years in. Finished a gasket today. It fitted.
beats.chinese: 修手风琴风箱的学徒。干了两年。今天做完一个密封垫。装得上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They brush a small fleck from their sleeve, then check their phone again.
beats.chinese: 他们掸掉袖子上的一小点碎屑，又看了一眼手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Still wreck the odd one. Anyway, I'll let you get on. Nice meeting you.
beats.chinese: 偶尔还是会做坏一个。总之，不耽误你了。很高兴认识你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the walkway, Tane steps back enough to leave a clear gap.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道继续往前走，Tane 往后让了让，留出通行的空当。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Sorry about the mistaken wave.
beats.chinese: 谢了。刚才认错人，抱歉啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They give a small farewell wave, then turn back toward the direction their mate is expected from.
beats.chinese: 他们轻轻挥手道别，随后转身望向朋友预计会来的方向。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You turn toward the water. Tane puts the phone down by their side and leaves you space.
beats.chinese: 你转向水面。Tane 把拿着手机的手垂到身侧，给你留出空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All good. I'll stop giving you queue reports.
beats.chinese: 好啊。我也不继续给你播报排队进度了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The phone rings. Tane gives you a brief nod and shifts farther aside before answering.
beats.chinese: 手机响了。Tane 朝你点点头，又往旁边让了些才接起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah, I'm here. By the water. You've walked past me.
beats.chinese: 对，我在这儿。水边。你走过头了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At North Wharf in Wynyard Quarter, Tane Ropata recognises you with a small braided loop in their hand.
beats.chinese: 在温亚德码头区North Wharf，Tane Ropata手里拿着一小段编绳，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. For my mate's table-tennis bag. He keeps losing it among the black ones.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。给朋友的乒乓球拍袋做的。他老是在一堆黑袋子里找不着自己的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They check the knot once, then put the loop in their pocket, smiling.
beats.chinese: 他们检查一下绳结，笑着把编绳放进口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bright enough now. Mine's still got a bit of old string on it. Anyway, I'll give him this Thursday. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 这回够亮了。我自己的还系着一截旧线。总之，周四给他。散步愉快。

causality.presenceReason: Tane 下班后已到 North Wharf 等朋友，准备按约沿水边散步，玩家出现前已等了十分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At North Wharf in Wynyard Quarter, Ari Whitcombe has stopped beside the public waterfront path. After his shift, he came here for some air before heading home. With a message open on his phone, he looks up at you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在温亚德码头街区的 North Wharf，Ari Whitcombe 停在公共滨水步道旁。他下班后先来这里透透气，再回家。他的手机上打开着一条信息，他抬头看向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Quick question. Does 'I can't do Thursday' sound a bit blunt? No need to make up a reason for me.
beats.chinese: 问你个小问题。“周四去不了”，这样说是不是有点生硬？不用替我编理由。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances back at the message about cancelling coffee. Before you answer, his thumb moves across the screen to add a few words.
beats.chinese: 他低头看了看那条取消咖啡约会的信息。还没等你回答，他的拇指已经在屏幕上动起来，添了几个字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll add 'Dentist. Sorry about that.' There we go. I'm Ari, by the way.
beats.chinese: 我加上“得看牙医。不好意思啊。”好了。对了，我叫 Ari。

choices.english: Was the dentist part true?
choices.chinese: 看牙医那部分是真的吗？

choices.english: No worries. Taking a break out here?
choices.chinese: 没事。来这里歇一会儿？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ari glances at the unsent message. His thumb moves toward the words he just added.
beats.chinese: Ari 看了一眼还没发出的信息，拇指移向刚添上的那几个字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tuesday, actually. Ah. I'll have to change that.
beats.chinese: 其实是周二。啊，得改改了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He deletes the dentist excuse, locks the phone and pockets it. Almost immediately, a coin appears between his fingers.
beats.chinese: 他删掉看牙医的借口，锁屏，把手机收进口袋。几乎紧接着，一枚硬币就出现在他的指间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You've caught the rehearsal. Keen to see something with fewer appointments?
beats.chinese: 让你撞见彩排了。想看点不用预约的东西吗？

choices.english: All right. Let's see the coin trick.
choices.chinese: 好啊，看看你的硬币戏法。

choices.english: You could just say you're not up for coffee.
choices.chinese: 你可以直接说不想去喝咖啡。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ari puts the phone away without sending the message. He turns slightly toward the water, keeping the path clear.
beats.chinese: Ari 没有发送留言，便收起手机。他稍稍转向水面，让步道保持畅通。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah. Finished at the light rail passenger information desk. Wanted some air before heading home.
beats.chinese: 是啊。刚从轻轨乘客咨询台下班。想先透透气再回家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rolls his shoulders and loosens the zip of his violet track jacket.
beats.chinese: 他转了转肩膀，把紫色运动外套的拉链拉低了一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sometimes I drive out west after work. Couldn't face getting in the car today.
beats.chinese: 有时下班会开车往西边跑跑。今天实在不想钻进车里。

choices.english: Where out west do you usually go?
choices.chinese: 你通常去西边哪里？

choices.english: Enjoy the air. I'll keep going.
choices.chinese: 那你好好透透气。我继续走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ari holds the coin low between you, ready to begin. Before he closes his fist, his phone rings.
beats.chinese: Ari把硬币放低在你们之间，准备开始。还没合拢拳头，手机响了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One coin. Very modest—oh. That's him.
beats.chinese: 一枚硬币。预算非常——噢，是他。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes out the phone. The coffee friend's name fills the screen. Ari pockets the coin, lets the call ring out and turns the phone face down in his palm.
beats.chinese: 他取出手机。约喝咖啡的朋友名字出现在屏幕上。Ari收起硬币，任电话响完，把手机翻过来扣在掌心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have to answer him properly. In a minute. Sorry, show's stopped there. Take care.
beats.chinese: 得认真回他。一会儿再说。不好意思，演到这里停了。保重。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The coin stops moving. Ari slips it back into his pocket and takes out his phone again.
beats.chinese: 硬币停了下来。Ari 把它塞回口袋，重新拿出手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah, I could. Then there's the whole 'why, what's wrong?' bit.
beats.chinese: 嗯，是可以。然后就会有一整段“为什么，怎么了？”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He starts typing, erases the first few words and angles the screen back toward himself. His attention settles on the unfinished message.
beats.chinese: 他开始打字，删掉开头几个词，又把屏幕转回自己面前。他的注意力落在了那条没写完的信息上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll sort the wording out. Anyway, good to meet you.
beats.chinese: 我自己琢磨措辞吧。总之，很高兴认识你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ari turns back from the water to answer. His hands stay in his jacket pockets.
beats.chinese: Ari 从水面转回头来回答，双手仍插在外套口袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Piha, usually. I grew up in Mount Roskill, and somehow I'm still surprised how long it takes me to leave the house.
beats.chinese: 一般去 Piha。我在 Mount Roskill 长大，可直到现在，每次出门磨蹭那么久，我自己都觉得意外。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks his watch, then turns along the public path. He lifts one hand in farewell before walking on.
beats.chinese: 他看了看表，随后转向公共步道。他抬手道别，沿着步道走开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No coast trip tonight. Home and something out of the freezer. Catch you.
beats.chinese: 今晚不去海边了。回家，从冰箱里找点吃的。回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ari shifts farther to the side as you continue along the public path.
beats.chinese: 你沿着公共步道继续走，Ari 又往旁边让了让。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sweet as. Have a good one.
beats.chinese: 好嘞。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives you a brief wave, then turns toward the water. His phone stays in his pocket as the distance between you grows.
beats.chinese: 他朝你简短地挥挥手，随后转向水面。你们渐渐拉开距离，他的手机一直留在口袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers!
beats.chinese: 回见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing at North Wharf in Wynyard Quarter, Ari stands beside the public waterfront path. He has just set his phone to silent when he looks up and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 在温亚德码头街区的 North Wharf ，Ari 正站在岸上的公共滨水步道旁。他刚把手机调成静音，抬头便认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hey! Good to see you. Finished work, and I'm really not keen to answer any more practical questions today.
beats.chinese: 哦，嗨！很高兴见到你。下班了，今天实在不想再回答任何实用问题了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He laughs at himself and slips the phone into his pocket. He turns slightly along the path, leaving room for people to pass.
beats.chinese: 他自己先笑了，把手机放进口袋。他稍稍转向步道延伸的方向，留出空间让行人通过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Still using my desk voice, though. Haven't quite switched that off. I'm going to walk quietly for a bit. Catch you!
beats.chinese: 不过说话还是咨询台那个口气，还没完全关掉。我想安安静静走一小段。回见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At North Wharf in Auckland's Wynyard Quarter, Pippa Ngatai stands clear of passing foot traffic on the public waterfront path. Her handheld recorder is stopped. Two little splashes sound from the water, and she laughs, glancing towards you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在奥克兰温亚德码头街区的 North Wharf，Pippa Ngatai 站在临水公共步道上不挡人的位置，手持录音机处于停止状态。水面传来连续两下小小的拍水声，她笑出声，朝附近的你看过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Those two sounded like someone answering. I'm collecting water sounds, not voices.
beats.chinese: 刚才那两下像有人接了一句。我在收水声，不收人声。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers the recorder to her side without pressing any buttons and listens towards the water.
beats.chinese: 她把录音机垂到身侧，没有按任何按钮，继续侧耳听着水声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's stopped already. You don't need to keep quiet.
beats.chinese: 已经停着了，你不用特意保持安静。

choices.english: What sound were you trying to catch?
choices.chinese: 你刚才具体想录什么声音？

choices.english: I'd like a quiet moment here.
choices.chinese: 我想在这里安静一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Pippa turns slightly towards the water. The recorder stays lowered and stopped.
beats.chinese: Pippa 微微转向水面。录音机仍然放低着，没有录音。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That little double splash. I'm an apprentice audio editor for accessible audiobooks. I spend all day removing little noises, then come here to collect them.
beats.chinese: 就是那种连着两下的小水声。我在做无障碍有声书的音频剪辑学徒。白天一直删小杂音，出来又收集这些声音。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She hums two notes without seeming to notice, then catches herself and laughs.
beats.chinese: 她不自觉地哼了两个音，随后反应过来，笑出了声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, there I go. There's probably a lovely recording of me humming over the water. My flatmate gets that for free.
beats.chinese: 哎，又来了。录音里八成全是我伴着水声哼歌。我室友天天免费听这个。

choices.english: Can I hear a little of your recording?
choices.chinese: 我能听一小段你的录音吗？

choices.english: No playback for me. I'll just listen to the water for a moment.
choices.chinese: 我就不听回放了，在这儿听一会儿水声就好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Pippa switches off the stopped recorder and puts it in her bag. Her fingers tap once against the strap.
beats.chinese: Pippa把已经停录的机器关机，收进包里，手指在包带上敲了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I get fidgety when it's completely silent. Water's doing plenty of work here, though.
beats.chinese: 当然。四周一点声音都没有时，我会坐立不安。不过这里有水声，够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She listens without starting another explanation, then glances farther along the waterfront.
beats.chinese: 她没有继续解释，听了一会儿水声，朝更前面的滨水步道望去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give you some room.
beats.chinese: 我给你留点空间。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll stay here for a moment.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。我想在这里待一会儿。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll keep walking.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我继续往前走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Pippa selects a short section and plays it quietly through the recorder's speaker. Two soft splashes are followed by a distinctly tuneless hum.
beats.chinese: Pippa 选了一小段，用录音机的扬声器轻轻播放。两声柔和的水响之后，传来一段明显跑调的哼唱。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yep. That's me. The water was doing perfectly well until I joined in.
beats.chinese: 没错，是我。水本来唱得好好的，直到我也加入。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She grins, stops the playback after a few seconds and puts the recorder away.
beats.chinese: 她咧嘴笑了，几秒后关掉回放，把录音机收起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, recording finished. I'm going to walk for a bit. Enjoy the waterfront!
beats.chinese: 好，录音结束。我去走一会儿。祝你在水边逛得愉快！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Pippa puts the recorder in her bag. Water taps against the edge below the public path.
beats.chinese: Pippa 把录音机放进包里。步道下方，水轻轻拍着岸边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. No buttons needed for that.
beats.chinese: 好啊。这个倒不用按什么按钮。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She listens for a few seconds, briefly pursing her lips when another hum nearly escapes. Then she turns back towards the water.
beats.chinese: 她听了几秒，又差点哼出声，赶紧抿了一下嘴，随后转身面向水面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave you to it. I'm staying here a little longer. Bye!
beats.chinese: 那我就不打扰你听了。我还会在这儿待一小会儿。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Pippa settles the bag strap on her shoulder, leaving the recorder inside.
beats.chinese: Pippa 把包带在肩上理好，录音机留在包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. I'll have a wander farther along.
beats.chinese: 好啊。我沿着步道再逛逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives you a small wave and starts along the same public path, away from your spot.
beats.chinese: 她朝你轻轻挥手，沿着同一条公共步道走开，把这处位置留给你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good day!
beats.chinese: 祝你今天愉快！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the public path. Pippa stays where she is, with her recorder packed away.
beats.chinese: 你沿公共步道继续往前走。Pippa 留在原地，录音机仍收在包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No worries. Bye!
beats.chinese: 没问题。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shifts her bag out of the passing space and turns towards the water, tapping a quiet rhythm against her leg.
beats.chinese: 她把包挪到不妨碍通行的位置，转向水面，用手指轻轻在腿上打着节拍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And thanks for saying.
beats.chinese: 也谢谢你直接告诉我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At North Wharf in Wynyard Quarter, Pippa Ngatai recognises you while reading her flatmates' karaoke messages.
beats.chinese: 在温亚德码头区North Wharf，Pippa Ngatai看合租伙伴的卡拉OK消息时认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. They've picked tonight's songs. I've volunteered for one chorus. A realistic contribution.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。他们选好了今晚唱的歌。我自愿唱一段副歌。这个贡献比较现实。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She listens privately through one earbud to a practice clip, winces with a smile and pauses it before putting the phone away.
beats.chinese: 她用一只耳机私下听了自己的练习片段，笑着皱皱脸，暂停后收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right words, mostly. Tune's another matter. They'll join in, thank goodness. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 歌词大体没错，调子另说。幸好他们也会一起唱。散步愉快。

causality.presenceReason: Pippa 自行来到 North Wharf，为个人声音收藏采集岸边水声。接触发生时，手持录音机已经停止。
causality.placeAttitude: 她喜欢这里可细听的水声，把此处当作业余采声和散步的地方，也可以主动选择只听而不录。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留下的任务，采声是个人爱好，可随时收起设备或沿原步道走动。
causality.currentGoal: 留意连续两下的拍水声，为个人收藏寻找片段，同时不妨碍通行、不把与玩家的交谈录进去。
causality.currentState: 录音已停止，愿谈自己的声音收藏，对完全安静不自在，但不把这种不适变成玩家必须陪聊的义务。
causality.contactTrigger: 她本来就站在不挡人的位置，设备已停止。听见连续两下拍水声后，她笑出声，朝附近玩家解释这声音像有人接话，并说明自己在收水声、不收人声。玩家没有被预设为让路、配合或提供帮助。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留有声书音频剪辑学徒、奥克兰生活史、温暖跳跃语气、声音收藏、跑调哼唱及全静音时不自在。安静请求得到空间，采音器材不成为另一套重复的删录音事件。重逢是与合租伙伴卡拉OK的私人期待。
causality.reactionAndChange: a讨论自己的采音与跑调哼唱。aa应请求回放自己的片段后准备散步，ab应玩家选择收机，共听片刻再结束交流，自己仍留下。b听到安静请求后收机，说明自己对全静音不自在，但可听水声。ba玩家留下，她往前走。bb玩家继续走，她留原处听水。
causality.spatialContinuity: 初遇时她始终位于 North Wharf 岸上公共步道不妨碍通行的位置，不再通过让路触发接触。所有分支和重逢均使用同一条岸上公共步道及临水位置，不进入旧港区设施或新增空间。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Pippa Ngatai。本次重逢位于温亚德码头街区，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At North Wharf in Wynyard Quarter, Margaret Ashford waits on the public walkway beside the water. The retired film-poster screen printer has arrived early to meet her sister for a walk.
beats.chinese: 在温亚德码头街区的 North Wharf，Margaret Ashford 正等在水边的公共步道上。这位退休电影海报丝网印刷师提前到了，要和姐姐碰面散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here's looking at you, Mr Bond.
beats.chinese: 敬你，邦德先生。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Margaret turns from the water, notices you nearby and gives a small, apologetic wave. She stays clear of the walking route.
beats.chinese: Margaret 从水面转过头，发现你就在附近，便略带歉意地挥了挥手。她站在不妨碍通行的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, I was talking to myself. Casablanca, every word. I'm Margaret. Just waiting for my sister.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，我在自言自语。《卡萨布兰卡》，一个字都没错。我叫 Margaret，正在等我姐姐。

choices.english: I think it's “kid”, not “Mr Bond”.
choices.chinese: 我记得是“kid”，不是“邦德先生”。

choices.english: No worries. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 没关系。那我就不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Margaret lifts one finger, ready to defend the line, then pauses.
beats.chinese: Margaret 竖起一根手指，正要为那句台词辩护，却又停了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, I'm sure it's Bond... Oh, now you've made me hear both versions.
beats.chinese: 不，我肯定是邦德……哎呀，你这么一说，我脑子里两个版本都有了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes out her own phone and opens the browser.
beats.chinese: 她拿出自己的手机，打开浏览器。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll check it properly before I agree. My memory sounds terribly convincing, even to me.
beats.chinese: 我得查清楚了才能认同。我的记忆听着特别有说服力，连我自己都信。

choices.english: Go on, check it.
choices.chinese: 好呀，查查吧。

choices.english: We can leave it there. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 不用纠结这个了。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Margaret lowers her hand without trying to keep your attention.
beats.chinese: Margaret 放下手，没有试图继续留住你的注意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Enjoy the waterfront.
beats.chinese: 当然。好好逛逛水边吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her phone buzzes. Her sister is a few minutes away. Margaret sends a quick reply and puts it away.
beats.chinese: 她的手机振了一下。姐姐发消息说还要几分钟。Margaret 简短回复后收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A few more minutes to myself. I'll save the next performance for my sister.
beats.chinese: 还能自己待几分钟。下一场表演就留给我姐姐吧。

choices.english: Enjoy your walk. I'll keep going.
choices.chinese: 祝你散步愉快。我继续走了。

choices.english: Actually, give me one more line.
choices.chinese: 不过，再来一句吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Margaret reads the quotation on her phone, then lets out a short laugh.
beats.chinese: Margaret 看着手机上的台词，随即笑出了声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Kid. You're right. I've put James Bond in Rick's café without even buying him a drink.
beats.chinese: 是 kid。你说得对。我把詹姆斯·邦德塞进了里克的咖啡馆，连杯酒都没请他喝。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the page and pockets her phone, then turns back toward the water to wait.
beats.chinese: 她关掉页面，把手机放回口袋，转身面向水面继续等人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thirty years printing film posters. You'd think I'd remember who was in them. Thanks for the chat. Enjoy your day.
beats.chinese: 印了三十年电影海报，照理说该记得里面都有谁。谢谢你陪我聊这几句。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Margaret stops before entering a search. The quotation remains unchecked.
beats.chinese: Margaret 还没输入搜索内容就停下了。那句台词暂时没有得到核实。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. We'll leave that one unconfirmed.
beats.chinese: 好，那这句就暂且存疑吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the phone away and gives you a cheerful wave as you carry on along the public walkway.
beats.chinese: 她收起手机。你沿公共步道继续走，她笑着向你挥手道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I run a monthly film-mix-up night. Usually I manage to wait until there's an audience. Bye now!
beats.chinese: 我每个月都办一次电影混搭猜谜夜。通常我还能忍到观众到场再开始。再见啦！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the walkway. Margaret remains where she is, leaving room for people to pass.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道继续往前走。Margaret 留在原地，给过路的人留出空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. We will.
beats.chinese: 谢谢，我们会好好散步的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives a brief wave, then turns toward someone approaching. Her sister waves back and stops beside her.
beats.chinese: 她简短地挥手道别，随后转向一个走近的人。姐姐向她挥了挥手，在她身旁停下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you are! I was early. You ought to write that down.
beats.chinese: 你来啦！我今天可是先到的。你该把这事记下来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Margaret turns back with a broad grin, keeping the walkway clear.
beats.chinese: Margaret 咧嘴笑着转回来，依然没有挡住步道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: May the shark be with you. Jaws, obviously.
beats.chinese: 愿鲨鱼与你同在。显然是《大白鲨》。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She starts to nod with certainty, stops halfway and laughs. She raises a hand in farewell.
beats.chinese: 她正要笃定地点头，点到一半就停住，笑了起来。她抬起手向你道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, I've put Star Wars in it. My sister gets a whole evening of this every month. That's your short version. Enjoy your day!
beats.chinese: 不对，我把《星球大战》掺进去了。我姐姐每个月都得听我这么讲一整晚。你这份是短版。祝你今天愉快！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At North Wharf in Wynyard Quarter, you see Margaret waiting for her sister at the side of the public walkway. She recognizes you, still studying a spot of ink on her fingertip.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到温亚德码头街区的 North Wharf，你看见 Margaret 在公共步道一侧等姐姐。她认出了你，目光还停留在指尖的一点油墨上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again! This little bit of ink's been on my finger since this morning. Still makes me smile.
beats.chinese: 哎呀，又见面啦！这点油墨从早上就留在我手指上。现在看着还是高兴。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers her hand. The colour on this morning's proof came out just as she wanted.
beats.chinese: 她放下手。今天上午那张试印样张的颜色，正合她的心意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My sister's not here yet. I'm happy to wait a bit longer. Enjoy your walk!
beats.chinese: 我姐姐还没到。我愿意再等一会儿。祝你散步愉快！

causality.presenceReason: Margaret 提前到 North Wharf，等姐姐碰面散步，玩家出现前就有独立安排。

causality.stayingConstraint: 她需要留在约定地点等姐姐，不跟随玩家，也不占用通行路线。
causality.currentGoal: 等人时随口回想电影台词，并在受到纠正后决定是否当场查证。
causality.currentState: 今天心情轻快、话多，对自己的电影记忆过分自信，但没有要求陌生人陪聊。
causality.contactTrigger: 她朝水面念出的台词用了第二人称，发现附近有人后主动说明不是在对玩家说话，并作自我介绍。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留退休海报丝网印刷师身份、电影混记、先辩半句再查证的习惯，以及查明后自然自嘲的反应。重逢时，她为上午试印得到满意的颜色而高兴，体现她对印刷工作的准确要求，不延伸成技术讲解或招揽。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 当场查证并承认记错，结束短聊后继续等人。ab 接受不再查证，保留疑问并向离开的玩家道别。ba 不挽留玩家，随后与姐姐会合。bb 应玩家主动要求再说一句，自己发现混片并以短笑话结束交流。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全部行动发生在 North Wharf 水边公共步道上，只有站立、转身、使用随身手机及步道内通行，没有增设设施或进入水面。重逢时她站在步道一侧等姐姐，端详指尖后放下手，始终不妨碍通行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: It is Saturday at Ōtara Markets, where stalls stand across the car park. Tavita Faleolo has come to restock his home pantry. He stops between the stalls, crosses coconut buns off his list, then holds his pen above that same line.
beats.chinese: 周六，奥塔拉市集的棚摊铺开在停车场上。Tavita Faleolo 来给家里的食品柜补货。他在棚摊间停下，把清单上的椰蓉包划掉，笔却又悬在了那一行上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The thing I want most, and I've crossed it off first. They were lovely. I just want to wait a bit before having them again.
beats.chinese: 最想吃的，倒先给我划掉了。上次吃着真好。我就是想再等等，过些日子再吃。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances up at you nearby with a small smile, then lowers the pen.
beats.chinese: 他抬头看看站在附近的你，微微一笑，把笔放低。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Anyway, that's enough explaining from me. You didn't ask for the story behind my shopping list.
beats.chinese: 好了，我就不多解释了。你也没问我这张购物清单背后的故事。

choices.english: Do you always bring a list?
choices.chinese: 你买东西总带清单吗？

choices.english: I'll leave you to your shopping.
choices.chinese: 那不耽误你买东西了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tavita smooths the list against his bag. One item has been crossed out twice.
beats.chinese: Tavita 在购物袋上把清单抚平。其中一项被划了两道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Usually. I keep ingredients in stock at a baking school, so I get carried away at home. Though the coconut buns weren't exactly essential.
beats.chinese: 一般都带。我在烘焙学校管食材库存，回了家也容易来这套。不过，椰蓉包倒算不上必需品。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He runs a thumb over the crossed-out item, looks towards the stalls, then looks back at the list. He folds it and slips it into his shirt pocket.
beats.chinese: 他的拇指划过被勾掉的那一项，朝棚摊望望，又低头看清单。他把清单折好，塞进衬衫口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Loved them two weeks ago. Put them down, crossed them off, put them back. I've spent more time deciding than I'd spend eating one.
beats.chinese: 两周前吃过，真喜欢。写上，划掉，又写上。决定买不买花的时间，都够吃完一个了。

choices.english: Do you actually feel like having one today?
choices.chinese: 那你今天到底想不想吃一个？

choices.english: You can leave them crossed out. What else is on the list?
choices.chinese: 划掉也没关系。清单上还有什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tavita puts his pen away and folds the list.
beats.chinese: Tavita 收起笔，把清单折好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Still got a few things to get.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我还有几样东西要买。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips the list into his shirt pocket and shifts his bag away from the space between you.
beats.chinese: 他把清单塞进衬衫口袋，将购物袋挪到另一侧，不再占着你们之间的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll let you get on. I've already stood here long enough talking myself out of a very good bun.
beats.chinese: 不耽误你了。我已经在这儿站了半天，劝自己别买一个特别好吃的面包。

choices.english: What's wrong with buying it if it's that good?
choices.chinese: 那么好吃，买一个有什么问题？

choices.english: Enjoy your shopping. Give him a wave and continue through the market.
choices.chinese: 祝你逛得开心。挥挥手，继续逛市集。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tavita looks towards the stalls again. This time he leaves the list folded.
beats.chinese: Tavita 又朝棚摊望去。这次，他没有再展开清单。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I do, actually. I've been checking how long it's been instead of whether I want one.
beats.chinese: 想。还真想。我一直在算隔了多久，倒没想自己到底想不想吃。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He settles the bag on his shoulder and turns towards the stalls, ending his debate with the paper still in his pocket.
beats.chinese: 他把购物袋背稳，转身朝棚摊走去。清单还留在口袋里，他总算不再跟它来回商量。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll see if they've got one. Thanks for the chat. Enjoy your morning.
beats.chinese: 我去看看还有没有。谢谢你陪我聊几句。祝你上午过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tavita unfolds the list, leaving the coconut buns crossed out. His finger moves down to the remaining items.
beats.chinese: Tavita 展开清单，没再改动划掉的椰蓉包。他的手指往下移，找到剩下几项。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cooking oil, onions, garlic. The boring things I somehow forget while remembering every bun I've ever eaten.
beats.chinese: 食用油、洋葱、大蒜。这些不起眼的东西我偏偏会忘，吃过的面包倒是个个记得。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the paper with those three items facing out and starts along the stalls to continue his shopping.
beats.chinese: 他把那三项折到纸的外侧，沿着棚摊继续买东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave the buns for another visit. Good talking to you. Better get these before I come home with garlic and nothing else.
beats.chinese: 椰蓉包留着改天吃。跟你聊天很开心。我得去把这些买齐，免得最后只带着大蒜回家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tavita pauses before turning away. He gives a small shake of his head, smiling.
beats.chinese: Tavita 在转身前停下来，笑着轻轻摇头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nothing wrong with it. They really were lovely. I just like leaving a bit of time before having a favourite again.
beats.chinese: 没什么问题。它们真的很好吃。我只是喜欢隔些日子，再吃自己特别喜欢的东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His hand briefly returns to the folded list, then drops to his side. He turns his attention back to the market.
beats.chinese: 他的手又碰了一下折好的清单，随即垂下，注意力重新回到市集。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There I go, explaining a whole bun policy to someone I've just met. I'll leave it today. Have a good wander.
beats.chinese: 瞧我，刚认识就把买面包的整套讲究都说出来了。今天先不买了。祝你逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You wave and continue through the market. Tavita stays clear of your route, his list safely in his pocket.
beats.chinese: 你挥挥手，继续逛市集。Tavita 没有挡着你的路，清单稳稳地收在口袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Good talking to you.
beats.chinese: 你也是。跟你聊得很开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He returns the wave, then turns towards the stalls and takes out his list with both hands.
beats.chinese: 他也挥挥手，随后转向棚摊，用两只手拿出了清单。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Back to the list.
beats.chinese: 好，接着看清单。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another Saturday at Ōtara Markets, Tavita Faleolo is checking a bag of tomatoes beside the stalls, clear of passing shoppers. He notices you and smiles in recognition.
beats.chinese: 又一个周六，在奥塔拉市集，Tavita Faleolo 正在棚摊旁检查一袋番茄，没有挡着来往的顾客。他看见你，认出来后笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello, good to see you. That's everything bought for the family barbecue. Tomatoes were the last thing on my list.
beats.chinese: 你好，很高兴见到你。家里烧烤要用的东西都买齐了。番茄是清单上最后一样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Looking pleased, he gathers the handles and settles the bag securely in his hand. He turns to continue along the stalls.
beats.chinese: 他满意地拢好提手，把袋子拿稳，转身准备沿着棚摊继续走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now I'm looking forward to getting home and taking our time with the prep. I won't add anything else today. Enjoy your morning. See you.
beats.chinese: 现在就盼着回家，跟家里人慢慢准备。今天不再添东西了。祝你上午过得愉快，回头见。

causality.presenceReason: Tavita 在玩家出现前已于周六来到奥塔拉市集，给自家食品柜补货，清单上有油、洋葱和大蒜，也写过想吃的椰蓉包。
causality.placeAttitude: 他喜欢这里吃过的椰蓉包，也享受买食材，但今天为是否过早重吃而犹豫。这种犹豫不影响他对食物的真诚赞美。
causality.stayingConstraint: 尚未买齐清单上的日常食材，没有必须留住玩家的理由，也没有强制停留的外部限制。玩家可以接话，也可以礼貌结束。
causality.currentGoal: 决定今天是否买椰蓉包，再继续完成自己的日常采购。
causality.currentState: 心情温和、时间不紧，对想吃的东西有兴趣，却已经因反复权衡耽搁了一会儿。他愿意随口聊两句，也会意识到自己解释过多并收住。
causality.contactTrigger: 他在周六停车场市集的棚摊间停下，把椰蓉包从清单上划掉，笔又悬在同一行上，主动向附近玩家感叹自己把最想吃的先划掉了，随后收住解释。接触不再依赖风吹纸张、捡拾或玩家让位。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留 Māngere 成长经历、奥克兰生活、萨摩亚裔新西兰人身份、烘焙学校食材库管工作、大家庭周日聚餐经历与家庭采购习惯。保留他对美食的真诚热情、主动拉开重享间隔的偏好、被误解时容易解释过多的毛病，以及不干涉别人重复享用的边界。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家问清单习惯时，a 中他谈到工作和反复划掉椰蓉包，并把清单折好放进口袋。aa 中他承认当下确实想吃，独自转去看看是否有售。ab 中保留划线决定，按剩余清单继续采购。玩家表示不耽误采购时，b 中他收起笔和清单，礼貌结束话题。玩家若再问那么好吃为何不买，ba 中他解释喜爱与暂不重吃可以同时存在，说多后自行收住并结束交谈。bb 中他接受玩家离开，回应道别后继续看清单购物。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程使用周六停车场市集的棚摊区域，不新增座椅、柜台、道路入口或其他设施。清单、笔和购物袋均为个人采购随身物。人物停留和继续走动都不阻挡其他顾客，不需要进入新场景完成剧情。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Tavita Faleolo。本次重逢位于奥塔拉周六市集，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: It is Saturday at Ōtara Markets, with canopy stalls across the car park. Hemi Whitiora, a school costume-library manager, holds a small notebook beside a stall. They are waiting for a cousin to deliver an agreed payment in vegetables.
beats.chinese: 周六，奥塔拉市集的棚摊铺在停车场上。学校戏服库管理员 Hemi Whitiora 拿着一本小记事本，站在棚摊旁，等一位表亲送来谈好的报酬——一袋蔬菜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd like to wait here for someone. Are you stopping here too? I can stand on the other side.
beats.chinese: 我想在这儿等个人。你也要在这一小块停留吗？我可以站另一边。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hemi keeps the notebook in hand and looks towards you, leaving room for people to pass between the stalls.
beats.chinese: Hemi 手里仍拿着记事本，朝你看过来，留着摊位之间供人通行的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Hemi. Waiting for my cousin. They owe me some vegetables.
beats.chinese: 我叫 Hemi。在等表亲。对方欠我一袋菜。

choices.english: Owe you? Was there a deal?
choices.chinese: 欠你的？你们谈了什么条件吗？

choices.english: Thanks for asking. I'll just look around.
choices.chinese: 谢谢你先问一声。我随便看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hemi takes a pencil from their shoulder bag and opens the small notebook.
beats.chinese: Hemi 从肩包里拿出一支铅笔，翻开手里的小记事本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I carried an offer about a family boat. Forty percent and the trailer. Those were the words.
beats.chinese: 我替家里传了个关于船的提议。百分之四十，再加拖车。原话就是这样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They find an entry and rest the pencil beside it without making a mark.
beats.chinese: Hemi 翻到一条记录，把铅笔停在旁边，暂时没落笔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Vegetables were my fee. The boat's their business. I just take the offers back and forth.
beats.chinese: 蔬菜是我的报酬。船的事归他们。我只负责来回传条件。

choices.english: Would you pass on an apology as well?
choices.chinese: 那你也会帮忙转达道歉吗？

choices.english: Even family has to pay you?
choices.chinese: 连家里人也得付你报酬？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hemi stays beside the canopy stall while you look over the nearby stalls.
beats.chinese: 你打量附近的摊位，Hemi 留在棚摊旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 当然。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They open the notebook, check an entry, then take a pencil from their shoulder bag and tuck it inside the notebook.
beats.chinese: Hemi 翻开记事本，核对了一条记录，再从肩包里拿出铅笔，夹进本子里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My cousin knows to look for me here.
beats.chinese: 我表亲知道来这儿找我。

choices.english: Before I go, what do you do during the week?
choices.chinese: 走之前问一句，你平时做什么工作？

choices.english: Give a small wave and move along the stalls.
choices.chinese: 轻轻挥手，沿着摊位继续逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hemi leaves the pencil resting on the open notebook.
beats.chinese: Hemi 让铅笔停在摊开的记事本上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. Amounts, dates, who gets the boat. Apologies go direct.
beats.chinese: 不转。金额、日期、船归谁，这些我传。道歉得本人去说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their cousin arrives and holds out a bag of vegetables. Hemi accepts it, checks the contents and puts a tick beside the entry.
beats.chinese: 那位表亲到了，递来一袋蔬菜。Hemi 接过袋子，看了看里面的东西，在那条记录旁打了个勾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. My part's settled. Enjoy your morning.
beats.chinese: 好了。我这份结清了。祝你上午逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hemi looks up from the entry, keeping one finger on the page.
beats.chinese: Hemi 从记录上抬起眼睛，一根手指还按在那页纸上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Family usually takes longer. Yes.
beats.chinese: 家里人的事通常更费时间。对，也得付。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They close the notebook and put it into their own shoulder bag. They remain beside the canopy, waiting for their cousin.
beats.chinese: Hemi合上记事本，装进自己的肩包。他们仍在棚摊旁等表亲。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Still waiting for my cousin. Then onions. That's my next bit of business. Have a good morning.
beats.chinese: 还得等表亲来。然后买洋葱，接下来忙这个。祝你上午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hemi lowers the notebook and turns back towards you.
beats.chinese: Hemi 放低记事本，重新转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I run a costume library at a secondary school. Part-time. Mostly just me and the repairs.
beats.chinese: 我在一所中学管戏服库。兼职。大多时候，就我一个人，还有那些要修补的衣服。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They smooth a loose thread against their own cuff, then put the notebook back in the bag.
beats.chinese: Hemi 把自己袖口的一根线头捋平，再把记事本放回包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've been retiring the eighties prom dresses for years. A few refuse to go. Anyway, enjoy your look round.
beats.chinese: 我让那些八十年代的舞会裙退役，都退了好些年了。还有几件不肯走。好了，你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You wave and continue along the canopy stalls. Hemi stays where their cousin can find them.
beats.chinese: 你挥挥手，沿着棚摊继续往前逛。Hemi 留在原处，方便表亲找到。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye, then.
beats.chinese: 那，再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hemi returns the wave, then looks across the canopy stalls with the notebook still in hand.
beats.chinese: Hemi 也挥了挥手，随后望向棚摊之间，手里仍拿着记事本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mind how you go.
beats.chinese: 慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another Saturday at Ōtara Markets, Hemi stands beside a canopy stall, holding a closed notebook with a pencil tucked inside. They recognise you and lift a hand in greeting.
beats.chinese: 另一个周六，在奥塔拉市集，Hemi 站在棚摊旁，手里拿着合上的小本，里面夹着一支铅笔。认出你后，Hemi 抬手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Someone owes me a bag of vegetables. Today they asked to pick up onions for me next week instead. Fine by me.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。有人欠我一袋菜。今天问能不能改成下周替我买洋葱。我没意见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hemi types a reply on their phone, asking for the quantity and delivery time in writing first. The pencil stays tucked inside the closed notebook. They leave the debt uncrossed.
beats.chinese: Hemi 用手机回复，要求先写清洋葱的数量和交付时间。铅笔仍夹在合上的小本里，这笔账还没销。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: How they pay is negotiable. Get it clear first. I'm staying here for the reply. Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 怎么付可以商量，先说清楚。我还在这儿等回复，你慢慢逛。

causality.presenceReason: Hemi 在周六的奥塔拉市集等表亲，用一袋蔬菜收取传递家庭财产提议的报酬，也打算买洋葱。
causality.placeAttitude: 把市集当作办私事和买菜的普通地方，没有主动结交陌生人的计划，也不预设玩家来此购物。
causality.stayingConstraint: 已约好在棚摊旁等表亲，需要留在对方能找到的位置，但可以在同一小块区域换边站。
causality.currentGoal: 等表亲交付蔬菜，核对后在小本上销账，再处理自己的采购。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: It is Saturday at Ōtara Markets. Kai Parata has come to buy vegetables for a whānau lunch. They stop beside a parking-lot stall near you, holding a folded shopping list with the handwritten quiz scores facing themself.
beats.chinese: 周六，奥塔拉市集正在营业。Kai Parata 来买大家庭聚餐要用的蔬菜。他们在你附近的停车场棚摊旁停下，手里始终拿着折好的购物单，手写的问答赛比分朝着自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey, I'm still annoyed about losing last night's pub quiz. Fancy a quick question before I get the shopping? No worries if you're not keen.
beats.chinese: 嘿，昨晚酒吧问答赛输了，我现在还不服。买菜前想来一道快问快答吗？不玩也没事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kai turns the paper over to the vegetable list. They keep it in their hand, with an empty shopping bag hanging from their wrist.
beats.chinese: Kai 把纸翻到写着蔬菜清单的那面，仍拿在手里，手腕上挂着一个空购物袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Still need kūmara, onions and cabbage for lunch with the whānau. Can't spend all morning on a rematch.
beats.chinese: 还得买红薯、洋葱和卷心菜，给家里人准备午饭。不能一上午都忙着再比一次。

choices.english: What happened at the quiz?
choices.chinese: 问答赛怎么了？

choices.english: Why not ask your friends for a rematch?
choices.chinese: 为什么不找朋友再比一次？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kai turns the score towards themself. Their finger stops beside a number that has been underlined twice.
beats.chinese: Kai 把记分的那面转向自己，手指停在一个画了两道下划线的数字旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lost the individual round by one. Some stranger called Trev. I remembered the answer on the way home, obviously.
beats.chinese: 个人赛差一分输了。赢的是个叫 Trev 的陌生人。当然，回家路上我就想起答案了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They fold the score out of sight, then lift an empty hand with a sudden grin.
beats.chinese: 他们把比分折到里面，忽然咧嘴一笑，抬起空着的那只手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fancy one round of rock-paper-scissors? One round. I could use a win.
beats.chinese: 来一局石头剪刀布？就一局。我正想赢一次呢。

choices.english: Agree to one round. Throw rock on three.
choices.chinese: 答应玩一局，数到三时出石头。

choices.english: No game for me. Good luck with the vegetables.
choices.chinese: 我就不玩了。祝你买菜顺利。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kai's phone buzzes. They check the message while keeping the shopping list pinched between two fingers.
beats.chinese: Kai 的手机振了一下。他们用两根手指夹着购物单，看了眼消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Funny you ask. Here's my mate asking for a rematch after lunch. Nah.
beats.chinese: 你问得真巧。正好，朋友问我午饭后要不要再比一次。不来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kai types a short refusal. Their smile returns as another message arrives, but they shake their head.
beats.chinese: Kai 打了一条简短的拒绝消息。又一条消息到了，他们重新笑起来，却摇了摇头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't go all out against close mates. They want me to. We've had this argument over about six different games.
beats.chinese: 跟好朋友比，我就是不肯使全力。他们偏想让我认真。换了差不多六种游戏，我们还在争这个。

choices.english: I can see why they'd want your best game.
choices.chinese: 我能理解他们为什么想让你认真比。

choices.english: I'll leave that argument to you lot. What's on the shopping list?
choices.chinese: 这个还是留给你们自己争吧。购物单上有什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On three, your rock beats Kai's scissors. Kai holds the losing gesture for an extra second.
beats.chinese: 数到三，你的石头赢了 Kai 的剪刀。Kai 的手保持着输掉的手势，又停了一秒。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One–nil to you. Ah, come on.
beats.chinese: 你一比零赢了。哎，不是吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their grin disappears. They press a sharp crease into the list, glance at your hand, then give you a small farewell nod.
beats.chinese: 他们的笑容消失了，用力把购物单折出一道硬痕，瞥了眼你的手，随后朝你轻轻点头道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You won. Fair enough. I'm off to buy onions and be annoyed about that.
beats.chinese: 你赢了，没话说。我买洋葱去了，顺便生会儿闷气。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kai lowers their hand immediately and opens the list with the vegetables facing up.
beats.chinese: Kai 立刻放下手，展开购物单，让写着蔬菜的那面朝上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All good. Saved yourself a very intense three seconds.
beats.chinese: 没事。你省下了特别紧张的三秒钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck their phone away and turn towards the stalls, leaving the route past them clear.
beats.chinese: 他们收好手机，转向棚摊，没有挡住你经过的路线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, lunch for the whānau. Better actually buy something. See you.
beats.chinese: 好了，还得给家里人准备午饭。该正经买点东西了。回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kai looks down at the unfinished reply. Their thumb pauses, but they do not delete the refusal.
beats.chinese: Kai 低头看着尚未发出的回复，拇指停了下来，却没有删掉拒绝的话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah. They've said that too. I tell them before we start. They hate it anyway.
beats.chinese: 嗯，他们也这么说。开始前我就会讲清楚，可他们照样不乐意。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They send the message, pocket the phone and fold the shopping list into a narrow strip.
beats.chinese: 他们发出消息，把手机放进口袋，再将购物单折成长条。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Still going for lunch with them. Just no rematch. Anyway, I'd better get these vegetables. See you.
beats.chinese: 午饭还是要一起吃的，就是不再比了。好了，我得买这些菜去了。回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kai puts the phone away without replying and turns the list so the vegetable names are easy to see.
beats.chinese: Kai 没有回复，收起手机，把购物单转过来，让上面的菜名清楚地露出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Kūmara, onions, cabbage. I turn and brush cheese wheels at a little creamery in Kumeū all week. Today I'm on vegetables.
beats.chinese: 红薯、洋葱、卷心菜。我平时在库梅乌一家小乳酪坊给整轮奶酪翻面、刷表皮。今天负责蔬菜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They check the empty shopping bag over their wrist, then fold the list with the quiz scores hidden inside.
beats.chinese: 他们检查了一下挂在手腕上的空购物袋，把问答赛的比分折到购物单里面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Apprentice cheese cave attendant. Actual job title, yeah. Right, cabbage first. Have a good one.
beats.chinese: 奶酪熟成窖管理员学徒。对，真是这个职位名称。好了，先买卷心菜。祝你逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later Saturday at Ōtara Markets, Kai Parata is among the parking-lot stalls with a full shopping bag. They recognise you while shifting its weight from one hand to the other.
beats.chinese: 另一个周六，在奥塔拉市集停车场的棚摊之间，Kai Parata 提着装满的购物袋。他们正换手提袋，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey, good to see you. I've bought enough kūmara to regret bringing one bag.
beats.chinese: 嘿，见到你真好。我买了太多红薯，已经后悔只带一个袋子了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kai gathers both handles firmly into one hand and tests the weight. The bag stays closed.
beats.chinese: Kai 用一只手牢牢拢住两根提带，试了试重量。袋口没有松开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yep, I've got it. No more shopping for me. Enjoy your morning.
beats.chinese: 行，提得住。我可不能再买了。祝你上午逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Saturday's Ōtara Markets, Ashwin Patel waits beside a canopy stall for their aunt. Their shopping list has a printed pixel figure on the reverse, with one boot redrawn several times.
beats.chinese: 周六的奥塔拉市集，Ashwin Patel在棚摊旁等姨妈。购物清单背面印着像素小人，一只靴子重画了好几遍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ten minutes on one boot. My aunt's managed half the market in that time.
beats.chinese: 一只靴子就看了十分钟。同样这会儿，我姨妈都逛完半个市集了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lower the paper and glance towards the canopy stalls where their aunt is browsing.
beats.chinese: 他们放低纸，朝姨妈正在逛的那片棚摊望去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The shopping list is on the other side. I'm Ashwin, by the way.
beats.chinese: 购物清单在另一面。对了，我叫Ashwin。

choices.english: Is that a game character?
choices.chinese: 那是游戏角色吗？

choices.english: Your aunt sounds quicker at this than you.
choices.chinese: 听起来你姨妈动作比你快多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ashwin turns the drawing upright. Small squares around one boot have been crossed out and redrawn.
beats.chinese: Ashwin把画着图案的一面转正。小人一只靴子周围的几格方块被划掉重画过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: An old game sprite. I restore them for fun. That boot has taken rather more of my weekend than it deserves.
beats.chinese: 一个老游戏的精灵图。我修复这些图案，纯粹是爱好。那只靴子占掉的周末时间实在有点多。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their phone vibrates. They read a message, then stop turning the sheet.
beats.chinese: 手机震了一下。他们读完消息，转动纸片的手停住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Our bowls group has decided Tuesday's practice game counts towards the total. We finished it already.
beats.chinese: 我们草地滚球那群人决定，把周二的练习赛算进总分。那场早就打完了。

choices.english: Does counting it change the result?
choices.chinese: 算进去会改变结果吗？

choices.english: I'll leave the bowls to you. Can I see the drawing once more?
choices.chinese: 滚球的事就交给你自己处理吧。我能再看一眼那幅画吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ashwin nods and turns the sheet over to the shopping list.
beats.chinese: Ashwin点点头，把纸翻到购物清单那一面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She knows what she's looking for. I've got the list. Rhubarb next, once she's ready.
beats.chinese: 她知道要看什么。清单在我这里，等她好了，下一样买大黄。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They fold the drawing inward and tuck the sheet beneath their tote's handle.
beats.chinese: 他们把画折在里面，将纸压到手提袋的提手下面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My aunt is browsing. I've got the list, so she can take as long as she likes.
beats.chinese: 我姨妈还在逛。清单在我这里，她想逛多久都行。

choices.english: Is the rhubarb for cooking?
choices.chinese: 大黄是买来做吃的吗？

choices.english: Enjoy your morning. [Continue through the market.]
choices.chinese: 祝你上午愉快。[继续逛市集。]

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ashwin checks the earlier messages in the group conversation, scrolling back to Tuesday.
beats.chinese: Ashwin翻看群聊里的旧消息，一直翻到周二。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I'd move up one place. We agreed it was practice. It stays practice.
beats.chinese: 会。我能上升一名。说好是练习赛。那就还是练习赛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They type a reply, reread it, then add the date of the original agreement. Their thumb hovers before they send it.
beats.chinese: 他们打好回复，重读一遍，又添上原先约定的日期。拇指停了一下，才按下发送。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've probably made their morning a little tedious. Thank you for stopping. I'll let you get on.
beats.chinese: 我大概把他们这个上午弄得有点烦了。谢谢你停下来聊。你继续逛吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ashwin pockets the phone without replying and holds the drawing where you can see it.
beats.chinese: Ashwin没回消息，把手机收进口袋，将画举到你能看清的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Certainly. Sixteen pixels across. I printed it larger so I could mark the damaged bits.
beats.chinese: 当然。横向十六个像素。我把它放大打印了，方便标出损坏的地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After a brief look, Ashwin folds the sheet and slips it fully into their tote. They turn their attention back towards the stalls.
beats.chinese: 让你看了片刻后，Ashwin折起纸，把它完整地收进手提袋，重新望向棚摊。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough attention for one tiny boot. Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 一只小靴子，得到这些关注也够了。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ashwin turns the folded list to the word 'rhubarb' and nods.
beats.chinese: Ashwin把折好的清单翻到写着“大黄”的地方，点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Rhubarb and vanilla jam. I run a small shop in Grey Lynn. My aunt got me started with her market stall.
beats.chinese: 做大黄香草果酱。我在Grey Lynn开了一家小店。当初就是跟着姨妈摆市集摊位入的行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their aunt returns through the stalls and raises a hand. Ashwin lifts the tote and turns to meet her.
beats.chinese: 姨妈从摊位间回来，抬手招呼。Ashwin提起袋子，转身迎向她。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There she is. We're shopping together for once. Lovely talking to you.
beats.chinese: 她来了。我们难得一起买东西。很高兴和你聊了几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue through the market, Ashwin lifts a hand in farewell.
beats.chinese: 你继续往市集里走，Ashwin抬手道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. You too.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。也祝你愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They notice the paper slipping and push it right down into the tote before settling back beside the canopy.
beats.chinese: 他们发现纸片在往下滑，便把它彻底塞进袋里，重新站回棚边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. It can stay in there.
beats.chinese: 好了。就在里面待着吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another Saturday at Ōtara Markets, Ashwin recognises you beside the canopy stalls and puts their phone away.
beats.chinese: 另一个周六，在奥塔拉市集的棚摊旁，Ashwin认出了你，把手机收了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. No shopping list today. I'm just looking at whatever my aunt picks out. We agreed before we left, so I'm happy to take my time.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天没有购物清单。姨妈挑什么，我就陪着看什么。出门前就说好了，我很愿意慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ashwin leaves their phone in their pocket. Their aunt raises a hand to them from among the same canopy stalls, and they lift a hand in reply.
beats.chinese: Ashwin没有再拿出手机。姨妈在同一片棚摊间朝他们招手，他们也抬手回应。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's my aunt. I'll go and join her. Good to see you. Enjoy your Saturday.
beats.chinese: 我姨妈在那儿。我过去陪她了。见到你真好。祝你周六愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Wale Street in Bo-Kaap, Sasha Petersen has paused during an off-duty walk beside the colourful houses. She is adding something to a pocket notebook when she notices you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在波卡普的韦尔街，Sasha Petersen下班后散步，走到彩色住宅旁停了下来。她正往随身小本子里添几笔，注意到你就在附近。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could a house sneeze? Oh, sorry. That was supposed to stay in my head. I'm Sasha.
beats.chinese: 房子会打喷嚏吗？啊，不好意思。这话本来只该在脑子里想想。我叫Sasha。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers the notebook and moves a little aside, keeping the pavement clear.
beats.chinese: 她放低本子，稍稍往旁边让了让，留出人行道上的通行空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm just out for a walk. Apparently I've brought my own conversation.
beats.chinese: 我只是出来散个步。看来连聊天对象都自己带了。

choices.english: What would come out when it sneezed?
choices.chinese: 那它打喷嚏会喷出什么？

choices.english: Is the notebook for work?
choices.chinese: 那个本子是工作用的吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sasha turns the notebook sideways in her hand. Her reply comes much faster now.
beats.chinese: Sasha把手里的本子横了过来，这回答得快多了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Paint, surely. One enormous sneeze and the whole street needs repainting. Although the windows would rattle first. There'd be a warning.
beats.chinese: 肯定是油漆啊。一个大喷嚏，整条街都得重刷。不过窗户应该会先响起来，算是个预警。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks up at the houses, then shakes her head at her own calculation.
beats.chinese: 她抬头看看房子，又对自己这番推算摇了摇头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I only wanted to work out the noise. Now I've created a maintenance problem.
beats.chinese: 我本来只想琢磨一下声音。结果给自己弄出个维修问题。

choices.english: I'd give it a giant tissue. No repainting needed.
choices.chinese: 我会给它一张巨型纸巾。这样就不用重刷了。

choices.english: How did you end up thinking about sneezing houses?
choices.chinese: 你怎么会想到房子打喷嚏的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sasha brings the notebook against her hoodie. Her shoulders tighten slightly.
beats.chinese: Sasha把本子贴到连帽衫前，肩膀微微绷紧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I record oral histories at a community archive. Apprentice.
beats.chinese: 不是。我在一家社区档案馆录口述历史。还是学徒。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the notebook with her thumb. The movement is sharper than it needs to be.
beats.chinese: 她用拇指合上本子，动作有点生硬。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd rather skip the job-and-life-plan questions.
beats.chinese: 我不太想聊工作啊、人生规划啊这类问题。

choices.english: I only meant the notebook. We can leave it there.
choices.chinese: 我只是问问本子。不聊这个也行。

choices.english: All right. I'll leave you to your walk.
choices.chinese: 好，那就不打扰你散步了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sasha opens the notebook again, grinning, and writes two words near the bottom of the page.
beats.chinese: Sasha笑着重新翻开本子，在页脚附近写了两个词。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Giant tissue. Yes. Though someone has to wash it, and I refuse to be on that committee.
beats.chinese: 巨型纸巾。行。不过总得有人洗，我拒绝加入那个委员会。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the notebook away and lifts a hand in farewell, staying beside the houses as she finishes laughing.
beats.chinese: 她收起本子，抬手道别，留在住宅旁，把剩下那点笑意笑完。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. That one's going into my collection. Thanks for the ridiculous minute. Take care.
beats.chinese: 好，这个得收进我的怪问题集里。谢谢你陪我胡扯这一分钟。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sasha glances at the nearest house, then back at her notebook.
beats.chinese: Sasha瞥了一眼最近的房子，又看回自己的本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I wondered how loud a sneeze would have to be to rattle a window. Then I gave the whole house a nose. It got away from me.
beats.chinese: 我在想，喷嚏得多响才能震得窗户响。然后就给整栋房子安了个鼻子。越想越离谱了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pockets the notebook and turns along the pavement, leaving the doorways clear.
beats.chinese: 她把本子放进口袋，转身沿人行道继续走，没有在住宅门前逗留。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I collect these questions for friends. Some of them have started refusing to answer. Anyway, I'll let you go. Bye.
beats.chinese: 我收集这些问题拿去问朋友。有几个人已经开始拒绝回答了。好啦，不耽误你了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sasha looks down at the closed notebook. Her grip loosens.
beats.chinese: Sasha低头看了看合上的本子，手松了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You did only ask about the notebook. Sorry. I jumped ahead by about six questions.
beats.chinese: 你确实只问了本子。对不起。我自己往后脑补了大概六个问题。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives a small, awkward smile and opens the notebook again without turning it towards you.
beats.chinese: 她有些尴尬地笑了笑，重新打开本子，没有把内容转给你看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave it there too. Have a good day.
beats.chinese: 那我也就不多说了。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sasha nods and slips the notebook into her hoodie pocket.
beats.chinese: Sasha点点头，把本子塞进连帽衫口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. Take care.
beats.chinese: 好。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a step along the pavement, then turns her head briefly before continuing her walk.
beats.chinese: 她沿人行道走了一步，短暂回过头，然后继续散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And sorry for the sharp answer.
beats.chinese: 还有，刚才语气太冲了，对不起。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Wale Street, Sasha closes her notebook on the public pavement beside the colourful houses. She recognises you and looks up.
beats.chinese: 在韦尔街，Sasha在彩色住宅旁的公共人行道上合上本子。她认出了你，抬起头来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello. I haven't thought of a single odd question worth writing down on this walk.
beats.chinese: 啊，你好。今天散步到现在，一个想记下来的怪问题都没想到。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the notebook into her hoodie pocket and leaves it there, looking along the street with a small, contented smile.
beats.chinese: 她把本子放进连帽衫口袋，不再拿出来想，望着街道，露出一丝满足的笑意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just walking today, then. That's nice too.
beats.chinese: 今天就只是走路。也挺好。

causality.presenceReason: Sasha下班后到韦尔街散步，停下来把一个荒诞假设记进随身本子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the public pavement beside Bo-Kaap's colourful houses on Wale Street, Zintle Mbeki is about to put her pencil away. She looks from her building sketch to the windows along the street, then towards you.
beats.chinese: 在波卡普 Wale Street 彩屋旁的公共人行道上，Zintle Mbeki 正准备收起铅笔。她看看建筑速写，又看看沿街的窗户，随后望向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One window left. You pick, I'll draw.
beats.chinese: 还差一扇窗。你挑，我画。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She has already turned the sketchbook towards you before she pauses for an answer. She keeps it close enough to leave the pavement clear.
beats.chinese: 她已经把速写本转向你，才停下来等答复。本子仍收在身前，没有挡住人行道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Zintle. Came for one building sketch before heading home. You up for choosing?
beats.chinese: 我叫 Zintle。本想回家前画一幅建筑速写。愿意帮我挑一扇吗？

choices.english: Sure, I'll choose one. Do you draw buildings often?
choices.chinese: 好，我来挑一扇。你经常画建筑吗？

choices.english: No thanks. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 不了，谢谢。我不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You point out a window, and Zintle marks its place in her sketch without moving into the walking route. The drawing follows the fronts of the houses.
beats.chinese: 你指出一扇窗，Zintle 在速写上标出它的位置，没有挪到行人通行的位置。纸上画的是沿街住宅的外立面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lunch breaks, mostly. I install and remove billboards around Cape Town. Buildings get most of my attention.
beats.chinese: 主要趁午休画。我在开普敦各处安装、拆卸广告牌。平时看的大多也是建筑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She flips to a blank page, draws a short line and offers the pencil, all before waiting for an answer.
beats.chinese: 她翻到空白页，划下一条短线，就把铅笔递了出来，根本没等你答应。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Your turn. One window. I've started the edge—no, wait, you might want a different one.
beats.chinese: 轮到你。画一扇窗。我把边起好了——不，等等，你可能想画另一扇。

choices.english: Let me choose. I'll draw one window, then give it back.
choices.chinese: 让我自己选。我画一扇窗，然后还给你。

choices.english: No drawing for me. I'll carry on.
choices.chinese: 我就不画了。我继续走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Zintle closes the sketchbook and puts the pencil away. Her phone lights up with a second message from her cousin.
beats.chinese: Zintle合上速写本，收好铅笔。手机亮起，是表亲的第二条消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. 'Keep the old colours.' Should have read that before I changed every one.
beats.chinese: 啊，“保留旧颜色”。真该在全改完之前读这句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens the restored game image on her phone, then checks that the untouched original is still saved beside it.
beats.chinese: 她打开手机里修复过的游戏图像，又确认未改动的原图还和它并存。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: First message asked me to repair it. I got enthusiastic. I still like my colours, mind.
beats.chinese: 第一条请我帮忙修。我一兴奋就动手了。不过我还是觉得自己的配色好。

choices.english: Have you told her about the new colours?
choices.chinese: 你告诉她换了新配色吗？

choices.english: Take care, Zintle.
choices.chinese: 保重，Zintle。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Zintle turns to a fresh part of the page and holds the book steady while you draw your chosen window.
beats.chinese: Zintle 把本子转到纸上空白的部分，稳稳托着，让你画自己选的那扇窗。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Your window. I'll keep my pencil opinions to myself.
beats.chinese: 行。你选的窗。我就不指挥你的铅笔了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: When you return the pencil, she briefly raises it towards the drawing, then puts it into her bag without adding anything. She closes the book.
beats.chinese: 你还回铅笔时，她下意识把笔抬向画面，又没添一笔就收进包里，合上本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nearly added a sill. You said one window, and there it is. Thanks for joining in. Cheers.
beats.chinese: 差点又给它添个窗台。你说画一扇窗，这就画好了。谢谢你一起画。回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Zintle draws the offered pencil back and turns the book towards herself. Your route along the pavement stays clear.
beats.chinese: Zintle 收回递出的铅笔，把本子转回自己面前。你沿人行道前行的路一直空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Okay. I handed you a turn before you asked for one.
beats.chinese: 好。你都没说想画，我就给你安排上了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you carry on, she returns to her original drawing and adds a short line at its edge.
beats.chinese: 你继续往前走，她翻回原来的画，在边缘添了一条短线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. I'll finish this bit myself.
beats.chinese: 回见。这一点我自己画完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Zintle reads the second message again, then selects both image files.
beats.chinese: Zintle又读一遍第二条消息，选中两个图像文件。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Not yet. She asked for the damaged bits repaired, the old palette kept. Mine's more cheerful. That's not what she asked, though.
beats.chinese: 还没有。她要修坏掉的部分，保留原配色。我这版更活泼，不过她要的不是这个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sends the original and her changed version, explaining the difference. Then she puts the phone away.
beats.chinese: 她发去原图和自己改过的版本，说明区别，然后收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She can choose. I'll do the old colours if she wants. No answer yet. Anyway, home for me. Cheers.
beats.chinese: 让她选。要旧配色，我再做。还没回复呢。好了，我回家去。回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Zintle keeps both versions saved and puts the phone in her bag beside the closed sketchbook.
beats.chinese: Zintle把两个版本都留好，手机放进包里，挨着合好的速写本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. I'll answer her when I get home.
beats.chinese: 你也是。回家再给她答复。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the pavement. She secures her bag and turns in the other direction.
beats.chinese: 你沿人行道前行。她收好包，转向另一边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Should read all the messages first. Apparently that's part of the job. Cheers.
beats.chinese: 得先把消息全读完。看来这也算工序。回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later outing along Wale Street, you encounter Zintle beside the colourful houses again. She has stopped on the public pavement to free her jacket cuff from its zip.
beats.chinese: 在 Wale Street 走动时，你又在彩屋旁遇见 Zintle。她停在公共人行道上，正把夹进拉链里的外套袖口弄出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey, I recognise you. Caught my own sleeve. Very efficient way to lose a hand.
beats.chinese: 嘿，认得你。把自己的袖子夹住了。这样腾不出手，倒是挺有效率。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She eases the zip down, pulls the cloth free and flexes her released wrist with an exaggerated flourish.
beats.chinese: 她慢慢拉下拉链，抽出布料，夸张地转了一圈终于解放的手腕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I only came out for a short walk. Better keep both arms available. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 好了。我就是出来走一小段。还是把两只胳膊都留着用吧。见到你真好。

causality.presenceReason: 她在用户出现前已来 Wale Street 画建筑，打算完成一幅速写后回家。
causality.placeAttitude: 彩屋的建筑外立面吸引她来画画，她把这里当作有人生活的街道，始终留在公共人行道。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有工作值守或必须久留的义务，停留限于这次短暂速写，收好本子即可离开。

causality.currentState: 下班后的兴致尚足，动作和说话都快，愿意搭话，也容易先安排别人参与再等答复。
causality.contactTrigger: 她准备收笔时直接向附近的用户说还差一扇窗，请用户挑、自己画，已经转过本子才补问对方是否愿意。没有掉落物品，也没有默认用户同意。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beside the colourful homes on Wale Street in Bo-Kaap, Anele Nkosi is checking notes from a film she watched. She came to look at its supposed chase location. She looks up from her notebook at you.
beats.chinese: 在波卡普的 Wale Street 彩色住宅旁，Anele Nkosi 正核对看电影时记下的笔记。她特意来看看片中据说拍过追逐戏的地方。她从笔记本上抬起头，望向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me, this is Wale Street, isn't it? I'd like to check the name I heard in the film before I blame the editing.
beats.chinese: 打扰一下，这条街是 Wale Street，对吗？我想先核实电影里听到的街名，再怪剪辑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Anele waits briefly for an answer, keeping the notebook facing herself and leaving the path clear.
beats.chinese: Anele 稍等片刻，笔记本仍朝着自己，也留出了通行的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Anele. I came to check one turn in a film chase. I've changed my mind twice already.
beats.chinese: 我叫 Anele。我是来核对电影追逐戏里的一个转弯的。到现在已经改了两次主意了。

choices.english: What happens in the chase?
choices.chinese: 那场追逐戏讲了什么？

choices.english: I'll leave you to your checking.
choices.chinese: 那我就不打扰你核对了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Anele opens the notebook just wide enough to expose a rough route and several crossed-out arrows.
beats.chinese: Anele 把笔记本打开一点，露出一条粗略的路线和几处被划掉的箭头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A woman runs off with a bag. She turns left here, then right—no, wait, I've drawn that backwards. The next shot puts her somewhere else entirely.
beats.chinese: 一个女人拿着包跑了。她在这里左转，再右转——不，等等，我画反了。下一个镜头里，她已经到了完全不同的地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her finger follows an arrow, stops, then retraces it. She starts turning to another page before looking up at you.
beats.chinese: 她的手指顺着箭头移动，停住，又倒着划回来。她正要翻到另一页，才抬头看你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I mount antique maps for framing at a conservation workshop. Apparently a whole day looking at roads isn't enough for me.
beats.chinese: 我在一家文物修复工作室给古地图做装框前的装裱。看来整天看那些路，我还没看够。

choices.english: I meant the story. Does she get away?
choices.chinese: 我想问的是剧情。她逃掉了吗？

choices.english: Show me the turn on your page.
choices.chinese: 给我看看你纸上画的那个转弯吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Anele closes the notebook without trying to show you the page.
beats.chinese: Anele 合上笔记本，没有再把那页纸展示给你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll check the street name myself.
beats.chinese: 当然。街名我自己再核实一下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She secures the notebook under her arm and looks along Wale Street.
beats.chinese: 她把笔记本夹在臂下，望向 Wale Street。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got a little walking left before I head home.
beats.chinese: 回家之前，我还想再走一小段。

choices.english: Enjoy your walk. I'll carry on.
choices.chinese: 祝你散步愉快。我继续走了。

choices.english: Would you like company for a short walk?
choices.chinese: 要不要一起走一小段？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Anele takes her finger off the route and shuts the notebook.
beats.chinese: Anele 把手指从路线上移开，合上笔记本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, she gets away. Then she opens the bag and finds somebody's lunch. I'd have been furious.
beats.chinese: 逃掉了。然后她打开包，发现里面是别人的午饭。换成我可要气坏了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She laughs, tucks the notebook under her arm, and turns her attention back to the street.
beats.chinese: 她笑起来，把笔记本夹到臂下，重新望向街道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Anyway, that's the chase. Enjoy your day. I'm going to have one more look here.
beats.chinese: 总之，追逐戏就是这样。祝你今天愉快。我还要在这里再看一眼。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Anele angles the notebook towards you. Two arrows on the same stretch point in opposite directions.
beats.chinese: Anele 把笔记本朝你倾过来。同一段路上，两个箭头指着相反的方向。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This is the turn. And this arrow is my correction. Unfortunately, I didn't cross out the first one.
beats.chinese: 就是这个转弯。这个箭头是后来改的。可惜，我忘了把原来的划掉。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She studies both arrows, then closes the notebook and takes a few slow steps along the public pavement.
beats.chinese: 她盯着两个箭头看了看，随后合上笔记本，沿公共人行道缓缓走了几步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll watch that bit again before I blame the editor. Thanks for the chat. I'll leave you to your day.
beats.chinese: 怪剪辑师之前，我得把那段再看一遍。谢谢你陪我聊聊。我不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the pavement. Anele stays where she is, with the notebook tucked securely under her arm.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿人行道前行。Anele 留在原处，把笔记本稳稳夹在臂下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Enjoy the rest of your day.
beats.chinese: 你也是。祝你接下来过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives a small wave, then opens the notebook again and looks from her notes to the street.
beats.chinese: 她轻轻挥手，然后重新打开笔记本，对照着笔记看向街道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now, did she turn left or right?
beats.chinese: 那么，她当时是左转还是右转？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Anele meets your offer with a small smile, keeping the notebook under her arm.
beats.chinese: 听到你的提议，Anele 微微一笑，笔记本仍夹在臂下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you, but I'd like to walk by myself today.
beats.chinese: 谢谢，不过今天我想自己走走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns to continue along the same public pavement, leaving room for other people to pass.
beats.chinese: 她转身，准备沿同一条公共人行道继续走，也给其他行人留出通行的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I want to stop and double back whenever I feel like it. Enjoy the rest of your day.
beats.chinese: 我想什么时候停下、什么时候折回几步，就随自己。祝你接下来过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing on Wale Street in Bo-Kaap, Anele is standing on the public pavement beside the colourful homes. She is putting a small packet of biscuits into her bag when she recognises you.
beats.chinese: 在波卡普的 Wale Street ，Anele 正站在彩色住宅旁的公共人行道上，把一小包饼干放进包里。她认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I'm seeing a film later. I came out early for a walk.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我晚些时候要看电影，提前出来走走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the notebook she has been carrying, smiling at the thought of the film. Today, she is leaving the route research until afterwards.
beats.chinese: 想到待会儿的电影，她带着期待的笑容合上随身笔记本。今天，她打算看完以后再研究路线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Let me enjoy it once first. I'll think about the streets after the credits.
beats.chinese: 先让我好好看一遍。街道的事，散场以后再想。

causality.presenceReason: Anele 看过一部电影，带着手写笔记来到 Wale Street，想实地核对追逐戏中的一个转弯。

causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留下的外部义务。她尚未核实电影中的街名与转弯，想在回家前再看一会儿、走一小段。
causality.currentGoal: 先核实这里是否就是电影里听到的 Wale Street，再对照街道与自己的路线笔记，判断追逐戏中的转弯是否接得上，不急着归咎于剪辑。

causality.contactTrigger: Anele 自己看着笔记，主动向玩家询问这条街是否叫 Wale Street。这是范围有限的事实询问，不要求玩家认识路线、读图或辨认笔迹。她短暂等待回答，随后介绍姓名，并说明自己来看追逐戏中的转弯。文本不预设玩家已经确认街名，也不预设玩家答应帮忙。
